`mcp/src/vinput.ts`:

```ts
// Thin, explicit wrapper around the vinput CLI. Every call returns the CLI's own JSON reply; nothing is swallowed.
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { existsSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join, resolve } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

export interface CliResult {
  /** true only when vinput replied "ok":true (or a JSON array, for `list`) AND exited with code 0 */
  ok: boolean;
  /** the parsed JSON reply (object or array), or an error object built here when there was none */
  json: unknown;
  exitCode: number | null;
  stderr: string;
  timedOut: boolean;
  argv: string[];
}

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

/** vinput.exe: $VINPUT_EXE, else <repo>/dist/vinput.exe (this file lives in <repo>/mcp/build). */
export function resolveVinputExe(): string {
  const env = process.env.VINPUT_EXE;
  if (env && env.trim()) return resolve(env.trim());
  return resolve(here, "..", "..", "dist", "vinput.exe");
}

/** Folder for captures when the caller gives no path: $VINPUT_CAPTURE_DIR, else <repo>/captures. */
export function captureDir(): string {
  const env = process.env.VINPUT_CAPTURE_DIR;
  const dir = env && env.trim() ? resolve(env.trim()) : resolve(dirname(resolveVinputExe()), "..", "captures");
  if (!existsSync(dir)) mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  return dir;
}

export function defaultCapturePath(pid: number): string {
  const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, "").replace(/\..*$/, "").replace("T", "_");
  return join(captureDir(), `pid${pid}_${stamp}_${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e6)}.png`);
}

/** Last stdout line that parses as JSON (vinput prints exactly one JSON reply line; progress goes to stderr). */
function lastJson(stdout: string): unknown {
  const lines = stdout.split(/\r?\n/).map((l) => l.trim()).filter((l) => l.startsWith("{") || l.startsWith("["));
  for (let i = lines.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    try { return JSON.parse(lines[i]); } catch { /* try the previous line */ }
  }
  return undefined;
}

export async function runVinput(args: string[], timeoutMs: number): Promise<CliResult> {
  const exe = resolveVinputExe();
  const argv = ["--json", ...args];
  if (!existsSync(exe)) {
    return { ok: false, json: { ok: false, error: `vinput.exe not found at ${exe}. Build it (build.bat) or set VINPUT_EXE.` }, exitCode: null, stderr: "", timedOut: false, argv };
  }
  return await new Promise<CliResult>((resolvePromise) => {
    const child = spawn(exe, argv, { windowsHide: true, stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"] });
    let stdout = "", stderr = "", timedOut = false, settled = false;
    child.stdout.setEncoding("utf8"); child.stderr.setEncoding("utf8");
    child.stdout.on("data", (d: string) => { stdout += d; });
    child.stderr.on("data", (d: string) => { if (stderr.length < 64 * 1024) stderr += d; });
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { timedOut = true; child.kill(); }, timeoutMs);
    const finish = (exitCode: number | null, spawnError?: Error) => {
      if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer);
      let json = lastJson(stdout);
      let ok = false;
      if (spawnError) json = { ok: false, error: `cannot start vinput.exe: ${spawnError.message}` };
      else if (timedOut) json = { ok: false, error: `vinput did not answer within ${timeoutMs} ms (process killed)`, partial_reply: json ?? null };
      else if (json === undefined) json = { ok: false, error: `vinput exited with code ${exitCode} and printed no JSON`, stdout: stdout.slice(-2000) };
      else if (Array.isArray(json)) ok = exitCode === 0;
      else ok = (json as { ok?: unknown }).ok === true && exitCode === 0;
      resolvePromise({ ok, json, exitCode, stderr: stderr.trim(), timedOut, argv });
    };
    child.on("error", (e) => finish(null, e));
    child.on("close", (code) => finish(code));
  });
}

```

`mcp/test/handshake.mjs`:

```mjs
// MCP handshake test: start the BUILT server over stdio, initialize, tools/list, and check every tool has a schema
// and a description. Needs no game and no vinput binaries. Exit 0 = PASS.
import { Client } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/index.js";
import { StdioClientTransport } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/stdio.js";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { dirname, resolve } from "node:path";

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const server = resolve(here, "..", "build", "index.js");
const expected = ["launch", "attach", "list_targets", "status", "capture", "ocr", "find_text", "click_text", "wait_text",
  "find_image", "click_image", "wait_image", "pixel", "wait_change", "click", "move", "move_relative", "drag", "scroll",
  "key", "key_down", "key_up", "type_text", "pad", "list_keys", "run_script", "release", "detach"];

const transport = new StdioClientTransport({ command: process.execPath, args: [server], stderr: "pipe" });
let stderr = "";
transport.stderr?.on("data", (d) => { stderr += d; });
const client = new Client({ name: "handshake-test", version: "1.0.0" });
let failures = 0;
const check = (cond, what) => { console.log(`${cond ? "PASS" : "FAIL"} ${what}`); if (!cond) failures++; };
try {
  await client.connect(transport);
  const info = client.getServerVersion();
  check(info?.name === "llm-game-automation-mcp", `initialize: server name ${info?.name} ${info?.version}`);
  check(typeof client.getInstructions() === "string" && client.getInstructions().length > 50, "initialize: server instructions present");
  const { tools } = await client.listTools();
  const names = tools.map((t) => t.name);
  console.log(`tools/list: ${names.length} tools: ${names.join(", ")}`);
  for (const n of expected) check(names.includes(n), `tool ${n} listed`);
  for (const t of tools) {
    check(typeof t.description === "string" && t.description.length >= 30, `tool ${t.name} has a description`);
    check(t.inputSchema?.type === "object", `tool ${t.name} has an object input schema`);
  }
  const launch = tools.find((t) => t.name === "launch");
  check(!!launch?.inputSchema?.properties?.exe && !!launch?.inputSchema?.properties?.early, "launch schema exposes exe and early");
  const click = tools.find((t) => t.name === "click");
  check((click?.inputSchema?.required ?? []).includes("pid"), "click schema requires pid");
  // an argument error must come back as an explicit error, not silently
  const bad = await client.callTool({ name: "launch", arguments: {} });
  check(bad.isError === true && JSON.parse(bad.content[0].text).ok === false, "launch with no target returns isError + ok:false");
} catch (e) {
  failures++; console.log(`FAIL exception: ${e.stack ?? e}`); console.log(stderr);
} finally {
  await client.close().catch(() => {});
}
console.log(failures ? `handshake: FAIL (${failures})` : "handshake: PASS");
process.exit(failures ? 1 : 0);

```

`mcp/test/smoke.mjs`:

```mjs
// Live end-to-end smoke test THROUGH MCP against the synthetic menu target (test/vi_uitarget.cpp, built by build.bat).
// launch -> capture (image) -> wait_text -> ocr -> find_text -> key -> click_text -> wait_text -> type_text -> capture ->
// release -> detach, then the anti-cheat refusal through attach. The target logs every key/click, so each action is
// checked in the target's own log, not only in vinput's reply. Processes started here are stopped by PID.
import { Client } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/index.js";
import { StdioClientTransport } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/stdio.js";
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, resolve } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const repo = resolve(here, "..", "..");
const dist = resolve(repo, "dist");
const out = resolve(repo, "build", "test", "mcp_smoke");
mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
const log = resolve(out, "uitarget.log"); rmSync(log, { force: true });
for (const f of ["vinput.exe", "vinput64.dll", "vi_uitarget.exe", "vi_actarget.exe", "acdummy/x64/EasyAntiCheat_x64.dll"])
  if (!existsSync(resolve(dist, f))) { console.log(`FAIL missing dist/${f}: run build.bat first`); process.exit(1); }

const transport = new StdioClientTransport({
  command: process.execPath, args: [resolve(here, "..", "build", "index.js")], stderr: "pipe",
  env: { ...process.env, VINPUT_EXE: resolve(dist, "vinput.exe"), VINPUT_CAPTURE_DIR: out, VINPUT_OWNER: "mcp-smoke" },
});
let serverErr = ""; transport.stderr?.on("data", (d) => { serverErr += d; });
const client = new Client({ name: "smoke-test", version: "1.0.0" });
let failures = 0; const owned = [];
const check = (cond, what, detail = "") => { console.log(`${cond ? "PASS" : "FAIL"} ${what}${!cond && detail ? " :: " + detail : ""}`); if (!cond) failures++; return cond; };
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
async function call(name, args) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const r = await client.callTool({ name, arguments: args }, undefined, { timeout: 600000 });
  const text = r.content.find((c) => c.type === "text")?.text ?? "";
  let json = null; try { json = JSON.parse(text); } catch { /* reported below */ }
  const image = r.content.find((c) => c.type === "image");
  console.log(`  ${name} ${JSON.stringify(args).slice(0, 120)} -> isError=${!!r.isError} ${Date.now() - t0} ms ${text.slice(0, 200)}`);
  return { r, json, image, text };
}
const targetLog = () => (existsSync(log) ? readFileSync(log, "utf8") : "");

try {
  await client.connect(transport);
  // 1. launch the synthetic menu target through MCP
  const L = await call("launch", { exe: resolve(dist, "vi_uitarget.exe"), args: `"${log}" -28000 600 --load-ms 300`,
    settle_s: 1, timeout_s: 30, lock: resolve(out, "launch.lock"), claim: true });
  const pid = L.json?.pid;
  if (pid) owned.push(pid);
  check(!L.r.isError && L.json?.ok === true && L.json?.injected === true && pid > 0, "launch: injected, pid returned", L.text);
  check(L.json?.foreground_restored === true, "launch: the real foreground was handed back", L.text);
  if (!pid) throw new Error("no pid");

  // 2. look
  const C1 = await call("capture", { pid, after_frames: 3 });
  check(!C1.r.isError && C1.json?.w === 800 && C1.json?.h === 450, "capture: 800x450 frame", C1.text);
  check(C1.image?.mimeType === "image/png" && C1.image.data.startsWith("iVBORw0KGgo"), "capture: PNG returned as MCP image content");
  check(existsSync(C1.json?.path ?? ""), "capture: PNG saved at the reported path");
  const W1 = await call("wait_text", { pid, text: "PLAY", timeout_ms: 10000 });
  check(!W1.r.isError && W1.json?.ok === true, "wait_text PLAY: main menu is up", W1.text);
  const O = await call("ocr", { pid });
  check(!O.r.isError && Array.isArray(O.json?.lines) && O.json.lines.some((l) => /PLAY/i.test(l.text)), "ocr: lines include PLAY", O.text.slice(0, 300));
  const F = await call("find_text", { pid, text: "OPTIONS" });
  check(!F.r.isError && F.json?.ok === true && F.json?.dry_run !== false, "find_text OPTIONS: found without clicking", F.text);

  // 3. act + verify in the target's own log
  const K = await call("key", { pid, key: "a" });
  await sleep(300);
  check(!K.r.isError && /CHAR U\+0061/i.test(targetLog()), "key a: target received WM_CHAR 'a'", K.text);
  const CT = await call("click_text", { pid, text: "PLAY" });
  check(!CT.r.isError && CT.json?.ok === true, "click_text PLAY: clicked", CT.text);
  const W2 = await call("wait_text", { pid, text: "Select a game type", timeout_ms: 8000 });
  check(!W2.r.isError && /CLICK \d+ \d+ PLAY/.test(targetLog()), "wait_text: SELECT screen reached, target logged a click on PLAY", W2.text);
  const T = await call("type_text", { pid, text: "hi" });
  await sleep(300);
  check(!T.r.isError && /CHAR U\+0068/i.test(targetLog()) && /CHAR U\+0069/i.test(targetLog()), "type_text hi: target received 'h' and 'i'", T.text);
  const C2 = await call("capture", { pid, include_image: false, region: { x: 0, y: 0, w: 400, h: 200 } });
  check(!C2.r.isError && C2.json?.w === 400 && !C2.image, "capture region without image", C2.text);
  const S = await call("status", { pid });
  check(!S.r.isError && S.json?.really_foreground === false, "status: the game stayed in the background", S.text.slice(0, 300));

  // 4. explicit errors
  const E1 = await call("click_text", { pid, text: "NO SUCH BUTTON", timeout_ms: 500 });
  check(E1.r.isError === true && E1.json?.ok === false, "click_text missing text: isError + ok:false");
  const E2 = await call("status", { pid: 999999 });
  check(E2.r.isError === true && E2.json?.ok === false, "status on a pid without vinput: isError + ok:false", E2.text);

  // 5. release / detach
  const R = await call("release", { pid });
  check(!R.r.isError, "release", R.text);
  const D = await call("detach", { pid });
  check(!D.r.isError && D.json?.unclaim?.ok === true, "detach: input released and claim dropped", D.text);

  // 6. anti-cheat refusal through MCP: a target holding a module NAMED like EasyAntiCheat (an empty dummy DLL)
  const acLog = resolve(out, "actarget.log");
  const ac = spawn(resolve(dist, "vi_actarget.exe"), [acLog, "--load", resolve(dist, "acdummy", "x64", "EasyAntiCheat_x64.dll")], { windowsHide: true, stdio: "ignore" });
  owned.push(ac.pid);
  for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !(existsSync(acLog) && readFileSync(acLog, "utf8").includes("WINDOW ready")); i++) await sleep(100);
  const A = await call("attach", { pid: ac.pid });
  check(A.r.isError === true && A.json?.anticheat_refused === true && A.json?.anticheat?.product === "EasyAntiCheat", "attach to an anti-cheat target: refused through MCP", A.text);
} catch (e) {
  failures++; console.log(`FAIL exception: ${e.stack ?? e}`);
} finally {
  await client.close().catch(() => {});
  for (const p of owned) { try { process.kill(p); console.log(`stopped owned pid ${p}`); } catch { /* already gone */ } }
}
if (failures) console.log(`server stderr:\n${serverErr}`);
console.log(failures ? `smoke: FAIL (${failures})` : "smoke: PASS");
process.exit(failures ? 1 : 0);

```

`mcp/tsconfig.json`:

```json
{
```

```h
// vi_acguard.h - anti-cheat refusal (defence in depth, NOT a guarantee).
//
// vinput is for single-player / offline games. Before it injects anything it refuses - with a clear error and NO
// override flag - when any of these is true:
//   1. the target process has a module loaded whose name belongs to a known anti-cheat (EasyAntiCheat, BattlEye, ...);
//   2. the target's executable folder (or up to 3 parent folders, never a drive root) contains a known anti-cheat
//      component (e.g. an "EasyAntiCheat" or "BattlEye" folder, start_protected_game.exe) - this catches a protected
//      game BEFORE its anti-cheat has loaded, e.g. `launch --early`;
//   3. a known anti-cheat process is running, or a known anti-cheat service / kernel driver is active, anywhere on
//      the machine (kernel anti-cheats watch the whole system, not one game).
// The injected DLL repeats check 1 at start-up and keeps watching: if an anti-cheat module is loaded into the game
// after injection, every input/capture command is refused from then on.
//
// The lists below are best-effort and name-based. A renamed, new or unlisted anti-cheat is NOT detected. Never rely
// on this check to decide whether a game is safe to automate: read DISCLAIMER.md.
#pragma once
#include <windows.h>
#include <wchar.h>

namespace vi_ac {

struct Entry { const char* product; const wchar_t* name; bool prefix; };

inline const char* MatchIn(const Entry* list, size_t n, const wchar_t* name, size_t len) {
    if (!name) return nullptr;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        size_t wl = wcslen(list[i].name);
        if (list[i].prefix ? (len >= wl && !_wcsnicmp(name, list[i].name, wl)) : (len == wl && !_wcsnicmp(name, list[i].name, wl)))
            return list[i].product;
    }
    return nullptr;
}
inline const char* MatchModule(const wchar_t* baseName, size_t len) { size_t n; const Entry* k = ModuleList(n); return MatchIn(k, n, baseName, len); }
inline const char* MatchModule(const wchar_t* baseName) { return baseName ? MatchModule(baseName, wcslen(baseName)) : nullptr; }

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CLI-side scan (process / service / folder). Not compiled into the injected DLL.
// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#ifdef VI_ACGUARD_SCANNER
#include <tlhelp32.h>
#include <string>
#pragma comment(lib, "advapi32.lib")

namespace vi_ac {

struct Finding { bool refused = false; bool modulesChecked = false; std::string product, kind, name, error; };

inline std::string Narrow(const std::wstring& w) {
    if (w.empty()) return {};
    int n = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, w.c_str(), (int)w.size(), nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
    std::string s(n, '\0'); WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, w.c_str(), (int)w.size(), &s[0], n, nullptr, nullptr); return s;
}
inline bool Hit(Finding& f, const char* product, const char* kind, const std::wstring& name) {
    if (!product) return false;
    f.refused = true; f.product = product; f.kind = kind; f.name = Narrow(name); return true;
}

// 1. modules loaded in the target. suspendedOk: the caller created the process suspended, so an empty / partial
//    module list (loader not initialised yet) is expected; otherwise an unreadable module list is itself a refusal.
inline bool ScanModules(DWORD pid, bool suspendedOk, Finding& f) {
    HANDLE snap = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    DWORD err = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPMODULE | TH32CS_SNAPMODULE32, pid);
        if (snap != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) break;
        err = GetLastError();
        if (err != ERROR_BAD_LENGTH && err != ERROR_PARTIAL_COPY) break;
        if (err == ERROR_PARTIAL_COPY && suspendedOk) break;
        Sleep(25);
    }
    if (snap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        if (suspendedOk) return false;   // folder + system checks still apply
        f.refused = true; f.kind = "unverifiable"; f.product = "unknown";
        f.error = "cannot list the target's modules (win32=" + std::to_string(err) + "); refusing because an anti-cheat cannot be ruled out";
        return true;
    }
    MODULEENTRY32W me = {sizeof(me)};
    bool any = false;
    for (BOOL ok = Module32FirstW(snap, &me); ok; ok = Module32NextW(snap, &me)) {
        any = true;
        if (Hit(f, MatchModule(me.szModule), "module", me.szModule)) { CloseHandle(snap); f.modulesChecked = true; return true; }
    }
    CloseHandle(snap);
    f.modulesChecked = any;
    return false;
}

// 2. anti-cheat components next to the game executable (folder and up to 3 parents, never a drive root).
inline bool ScanFolders(const std::wstring& imagePath, Finding& f) {
    if (imagePath.empty()) return false;
    wchar_t full[MAX_PATH * 2] = {0};
    if (!GetFullPathNameW(imagePath.c_str(), MAX_PATH * 2, full, nullptr)) return false;
    std::wstring dir = full;
    size_t n; const Entry* k = FolderMarkerList(n);
    for (int level = 0; level < 4; level++) {
        size_t sl = dir.find_last_of(L"\\/");
        if (sl == std::wstring::npos) return false;
        dir = dir.substr(0, sl);
        if (dir.size() <= 3 || dir.find_last_of(L"\\/") == std::wstring::npos) return false;   // "C:" or "C:\"
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            std::wstring p = dir + L"\\" + k[i].name;
            if (GetFileAttributesW(p.c_str()) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) return Hit(f, k[i].product, "game_folder", p);
        }
    }
    return false;
}

// 3. anti-cheat processes and active services / kernel drivers anywhere on the machine.
inline bool ScanSystem(Finding& f) {
    size_t n; const Entry* k = ProcessList(n);
    HANDLE snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
    if (snap != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        PROCESSENTRY32W pe = {sizeof(pe)};
        for (BOOL ok = Process32FirstW(snap, &pe); ok; ok = Process32NextW(snap, &pe))
            if (Hit(f, MatchIn(k, n, pe.szExeFile, wcslen(pe.szExeFile)), "process", pe.szExeFile)) { CloseHandle(snap); return true; }
        CloseHandle(snap);
    }
    k = ServiceList(n);
    SC_HANDLE scm = OpenSCManagerW(nullptr, nullptr, SC_MANAGER_ENUMERATE_SERVICE);
    if (!scm) return false;
    DWORD need = 0, count = 0, resume = 0;
    EnumServicesStatusExW(scm, SC_ENUM_PROCESS_INFO, SERVICE_DRIVER | SERVICE_WIN32, SERVICE_ACTIVE, nullptr, 0, &need, &count, &resume, nullptr);
    std::string buf(need + 4096, '\0'); resume = 0;
    bool found = false;
    if (EnumServicesStatusExW(scm, SC_ENUM_PROCESS_INFO, SERVICE_DRIVER | SERVICE_WIN32, SERVICE_ACTIVE, (LPBYTE)&buf[0], (DWORD)buf.size(), &need, &count, &resume, nullptr)) {
        auto* s = (ENUM_SERVICE_STATUS_PROCESSW*)&buf[0];
        for (DWORD i = 0; i < count && !found; i++) {
            const wchar_t* sn = s[i].lpServiceName; const wchar_t* dn = s[i].lpDisplayName;
            found = Hit(f, MatchIn(k, n, sn, sn ? wcslen(sn) : 0), "service", sn ? sn : L"") ||
                    Hit(f, MatchIn(k, n, dn, dn ? wcslen(dn) : 0), "service", dn ? dn : L"");
        }
    }
    CloseServiceHandle(scm);
    return found;
}

inline std::wstring ImagePathOf(DWORD pid) {
    std::wstring path;
    HANDLE h = OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, FALSE, pid);
    if (!h) return path;
    wchar_t buf[MAX_PATH * 2]; DWORD len = MAX_PATH * 2;
    if (QueryFullProcessImageNameW(h, 0, buf, &len)) path.assign(buf, len);
    CloseHandle(h); return path;
}

// Full check before injecting into a running (or freshly created suspended) process.
inline Finding CheckTarget(DWORD pid, bool suspendedOk) {
    Finding f;
    if (ScanSystem(f)) return f;
    if (ScanFolders(ImagePathOf(pid), f)) return f;
    ScanModules(pid, suspendedOk, f);
    return f;
}
// Check before starting an executable (launch --exe): machine-wide + folder only.
inline Finding CheckExe(const std::wstring& exe) {
    Finding f;
    if (ScanSystem(f)) return f;
    ScanFolders(exe, f);
    return f;
}

}  // namespace vi_ac
#endif
```

`src/vi_cap12.h`:

```h
// vi_cap12.h - native D3D12 back-buffer capture for vinput. Included INSIDE vinput_core.cpp's anonymous
// namespace (uses Log, ConvertRow, Typed, g_capPix/W/H/Err, HookAddr).
//
// Flow (game thread, inside the Present hook, only when a capture is requested):
//   queue  = a DIRECT queue seen by our ExecuteCommandLists hook on the back buffer's device, preferring the
//            presenting thread (installed by the monitor thread on the first D3D12 frame). The cheaper
//            swapchain->GetDevice(ID3D12CommandQueue) is tried first but FAILS on flip-model swapchains (MEASURED).
//   record = barrier PRESENT->COPY_SOURCE, CopyTextureRegion(back buffer[GetCurrentBackBufferIndex]) -> our
//            READBACK buffer, barrier back to PRESENT; ExecuteCommandLists on the game's queue; Signal(our fence)
//   NO wait on the game thread: the requester thread waits on the fence, maps and converts.
// The game is never stalled; it only pays for recording one copy. We never hold a back-buffer reference
// past the Present hook, so ResizeBuffers is never blocked; our objects are released on ResizeBuffers,
// on device removal and whenever the game's device changes.

std::mutex g_c12Mx;
struct Cap12 {
    ID3D12Device* dev = nullptr;
    ID3D12CommandAllocator* alloc = nullptr;
    ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* list = nullptr;
    ID3D12Fence* fence = nullptr;
    UINT64 fenceVal = 0;
    ID3D12Resource* rb = nullptr; UINT64 rbSize = 0;
    bool pending = false; UINT64 waitVal = 0;
    UINT w = 0, h = 0; DXGI_FORMAT fmt = DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN; D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT fp{};
    bool stale = false;          // release once the in-flight readback is done (resize / device change)
    long releases = 0, leaks = 0, submits = 0;
} g_c12;

// The swapchain does NOT hand out its queue (GetDevice(ID3D12CommandQueue) fails on a flip-model D3D12 swapchain,
// MEASURED 2026-11-02), so the queue comes from an ExecuteCommandLists hook, installed by the monitor thread as soon
// as a D3D12 frame is seen. We keep the DIRECT queues seen (AddRef'd, at most 8) with the thread and time of their
// last submission, and pick the one on the back buffer's device, preferring the presenting thread, then the latest.
using PFN_ECL = void(STDMETHODCALLTYPE*)(ID3D12CommandQueue*, UINT, ID3D12CommandList* const*);
PFN_ECL o_ExecuteCommandLists = nullptr;
struct EclQ { ID3D12CommandQueue* q; DWORD tid; DWORD tick; };
std::mutex g_eclMx;
EclQ g_eclQs[8] = {}; int g_eclN = 0;
std::atomic<bool> g_eclWanted{false}, g_eclInstalled{false};
std::atomic<int> g_c12QueueSource{0};                    // 1 = swapchain GetDevice, 2 = ExecuteCommandLists hook
thread_local bool t_ourEcl = false;
void STDMETHODCALLTYPE h_ExecuteCommandLists(ID3D12CommandQueue* q, UINT n, ID3D12CommandList* const* lists) {
    if (!t_ourEcl && q) {
        DWORD tid = GetCurrentThreadId(), now = GetTickCount();
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lk(g_eclMx, std::try_to_lock);   // never make the game wait on us
        if (lk.owns_lock()) {
            int i = 0;
            for (; i < g_eclN; i++) if (g_eclQs[i].q == q) { g_eclQs[i].tid = tid; g_eclQs[i].tick = now; break; }
            if (i == g_eclN && g_eclN < 8) {
                D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_DESC d = q->GetDesc();
                if (d.Type == D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT) { q->AddRef(); g_eclQs[g_eclN++] = {q, tid, now}; }
            }
        }
    }
    o_ExecuteCommandLists(q, n, lists);
}

// Releases our objects. Caller holds g_c12Mx. If a readback is still on the GPU we wait (bounded); if the
// GPU never finishes we LEAK instead of releasing something in use (releasing it would remove the device).
void Release12Locked(const char* why) {
    if (g_c12.pending && g_c12.fence) {
        if (g_c12.fence->GetCompletedValue() < g_c12.waitVal) {
            HANDLE ev = CreateEventW(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr);
            if (ev && SUCCEEDED(g_c12.fence->SetEventOnCompletion(g_c12.waitVal, ev))) WaitForSingleObject(ev, 1000);
            if (ev) CloseHandle(ev);
        }
        UINT64 done = g_c12.fence->GetCompletedValue();
        if (done != UINT64_MAX && done < g_c12.waitVal) {
            long rel = g_c12.releases, lk = g_c12.leaks + 1, sb = g_c12.submits;
            Log("d3d12 capture: release (%s) while readback still in flight -> leaking our objects instead", why);
            g_c12 = Cap12{};
            g_c12.releases = rel; g_c12.leaks = lk; g_c12.submits = sb;
            return;
        }
    }
    long rel = g_c12.releases + 1, lk = g_c12.leaks, sb = g_c12.submits;
    if (g_c12.rb) g_c12.rb->Release();
    if (g_c12.list) g_c12.list->Release();
    if (g_c12.alloc) g_c12.alloc->Release();
    if (g_c12.fence) g_c12.fence->Release();
    if (g_c12.dev) g_c12.dev->Release();
    bool had = g_c12.dev != nullptr;
    g_c12 = Cap12{};
    g_c12.releases = had ? rel : rel - 1; g_c12.leaks = lk; g_c12.submits = sb;
    if (had) Log("d3d12 capture: released our objects (%s)", why);
}
// Called from the ResizeBuffers hooks and on device removal. Never blocks the game behind a requester.
void Drop12(const char* why) {
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lk(g_c12Mx, std::try_to_lock);
    if (!lk.owns_lock()) { g_c12.stale = true; return; }   // a requester is mapping: it releases when done
    if (g_c12.dev) Release12Locked(why);
}

ID3D12CommandQueue* QueueFor12(IDXGISwapChain* sc, ID3D12Device* bbDev) {
    ID3D12CommandQueue* q = nullptr;
    if (SUCCEEDED(sc->GetDevice(__uuidof(ID3D12CommandQueue), (void**)&q)) && q) { g_c12QueueSource = 1; return q; }
    g_eclWanted = true;
    if (!g_eclInstalled) return nullptr;
    DWORD tid = GetCurrentThreadId();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_eclMx);
    int best = -1; int bestScore = -1; DWORD bestTick = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_eclN; i++) {
        ID3D12Device* d = nullptr;
        if (FAILED(g_eclQs[i].q->GetDevice(__uuidof(ID3D12Device), (void**)&d)) || !d) continue;
        bool same = d == bbDev; d->Release();
        if (!same) continue;
        int score = g_eclQs[i].tid == tid ? 1 : 0;
        if (score > bestScore || (score == bestScore && (LONG)(g_eclQs[i].tick - bestTick) > 0)) { best = i; bestScore = score; bestTick = g_eclQs[i].tick; }
    }
    if (best < 0) return nullptr;
    q = g_eclQs[best].q; q->AddRef(); g_c12QueueSource = 2;
    return q;
}
void ReleaseEclQueues() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_eclMx);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_eclN; i++) g_eclQs[i].q->Release();
    g_eclN = 0;
}

// Game thread. Returns true when a readback was submitted (requester must call Finish12).
bool Begin12(IDXGISwapChain* sc, std::string& err) {
    IDXGISwapChain3* sc3 = nullptr;
    ID3D12Resource* bb = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(sc->QueryInterface(__uuidof(IDXGISwapChain3), (void**)&sc3)) || !sc3) { err = "no IDXGISwapChain3"; return false; }
    UINT idx = sc3->GetCurrentBackBufferIndex();
    sc3->Release(); sc3 = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(sc->GetBuffer(idx, __uuidof(ID3D12Resource), (void**)&bb)) || !bb) { err = "GetBuffer(ID3D12Resource) failed"; return false; }
    ID3D12Device* dev = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(bb->GetDevice(__uuidof(ID3D12Device), (void**)&dev)) || !dev) { bb->Release(); err = "back buffer has no device"; return false; }
    ID3D12CommandQueue* q = QueueFor12(sc, dev);
    if (!q) { bb->Release(); dev->Release(); g_capRetryable = true; err = g_eclInstalled ? "no DIRECT command queue on the swapchain's device seen yet" : "command-queue hook not installed yet"; return false; }
    bool ok = false;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_c12Mx);
    do {
        if (dev->GetDeviceRemovedReason() != S_OK) { if (g_c12.dev) Release12Locked("device removed"); ReleaseEclQueues(); err = "device removed"; break; }
        if (g_c12.pending) {
            UINT64 done = g_c12.fence ? g_c12.fence->GetCompletedValue() : 0;
            if (done == UINT64_MAX) { Release12Locked("device removed (fence)"); err = "device removed"; break; }
            if (done < g_c12.waitVal) { err = "previous readback still in flight"; break; }
            g_c12.pending = false;
        }
        if (g_c12.stale || (g_c12.dev && g_c12.dev != dev)) Release12Locked(g_c12.stale ? "resize" : "device changed");
        if (!g_c12.dev) {
            D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE t = D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT;
            if (FAILED(dev->CreateCommandAllocator(t, __uuidof(ID3D12CommandAllocator), (void**)&g_c12.alloc)) ||
                FAILED(dev->CreateCommandList(0, t, g_c12.alloc, nullptr, __uuidof(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList), (void**)&g_c12.list)) ||
                FAILED(dev->CreateFence(0, D3D12_FENCE_FLAG_NONE, __uuidof(ID3D12Fence), (void**)&g_c12.fence))) {
                err = "creating allocator/list/fence failed"; g_c12.dev = dev; dev->AddRef(); Release12Locked("create failed"); break;
            }
            g_c12.list->Close();
            g_c12.dev = dev; dev->AddRef();
            Log("d3d12 capture: created allocator/list/fence on device %p (queue source %d)", dev, (int)g_c12QueueSource);
        }
        D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC rd = bb->GetDesc();
        if (rd.Dimension != D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D || rd.SampleDesc.Count != 1) { err = "back buffer is not a single-sample 2D texture"; break; }
        BYTE probe[16] = {0}, out[8];
        if (!ConvertRow(rd.Format, probe, out, 1)) { char b[64]; sprintf_s(b, "unsupported backbuffer format %d", (int)rd.Format); err = b; break; }
        D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT fp{}; UINT rows = 0; UINT64 rowBytes = 0, total = 0;
        dev->GetCopyableFootprints(&rd, 0, 1, 0, &fp, &rows, &rowBytes, &total);
        if (!g_c12.rb || g_c12.rbSize < total) {
            if (g_c12.rb) { g_c12.rb->Release(); g_c12.rb = nullptr; g_c12.rbSize = 0; }
            D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp{}; hp.Type = D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK;
            D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC bd{}; bd.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER; bd.Width = total; bd.Height = 1; bd.DepthOrArraySize = 1;
            bd.MipLevels = 1; bd.SampleDesc.Count = 1; bd.Layout = D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR;
            if (FAILED(dev->CreateCommittedResource(&hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &bd, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, nullptr, __uuidof(ID3D12Resource), (void**)&g_c12.rb))) {
                g_c12.rb = nullptr; err = "readback buffer allocation failed"; break;
            }
            g_c12.rbSize = total;
        }
        if (FAILED(g_c12.alloc->Reset()) || FAILED(g_c12.list->Reset(g_c12.alloc, nullptr))) { err = "command list reset failed"; break; }
        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER b{}; b.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION; b.Transition.pResource = bb;
        b.Transition.Subresource = 0; b.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT; b.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE;
        g_c12.list->ResourceBarrier(1, &b);
        D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION dst{}, src{};
        dst.pResource = g_c12.rb; dst.Type = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_PLACED_FOOTPRINT; dst.PlacedFootprint = fp;
        src.pResource = bb; src.Type = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_SUBRESOURCE_INDEX; src.SubresourceIndex = 0;
        g_c12.list->CopyTextureRegion(&dst, 0, 0, 0, &src, nullptr);
        std::swap(b.Transition.StateBefore, b.Transition.StateAfter);
        g_c12.list->ResourceBarrier(1, &b);
        if (FAILED(g_c12.list->Close())) { err = "command list close failed"; break; }
        ID3D12CommandList* cl = g_c12.list;
        t_ourEcl = true; q->ExecuteCommandLists(1, &cl); t_ourEcl = false;
        g_c12.waitVal = ++g_c12.fenceVal;
        if (FAILED(q->Signal(g_c12.fence, g_c12.waitVal))) { err = "queue Signal failed"; break; }
        g_c12.pending = true; g_c12.submits++;
        g_c12.w = (UINT)rd.Width; g_c12.h = rd.Height; g_c12.fmt = rd.Format; g_c12.fp = fp;
        ok = true;
    } while (false);
    if (bb) bb->Release();
    if (sc3) sc3->Release();
    dev->Release(); q->Release();
    return ok;
}

// Requester thread: wait for our fence (not the game), map, convert into g_capPix.
bool Finish12(DWORD timeoutMs, std::string& err) {
    ID3D12Fence* fence = nullptr; UINT64 val = 0;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_c12Mx);
        if (!g_c12.pending || !g_c12.fence) { err = "no readback pending"; return false; }
        fence = g_c12.fence; fence->AddRef(); val = g_c12.waitVal;
    }
    if (fence->GetCompletedValue() < val) {
        HANDLE ev = CreateEventW(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr);
        if (ev && SUCCEEDED(fence->SetEventOnCompletion(val, ev))) WaitForSingleObject(ev, timeoutMs);
        if (ev) CloseHandle(ev);
    }
    UINT64 done = fence->GetCompletedValue();
    fence->Release();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_c12Mx);
    if (done == UINT64_MAX) { Release12Locked("device removed (readback)"); err = "device removed"; return false; }
    if (done < val) { err = "GPU readback did not complete within timeout"; return false; }
    if (!g_c12.pending || g_c12.waitVal != val || !g_c12.rb) { err = "readback was dropped"; return false; }
    bool ok = false;
    void* p = nullptr;
    HRESULT mhr = g_c12.rb->Map(0, nullptr, &p);
    if (SUCCEEDED(mhr) && p) {
        g_capPix.resize((size_t)g_c12.w * g_c12.h * 4);
        ok = true;
        const BYTE* base = (const BYTE*)p + g_c12.fp.Offset;
        for (UINT y = 0; y < g_c12.h && ok; y++) ok = ConvertRow(g_c12.fmt, base + (size_t)y * g_c12.fp.Footprint.RowPitch, g_capPix.data() + (size_t)y * g_c12.w * 4, g_c12.w);
        D3D12_RANGE none{0, 0}; g_c12.rb->Unmap(0, &none);
        if (ok) { g_capW = g_c12.w; g_capH = g_c12.h; g_capFmt = g_c12.fmt; }
        else { g_capPix.clear(); err = "format conversion failed"; }
    } else { char b[64]; sprintf_s(b, "Map(readback) failed hr=0x%08X", (unsigned)mhr); err = b; }
    g_c12.pending = false;
    if (g_c12.stale) Release12Locked("resize (deferred)");
    return ok;
}

// Monitor thread: install the ExecuteCommandLists hook only when a D3D12 swapchain did not hand out its queue.
void TryHookEcl() {
    if (!g_eclWanted || g_eclInstalled) return;
    HMODULE h = GetModuleHandleW(L"d3d12.dll"); if (!h) return;
    using PFN_Create = HRESULT(WINAPI*)(IUnknown*, D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL, REFIID, void**);
    PFN_Create create = (PFN_Create)GetProcAddress(h, "D3D12CreateDevice");
    if (!create) return;
    g_eclInstalled = true;   // one attempt
    ID3D12Device* dev = nullptr; ID3D12CommandQueue* q = nullptr;
    if (SUCCEEDED(create(nullptr, D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0, __uuidof(ID3D12Device), (void**)&dev)) && dev) {
        D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_DESC qd{}; qd.Type = D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT;
        if (SUCCEEDED(dev->CreateCommandQueue(&qd, __uuidof(ID3D12CommandQueue), (void**)&q)) && q) {
            void** vt = *(void***)q;
            HookAddr("ID3D12CommandQueue::ExecuteCommandLists", vt[10], (void*)&h_ExecuteCommandLists, (void**)&o_ExecuteCommandLists);
            q->Release();
        }
        dev->Release();
    } else g_hooksFail += "ID3D12CommandQueue::ExecuteCommandLists(no device) ";
    Log("ExecuteCommandLists fallback hook %s", o_ExecuteCommandLists ? "installed" : "FAILED");
}
```

`src/vi_capgl.h`:

```h
// vi_capgl.h - native OpenGL capture for vinput. Included INSIDE vinput_core.cpp's anonymous namespace.
//
// Hooks opengl32!wglSwapBuffers and gdi32!SwapBuffers (gdi32 calls wglSwapBuffers itself, so a thread-local
// guard counts each frame once). On a capture request the game's own GL thread, with its context current and
// BEFORE the swap, reads GL_BACK of the default framebuffer with glReadPixels(GL_BGRA). Every piece of GL
// state we touch is saved and restored (read buffer, read framebuffer, pixel-pack buffer, pack alignment /
// row length / skips / swap / lsb). glGetError is drained before and after the read; that hides one pending
// game-side GL error at the capture frame (documented). The read is synchronous: at most one frame of stall
// on the capture frame only. Nothing is cached, so there is nothing to release on resize.
using PFN_wglSwap = BOOL(WINAPI*)(HDC);
PFN_wglSwap o_wglSwapBuffers = nullptr, o_gdiSwapBuffers = nullptr;
std::atomic<bool> g_glHooked{false};
thread_local int t_inSwap = 0;

struct GlFns {
    void (WINAPI* ReadPixels)(GLint, GLint, GLsizei, GLsizei, GLenum, GLenum, void*) = nullptr;
    void (WINAPI* GetIntegerv)(GLenum, GLint*) = nullptr;
    void (WINAPI* PixelStorei)(GLenum, GLint) = nullptr;
    void (WINAPI* ReadBuffer)(GLenum) = nullptr;
    GLenum (WINAPI* GetError)() = nullptr;
    HGLRC (WINAPI* GetCurrentContext)() = nullptr;
    PROC (WINAPI* GetProcAddr)(LPCSTR) = nullptr;
    void (WINAPI* BindFramebuffer)(GLenum, GLuint) = nullptr;   // GL 3.0 / ARB_framebuffer_object (per context)
    void (WINAPI* BindBuffer)(GLenum, GLuint) = nullptr;        // GL 1.5
    HGLRC fnCtx = nullptr;
} g_gl;

bool GlResolve() {
    HMODULE h = GetModuleHandleW(L"opengl32.dll"); if (!h) return false;
    if (!g_gl.ReadPixels) {
        g_gl.ReadPixels = (decltype(g_gl.ReadPixels))GetProcAddress(h, "glReadPixels");
        g_gl.GetIntegerv = (decltype(g_gl.GetIntegerv))GetProcAddress(h, "glGetIntegerv");
        g_gl.PixelStorei = (decltype(g_gl.PixelStorei))GetProcAddress(h, "glPixelStorei");
        g_gl.ReadBuffer = (decltype(g_gl.ReadBuffer))GetProcAddress(h, "glReadBuffer");
        g_gl.GetError = (decltype(g_gl.GetError))GetProcAddress(h, "glGetError");
        g_gl.GetCurrentContext = (decltype(g_gl.GetCurrentContext))GetProcAddress(h, "wglGetCurrentContext");
        g_gl.GetProcAddr = (decltype(g_gl.GetProcAddr))GetProcAddress(h, "wglGetProcAddress");
    }
    return g_gl.ReadPixels && g_gl.GetIntegerv && g_gl.PixelStorei && g_gl.ReadBuffer && g_gl.GetError && g_gl.GetCurrentContext && g_gl.GetProcAddr;
}
// Extension entry points are per context on Windows; wglGetProcAddress may return small sentinel values.
PROC GlExt(const char* n) { PROC p = g_gl.GetProcAddr(n); ULONG_PTR v = (ULONG_PTR)p; return (v <= 3 || v == (ULONG_PTR)-1) ? nullptr : p; }

void CaptureGL(HDC dc, HWND w) {
    if (!GlResolve()) { g_capErr = "gl: opengl32 entry points not found"; return; }
    HGLRC ctx = g_gl.GetCurrentContext();
    if (!ctx) { g_capErr = "gl: no current GL context on the SwapBuffers thread"; return; }
    if (ctx != g_gl.fnCtx) {
        g_gl.fnCtx = ctx;
        g_gl.BindFramebuffer = (decltype(g_gl.BindFramebuffer))GlExt("glBindFramebuffer");
        if (!g_gl.BindFramebuffer) g_gl.BindFramebuffer = (decltype(g_gl.BindFramebuffer))GlExt("glBindFramebufferEXT");
        g_gl.BindBuffer = (decltype(g_gl.BindBuffer))GlExt("glBindBuffer");
    }
    RECT rc{}; GetClientRect(w, &rc);
    int cw = rc.right, ch = rc.bottom;
    if (cw <= 0 || ch <= 0) { g_capErr = "gl: empty client rect"; return; }
    const GLenum READ_FB_BINDING = 0x8CAA, READ_FB = 0x8CA8, PACK_BUF_BINDING = 0x88ED, PACK_BUF = 0x88EB;
    const GLenum PACK_ROW_LENGTH = 0x0D02, PACK_SKIP_ROWS = 0x0D03, PACK_SKIP_PIXELS = 0x0D04, PACK_SWAP = 0x0D00, PACK_LSB = 0x0D01, PACK_ALIGN = 0x0D05;
    const GLenum BGRA = 0x80E1;
    while (g_gl.GetError() != GL_NO_ERROR) {}
    GLint readBuf = 0, readFb = 0, packBuf = 0, rowLen = 0, skipRows = 0, skipPix = 0, swapB = 0, lsb = 0, align = 4;
    if (g_gl.BindFramebuffer) g_gl.GetIntegerv(READ_FB_BINDING, &readFb);
    if (g_gl.BindBuffer) g_gl.GetIntegerv(PACK_BUF_BINDING, &packBuf);
    g_gl.GetIntegerv(PACK_ROW_LENGTH, &rowLen); g_gl.GetIntegerv(PACK_SKIP_ROWS, &skipRows); g_gl.GetIntegerv(PACK_SKIP_PIXELS, &skipPix);
    g_gl.GetIntegerv(PACK_SWAP, &swapB); g_gl.GetIntegerv(PACK_LSB, &lsb); g_gl.GetIntegerv(PACK_ALIGN, &align);
    while (g_gl.GetError() != GL_NO_ERROR) {}   // GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER_BINDING is invalid on pre-3.0 contexts
    if (g_gl.BindFramebuffer && readFb) g_gl.BindFramebuffer(READ_FB, 0);
    g_gl.GetIntegerv(GL_READ_BUFFER, &readBuf);   // read-buffer state belongs to the bound framebuffer: query FB 0's
    if (g_gl.BindBuffer && packBuf) g_gl.BindBuffer(PACK_BUF, 0);
    g_gl.PixelStorei(PACK_ROW_LENGTH, 0); g_gl.PixelStorei(PACK_SKIP_ROWS, 0); g_gl.PixelStorei(PACK_SKIP_PIXELS, 0);
    g_gl.PixelStorei(PACK_SWAP, 0); g_gl.PixelStorei(PACK_LSB, 0); g_gl.PixelStorei(PACK_ALIGN, 4);
    g_gl.ReadBuffer(GL_BACK);
    std::vector<BYTE> px((size_t)cw * ch * 4);
    g_gl.ReadPixels(0, 0, cw, ch, BGRA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, px.data());
    GLenum e = g_gl.GetError();
    while (g_gl.GetError() != GL_NO_ERROR) {}
    g_gl.ReadBuffer((GLenum)readBuf);
    g_gl.PixelStorei(PACK_ROW_LENGTH, rowLen); g_gl.PixelStorei(PACK_SKIP_ROWS, skipRows); g_gl.PixelStorei(PACK_SKIP_PIXELS, skipPix);
    g_gl.PixelStorei(PACK_SWAP, swapB); g_gl.PixelStorei(PACK_LSB, lsb); g_gl.PixelStorei(PACK_ALIGN, align);
    if (g_gl.BindBuffer && packBuf) g_gl.BindBuffer(PACK_BUF, (GLuint)packBuf);
    if (g_gl.BindFramebuffer && readFb) g_gl.BindFramebuffer(READ_FB, (GLuint)readFb);
    while (g_gl.GetError() != GL_NO_ERROR) {}
    if (e != GL_NO_ERROR) { char b[64]; sprintf_s(b, "gl: glReadPixels error 0x%04X", (unsigned)e); g_capErr = b; return; }
    // GL rows are bottom-up
    g_capPix.resize(px.size());
    size_t row = (size_t)cw * 4;
    for (int y = 0; y < ch; y++) {
        BYTE* d = g_capPix.data() + (size_t)y * row; memcpy(d, px.data() + (size_t)(ch - 1 - y) * row, row);
        for (int x = 0; x < cw; x++) d[4 * x + 3] = 255;
    }
    g_capW = (UINT)cw; g_capH = (UINT)ch;
}
void GlFrame(HDC dc) {
    C.present++;
    HWND w = WindowFromDC(dc);
    if (!w) return;
    if (g_hwnd && w != g_hwnd && GetAncestor(w, GA_ROOT) != g_hwnd) return;
    OnFrame(API_GL);
    if (BeginCaptureClaim()) { CaptureGL(dc, w); EndCapture(API_GL); }
}
BOOL WINAPI h_wglSwapBuffers(HDC dc) {
    if (t_inSwap == 0) GlFrame(dc);
    t_inSwap++; BOOL r = o_wglSwapBuffers(dc); t_inSwap--;
    return r;
}
BOOL WINAPI h_gdiSwapBuffers(HDC dc) {
    if (t_inSwap == 0) GlFrame(dc);
    t_inSwap++; BOOL r = o_gdiSwapBuffers(dc); t_inSwap--;
    return r;
}
// Monitor thread: hook once opengl32.dll is in the process (never loads it).
// Also called from the loader's DLL-load notification with the module just mapped (early injection).
void TryHookGL(HMODULE h = nullptr) {
    if (g_glHooked) return;
    if (!h) h = GetModuleHandleW(L"opengl32.dll"); if (!h) return;
    if (g_glHooked.exchange(true)) return;
    HookAddr("wglSwapBuffers", (void*)GetProcAddress(h, "wglSwapBuffers"), (void*)&h_wglSwapBuffers, (void**)&o_wglSwapBuffers);
    HMODULE g = GetModuleHandleW(L"gdi32.dll");
    if (g) HookAddr("SwapBuffers", (void*)GetProcAddress(g, "SwapBuffers"), (void*)&h_gdiSwapBuffers, (void**)&o_gdiSwapBuffers);
    Log("opengl hooks installed");
}
```

`src/vi_capvk.h`:

```h
// vi_capvk.h - native Vulkan capture for vinput. Included INSIDE vinput_core.cpp's anonymous namespace.
//
// vulkan-1.dll is never loaded by vinput and never linked; hooks go in only once the game has it loaded.
// Hooked loader exports (inline): vkCreateDevice, vkDestroyDevice, vkGetDeviceQueue, vkGetDeviceQueue2,
// vkCreateSwapchainKHR, vkDestroySwapchainKHR, vkQueuePresentKHR, vkGetDeviceProcAddr. The vkGetDeviceProcAddr
// hook hands out our wrappers for the device-level ones, so games that resolve through it (volk-style) are
// covered too. Every wrapper calls the loader trampoline, which dispatches through the handle.
//
// LIMIT (by design, see README): the device, its queues and the swapchain must be CREATED AFTER injection
// (we need the physical device, the queue family and the swapchain format/extent/images, and we add
// TRANSFER_SRC to the swapchain usage). Inject before the game creates its VkDevice (or force a swapchain
// recreation after injection for a game that resolved vkGetDeviceProcAddr late).
//
// Capture (game thread, inside vkQueuePresentKHR, only on request): one command buffer waits on the present's
// wait semaphores, transitions the presented image PRESENT_SRC -> TRANSFER_SRC, copies it to a host-visible
// buffer, transitions it back, and signals our per-image semaphore + our fence; the present is then issued
// waiting on our semaphore. The requester thread waits on the fence; the game thread never waits.

using PFN_vkVoid = PFN_vkVoidFunction;
PFN_vkCreateDevice o_vkCreateDevice = nullptr;
PFN_vkDestroyDevice o_vkDestroyDevice = nullptr;
PFN_vkGetDeviceQueue o_vkGetDeviceQueue = nullptr;
PFN_vkGetDeviceQueue2 o_vkGetDeviceQueue2 = nullptr;
PFN_vkCreateSwapchainKHR o_vkCreateSwapchainKHR = nullptr;
PFN_vkDestroySwapchainKHR o_vkDestroySwapchainKHR = nullptr;
PFN_vkQueuePresentKHR o_vkQueuePresentKHR = nullptr;
PFN_vkGetDeviceProcAddr o_vkGetDeviceProcAddr = nullptr;
std::atomic<bool> g_vkHooked{false};
std::atomic<bool> g_vkEnabled{true};   // config vk=off: hooks stay pass-through, no capture / no usage change

struct VkLoaderFns {
#define VKF(n) PFN_##n n = nullptr;
    VKF(vkCreateCommandPool) VKF(vkDestroyCommandPool) VKF(vkAllocateCommandBuffers) VKF(vkResetCommandPool)
    VKF(vkCreateFence) VKF(vkDestroyFence) VKF(vkWaitForFences) VKF(vkResetFences) VKF(vkGetFenceStatus)
    VKF(vkBeginCommandBuffer) VKF(vkEndCommandBuffer) VKF(vkCmdPipelineBarrier) VKF(vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer)
    VKF(vkQueueSubmit) VKF(vkCreateBuffer) VKF(vkDestroyBuffer) VKF(vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements)
    VKF(vkAllocateMemory) VKF(vkFreeMemory) VKF(vkBindBufferMemory) VKF(vkMapMemory) VKF(vkUnmapMemory)
    VKF(vkInvalidateMappedMemoryRanges) VKF(vkCreateSemaphore) VKF(vkDestroySemaphore)
    VKF(vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR) VKF(vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties)
#undef VKF
    bool ok = false;
} g_vkf;

template <class T> uint64_t VkKey(T h) {
    if constexpr (std::is_pointer<T>::value) return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)h; else return (uint64_t)h;
}
struct VkScInfo { VkDevice dev = nullptr; VkFormat fmt = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED; VkExtent2D ext{}; uint32_t layers = 1; bool transferSrc = false; HWND hwnd = nullptr; std::vector<VkImage> imgs; std::vector<VkSemaphore> sems; };
std::mutex g_vkMx;
std::map<VkDevice, VkPhysicalDevice> g_vkDevs;
std::map<VkQueue, std::pair<VkDevice, uint32_t>> g_vkQueues;
std::map<uint64_t, VkScInfo> g_vkScs;
std::map<uint64_t, HWND> g_vkSurfaces;   // VkSurfaceKHR -> window (vkCreateWin32SurfaceKHR)
std::atomic<long> g_vkUsageAdded{0}, g_vkPresents{0}, g_vkPresentsOther{0};
PFN_vkCreateWin32SurfaceKHR o_vkCreateWin32SurfaceKHR = nullptr;
struct VkCap {
    VkDevice dev = nullptr; uint32_t family = 0;
    VkCommandPool pool = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkCommandBuffer cb = nullptr; VkFence fence = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkBuffer buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkDeviceMemory mem = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkDeviceSize size = 0; void* map = nullptr; bool coherent = true;
    bool pending = false; uint64_t seq = 0; uint32_t w = 0, h = 0; VkFormat fmt = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
} g_vkc;
uint64_t g_vkSeq = 0;
std::atomic<long> g_vkSubmits{0}, g_vkReleases{0};

bool VkResolve() {
    if (g_vkf.ok) return true;
    HMODULE h = GetModuleHandleW(L"vulkan-1.dll"); if (!h) return false;
#define VKR(n) g_vkf.n = (PFN_##n)GetProcAddress(h, #n); if (!g_vkf.n) return false;
    VKR(vkCreateCommandPool) VKR(vkDestroyCommandPool) VKR(vkAllocateCommandBuffers) VKR(vkResetCommandPool)
    VKR(vkCreateFence) VKR(vkDestroyFence) VKR(vkWaitForFences) VKR(vkResetFences) VKR(vkGetFenceStatus)
    VKR(vkBeginCommandBuffer) VKR(vkEndCommandBuffer) VKR(vkCmdPipelineBarrier) VKR(vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer)
    VKR(vkQueueSubmit) VKR(vkCreateBuffer) VKR(vkDestroyBuffer) VKR(vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements)
    VKR(vkAllocateMemory) VKR(vkFreeMemory) VKR(vkBindBufferMemory) VKR(vkMapMemory) VKR(vkUnmapMemory)
    VKR(vkInvalidateMappedMemoryRanges) VKR(vkCreateSemaphore) VKR(vkDestroySemaphore)
    VKR(vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR) VKR(vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties)
#undef VKR
    g_vkf.ok = true;
    return true;
}
// VkFormat -> the DXGI format ConvertRow understands (+ whether R and B must be swapped afterwards)
DXGI_FORMAT VkToDxgi(VkFormat f, bool* swapRB) {
    *swapRB = false;
    switch (f) {
    case VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM: case VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB: return DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
    case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM: case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB: return DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    case VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_UNORM_PACK32: return DXGI_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_UNORM;
    case VK_FORMAT_A2R10G10B10_UNORM_PACK32: *swapRB = true; return DXGI_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_UNORM;
    case VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT: return DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT;
    default: return DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
    }
}
uint32_t VkBpp(VkFormat f) { return f == VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT ? 8 : 4; }

// caller holds g_vkMx
void VkReleaseCapLocked(const char* why) {
    if (!g_vkc.dev) return;
    if (g_vkc.pending && g_vkc.fence) {
        VkResult r = g_vkf.vkWaitForFences(g_vkc.dev, 1, &g_vkc.fence, VK_TRUE, 1000000000ULL);
        if (r == VK_TIMEOUT) { Log("vk capture: release (%s) while copy in flight -> leaking our objects", why); g_vkc = VkCap{}; return; }
    }
    VkDevice d = g_vkc.dev;
    if (g_vkc.map) g_vkf.vkUnmapMemory(d, g_vkc.mem);
    if (g_vkc.buf) g_vkf.vkDestroyBuffer(d, g_vkc.buf, nullptr);
    if (g_vkc.mem) g_vkf.vkFreeMemory(d, g_vkc.mem, nullptr);
    if (g_vkc.fence) g_vkf.vkDestroyFence(d, g_vkc.fence, nullptr);
    if (g_vkc.pool) g_vkf.vkDestroyCommandPool(d, g_vkc.pool, nullptr);   // frees the command buffer
    g_vkc = VkCap{};
    g_vkReleases++;
    Log("vk capture: released our objects (%s)", why);
}

// Game thread, inside vkQueuePresentKHR. On success *out is the present info to use (waiting on our semaphore).
bool BeginVk(VkQueue q, const VkPresentInfoKHR* pi, VkPresentInfoKHR* out, VkSemaphore* sigOut, std::string& err) {
    if (!g_vkEnabled) { err = "vk: capture disabled (config vk=off)"; return false; }
    if (!pi || pi->swapchainCount < 1 || !pi->pSwapchains || !pi->pImageIndices) { err = "vk: empty present"; return false; }
    if (!VkResolve()) { err = "vk: loader entry points not found"; return false; }
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_vkMx);
    auto qi = g_vkQueues.find(q);
    if (qi == g_vkQueues.end()) { err = "vk: present queue was obtained before vinput was injected (inject before the game creates its VkDevice)"; return false; }
    VkDevice dev = qi->second.first; uint32_t fam = qi->second.second;
    auto di = g_vkDevs.find(dev);
    if (di == g_vkDevs.end()) { err = "vk: device was created before vinput was injected"; return false; }
    auto si = g_vkScs.find(VkKey(pi->pSwapchains[0]));
    if (si == g_vkScs.end()) { err = "vk: swapchain was created before vinput was injected (resize the window to make the game recreate it)"; return false; }
    VkScInfo& sc = si->second;
    uint32_t idx = pi->pImageIndices[0];
    if (idx >= sc.imgs.size()) { err = "vk: image index out of range"; return false; }
    if (!sc.transferSrc) { err = "vk: swapchain images lack TRANSFER_SRC usage (driver refused to add it)"; return false; }
    bool swapRB; if (VkToDxgi(sc.fmt, &swapRB) == DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN) { char b[64]; sprintf_s(b, "vk: unsupported swapchain format %d", (int)sc.fmt); err = b; return false; }
    if (g_vkc.pending) {
        VkResult s = g_vkf.vkGetFenceStatus(g_vkc.dev, g_vkc.fence);
        if (s == VK_NOT_READY) { err = "vk: previous readback still in flight"; return false; }
        if (s != VK_SUCCESS) { VkReleaseCapLocked("device lost"); err = "vk: device lost"; return false; }
        g_vkc.pending = false;
    }
    if (g_vkc.dev && (g_vkc.dev != dev || g_vkc.family != fam)) VkReleaseCapLocked("device/queue family changed");
    if (!g_vkc.dev) {
        VkCommandPoolCreateInfo pc{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO}; pc.queueFamilyIndex = fam; pc.flags = VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_TRANSIENT_BIT;
        VkFenceCreateInfo fc{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO};
        g_vkc.dev = dev; g_vkc.family = fam;
        if (g_vkf.vkCreateCommandPool(dev, &pc, nullptr, &g_vkc.pool) != VK_SUCCESS) { err = "vk: vkCreateCommandPool failed"; VkReleaseCapLocked("create failed"); return false; }
        VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ai{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO}; ai.commandPool = g_vkc.pool; ai.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY; ai.commandBufferCount = 1;
        if (g_vkf.vkAllocateCommandBuffers(dev, &ai, &g_vkc.cb) != VK_SUCCESS) { err = "vk: vkAllocateCommandBuffers failed"; VkReleaseCapLocked("create failed"); return false; }
        if (g_vkf.vkCreateFence(dev, &fc, nullptr, &g_vkc.fence) != VK_SUCCESS) { err = "vk: vkCreateFence failed"; VkReleaseCapLocked("create failed"); return false; }
        Log("vk capture: created pool/cb/fence on device %p family %u", dev, fam);
    }
    VkDeviceSize need = (VkDeviceSize)sc.ext.width * sc.ext.height * VkBpp(sc.fmt);
    if (g_vkc.size < need) {
        if (g_vkc.map) { g_vkf.vkUnmapMemory(dev, g_vkc.mem); g_vkc.map = nullptr; }
        if (g_vkc.buf) { g_vkf.vkDestroyBuffer(dev, g_vkc.buf, nullptr); g_vkc.buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
        if (g_vkc.mem) { g_vkf.vkFreeMemory(dev, g_vkc.mem, nullptr); g_vkc.mem = VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
        g_vkc.size = 0;
        VkBufferCreateInfo bc{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO}; bc.size = need; bc.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT; bc.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
        if (g_vkf.vkCreateBuffer(dev, &bc, nullptr, &g_vkc.buf) != VK_SUCCESS) { err = "vk: vkCreateBuffer failed"; return false; }
        VkMemoryRequirements mr; g_vkf.vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(dev, g_vkc.buf, &mr);
        VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties mp; g_vkf.vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(di->second, &mp);
        int best = -1, bestScore = -1;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mp.memoryTypeCount; i++) {
            if (!(mr.memoryTypeBits & (1u << i))) continue;
            VkMemoryPropertyFlags f = mp.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags;
            if (!(f & VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT)) continue;
            int score = ((f & VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_CACHED_BIT) ? 2 : 0) + ((f & VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT) ? 1 : 0);
            if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = (int)i; }
        }
        if (best < 0) { g_vkf.vkDestroyBuffer(dev, g_vkc.buf, nullptr); g_vkc.buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; err = "vk: no host-visible memory type"; return false; }
        VkMemoryAllocateInfo ma{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO}; ma.allocationSize = mr.size; ma.memoryTypeIndex = (uint32_t)best;
        if (g_vkf.vkAllocateMemory(dev, &ma, nullptr, &g_vkc.mem) != VK_SUCCESS) { g_vkf.vkDestroyBuffer(dev, g_vkc.buf, nullptr); g_vkc.buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; err = "vk: vkAllocateMemory failed"; return false; }
        if (g_vkf.vkBindBufferMemory(dev, g_vkc.buf, g_vkc.mem, 0) != VK_SUCCESS || g_vkf.vkMapMemory(dev, g_vkc.mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &g_vkc.map) != VK_SUCCESS) {
            g_vkf.vkDestroyBuffer(dev, g_vkc.buf, nullptr); g_vkf.vkFreeMemory(dev, g_vkc.mem, nullptr); g_vkc.buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; g_vkc.mem = VK_NULL_HANDLE; g_vkc.map = nullptr;
            err = "vk: bind/map failed"; return false;
        }
        g_vkc.coherent = (mp.memoryTypes[best].propertyFlags & VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT) != 0;
        g_vkc.size = need;
    }
    if (sc.sems.size() < sc.imgs.size()) sc.sems.resize(sc.imgs.size(), VK_NULL_HANDLE);
    if (!sc.sems[idx]) {
        VkSemaphoreCreateInfo sci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_CREATE_INFO};
        if (g_vkf.vkCreateSemaphore(dev, &sci, nullptr, &sc.sems[idx]) != VK_SUCCESS) { sc.sems[idx] = VK_NULL_HANDLE; err = "vk: vkCreateSemaphore failed"; return false; }
    }
    VkImage img = sc.imgs[idx];
    if (g_vkf.vkResetFences(dev, 1, &g_vkc.fence) != VK_SUCCESS || g_vkf.vkResetCommandPool(dev, g_vkc.pool, 0) != VK_SUCCESS) { err = "vk: reset failed"; return false; }
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO}; bi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    if (g_vkf.vkBeginCommandBuffer(g_vkc.cb, &bi) != VK_SUCCESS) { err = "vk: vkBeginCommandBuffer failed"; return false; }
    VkImageMemoryBarrier ib{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER};
    ib.srcAccessMask = 0; ib.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT;
    ib.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR; ib.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
    ib.srcQueueFamilyIndex = ib.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; ib.image = img;
    ib.subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1};
    g_vkf.vkCmdPipelineBarrier(g_vkc.cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 1, &ib);
    VkBufferImageCopy rg{}; rg.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}; rg.imageExtent = {sc.ext.width, sc.ext.height, 1};
    g_vkf.vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(g_vkc.cb, img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, g_vkc.buf, 1, &rg);
    ib.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT; ib.dstAccessMask = 0;
    ib.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL; ib.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR;
    VkBufferMemoryBarrier bb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_MEMORY_BARRIER};
    bb.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT; bb.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_HOST_READ_BIT;
    bb.srcQueueFamilyIndex = bb.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; bb.buffer = g_vkc.buf; bb.offset = 0; bb.size = VK_WHOLE_SIZE;
    g_vkf.vkCmdPipelineBarrier(g_vkc.cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_HOST_BIT, 0, 0, nullptr, 1, &bb, 1, &ib);
    if (g_vkf.vkEndCommandBuffer(g_vkc.cb) != VK_SUCCESS) { err = "vk: vkEndCommandBuffer failed"; return false; }
    std::vector<VkPipelineStageFlags> stages(pi->waitSemaphoreCount, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT);
    VkSubmitInfo si2{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO};
    si2.waitSemaphoreCount = pi->waitSemaphoreCount; si2.pWaitSemaphores = pi->pWaitSemaphores; si2.pWaitDstStageMask = stages.empty() ? nullptr : stages.data();
    si2.commandBufferCount = 1; si2.pCommandBuffers = &g_vkc.cb;
    si2.signalSemaphoreCount = 1; si2.pSignalSemaphores = &sc.sems[idx];
    VkResult r = g_vkf.vkQueueSubmit(q, 1, &si2, g_vkc.fence);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) { char b[64]; sprintf_s(b, "vk: vkQueueSubmit failed %d", (int)r); err = b; if (r == VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST) VkReleaseCapLocked("device lost"); return false; }
    *sigOut = sc.sems[idx];
    *out = *pi; out->waitSemaphoreCount = 1; out->pWaitSemaphores = sigOut;
    g_vkc.pending = true; g_vkc.seq = ++g_vkSeq; g_vkc.w = sc.ext.width; g_vkc.h = sc.ext.height; g_vkc.fmt = sc.fmt;
    g_vkSubmits++;
    return true;
}

// Requester thread: wait on OUR fence, convert the host-visible copy into g_capPix.
bool FinishVk(DWORD timeoutMs, std::string& err) {
    VkDevice dev; VkFence fence; uint64_t seq;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_vkMx);
        if (!g_vkc.pending) { err = "vk: no readback pending"; return false; }
        dev = g_vkc.dev; fence = g_vkc.fence; seq = g_vkc.seq;
    }
    VkResult r = g_vkf.vkWaitForFences(dev, 1, &fence, VK_TRUE, (uint64_t)timeoutMs * 1000000ULL);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_vkMx);
    if (!g_vkc.pending || g_vkc.seq != seq) { err = "vk: readback was dropped"; return false; }
    if (r == VK_TIMEOUT) { err = "vk: GPU copy did not complete within timeout"; return false; }
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) { VkReleaseCapLocked("device lost (readback)"); err = "vk: device lost"; return false; }
    if (!g_vkc.coherent) { VkMappedMemoryRange mr{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MAPPED_MEMORY_RANGE}; mr.memory = g_vkc.mem; mr.offset = 0; mr.size = VK_WHOLE_SIZE; g_vkf.vkInvalidateMappedMemoryRanges(dev, 1, &mr); }
    bool swapRB; DXGI_FORMAT f = VkToDxgi(g_vkc.fmt, &swapRB);
    uint32_t bpp = VkBpp(g_vkc.fmt);
    g_capPix.resize((size_t)g_vkc.w * g_vkc.h * 4);
    bool ok = true;
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < g_vkc.h && ok; y++) {
        BYTE* d = g_capPix.data() + (size_t)y * g_vkc.w * 4;
        ok = ConvertRow(f, (const BYTE*)g_vkc.map + (size_t)y * g_vkc.w * bpp, d, g_vkc.w);
        if (ok && swapRB) for (uint32_t x = 0; x < g_vkc.w; x++) std::swap(d[4 * x], d[4 * x + 2]);
    }
    g_vkc.pending = false;
    if (!ok) { g_capPix.clear(); err = "vk: format conversion failed"; return false; }
    g_capW = g_vkc.w; g_capH = g_vkc.h; g_capFmt = f;
    return true;
}

// ---- hooks ----
thread_local int t_vkIn = 0;
VkResult VKAPI_CALL h_vkCreateDevice(VkPhysicalDevice pd, const VkDeviceCreateInfo* ci, const VkAllocationCallbacks* a, VkDevice* out) {
    VkResult r = o_vkCreateDevice(pd, ci, a, out);
    if (r == VK_SUCCESS && out && *out) { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_vkMx); g_vkDevs[*out] = pd; Log("vk: device %p created (physical %p)", *out, pd); }
    return r;
}
void VKAPI_CALL h_vkDestroyDevice(VkDevice d, const VkAllocationCallbacks* a) {
    if (d) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_vkMx);
        if (g_vkc.dev == d) VkReleaseCapLocked("vkDestroyDevice");
        for (auto it = g_vkScs.begin(); it != g_vkScs.end();) {
            if (it->second.dev == d) { for (VkSemaphore s : it->second.sems) if (s && VkResolve()) g_vkf.vkDestroySemaphore(d, s, nullptr); it = g_vkScs.erase(it); } else ++it;
        }
        for (auto it = g_vkQueues.begin(); it != g_vkQueues.end();) { if (it->second.first == d) it = g_vkQueues.erase(it); else ++it; }
        g_vkDevs.erase(d);
    }
    o_vkDestroyDevice(d, a);
}
void VKAPI_CALL h_vkGetDeviceQueue(VkDevice d, uint32_t fam, uint32_t idx, VkQueue* q) {
    o_vkGetDeviceQueue(d, fam, idx, q);
    if (q && *q) { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_vkMx); g_vkQueues[*q] = {d, fam}; }
}
void VKAPI_CALL h_vkGetDeviceQueue2(VkDevice d, const VkDeviceQueueInfo2* info, VkQueue* q) {
    o_vkGetDeviceQueue2(d, info, q);
    if (q && *q && info) { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_vkMx); g_vkQueues[*q] = {d, info->queueFamilyIndex}; }
}
VkResult VKAPI_CALL h_vkCreateSwapchainKHR(VkDevice d, const VkSwapchainCreateInfoKHR* ci, const VkAllocationCallbacks* a, VkSwapchainKHR* sc) {
    if (!ci || !g_vkEnabled) return o_vkCreateSwapchainKHR(d, ci, a, sc);
    VkSwapchainCreateInfoKHR c = *ci;
    bool added = !(c.imageUsage & VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT);
    c.imageUsage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT;
    VkResult r = o_vkCreateSwapchainKHR(d, &c, a, sc);
    bool transferSrc = r == VK_SUCCESS;
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS && added) { r = o_vkCreateSwapchainKHR(d, ci, a, sc); transferSrc = false; Log("vk: swapchain refused TRANSFER_SRC usage; created as the game asked"); }
    if (r == VK_SUCCESS && sc && VkResolve()) {
        if (added && transferSrc) g_vkUsageAdded++;
        VkScInfo s; s.dev = d; s.fmt = ci->imageFormat; s.ext = ci->imageExtent; s.layers = ci->imageArrayLayers; s.transferSrc = transferSrc;
        uint32_t n = 0;
        if (g_vkf.vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR(d, *sc, &n, nullptr) == VK_SUCCESS && n) { s.imgs.resize(n); if (g_vkf.vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR(d, *sc, &n, s.imgs.data()) != VK_SUCCESS) s.imgs.clear(); }
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_vkMx);
        auto sf = g_vkSurfaces.find(VkKey(ci->surface)); if (sf != g_vkSurfaces.end()) s.hwnd = sf->second;
        Log("vk: swapchain %llx created %ux%u fmt %d images %u transfer_src %d hwnd %p", (unsigned long long)VkKey(*sc), ci->imageExtent.width, ci->imageExtent.height, (int)ci->imageFormat, n, (int)transferSrc, s.hwnd);
        g_vkScs[VkKey(*sc)] = std::move(s);
    }
    return r;
}
void VKAPI_CALL h_vkDestroySwapchainKHR(VkDevice d, VkSwapchainKHR s, const VkAllocationCallbacks* a) {
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_vkMx);
        auto it = g_vkScs.find(VkKey(s));
        if (it != g_vkScs.end()) {
            if (g_vkc.pending && g_vkc.dev == d) g_vkf.vkWaitForFences(d, 1, &g_vkc.fence, VK_TRUE, 1000000000ULL);
            // legal: the game must have finished every use of the swapchain's images (incl. the present waits on our semaphores)
            for (VkSemaphore x : it->second.sems) if (x && VkResolve()) g_vkf.vkDestroySemaphore(d, x, nullptr);
            g_vkScs.erase(it);
        }
    }
    o_vkDestroySwapchainKHR(d, s, a);
}
VkResult VKAPI_CALL h_vkQueuePresentKHR(VkQueue q, const VkPresentInfoKHR* pi) {
    if (t_vkIn) return o_vkQueuePresentKHR(q, pi);
    C.present++; g_vkPresents++;
    // only presents to the game window are frames (a swapchain whose surface we did not see is assumed to be it)
    HWND w = nullptr;
    if (pi && pi->swapchainCount && pi->pSwapchains) { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_vkMx); auto it = g_vkScs.find(VkKey(pi->pSwapchains[0])); if (it != g_vkScs.end()) w = it->second.hwnd; }
    // t_vkIn also marks the driver's own DXGI Present (AMD presents Vulkan through an internal D3D12 swapchain on
    // this thread) as foreign, so the frame is not counted twice
    if (w && g_hwnd && w != g_hwnd) { g_vkPresentsOther++; t_vkIn++; VkResult r0 = o_vkQueuePresentKHR(q, pi); t_vkIn--; return r0; }
    t_vkIn++;
    OnFrame(API_VK);
    VkPresentInfoKHR mod; VkSemaphore sig = VK_NULL_HANDLE; bool use = false;
    if (BeginCaptureClaim()) {
        use = BeginVk(q, pi, &mod, &sig, g_capErr);
        if (use) g_capPending = API_VK;
        EndCapture(API_VK);
    }
    VkResult r = o_vkQueuePresentKHR(q, use ? &mod : pi);
    t_vkIn--;
    return r;
}
VkResult VKAPI_CALL h_vkCreateWin32SurfaceKHR(VkInstance inst, const VkWin32SurfaceCreateInfoKHR* ci, const VkAllocationCallbacks* a, VkSurfaceKHR* s) {
    VkResult r = o_vkCreateWin32SurfaceKHR(inst, ci, a, s);
    if (r == VK_SUCCESS && s && ci) { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_vkMx); g_vkSurfaces[VkKey(*s)] = ci->hwnd; }
    return r;
}
PFN_vkVoidFunction VKAPI_CALL h_vkGetDeviceProcAddr(VkDevice d, const char* n) {
    PFN_vkVoidFunction f = o_vkGetDeviceProcAddr(d, n);
    if (!f || !n) return f;
    // only hand out a wrapper whose loader trampoline we actually hold
    if (!strcmp(n, "vkQueuePresentKHR") && o_vkQueuePresentKHR) return (PFN_vkVoidFunction)&h_vkQueuePresentKHR;
    if (!strcmp(n, "vkCreateSwapchainKHR") && o_vkCreateSwapchainKHR) return (PFN_vkVoidFunction)&h_vkCreateSwapchainKHR;
    if (!strcmp(n, "vkDestroySwapchainKHR") && o_vkDestroySwapchainKHR) return (PFN_vkVoidFunction)&h_vkDestroySwapchainKHR;
    if (!strcmp(n, "vkGetDeviceQueue") && o_vkGetDeviceQueue) return (PFN_vkVoidFunction)&h_vkGetDeviceQueue;
    if (!strcmp(n, "vkGetDeviceQueue2") && o_vkGetDeviceQueue2) return (PFN_vkVoidFunction)&h_vkGetDeviceQueue2;
    if (!strcmp(n, "vkDestroyDevice") && o_vkDestroyDevice) return (PFN_vkVoidFunction)&h_vkDestroyDevice;
    return f;
}
// Also called from the loader's DLL-load notification with the module just mapped (early injection), so a game
// that LoadLibrary's vulkan-1.dll and creates its device right away is hooked before its first Vulkan call.
void TryHookVk(HMODULE h = nullptr) {
    if (g_vkHooked) return;
    if (!h) h = GetModuleHandleW(L"vulkan-1.dll"); if (!h) return;
    if (g_vkHooked.exchange(true)) return;
    HookAddr("vkCreateDevice", (void*)GetProcAddress(h, "vkCreateDevice"), (void*)&h_vkCreateDevice, (void**)&o_vkCreateDevice);
    HookAddr("vkDestroyDevice", (void*)GetProcAddress(h, "vkDestroyDevice"), (void*)&h_vkDestroyDevice, (void**)&o_vkDestroyDevice);
    HookAddr("vkGetDeviceQueue", (void*)GetProcAddress(h, "vkGetDeviceQueue"), (void*)&h_vkGetDeviceQueue, (void**)&o_vkGetDeviceQueue);
    HookAddr("vkGetDeviceQueue2", (void*)GetProcAddress(h, "vkGetDeviceQueue2"), (void*)&h_vkGetDeviceQueue2, (void**)&o_vkGetDeviceQueue2);
    HookAddr("vkCreateSwapchainKHR", (void*)GetProcAddress(h, "vkCreateSwapchainKHR"), (void*)&h_vkCreateSwapchainKHR, (void**)&o_vkCreateSwapchainKHR);
    HookAddr("vkDestroySwapchainKHR", (void*)GetProcAddress(h, "vkDestroySwapchainKHR"), (void*)&h_vkDestroySwapchainKHR, (void**)&o_vkDestroySwapchainKHR);
    HookAddr("vkQueuePresentKHR", (void*)GetProcAddress(h, "vkQueuePresentKHR"), (void*)&h_vkQueuePresentKHR, (void**)&o_vkQueuePresentKHR);
    HookAddr("vkGetDeviceProcAddr", (void*)GetProcAddress(h, "vkGetDeviceProcAddr"), (void*)&h_vkGetDeviceProcAddr, (void**)&o_vkGetDeviceProcAddr);
    HookAddr("vkCreateWin32SurfaceKHR", (void*)GetProcAddress(h, "vkCreateWin32SurfaceKHR"), (void*)&h_vkCreateWin32SurfaceKHR, (void**)&o_vkCreateWin32SurfaceKHR);
    Log("vulkan hooks installed");
}
```

`src/vi_cli_image.inl`:

```inl
// vi_cli_image.inl - find-image / click-image / wait-image (included by vi_cli_ui.inl).
// ---- image templates ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct ImageQuery { vi_vision::Image pattern; vi_ncc::Options opt; };
static bool ParseImageQuery(const Args& a, const char* cmd, ImageQuery& q, std::string& err) {
    if (a.pos.empty()) { err = std::string(cmd) + " needs a template .png"; return false; }
    wchar_t full[MAX_PATH]; GetFullPathNameW(U2W(a.pos[0]).c_str(), MAX_PATH, full, nullptr);
    if (!vi_vision::LoadPng(full, q.pattern, err)) { err = a.pos[0] + ": " + err; return false; }
    if (HasOpt(a, "threshold")) { q.opt.threshold = atof(GetOpt(a, "threshold").c_str()); if (!(q.opt.threshold > 0 && q.opt.threshold <= 1)) { err = "--threshold must be in (0,1]"; return false; } }
    if (HasOpt(a, "no-scale")) q.opt.scales = {1.0};
    else if (HasOpt(a, "scales")) { bool dummy; q.opt.scales = ParseScales(GetOpt(a, "scales"), dummy, err); if (q.opt.scales.empty()) return false; }
    return true;
}
static std::string ImageHitJson(const Frame& f, const vi_ncc::Match& m, int index) {
    const vi_text::Box b = ToClient(f, {m.x, m.y, m.w, m.h});
    return "{\"index\":" + std::to_string(index) + ",\"box\":" + BoxJ(b) + ",\"center\":[" + std::to_string(b.x + b.w / 2) + "," + std::to_string(b.y + b.h / 2) +
        "],\"score\":" + Num(m.score) + ",\"scale\":" + Num(m.scale) + "}";
}
// mode: 0 click-image, 1 wait-image, 2 find-image
static Reply CmdImage(DWORD pid, const Args& a, int mode) {
    const char* name = mode == 0 ? "click-image" : mode == 1 ? "wait-image" : "find-image";
    ImageQuery q; std::string err;
    if (!ParseImageQuery(a, name, q, err)) return Fail(err);
    int nth; if (!ParseNth(a, nth, err)) return Fail(err);
    const bool gone = HasOpt(a, "gone");
    if (mode != 1 && gone) return Fail("--gone only applies to wait-image");
    double timeout = atof(GetOpt(a, "timeout", mode == 0 ? "5000" : mode == 1 ? "15000" : "0").c_str());
    if (!(timeout >= 0 && timeout <= 600000)) return Fail("--timeout is milliseconds, 0..600000");
    const DWORD t0 = GetTickCount(); unsigned polls = 0;
    for (;;) {
        Frame f; if (!Grab(pid, a, f, err)) return Fail(err, "\"polls\":" + std::to_string(polls));
        vi_ncc::Result r = vi_ncc::Find(f.img, q.pattern, q.opt);
        if (!r.error.empty()) return Fail(r.error);
        ++polls;
        // reading order for --nth
        std::vector<vi_text::Hit> order;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < r.matches.size(); ++i) { vi_text::Hit h; h.first = (int)i; h.box = {r.matches[i].x, r.matches[i].y, r.matches[i].w, r.matches[i].h}; order.push_back(h); }
        vi_text::ReadingOrder(order);
        std::vector<vi_ncc::Match> m; for (auto& h : order) m.push_back(r.matches[(size_t)h.first]);
        const DWORD elapsed = GetTickCount() - t0;
        std::string stats = "\"elapsed_ms\":" + std::to_string(elapsed) + ",\"polls\":" + std::to_string(polls);
        std::string list = "[";
        for (size_t i = 0; i < m.size() && i < 20; ++i) list += (i ? "," : "") + ImageHitJson(f, m[i], (int)i + 1);
        list += "]";
        if (mode == 2) return {!m.empty(), std::string("{\"ok\":") + (m.empty() ? "false" : "true") + ",\"match_count\":" + std::to_string(m.size()) + ",\"matches\":" + list + ",\"threshold\":" + Num(q.opt.threshold) + "," + stats +
            (m.empty() ? ",\"error\":\"template not found at the threshold\"" : "") + "}"};
        if (mode == 0) {
            if (!m.empty()) {
                if (nth == 0 && m.size() > 1) return Fail("ambiguous: " + std::to_string(m.size()) + " matches for the template; pass --nth N or raise --threshold; nothing was clicked",
                    "\"ambiguous\":true,\"match_count\":" + std::to_string(m.size()) + ",\"candidates\":" + list + "," + stats);
                if (nth > (int)m.size()) return Fail("--nth " + std::to_string(nth) + " but only " + std::to_string(m.size()) + " matches; nothing was clicked", "\"match_count\":" + std::to_string(m.size()) + ",\"candidates\":" + list + "," + stats);
                const int index = nth ? nth : 1; const vi_text::Box b = ToClient(f, {m[(size_t)index - 1].x, m[(size_t)index - 1].y, m[(size_t)index - 1].w, m[(size_t)index - 1].h});
                std::string match = ImageHitJson(f, m[(size_t)index - 1], index);
                if (HasOpt(a, "dry-run")) return {true, "{\"ok\":true,\"clicked\":false,\"dry_run\":true,\"match\":" + match + ",\"match_count\":" + std::to_string(m.size()) + "," + stats + "}"};
                std::string resp; bool ok = Request(pid, ClickJson(a, b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2), resp) && resp.find("\"ok\":true") != std::string::npos;
                return {ok, std::string("{\"ok\":") + (ok ? "true" : "false") + ",\"clicked\":" + (ok ? "true" : "false") + ",\"match\":" + match + ",\"match_count\":" + std::to_string(m.size()) + "," + stats + ",\"click\":" + resp + "}"};
            }
        } else if (gone ? m.empty() : !m.empty()) {
            return {true, std::string("{\"ok\":true,\"found\":") + (m.empty() ? "false" : "true") + ",\"gone\":" + (m.empty() ? "true" : "false") + ",\"match_count\":" + std::to_string(m.size()) + ",\"matches\":" + list + "," + stats + "}"};
        }
        if (elapsed >= timeout && mode == 0 && HasOpt(a, "optional")) return {true, "{\"ok\":true,\"clicked\":false,\"skipped\":true,\"reason\":\"template not present (--optional)\"," + stats + "}"};
        if (elapsed >= timeout)
            return Fail(std::string(name) + ": " + (mode == 1 && gone ? "template still present" : "template not found") + (timeout > 0 ? " before timeout" : ""),
                        std::string("\"timed_out\":") + (timeout > 0 ? "true" : "false") + ",\"match_count\":" + std::to_string(m.size()) + "," + stats);
        Sleep(250);
    }
}
```

`src/vi_cli_script.inl`:

```inl
// vi_cli_script.inl - the script runner (included by vi_cli_ui.inl).
// script <file>: one command per line (same syntax as the CLI without --pid), '#' comments, `sleep <ms>`, `echo <text>`.
// Stops at the FIRST failing line and reports it. Every command's reply is printed as one JSON line as it runs.
static Reply RunScript(DWORD pid, const Args& a) {
    if (a.pos.empty()) return Fail("script needs a file");
    FILE* f = nullptr; _wfopen_s(&f, U2W(a.pos[0]).c_str(), L"rb");
    if (!f) return Fail("cannot open script: " + a.pos[0]);
    std::string text; char buf[4096]; size_t n;
    while ((n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), f)) > 0) text.append(buf, n);
    fclose(f);
    if (text.compare(0, 3, "\xEF\xBB\xBF") == 0) text.erase(0, 3);
    const bool keepGoing = HasOpt(a, "continue");
    {   // relative paths inside a script (templates, capture outputs) resolve against the script's own folder
        wchar_t full[MAX_PATH]; if (GetFullPathNameW(U2W(a.pos[0]).c_str(), MAX_PATH, full, nullptr)) {
            wchar_t* slash = wcsrchr(full, L'\\'); if (slash) { *slash = 0; SetCurrentDirectoryW(full); }
        }
    }
    DWORD t0 = GetTickCount(); int lineNo = 0, ran = 0, failed = 0; std::string firstFail; int failLine = 0;
    size_t pos = 0;
    while (pos <= text.size()) {
        size_t nl = text.find('\n', pos); if (nl == std::string::npos) nl = text.size();
        std::string l = text.substr(pos, nl - pos); pos = nl + 1; ++lineNo;
        while (!l.empty() && (l.back() == '\r' || l.back() == ' ' || l.back() == '\t')) l.pop_back();
        size_t s = l.find_first_not_of(" \t"); if (s == std::string::npos || l[s] == '#') continue;
        std::vector<std::string> tk = Tokenize(l.substr(s));
        if (tk.empty()) continue;
        Reply r;
        if (tk[0] == "sleep") { Sleep((DWORD)atoi(tk.size() > 1 ? tk[1].c_str() : "100")); r = {true, "{\"ok\":true,\"slept\":true}"}; }
        else if (tk[0] == "echo") { std::string t; for (size_t i = 1; i < tk.size(); ++i) t += (i > 1 ? " " : "") + tk[i]; r = {true, "{\"ok\":true,\"echo\":\"" + JEsc(t) + "\"}"}; }
        else if (tk[0] == "script" || tk[0] == "launch" || tk[0] == "inject" || tk[0] == "list" || tk[0] == "foreground") r = Fail("'" + tk[0] + "' is not allowed inside a script");
        else r = Dispatch(pid, tk);
        ++ran;
        FILE* progress=g_jsonOutput ? stderr : stdout;
        fprintf(progress,"{\"line\":%d,\"cmd\":\"%s\",\"reply\":%s}\n", lineNo, JEsc(tk[0]).c_str(), r.json.c_str()); fflush(progress);
        if (!r.ok) {
            ++failed;
            if (firstFail.empty()) failLine = lineNo, firstFail = "{\"failed_line\":" + std::to_string(lineNo) + ",\"line\":\"" + JEsc(l.substr(s)) + "\",\"reply\":" + r.json + "}";
            if (!keepGoing) break;
        }
    }
    if (failed) return {false, "{\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"script failed at line " + std::to_string(failLine) + "\",\"stopped\":" + (keepGoing ? "false" : "true") + ",\"commands_run\":" + std::to_string(ran) + ",\"failures\":" + std::to_string(failed) + ",\"first_failure\":" + firstFail + ",\"elapsed_ms\":" + std::to_string(GetTickCount() - t0) + "}"};
    return {true, "{\"ok\":true,\"script\":\"" + JEsc(a.pos[0]) + "\",\"commands_run\":" + std::to_string(ran) + ",\"elapsed_ms\":" + std::to_string(GetTickCount() - t0) + "}"};
}
```
