```inl
// vi_cli_small.inl - pixel / scroll / drag (included by vi_cli_ui.inl).
// ---- small commands ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
static Reply CmdPixel(DWORD pid, const Args& a) {
    if (a.pos.size() < 2) return Fail("pixel needs X Y (client pixels)");
    const int x = atoi(a.pos[0].c_str()), y = atoi(a.pos[1].c_str());
    Frame f; std::string err; if (!Grab(pid, a, f, err)) return Fail(err);
    const int px = (int)std::floor((x - f.ox) / f.sx), py = (int)std::floor((y - f.oy) / f.sy);
    vi_vision::Pixel p;
    if (!vi_vision::ReadPixel(f.img, px, py, p, err)) return Fail("pixel (" + std::to_string(x) + "," + std::to_string(y) + "): " + err);
    char hex[16]; sprintf_s(hex, "#%02X%02X%02X", p.r, p.g, p.b);
    return {true, "{\"ok\":true,\"x\":" + std::to_string(x) + ",\"y\":" + std::to_string(y) + ",\"r\":" + std::to_string(p.r) + ",\"g\":" + std::to_string(p.g) + ",\"b\":" + std::to_string(p.b) + ",\"hex\":\"" + hex + "\",\"frame_hash\":\"" + f.hash + "\"}"};
}
static Reply CmdScroll(DWORD pid, const Args& a) {
    if (a.pos.empty() || !IsNumber(a.pos[0])) return Fail("scroll needs N notches (positive = up/away, negative = down) and optional X Y");
    const int notches = atoi(a.pos[0].c_str());
    if (notches == 0 || notches > 1000 || notches < -1000) return Fail("scroll N must be 1..1000 in magnitude");
    std::string resp;
    if (a.pos.size() >= 3) {
        std::string m = "{"; PutS(m, "cmd", "mouse"); Put(m, "x", a.pos[1]); Put(m, "y", a.pos[2]);
        if (HasOpt(a, "norm")) Put(m, "norm", "true");
        m += "}";
        if (!Request(pid, m, resp) || resp.find("\"ok\":true") == std::string::npos) return {false, resp};
    } else if (a.pos.size() == 2) return Fail("scroll needs both X and Y, or neither");
    const double gap = atof(GetOpt(a, "notch-ms", "30").c_str());
    for (int i = 0; i < abs(notches); ++i) {
        std::string w = "{"; PutS(w, "cmd", "wheel"); Put(w, "delta", notches > 0 ? "120" : "-120"); if (HasOpt(a, "horizontal")) Put(w, "horizontal", "true");
        w += "}";
        if (!Request(pid, w, resp) || resp.find("\"ok\":true") == std::string::npos) return {false, resp};
        if (i + 1 < abs(notches)) Sleep((DWORD)gap);
    }
    return {true, "{\"ok\":true,\"notches\":" + std::to_string(notches) + ",\"delta_each\":" + std::string(notches > 0 ? "120" : "-120") + "}"};
}
static Reply CmdDrag(DWORD pid, const Args& a) {
    if (a.pos.size() < 4) return Fail("drag needs x1 y1 x2 y2 (client pixels)");
    const std::string button = GetOpt(a, "button", "left");
    const double ms = atof(GetOpt(a, "ms", "300").c_str());
    if (!(ms >= 0 && ms <= 60000)) return Fail("--ms must be 0..60000");
    int steps = (int)(ms / 20); steps = steps < 3 ? 3 : steps > 200 ? 200 : steps;
    auto coord = [&](std::string& j, const std::string& x, const std::string& y) {
        Put(j, "x", x); Put(j, "y", y); if (HasOpt(a, "norm")) Put(j, "norm", "true"); if (HasOpt(a, "capture-space")) PutS(j, "space", "capture");
    };
    std::string down = "{"; PutS(down, "cmd", "mousedown"); PutS(down, "button", button); coord(down, a.pos[0], a.pos[1]); down += "}";
    std::string move = "{"; PutS(move, "cmd", "mouse"); coord(move, a.pos[2], a.pos[3]); Put(move, "steps", std::to_string(steps)); Put(move, "step_ms", Num(ms / steps)); move += "}";
    std::string up = "{"; PutS(up, "cmd", "mouseup"); PutS(up, "button", button); coord(up, a.pos[2], a.pos[3]); up += "}";
    std::string r1, r2, r3;
    bool ok1 = Request(pid, down, r1) && r1.find("\"ok\":true") != std::string::npos;
    if (!ok1) return {false, "{\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"drag: mouse down failed\",\"down\":" + r1 + "}"};
    bool ok2 = Request(pid, move, r2) && r2.find("\"ok\":true") != std::string::npos;
    bool ok3 = Request(pid, up, r3) && r3.find("\"ok\":true") != std::string::npos;   // always release the button
    const bool ok = ok2 && ok3;
    return {ok, std::string("{\"ok\":") + (ok ? "true" : "false") + ",\"steps\":" + std::to_string(steps) + ",\"ms\":" + Num(ms) + ",\"down\":" + r1 + ",\"move\":" + r2 + ",\"up\":" + r3 + "}"};
}
```

`src/vi_cli_text.inl`:

```inl
// vi_cli_text.inl - click-text / wait-text / assert-text (included by vi_cli_ui.inl).
static std::wstring JoinWords(const vi_text::Line& l, int first, int last) {
    std::wstring s; for (int i = first; i <= last; ++i) { if (i > first) s += L' '; s += l.words[(size_t)i].text; } return s;
}
static std::string AllText(const std::vector<vi_text::Line>& lines, size_t limit = 400) {
    std::wstring s; for (auto& l : lines) { if (!s.empty()) s += L" | "; s += l.text; }
    if (s.size() > limit) s.resize(limit);
    return JU(s);
}
static std::string HitJson(const Frame& f, const std::vector<vi_text::Line>& lines, const vi_text::Hit& h, int index) {
    const vi_text::Box b = ToClient(f, h.box);
    std::string j = "{\"index\":" + std::to_string(index) + ",\"text\":\"" + JU(JoinWords(lines[(size_t)h.line], h.first, h.last)) + "\",\"line\":\"" + JU(h.line_text) +
        "\",\"box\":" + BoxJ(b) + ",\"center\":[" + std::to_string(b.x + b.w / 2) + "," + std::to_string(b.y + b.h / 2) + "],\"match_score\":" + Num(h.score) + "}";
    return j;
}
struct TextQuery { std::wstring text; vi_text::Options opt; std::vector<double> scales; bool autoScale = false; };
static bool ParseTextQuery(const Args& a, const char* cmd, TextQuery& q, std::string& err) {
    if (a.pos.empty() || a.pos[0].empty()) { err = std::string(cmd) + " needs the text to look for"; return false; }
    q.text = U2W(a.pos[0]); q.opt.exact = HasOpt(a, "exact");
    q.opt.fuzzy = atoi(GetOpt(a, "fuzzy", "0").c_str());
    if (q.opt.fuzzy < 0 || q.opt.fuzzy > 3) { err = "--fuzzy must be 0..3"; return false; }
    q.scales = ParseScales(GetOpt(a, "scale", "auto"), q.autoScale, err);
    return !q.scales.empty();
}
// One grab, then OCR passes until something matches: for each scale, the full frame and then (unless --no-tiles) the tiled
// pass merged on top of it. hits/lines describe the pass that matched, or the first pass.
static bool SearchText(DWORD pid, const Args& a, const TextQuery& q, Frame& f, std::vector<vi_text::Line>& lines, std::vector<vi_text::Hit>& hits, std::string& err) {
    if (!Grab(pid, a, f, err)) return false;
    std::string lang; bool first = true;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < q.scales.size(); ++i) {
        std::vector<vi_text::Line> l;
        if (!OcrOnce(f, q.scales[i], a, l, lang, err)) return false;
        for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass) {
            if (pass == 1) { if (HasOpt(a, "no-tiles")) break; if (!OcrTiles(f, q.scales[i], a, l, lang, err)) return false; }
            auto h = vi_text::Find(l, q.text, q.opt);
            if (first || !h.empty()) { lines = l; hits = std::move(h); first = false; }
            if (!hits.empty()) return true;
        }
    }
    return true;
}
static std::string CandidatesJson(const Frame& f, const std::vector<vi_text::Line>& lines, const std::vector<vi_text::Hit>& hits) {
    std::string j = "[";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < hits.size() && i < 20; ++i) j += (i ? "," : "") + HitJson(f, lines, hits[i], (int)i + 1);
    return j + "]";
}
static std::string ClickJson(const Args& a, int x, int y) {
    std::string j = "{"; PutS(j, "cmd", "click"); PutS(j, "button", GetOpt(a, "button", "left")); Put(j, "x", std::to_string(x)); Put(j, "y", std::to_string(y));
    static const char* pass[][2] = {{"count", "count"}, {"ms", "ms"}, {"hover-frames", "hover_frames"}, {"hover-timeout-ms", "hover_timeout_ms"}, {"settle-ms", "settle_ms"}};
    for (auto& p : pass) if (HasOpt(a, p[0])) Put(j, p[1], GetOpt(a, p[0]));
    return j + "}";
}
static bool ParseNth(const Args& a, int& nth, std::string& err) {
    nth = 0; if (!HasOpt(a, "nth")) return true;
    nth = atoi(GetOpt(a, "nth").c_str()); if (nth < 1) { err = "--nth is 1-based (reading order: rows top to bottom, left to right)"; return false; }
    return true;
}

// mode: 0 click-text, 1 wait-text, 2 assert-text
static Reply CmdText(DWORD pid, const Args& a, int mode) {
    const char* name = mode == 0 ? "click-text" : mode == 1 ? "wait-text" : "assert-text";
    TextQuery q; std::string err;
    if (!ParseTextQuery(a, name, q, err)) return Fail(err);
    int nth; if (!ParseNth(a, nth, err)) return Fail(err);
    const bool gone = HasOpt(a, "gone") || HasOpt(a, "absent");
    if (mode == 0 && gone) return Fail("--gone only applies to wait-text / assert-text");
    double timeout = atof(GetOpt(a, "timeout", mode == 0 ? "5000" : mode == 1 ? "15000" : "0").c_str());
    if (!(timeout >= 0 && timeout <= 600000)) return Fail("--timeout is milliseconds, 0..600000");
    const DWORD t0 = GetTickCount(); unsigned polls = 0;
    Frame f; std::vector<vi_text::Line> lines; std::vector<vi_text::Hit> hits;
    for (;;) {
        if (!SearchText(pid, a, q, f, lines, hits, err)) return Fail(err, "\"polls\":" + std::to_string(polls));
        ++polls;
        const DWORD elapsed = GetTickCount() - t0;
        std::string stats = "\"elapsed_ms\":" + std::to_string(elapsed) + ",\"polls\":" + std::to_string(polls);
        if (mode == 0) {
            if (!hits.empty()) {
                if (nth == 0 && hits.size() > 1)
                    return Fail("ambiguous: " + std::to_string(hits.size()) + " matches for the text; pass --nth N (1-based, reading order) or --exact; nothing was clicked",
                                "\"ambiguous\":true,\"match_count\":" + std::to_string(hits.size()) + ",\"candidates\":" + CandidatesJson(f, lines, hits) + "," + stats);
                if (nth > (int)hits.size())
                    return Fail("--nth " + std::to_string(nth) + " but only " + std::to_string(hits.size()) + " matches; nothing was clicked", "\"match_count\":" + std::to_string(hits.size()) + ",\"candidates\":" + CandidatesJson(f, lines, hits) + "," + stats);
                const int index = nth ? nth : 1; const vi_text::Hit& h = hits[(size_t)index - 1];
                const vi_text::Box b = ToClient(f, h.box); const int cx = b.x + b.w / 2, cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
                std::string match = HitJson(f, lines, h, index);
                if (HasOpt(a, "dry-run")) return {true, "{\"ok\":true,\"clicked\":false,\"dry_run\":true,\"match\":" + match + ",\"match_count\":" + std::to_string(hits.size()) + "," + kNoConfidence + "," + stats + "}"};
                std::string resp; bool ok = Request(pid, ClickJson(a, cx, cy), resp) && resp.find("\"ok\":true") != std::string::npos;
                return {ok, std::string("{\"ok\":") + (ok ? "true" : "false") + ",\"clicked\":" + (ok ? "true" : "false") + ",\"match\":" + match + ",\"match_count\":" + std::to_string(hits.size()) + "," + kNoConfidence + "," + stats + ",\"click\":" + resp + "}"};
            }
        } else if (gone ? hits.empty() : !hits.empty()) {
            std::string match = hits.empty() ? "null" : HitJson(f, lines, hits[(size_t)((nth ? nth : 1) <= (int)hits.size() ? (nth ? nth : 1) : 1) - 1], nth ? nth : 1);
            return {true, std::string("{\"ok\":true,\"found\":") + (hits.empty() ? "false" : "true") + ",\"gone\":" + (hits.empty() ? "true" : "false") + ",\"match\":" + match + ",\"match_count\":" + std::to_string(hits.size()) + "," + stats + "}"};
        }
        if (elapsed >= timeout) {
            if (mode == 0 && HasOpt(a, "optional")) return {true, "{\"ok\":true,\"clicked\":false,\"skipped\":true,\"reason\":\"text not present (--optional)\"," + stats + "}"};
            if (mode == 1 && !gone && HasOpt(a, "optional")) return {true, "{\"ok\":true,\"found\":false,\"skipped\":true,\"reason\":\"text not present (--optional)\"," + stats + "}"};
            const std::string what = mode == 0 ? "text not found" : gone ? "text still present" : "text not found";
            return Fail(std::string(name) + ": " + what + (timeout > 0 ? " before timeout" : ""),
                        std::string("\"timed_out\":") + (timeout > 0 ? "true" : "false") + ",\"match_count\":" + std::to_string(hits.size()) + ",\"ocr_saw\":\"" + AllText(lines) + "\"," + stats);
        }
        Sleep(250);
    }
}
```

`src/vi_cli_ui.inl`:

```inl
// vi_cli_ui.inl - UI-navigation commands of vinput.exe (textually included by vinput_cli.cpp, after the pipe client,
// Args helpers, Reply and WaitChange). Everything here runs in the CLI process; nothing is loaded into the game.
//   ocr  click-text  wait-text  assert-text  find-image  click-image  wait-image  pixel  scroll  drag  script
// Boxes in replies are [x,y,w,h] in CLIENT pixels (identical to capture pixels when the swapchain matches the window;
// the capture's origin/scale is applied when --region or a differently-sized swapchain is in play).

static double JsonNum(const std::string& json, const char* key, double def = 0) {
    std::string mark = "\"" + std::string(key) + "\":";
    size_t p = json.find(mark); if (p == std::string::npos) return def;
    return atof(json.c_str() + p + mark.size());
}
static std::string JU(const std::wstring& w) { return JEsc(W2U(w)); }
static std::string Num(double v) { char b[64]; sprintf_s(b, "%.3f", v); std::string s = b; while (s.size() > 1 && s.back() == '0') s.pop_back(); if (!s.empty() && s.back() == '.') s.pop_back(); return s; }

struct Frame {
    vi_vision::Image img;
    double ox = 0, oy = 0, sx = 1, sy = 1;   // client = origin + image * scale
    int clientW = 0, clientH = 0;
    std::string method, hash;
};
static vi_text::Box ToClient(const Frame& f, const vi_text::Box& b) {
    const int x0 = (int)std::lround(f.ox + b.x * f.sx), y0 = (int)std::lround(f.oy + b.y * f.sy);
    const int x1 = (int)std::lround(f.ox + (b.x + b.w) * f.sx), y1 = (int)std::lround(f.oy + (b.y + b.h) * f.sy);
    return {x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0};
}
static std::string BoxJ(const vi_text::Box& b) { return "[" + std::to_string(b.x) + "," + std::to_string(b.y) + "," + std::to_string(b.w) + "," + std::to_string(b.h) + "]"; }

// <dist>\run\logs, created and granted to AppContainers (a UWP target can only write there).
static std::wstring AcLogsDir() {
    // An inherited logs directory may be owned by another/elevated agent. Create a
    // caller-owned staging directory so granting its DACL does not require elevation.
    static const std::wstring logs = ExeDir() + L"\\run\\capture_" + std::to_wstring(GetCurrentProcessId()) + L"_" + std::to_wstring(GetTickCount64());
    CreateDirectoryW((ExeDir() + L"\\run").c_str(), nullptr); CreateDirectoryW(logs.c_str(), nullptr);
    std::string e;
    if (!GrantAppContainers(logs, FILE_GENERIC_READ | FILE_GENERIC_WRITE | DELETE, true, e)) {
        fprintf(stderr,"[vinput] capture staging permission failed: %s\n",e.c_str()); RemoveDirectoryW(logs.c_str()); return {};
    }
    return logs;
}
static bool Grab(DWORD pid, const Args& a, Frame& f, std::string& err) {
    std::wstring dir = QueryTargetToken(pid).appContainer ? AcLogsDir() : ExeDir() + L"\\logs"; CreateDirectoryW(dir.c_str(), nullptr);
    if (dir.empty()) { err="cannot grant AppContainer capture staging directory"; return false; }
    std::wstring path = dir + L"\\ui_" + std::to_wstring(pid) + L"_" + std::to_wstring(GetCurrentProcessId()) + L".png";
    std::string cmd = "{"; PutS(cmd, "cmd", "capture"); PutS(cmd, "path", W2U(path));
    if (HasOpt(a, "region")) PutS(cmd, "region", GetOpt(a, "region"));
    if (HasOpt(a, "method")) PutS(cmd, "method", GetOpt(a, "method"));
    if (HasOpt(a, "after-frames")) Put(cmd, "after_frames", GetOpt(a, "after-frames"));
    cmd += "}";
    std::string resp;
    if (!Request(pid, cmd, resp) || resp.find("\"ok\":true") == std::string::npos) {
        err = JsonText(resp, "error"); if (err.empty()) err = resp; return false;
    }
    std::string e;
    if (!vi_vision::LoadPng(path, f.img, e)) { err = "cannot read capture PNG: " + e; DeleteFileW(path.c_str()); return false; }
    DeleteFileW(path.c_str());
    if (QueryTargetToken(pid).appContainer) RemoveDirectoryW(dir.c_str());
    const double w = JsonNum(resp, "w"), h = JsonNum(resp, "h");
    f.ox = JsonNum(resp, "origin_x"); f.oy = JsonNum(resp, "origin_y");
    f.sx = w > 0 ? JsonNum(resp, "region_client_w", w) / w : 1; f.sy = h > 0 ? JsonNum(resp, "region_client_h", h) / h : 1;
    f.clientW = (int)JsonNum(resp, "client_w"); f.clientH = (int)JsonNum(resp, "client_h");
    f.method = JsonText(resp, "method"); f.hash = JsonText(resp, "hash");
    return true;
}

// ---- OCR ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
static std::vector<double> ParseScales(const std::string& s, bool& autoScale, std::string& err) {
    autoScale = false; std::vector<double> v;
    if (s.empty() || s == "auto") { autoScale = true; return {1.0, 2.0}; }
    size_t i = 0;
    while (i <= s.size()) {
        size_t c = s.find(',', i); if (c == std::string::npos) c = s.size();
        std::string t = s.substr(i, c - i); char* end = nullptr; double d = strtod(t.c_str(), &end);
        if (t.empty() || *end || !(d >= 0.2 && d <= 5)) { err = "scale list must be numbers 0.2..5 (or auto)"; return {}; }
        v.push_back(d); i = c + 1;
    }
    return v;
}
static bool OcrOnce(const Frame& f, double scale, const Args& a, std::vector<vi_text::Line>& lines, std::string& lang, std::string& err) {
    return vi_ocr::Recognize(f.img, (std::max)(1.0, scale), GetOpt(a, "lang"), lines, lang, err);
}
// Windows OCR layout analysis is not stable: the same words can vanish from a full frame and appear in a crop
// (seen on the synthetic target: OPTIONS and QUIT missing at 800x450, found in a 400x450 half). Tiled pass: 2x3
// overlapping tiles, merged into `lines` (a tile line replaces an overlapping line only when its text is longer).
static double LineOverlap(const vi_text::Box& a, const vi_text::Box& b) {
    const int l = (std::max)(a.x, b.x), t = (std::max)(a.y, b.y), r = (std::min)(a.x + a.w, b.x + b.w), bo = (std::min)(a.y + a.h, b.y + b.h);
    if (r <= l || bo <= t) return 0;
    const double inter = (double)(r - l) * (bo - t);
    return inter / (std::min)((double)a.w * a.h, (double)b.w * b.h);
}
static bool OcrTiles(const Frame& f, double scale, const Args& a, std::vector<vi_text::Line>& lines, std::string& lang, std::string& err) {
    const int W = f.img.w, H = f.img.h;
    if (W < 64 || H < 64) return true;
    const int tw = (std::min)(W, (int)std::ceil(W * 0.6)), th = (std::min)(H, (int)std::ceil(H * 0.45));
    const int xs[2] = {0, W - tw}, ys[3] = {0, (H - th) / 2, H - th};
    for (int yi = 0; yi < 3; ++yi) for (int xi = 0; xi < 2; ++xi) {
        vi_vision::Image tile; std::string e;
        if (!vi_vision::Crop(f.img, {xs[xi], ys[yi], tw, th}, tile, e)) { err = e; return false; }
        std::vector<vi_text::Line> tl;
        if (!vi_ocr::Recognize(tile, (std::max)(1.0, scale), GetOpt(a, "lang"), tl, lang, err)) return false;
        for (auto& line : tl) {
            line.box.x += xs[xi]; line.box.y += ys[yi];
            for (auto& w : line.words) { w.box.x += xs[xi]; w.box.y += ys[yi]; }
            int match = -1;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < lines.size(); ++i) if (LineOverlap(lines[i].box, line.box) > 0.5) { match = (int)i; break; }
            if (match < 0) lines.push_back(std::move(line));
            else if (line.text.size() > lines[(size_t)match].text.size()) lines[(size_t)match] = std::move(line);
        }
    }
    return true;
}
static std::string LineJson(const Frame& f, const vi_text::Line& l, bool words) {
    std::string j = "{\"text\":\"" + JU(l.text) + "\",\"box\":" + BoxJ(ToClient(f, l.box));
    if (words) {
        j += ",\"words\":[";
        for (size_t i = 0; i < l.words.size(); ++i) j += (i ? "," : "") + std::string("{\"text\":\"") + JU(l.words[i].text) + "\",\"box\":" + BoxJ(ToClient(f, l.words[i].box)) + "}";
        j += "]";
    }
    return j + "}";
}
static const char* kNoConfidence = "\"ocr_confidence\":null,\"ocr_confidence_note\":\"Windows.Media.Ocr reports no confidence; match_score is textual (1 = literal match, <1 = fuzzy)\"";

static Reply CmdOcr(DWORD pid, const Args& a) {
    bool autoScale; std::string err; auto scales = ParseScales(GetOpt(a, "scale", "1"), autoScale, err);
    if (scales.empty()) return Fail(err);
    Frame f; if (!Grab(pid, a, f, err)) return Fail(err);
    std::vector<vi_text::Line> lines; std::string lang;
    DWORD t0 = GetTickCount();
    if (!OcrOnce(f, scales[0], a, lines, lang, err)) return Fail(err);
    if (HasOpt(a, "tiles") && !OcrTiles(f, scales[0], a, lines, lang, err)) return Fail(err);
    const bool words = !HasOpt(a, "lines-only");
    std::string j = "{\"ok\":true,\"w\":" + std::to_string(f.img.w) + ",\"h\":" + std::to_string(f.img.h) + ",\"origin_x\":" + Num(f.ox) + ",\"origin_y\":" + Num(f.oy) +
        ",\"client_w\":" + std::to_string(f.clientW) + ",\"client_h\":" + std::to_string(f.clientH) + ",\"method\":\"" + f.method + "\",\"lang\":\"" + JEsc(lang) +
        "\",\"scale\":" + Num(scales[0]) + ",\"ocr_ms\":" + std::to_string(GetTickCount() - t0) + "," + kNoConfidence + ",\"line_count\":" + std::to_string(lines.size());
    std::wstring text; for (auto& l : lines) { if (!text.empty()) text += L"\n"; text += l.text; }
    j += ",\"text\":\"" + JU(text) + "\",\"lines\":[";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < lines.size(); ++i) j += (i ? "," : "") + LineJson(f, lines[i], words);
    j += "]}";
    if (HasOpt(a, "out")) {
        FILE* o = nullptr; _wfopen_s(&o, U2W(GetOpt(a, "out")).c_str(), L"wb");
        if (!o) return Fail("cannot write --out file");
        fwrite(j.data(), 1, j.size(), o); fclose(o);
        return {true, "{\"ok\":true,\"out\":\"" + JEsc(GetOpt(a, "out")) + "\",\"line_count\":" + std::to_string(lines.size()) + ",\"lang\":\"" + JEsc(lang) + "\"}"};
    }
    return {true, j};
}

#include "vi_cli_text.inl"   //@text
#include "vi_cli_image.inl"  //@image
#include "vi_cli_small.inl"  //@small

// ---- dispatch + script -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
static Reply RunScript(DWORD pid, const Args& a);   //@script
static Reply Dispatch(DWORD pid, const std::vector<std::string>& tk) {
    const std::string& cmd = tk[0];
    Args a = SplitArgs(std::vector<std::string>(tk.begin() + 1, tk.end()));
    if (cmd == "ocr") return CmdOcr(pid, a);
    if (cmd == "click-text") return CmdText(pid, a, 0); //@text
    if (cmd == "wait-text") return CmdText(pid, a, 1); //@text
    if (cmd == "assert-text") return CmdText(pid, a, 2); //@text
    if (cmd == "click-image") return CmdImage(pid, a, 0); //@image
    if (cmd == "wait-image") return CmdImage(pid, a, 1); //@image
    if (cmd == "find-image") return CmdImage(pid, a, 2); //@image
    if (cmd == "pixel") return CmdPixel(pid, a); //@small
    if (cmd == "scroll") return CmdScroll(pid, a); //@small
    if (cmd == "drag") return CmdDrag(pid, a); //@small
    if (cmd == "wait-change") return WaitChange(pid, a);
    if (cmd == "script") return RunScript(pid, a); //@script
    std::string j, err, resp;
    if (!BuildJson(tk, j, err)) return Fail(err);
    // An AppContainer target cannot write to the caller's folder: it writes the PNG into the granted
    // <dist>\run\logs folder and we move it to the requested path.
    std::wstring staged, wanted;
    if (cmd == "capture" && !a.pos.empty() && QueryTargetToken(pid).appContainer) {
        wchar_t full[MAX_PATH]; GetFullPathNameW(U2W(a.pos[0]).c_str(), MAX_PATH, full, nullptr); wanted = full;
        std::wstring stagingDir=AcLogsDir();
        if(stagingDir.empty()) return Fail("cannot grant AppContainer capture staging directory");
        staged = stagingDir + L"\\capture_" + std::to_wstring(pid) + L"_" + std::to_wstring(GetTickCount()) + L".png";
        std::string from = "\"path\":\"" + JEsc(W2U(wanted)) + "\"", to = "\"path\":\"" + JEsc(W2U(staged)) + "\"";
        size_t at = j.find(from); if (at != std::string::npos) { j.replace(at, from.size(), to); fprintf(stderr,"[vinput] staging AppContainer capture: %s\n", W2U(staged).c_str()); } else { return Fail("AppContainer capture path could not be staged"); }
    }
    bool ok = Request(pid, j, resp);
    if (!staged.empty() && ok && resp.find("\"ok\":true") != std::string::npos) {
        std::string from = "\"path\":\"" + JEsc(W2U(staged)) + "\"", to = "\"path\":\"" + JEsc(W2U(wanted)) + "\"";
        if (!MoveFileExW(staged.c_str(), wanted.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_COPY_ALLOWED)) {
            DWORD e = GetLastError(); DeleteFileW(staged.c_str());
            return Fail("AppContainer capture: cannot move staged PNG to the requested path (" + std::to_string(e) + ")");
        }
        size_t at = resp.find(from); if (at != std::string::npos) resp.replace(at, from.size(), to);
    }
    if(!staged.empty()) { DeleteFileW(staged.c_str()); RemoveDirectoryW(staged.substr(0,staged.find_last_of(L'\\')).c_str()); }
    return {ok && resp.find("\"ok\":true") != std::string::npos, resp};
}

#include "vi_cli_script.inl"  //@script
```

```h
            {"period", 0xBE}, {".", 0xBE}, {"slash", 0xBF}, {"/", 0xBF},
            {"semicolon", 0xBA}, {";", 0xBA}, {"quote", 0xDE}, {"apostrophe", 0xDE},
            {"grave", 0xC0}, {"tilde", 0xC0}, {"backquote", 0xC0},
            {"lbracket", 0xDB}, {"[", 0xDB}, {"rbracket", 0xDD}, {"]", 0xDD},
            {"backslash", 0xDC},
        };
        for (const auto& entry : aliases) {
            add(entry.name, entry.vk);
            // Both SDK spellings (oem_102) and compact spellings (oem102) are accepted.
            std::string compact(entry.name);
            compact.erase(std::remove(compact.begin(), compact.end(), '_'), compact.end());
            add(compact, entry.vk);
        }
        for (int vk = 1; vk <= 255; ++vk) add("vk" + std::to_string(vk), vk);
        return result;
    }();
    return names;
}

inline std::string Normalize(std::string name) {
    const size_t first = name.find_first_not_of(" \t\r\n");
    if (first == std::string::npos) return {};
    name = name.substr(first, name.find_last_not_of(" \t\r\n") - first + 1);
    for (char& ch : name) ch = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch)));
    if (name.compare(0, 3, "vk_") == 0) name.erase(0, 3);
    return name;
}

inline bool ParseNumber(const std::string& text, size_t start, unsigned base, int& vk) {
    if (start >= text.size()) return false;
    unsigned value = 0;
    for (size_t i = start; i < text.size(); ++i) {
        const unsigned char ch = static_cast<unsigned char>(text[i]);
        unsigned digit = 256;
        if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') digit = ch - '0';
        else if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'f') digit = ch - 'a' + 10;
        if (digit >= base || value > (255 - digit) / base) return false;
        value = value * base + digit;
    }
    if (!value || value > 255) return false;
    vk = static_cast<int>(value);
    return true;
}

inline bool ParseKey(const std::string& text, int& vk) {
    vk = 0;
    const std::string name = Normalize(text);
    if (name.compare(0, 2, "0x") == 0) return ParseNumber(name, 2, 16, vk);
    if (name.size() > 2 && name.compare(0, 2, "vk") == 0 && name[2] >= '0' && name[2] <= '9')
        return ParseNumber(name, 2, 10, vk);
    for (const auto& entry : Names()) if (entry.name == name) { vk = entry.vk; return true; }
    return false;
}

inline int VkFromName(const std::string& text) {
    int vk = 0;
    return ParseKey(text, vk) ? vk : 0;
}

inline std::string Name(int vk) {
    for (const auto& entry : Names()) if (entry.vk == vk) return entry.name;
    return {};
}

namespace detail {
inline bool ParseChordAt(const std::string& text, size_t start, unsigned depth, std::vector<int>& keys) {
    if (start >= text.size() || depth > 255) return false;
    // Longest matching token first makes the '+' in num+ a key-name character.
    // Its chord delimiter is a second '+': ctrl+num++w. Literal '+' works as ctrl++.
    for (size_t end = text.size(); end > start; --end) {
        if (end != text.size() && text[end] != '+') continue;
        int vk = 0;
        if (!ParseKey(text.substr(start, end - start), vk)) continue;
        keys.push_back(vk);
        if (end == text.size() || ParseChordAt(text, end + 1, depth + 1, keys)) return true;
        keys.pop_back();
    }
    return false;
}
}  // namespace detail

inline bool ParseChord(const std::string& text, std::vector<int>& keys, std::string* error = nullptr) {
    keys.clear();
    if (error) error->clear();
    if (text.size() > 4096 || !detail::ParseChordAt(text, 0, 0, keys)) {
        keys.clear();
        if (error) *error = "unknown or malformed key chord: " + text;
        return false;
    }
    // A chord is a simultaneous state: repeated aliases of one VK must not release it early.
    std::vector<int> unique;
    for (int vk : keys) if (std::find(unique.begin(), unique.end(), vk) == unique.end()) unique.push_back(vk);
    keys.swap(unique);
    return true;
}

inline std::vector<int> ParseCombo(const std::string& text) {
    std::vector<int> keys;
    ParseChord(text, keys);
    return keys;
}
}  // namespace vi_keys
```

`src/vi_ncc.h`:

```h
// Normalized cross-correlation template matching for vinput UI navigation (CLI process only).
//
//  * Greyscale (Rec.601) zero-mean NCC, so uniform brightness/contrast changes do not matter. Score range -1..1;
//    1.0 = identical up to gain/offset. A flat (textureless) template is refused: NCC is undefined for it.
//  * Scale: the template is tried at several scales (default 0.85 0.92 1.0 1.08 1.18) and each hit reports the
//    scale that matched. Larger differences (e.g. a UI scaled 1.5x) are NOT found: pass --scales explicitly.
//    Rotation, perspective and non-uniform scaling are not handled.
//  * Speed: coarse search on a box-downsampled pyramid level (factor 1/2/4 chosen so the template keeps >= 8 px),
//    then a full-resolution refinement around each coarse peak. Alpha is ignored.
#pragma once
#include "vi_vision.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>

namespace vi_ncc {
using vi_vision::Image;
struct Match { int x = 0, y = 0, w = 0, h = 0; double score = 0, scale = 1; };
struct Options {
    double threshold = 0.80;
    std::vector<double> scales{0.85, 0.92, 1.0, 1.08, 1.18};
    std::size_t max_matches = 50;
    double nms_iou = 0.30;
};
struct Result { std::vector<Match> matches; Match best; bool have_best = false; std::string error; };

struct Plane { int w = 0, h = 0; std::vector<float> v; };

inline Plane Gray(const Image& im) {
    Plane p; p.w = im.w; p.h = im.h; p.v.resize(static_cast<size_t>(im.w) * im.h);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < p.v.size(); ++i) {
        const std::uint8_t* q = &im.pixels[i * 4u];
        p.v[i] = 0.114f * q[0] + 0.587f * q[1] + 0.299f * q[2];
    }
    return p;
}
inline Plane Resample(const Plane& s, int nw, int nh) {  // area average when shrinking, bilinear when growing
    Plane o; o.w = nw; o.h = nh; o.v.resize(static_cast<size_t>(nw) * nh);
    const double sx = static_cast<double>(s.w) / nw, sy = static_cast<double>(s.h) / nh;
    for (int y = 0; y < nh; ++y) for (int x = 0; x < nw; ++x) {
        if (sx >= 1.0 || sy >= 1.0) {
            const int x0 = static_cast<int>(x * sx), x1 = (std::min)(s.w, (std::max)(x0 + 1, static_cast<int>(std::ceil((x + 1) * sx))));
            const int y0 = static_cast<int>(y * sy), y1 = (std::min)(s.h, (std::max)(y0 + 1, static_cast<int>(std::ceil((y + 1) * sy))));
            double acc = 0; int n = 0;
            for (int yy = y0; yy < y1; ++yy) for (int xx = x0; xx < x1; ++xx) { acc += s.v[static_cast<size_t>(yy) * s.w + xx]; ++n; }
            o.v[static_cast<size_t>(y) * nw + x] = static_cast<float>(acc / (std::max)(1, n));
        } else {
            const double fx = (x + 0.5) * sx - 0.5, fy = (y + 0.5) * sy - 0.5;
            const int x0 = (std::max)(0, static_cast<int>(std::floor(fx))), y0 = (std::max)(0, static_cast<int>(std::floor(fy)));
            const int x1 = (std::min)(s.w - 1, x0 + 1), y1 = (std::min)(s.h - 1, y0 + 1);
            const double wx = (std::max)(0.0, fx - x0), wy = (std::max)(0.0, fy - y0);
            auto at = [&](int xx, int yy) { return static_cast<double>(s.v[static_cast<size_t>(yy) * s.w + xx]); };
            o.v[static_cast<size_t>(y) * nw + x] = static_cast<float>((at(x0, y0) * (1 - wx) + at(x1, y0) * wx) * (1 - wy) + (at(x0, y1) * (1 - wx) + at(x1, y1) * wx) * wy);
        }
    }
    return o;
}

struct Template {
    int w = 0, h = 0; std::vector<float> zero_mean; double norm = 0;
    explicit Template(const Plane& p) : w(p.w), h(p.h), zero_mean(p.v) {
        double mean = 0; for (float f : p.v) mean += f; mean /= static_cast<double>(p.v.size());
        double sq = 0; for (float& f : zero_mean) { f = static_cast<float>(f - mean); sq += static_cast<double>(f) * f; }
        norm = std::sqrt(sq);
    }
    bool Flat() const { return norm / std::sqrt(static_cast<double>(w) * h) < 2.0; }  // std-dev below 2 grey levels
};

// Score of the template at (x, y). Window must fit.
inline double ScoreAt(const Plane& im, const Template& t, int x, int y) {
    double sum = 0, sum2 = 0, cross = 0;
    for (int ty = 0; ty < t.h; ++ty) {
        const float* row = &im.v[static_cast<size_t>(y + ty) * im.w + x];
        const float* tz = &t.zero_mean[static_cast<size_t>(ty) * t.w];
        for (int tx = 0; tx < t.w; ++tx) { const double v = row[tx]; sum += v; sum2 += v * v; cross += v * tz[tx]; }
    }
    const double n = static_cast<double>(t.w) * t.h, var = sum2 - sum * sum / n;
    if (var < 1e-3 * n) return 0.0;
    return cross / (t.norm * std::sqrt(var));
}

// Full coarse map via integral images.
inline void ScoreMap(const Plane& im, const Template& t, std::vector<float>& out, int& ow, int& oh) {
    ow = im.w - t.w + 1; oh = im.h - t.h + 1; out.assign(static_cast<size_t>((std::max)(0, ow)) * (std::max)(0, oh), 0.f);
    if (ow <= 0 || oh <= 0) return;
    const size_t iw = static_cast<size_t>(im.w) + 1;
    std::vector<double> s1((im.h + 1) * iw, 0.0), s2((im.h + 1) * iw, 0.0);
    for (int y = 0; y < im.h; ++y) {
        double r1 = 0, r2 = 0;
        for (int x = 0; x < im.w; ++x) {
            const double v = im.v[static_cast<size_t>(y) * im.w + x]; r1 += v; r2 += v * v;
            s1[(y + 1) * iw + x + 1] = s1[y * iw + x + 1] + r1; s2[(y + 1) * iw + x + 1] = s2[y * iw + x + 1] + r2;
        }
    }
    const double n = static_cast<double>(t.w) * t.h;
    for (int y = 0; y < oh; ++y) for (int x = 0; x < ow; ++x) {
        const size_t a = static_cast<size_t>(y) * iw + x, b = a + t.w, c = static_cast<size_t>(y + t.h) * iw + x, d = c + t.w;
        const double sum = s1[d] - s1[b] - s1[c] + s1[a], sum2 = s2[d] - s2[b] - s2[c] + s2[a], var = sum2 - sum * sum / n;
        if (var < 1e-3 * n) continue;
        double cross = 0;
        for (int ty = 0; ty < t.h; ++ty) {
            const float* row = &im.v[static_cast<size_t>(y + ty) * im.w + x]; const float* tz = &t.zero_mean[static_cast<size_t>(ty) * t.w];
            for (int tx = 0; tx < t.w; ++tx) cross += static_cast<double>(row[tx]) * tz[tx];
        }
        out[static_cast<size_t>(y) * ow + x] = static_cast<float>(cross / (t.norm * std::sqrt(var)));
    }
}

inline double Iou(const Match& a, const Match& b) {
    const int l = (std::max)(a.x, b.x), t = (std::max)(a.y, b.y), r = (std::min)(a.x + a.w, b.x + b.w), bo = (std::min)(a.y + a.h, b.y + b.h);
    if (r <= l || bo <= t) return 0;
    const double inter = static_cast<double>(r - l) * (bo - t);
    return inter / (static_cast<double>(a.w) * a.h + static_cast<double>(b.w) * b.h - inter);
}

inline Result Find(const Image& image, const Image& pattern, const Options& options = {}) {
    Result result;
    if (!vi_vision::Validate(image, result.error) || !vi_vision::Validate(pattern, result.error)) return result;
    if (!(options.threshold > -1.0 && options.threshold <= 1.0) || options.scales.empty()) { result.error = "invalid threshold or scale list"; return result; }
    const Plane im = Gray(image), tp = Gray(pattern);
    if (Template(tp).Flat()) { result.error = "template has no texture (flat colour): normalized correlation is undefined for it"; return result; }
    std::vector<Match> pool;
    for (double scale : options.scales) {
        if (!(scale >= 0.2 && scale <= 5.0)) { result.error = "scale must be 0.2..5"; return result; }
        const int sw = (std::max)(1, static_cast<int>(std::lround(tp.w * scale))), sh = (std::max)(1, static_cast<int>(std::lround(tp.h * scale)));
        if (sw > im.w || sh > im.h || sw < 4 || sh < 4) continue;
        const Plane full = (sw == tp.w && sh == tp.h) ? tp : Resample(tp, sw, sh);
        const Template tfull(full);
        if (tfull.Flat()) continue;
        const int smallest = (std::min)(sw, sh), f = smallest >= 32 ? 4 : smallest >= 16 ? 2 : 1;
        std::vector<Match> peaks;
        if (f == 1) {
            std::vector<float> map; int ow, oh; ScoreMap(im, tfull, map, ow, oh);
            for (int y = 0; y < oh; ++y) for (int x = 0; x < ow; ++x) {
                const float v = map[static_cast<size_t>(y) * ow + x]; if (v < options.threshold) continue;
                bool peak = true;
                for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1 && peak; ++dy) for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; ++dx) {
                    const int nx = x + dx, ny = y + dy; if ((!dx && !dy) || nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= ow || ny >= oh) continue;
                    if (map[static_cast<size_t>(ny) * ow + nx] > v) { peak = false; break; }
                }
                if (peak) peaks.push_back({x, y, sw, sh, v, scale});
            }
        } else {
            const Plane imc = Resample(im, (std::max)(1, im.w / f), (std::max)(1, im.h / f)), tc = Resample(full, (std::max)(2, sw / f), (std::max)(2, sh / f));
            const Template tcoarse(tc);
            if (tcoarse.Flat() || tc.w > imc.w || tc.h > imc.h) continue;
            std::vector<float> map; int ow, oh; ScoreMap(imc, tcoarse, map, ow, oh);
            const double loose = (std::max)(0.2, options.threshold - 0.25);
            std::vector<Match> coarse;
            for (int y = 0; y < oh; ++y) for (int x = 0; x < ow; ++x) {
                const float v = map[static_cast<size_t>(y) * ow + x]; if (v < loose) continue;
                bool peak = true;
                for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1 && peak; ++dy) for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; ++dx) {
                    const int nx = x + dx, ny = y + dy; if ((!dx && !dy) || nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= ow || ny >= oh) continue;
                    if (map[static_cast<size_t>(ny) * ow + nx] > v) { peak = false; break; }
                }
                if (peak) coarse.push_back({x * f, y * f, sw, sh, v, scale});
            }
            std::sort(coarse.begin(), coarse.end(), [](const Match& a, const Match& b) { return a.score > b.score; });
            if (coarse.size() > 60) coarse.resize(60);
            for (const Match& c : coarse) {
                Match best = c; best.score = -2;
                for (int dy = -(f + 1); dy <= f + 1; ++dy) for (int dx = -(f + 1); dx <= f + 1; ++dx) {
                    const int x = c.x + dx, y = c.y + dy; if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x + sw > im.w || y + sh > im.h) continue;
                    const double s = ScoreAt(im, tfull, x, y); if (s > best.score) { best.x = x; best.y = y; best.score = s; }
                }
                if (best.score >= options.threshold) peaks.push_back(best);
            }
        }
        for (const Match& p : peaks) pool.push_back(p);
    }
    std::stable_sort(pool.begin(), pool.end(), [](const Match& a, const Match& b) { return a.score > b.score; });
    for (const Match& m : pool) {
        bool suppressed = false;
        for (const Match& e : result.matches) if (Iou(m, e) > options.nms_iou) { suppressed = true; break; }
        if (suppressed) continue;
        if (result.matches.size() >= options.max_matches) break;
        result.matches.push_back(m);
    }
    if (!result.matches.empty()) { result.best = result.matches.front(); result.have_best = true; }
    return result;
}
}
```

`src/vi_ocr.h`:

```h
// Windows.Media.Ocr wrapper for the vinput CLI (never loaded into a game process).
// Input: BGRA image in capture pixels. Output: lines/words with boxes in the SAME pixel space
// (boxes are divided back by the up-scale factor).
// The WinRT OcrEngine reports NO per-word confidence, so none is invented here.
#pragma once
#include "vi_text.h"
#include "vi_vision.h"
#include <winrt/Windows.Foundation.h>
#include <winrt/Windows.Foundation.Collections.h>
#include <winrt/Windows.Globalization.h>
#include <winrt/Windows.Graphics.Imaging.h>
#include <winrt/Windows.Media.Ocr.h>
#include <winrt/Windows.Storage.Streams.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "windowsapp.lib")

namespace vi_ocr {
inline std::string Narrow(const winrt::hstring& h) {
    std::wstring w(h.c_str(), h.size());
    if (w.empty()) return {};
    int n = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, w.c_str(), static_cast<int>(w.size()), nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
    std::string s(static_cast<size_t>(n), '\0');
    WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, w.c_str(), static_cast<int>(w.size()), &s[0], n, nullptr, nullptr);
    return s;
}

// Bilinear up-scale (integer or fractional factor >= 1) of a BGRA image.
inline vi_vision::Image Upscale(const vi_vision::Image& src, double factor) {
    if (factor <= 1.0001) return src;
    vi_vision::Image out;
    out.w = static_cast<int>(src.w * factor + 0.5); out.h = static_cast<int>(src.h * factor + 0.5);
    out.pixels.resize(static_cast<size_t>(out.w) * out.h * 4u);
    for (int y = 0; y < out.h; ++y) {
        const double fy = (y + 0.5) / factor - 0.5; const int y0 = (std::max)(0, static_cast<int>(std::floor(fy))), y1 = (std::min)(src.h - 1, y0 + 1);
        const double wy = (std::max)(0.0, fy - y0);
        for (int x = 0; x < out.w; ++x) {
            const double fx = (x + 0.5) / factor - 0.5; const int x0 = (std::max)(0, static_cast<int>(std::floor(fx))), x1 = (std::min)(src.w - 1, x0 + 1);
            const double wx = (std::max)(0.0, fx - x0);
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) {
                auto at = [&](int xx, int yy) { return static_cast<double>(src.pixels[(static_cast<size_t>(yy) * src.w + xx) * 4u + c]); };
                const double v = (at(x0, y0) * (1 - wx) + at(x1, y0) * wx) * (1 - wy) + (at(x0, y1) * (1 - wx) + at(x1, y1) * wx) * wy;
                out.pixels[(static_cast<size_t>(y) * out.w + x) * 4u + c] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v + 0.5);
            }
        }
    }
    return out;
}

// scale >= 1. lang empty = the user's profile languages. Returns false with `error` on failure.
inline bool Recognize(const vi_vision::Image& image, double scale, const std::string& lang,
                      std::vector<vi_text::Line>& lines, std::string& usedLanguage, std::string& error) {
    namespace wgi = winrt::Windows::Graphics::Imaging;
    namespace wmo = winrt::Windows::Media::Ocr;
    namespace wss = winrt::Windows::Storage::Streams;
    try {
        winrt::init_apartment(winrt::apartment_type::multi_threaded);
        wmo::OcrEngine engine{nullptr};
        if (lang.empty()) engine = wmo::OcrEngine::TryCreateFromUserProfileLanguages();
        else {
            std::wstring wl(lang.begin(), lang.end());
            auto language = winrt::Windows::Globalization::Language(winrt::hstring(wl));
            if (!wmo::OcrEngine::IsLanguageSupported(language)) { error = "OCR language not supported/installed: " + lang; return false; }
            engine = wmo::OcrEngine::TryCreateFromLanguage(language);
        }
        if (!engine) { error = "no OCR engine for the requested language (install an OCR language pack)"; return false; }
        usedLanguage = Narrow(engine.RecognizerLanguage().LanguageTag());
        const vi_vision::Image scaled = Upscale(image, scale);
        const auto maxDimension = static_cast<int>(wmo::OcrEngine::MaxImageDimension());
        if (scaled.w > maxDimension || scaled.h > maxDimension) { error = "image exceeds OcrEngine.MaxImageDimension (" + std::to_string(maxDimension) + ")"; return false; }
        wss::DataWriter writer;
        writer.WriteBytes(winrt::array_view<const uint8_t>(scaled.pixels.data(), scaled.pixels.data() + scaled.pixels.size()));
        wgi::SoftwareBitmap bitmap(wgi::BitmapPixelFormat::Bgra8, scaled.w, scaled.h, wgi::BitmapAlphaMode::Ignore);
        bitmap.CopyFromBuffer(writer.DetachBuffer());
        wmo::OcrResult result = engine.RecognizeAsync(bitmap).get();
        lines.clear();
        for (auto const& line : result.Lines()) {
            vi_text::Line out; out.text = std::wstring(line.Text().c_str(), line.Text().size());
            bool first = true;
            for (auto const& word : line.Words()) {
                const auto r = word.BoundingRect();
                vi_text::Word w; w.text = std::wstring(word.Text().c_str(), word.Text().size());
                const int left = static_cast<int>(std::floor(r.X / scale)), top = static_cast<int>(std::floor(r.Y / scale));
                const int right = static_cast<int>(std::ceil((r.X + r.Width) / scale)), bottom = static_cast<int>(std::ceil((r.Y + r.Height) / scale));
                w.box = {left, top, right - left, bottom - top};
                out.box = first ? w.box : vi_text::Union(out.box, w.box); first = false;
                out.words.push_back(std::move(w));
            }
            if (!out.words.empty()) lines.push_back(std::move(out));
        }
        return true;
    } catch (winrt::hresult_error const& e) {
        error = "WinRT OCR failed: " + Narrow(e.message()); return false;
    } catch (std::exception const& e) {
        error = std::string("OCR failed: ") + e.what(); return false;
    }
}
}
```

```h
// Process identities and cooperative JSON locks for the test-only vinput CLI.
// Existing locks are NEVER reclaimed automatically, even if their status is stale.
#pragma once
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#include <tlhelp32.h>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cerrno>
#include <cstdio>
#include <utility>

namespace vi_session {

inline std::uint64_t FileTimeValue(const FILETIME& t) {
    ULARGE_INTEGER v{}; v.LowPart = t.dwLowDateTime; v.HighPart = t.dwHighDateTime; return v.QuadPart;
}
inline std::uint64_t NowUnixMs() {
    FILETIME ft{}; GetSystemTimeAsFileTime(&ft);
    return FileTimeValue(ft) / 10000ULL - 11644473600000ULL;
}
inline std::uint64_t ProcessCreationTime(DWORD pid) {
    HANDLE h = OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, FALSE, pid);
    if (!h) return 0;
    FILETIME c{}, e{}, k{}, u{}; bool ok = GetProcessTimes(h, &c, &e, &k, &u) != FALSE;
    CloseHandle(h); return ok ? FileTimeValue(c) : 0;
}
inline DWORD ParentProcessId() {
    HANDLE snapshot = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
    if (snapshot == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 0;
    PROCESSENTRY32W e{}; e.dwSize = sizeof(e); DWORD parent = 0;
    if (Process32FirstW(snapshot, &e)) do {
        if (e.th32ProcessID == GetCurrentProcessId()) { parent = e.th32ParentProcessID; break; }
    } while (Process32NextW(snapshot, &e));
    CloseHandle(snapshot); return parent;
}
// Access denied is unknown/alive, never grounds for declaring another owner's lock stale.
inline bool ProcessIdentityDead(DWORD pid, std::uint64_t creation) {
    HANDLE h = OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION | SYNCHRONIZE, FALSE, pid);
    if (!h) return GetLastError() == ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    bool dead = WaitForSingleObject(h, 0) == WAIT_OBJECT_0;
    FILETIME c{}, e{}, k{}, u{};
    if (!dead && creation && GetProcessTimes(h, &c, &e, &k, &u)) dead = FileTimeValue(c) != creation;
    CloseHandle(h); return dead;
}

struct FileIdentity {
    DWORD volume = 0, high = 0, low = 0;
    bool valid = false;
};
inline FileIdentity IdentityOf(HANDLE h) {
    BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION i{}; FileIdentity f;
    if (GetFileInformationByHandle(h, &i)) { f.volume = i.dwVolumeSerialNumber; f.high = i.nFileIndexHigh; f.low = i.nFileIndexLow; f.valid = true; }
    return f;
}
inline bool SameIdentity(const FileIdentity& a, const FileIdentity& b) {
    return a.valid && b.valid && a.volume == b.volume && a.high == b.high && a.low == b.low;
}

inline std::string JsonEscape(const std::string& s) {
    std::string r;
    for (unsigned char c : s) {
        if (c == '"' || c == '\\') { r += '\\'; r += static_cast<char>(c); }
        else if (c < 0x20) { char b[7]; sprintf_s(b, "\\u%04x", c); r += b; }
        else r += static_cast<char>(c);
    }
    return r;
}

namespace detail {
struct JsonValue { std::string text; bool quoted = false; };
class LockJsonReader {
    const std::string& s_; size_t p_ = 0;
    void Space() { while (p_ < s_.size() && (s_[p_] == ' ' || s_[p_] == '\r' || s_[p_] == '\n' || s_[p_] == '\t')) ++p_; }
    static int Hex(char c) { if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return c - '0'; if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') return c - 'a' + 10; if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') return c - 'A' + 10; return -1; }
    bool Codepoint(unsigned& cp) {
        if (p_ + 4 > s_.size()) return false;
        cp = 0; for (int i = 0; i != 4; ++i) { int v = Hex(s_[p_++]); if (v < 0) return false; cp = cp * 16 + static_cast<unsigned>(v); }
        return true;
    }
    static void Utf8(std::string& out, unsigned cp) {
        if (cp < 0x80) out += static_cast<char>(cp);
        else if (cp < 0x800) { out += static_cast<char>(0xc0 | (cp >> 6)); out += static_cast<char>(0x80 | (cp & 0x3f)); }
        else if (cp < 0x10000) { out += static_cast<char>(0xe0 | (cp >> 12)); out += static_cast<char>(0x80 | ((cp >> 6) & 0x3f)); out += static_cast<char>(0x80 | (cp & 0x3f)); }
        else { out += static_cast<char>(0xf0 | (cp >> 18)); out += static_cast<char>(0x80 | ((cp >> 12) & 0x3f)); out += static_cast<char>(0x80 | ((cp >> 6) & 0x3f)); out += static_cast<char>(0x80 | (cp & 0x3f)); }
    }
    bool String(std::string& out) {
        if (p_ >= s_.size() || s_[p_++] != '"') return false;
        while (p_ < s_.size()) {
            unsigned char c = static_cast<unsigned char>(s_[p_++]);
            if (c == '"') return true;
            if (c < 0x20) return false;
            if (c != '\\') { out += static_cast<char>(c); continue; }
            if (p_ == s_.size()) return false;
            char e = s_[p_++];
            switch (e) {
            case '"': case '\\': case '/': out += e; break;
            case 'b': out += '\b'; break; case 'f': out += '\f'; break; case 'n': out += '\n'; break; case 'r': out += '\r'; break; case 't': out += '\t'; break;
            case 'u': {
                unsigned cp; if (!Codepoint(cp)) return false;
                if (cp >= 0xd800 && cp <= 0xdbff) {
                    if (p_ + 2 > s_.size() || s_[p_++] != '\\' || s_[p_++] != 'u') return false;
                    unsigned lo; if (!Codepoint(lo) || lo < 0xdc00 || lo > 0xdfff) return false;
                    cp = 0x10000 + ((cp - 0xd800) << 10) + lo - 0xdc00;
                } else if (cp >= 0xdc00 && cp <= 0xdfff) return false;
                Utf8(out, cp); break;
            }
            default: return false;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
public:
    explicit LockJsonReader(const std::string& s) : s_(s) {}
    bool Read(std::map<std::string, JsonValue>& fields) {
        Space(); if (p_ == s_.size() || s_[p_++] != '{') return false;
        Space(); if (p_ < s_.size() && s_[p_] == '}') { ++p_; Space(); return p_ == s_.size(); }
        for (;;) {
            std::string key; if (!String(key)) return false; Space();
            if (p_ == s_.size() || s_[p_++] != ':') return false; Space();
            JsonValue value;
            if (p_ < s_.size() && s_[p_] == '"') { value.quoted = true; if (!String(value.text)) return false; }
            else {
                size_t begin = p_;
                while (p_ < s_.size() && s_[p_] >= '0' && s_[p_] <= '9') ++p_;
                if (begin == p_ || (p_ - begin > 1 && s_[begin] == '0')) return false;
                value.text = s_.substr(begin, p_ - begin);
            }
            if (!fields.emplace(key, std::move(value)).second) return false;
            Space(); if (p_ == s_.size()) return false;
            char c = s_[p_++]; if (c == '}') { Space(); return p_ == s_.size(); }
            if (c != ',') return false; Space();
        }
    }
};
inline bool Number(const std::map<std::string, JsonValue>& f, const char* key, std::uint64_t& out, bool quoted = false) {
    auto it = f.find(key); if (it == f.end() || it->second.quoted != quoted || it->second.text.empty()) return false;
    for (char c : it->second.text) if (c < '0' || c > '9') return false;
    errno = 0; char* end = nullptr; auto n = _strtoui64(it->second.text.c_str(), &end, 10);
    if (errno == ERANGE || !end || *end) return false; out = n; return true;
}
inline bool Text(const std::map<std::string, JsonValue>& f, const char* key, std::string& out) {
    auto it = f.find(key); if (it == f.end() || !it->second.quoted) return false; out = it->second.text; return true;
}
} // namespace detail

struct LockStatus {
    bool exists = false, format_ok = false, stale = false, expired = false, owner_dead = false;
    std::string owner, token, error;
    DWORD pid = 0;
    std::uint64_t pid_created_100ns = 0, created_unix_ms = 0, expires_unix_ms = 0;
    FileIdentity identity;
};

inline LockStatus InspectLockHandle(HANDLE h) {
    LockStatus status; status.exists = true; status.identity = IdentityOf(h);
    LARGE_INTEGER size{};
    if (!GetFileSizeEx(h, &size) || size.QuadPart <= 0 || size.QuadPart > 8192) { status.error = "lock is empty, too large, or unreadable"; return status; }
    std::string body(static_cast<size_t>(size.QuadPart), '\0'); DWORD n = 0;
    if (!ReadFile(h, &body[0], static_cast<DWORD>(body.size()), &n, nullptr) || n != body.size()) { status.error = "cannot read complete lock"; return status; }
    std::map<std::string, detail::JsonValue> f;
    if (!detail::LockJsonReader(body).Read(f)) { status.error = "legacy or malformed lock (never reclaimed)"; return status; }
    std::string creator; std::uint64_t schema = 0, pid = 0;
    bool valid = detail::Text(f, "creator", creator) && creator == "vinput" &&
        detail::Number(f, "schema", schema) && schema == 1 && detail::Text(f, "owner", status.owner) &&
        !status.owner.empty() && status.owner.size() <= 256 && detail::Text(f, "token", status.token) && !status.token.empty() &&
        detail::Number(f, "pid", pid) && pid > 0 && pid <= MAXDWORD &&
        detail::Number(f, "pid_created_100ns", status.pid_created_100ns, true) && status.pid_created_100ns > 0 &&
        detail::Number(f, "created_unix_ms", status.created_unix_ms) &&
        detail::Number(f, "expires_unix_ms", status.expires_unix_ms) && status.expires_unix_ms > status.created_unix_ms;
    if (!valid) { status.error = "legacy or malformed lock (never reclaimed)"; return status; }
    status.format_ok = true; status.pid = static_cast<DWORD>(pid);
    status.expired = NowUnixMs() >= status.expires_unix_ms;
    status.owner_dead = ProcessIdentityDead(status.pid, status.pid_created_100ns);
    status.stale = status.expired || status.owner_dead;
    return status;
}

inline LockStatus InspectLock(const std::wstring& path) {
    LockStatus status;
    HANDLE h = CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        DWORD e = GetLastError(); status.exists = e != ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND && e != ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND;
        if (status.exists) status.error = "lock cannot be inspected (win32=" + std::to_string(e) + ")";
        return status;
    }
    status = InspectLockHandle(h); CloseHandle(h); return status;
}

// Only a vinput-created JSON lock with the exact owner may be released. Optional token and file
// identity checks protect a long-running lease against a replacement made under the same name.
inline bool ReleaseOwnedLock(const std::wstring& path, const std::string& owner, std::string& error,
    const std::string& expected_token = {}, const FileIdentity& expected_identity = {}) {
    error.clear();
    HANDLE h = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE; DWORD open_error = 0;
    const ULONGLONG deadline = GetTickCount64() + 250;
    for (;;) {
        h = CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ | DELETE, 0, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
        if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) break;
        open_error = GetLastError();
        if ((open_error != ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION && open_error != ERROR_LOCK_VIOLATION) || GetTickCount64() >= deadline) break;
        Sleep(10);
    }
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) { error = "cannot exclusively open owned lock (win32=" + std::to_string(open_error) + ")"; return false; }
    LockStatus status = InspectLockHandle(h);
    bool allowed = status.format_ok && status.owner == owner &&
        (expected_token.empty() || status.token == expected_token) &&
        (!expected_identity.valid || SameIdentity(status.identity, expected_identity));
    if (!allowed) { CloseHandle(h); error = "lock owner, token, identity, or format does not match; left untouched"; return false; }
    FILE_DISPOSITION_INFO disposition{}; disposition.DeleteFile = TRUE;
    bool ok = SetFileInformationByHandle(h, FileDispositionInfo, &disposition, sizeof(disposition)) != FALSE;
    DWORD e = ok ? 0 : GetLastError(); CloseHandle(h);
    if (!ok) error = "cannot release owned lock (win32=" + std::to_string(e) + ")";
    return ok;
}

class JsonLock {
    std::wstring path_;
    std::string owner_, token_;
    FileIdentity identity_;
    bool held_ = false;
public:
    JsonLock() = default;
    JsonLock(const JsonLock&) = delete;
    JsonLock& operator=(const JsonLock&) = delete;
    ~JsonLock() { if (held_) { std::string ignored; Release(ignored); } }
    bool Held() const { return held_; }
    const std::string& Token() const { return token_; }
    bool Acquire(const std::wstring& path, const std::string& owner, unsigned ttl_sec, std::string& error, DWORD owner_pid = GetCurrentProcessId()) {
        error.clear();
        if (held_) { error = "this lease already holds a lock"; return false; }
        if (path.empty() || owner.empty() || owner.size() > 256 || owner.find('\0') != std::string::npos || ttl_sec < 1 || ttl_sec > 86400) { error = "lock needs a path, owner (1..256 bytes), and ttl (1..86400 seconds)"; return false; }
        int valid_utf8 = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, MB_ERR_INVALID_CHARS, owner.c_str(), static_cast<int>(owner.size()), nullptr, 0);
        if (!valid_utf8) { error = "owner must be valid UTF-8"; return false; }
        std::uint64_t creation = ProcessCreationTime(owner_pid);
        if (!creation || ProcessIdentityDead(owner_pid, creation)) { error = "owner PID must identify a live, queryable process"; return false; }
        HANDLE h = CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE | DELETE, 0, nullptr, CREATE_NEW, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
        if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
            DWORD e = GetLastError();
            if (e == ERROR_FILE_EXISTS || e == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS) {
                LockStatus old = InspectLock(path);
                error = old.format_ok ? "lock held by " + old.owner + (old.stale ? " (stale; not reclaimed)" : "") : "existing legacy/unreadable lock; left untouched";
            } else error = "cannot atomically create lock (win32=" + std::to_string(e) + ")";
            return false;
        }
        LARGE_INTEGER qpc{}; QueryPerformanceCounter(&qpc);
        std::uint64_t now = NowUnixMs();
        token_ = std::to_string(GetCurrentProcessId()) + "-" + std::to_string(creation) + "-" + std::to_string(qpc.QuadPart);
        std::string body = "{\"creator\":\"vinput\",\"schema\":1,\"owner\":\"" + JsonEscape(owner) + "\",\"pid\":" + std::to_string(owner_pid) +
            ",\"pid_created_100ns\":\"" + std::to_string(creation) + "\",\"created_unix_ms\":" + std::to_string(now) +
            ",\"expires_unix_ms\":" + std::to_string(now + static_cast<std::uint64_t>(ttl_sec) * 1000) + ",\"ttl_sec\":" + std::to_string(ttl_sec) + ",\"token\":\"" + token_ + "\"}\n";
        DWORD n = 0;
        bool ok = WriteFile(h, body.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(body.size()), &n, nullptr) && n == body.size() && FlushFileBuffers(h);
        identity_ = IdentityOf(h); ok = ok && identity_.valid;
        if (!ok) { FILE_DISPOSITION_INFO disposition{}; disposition.DeleteFile = TRUE; SetFileInformationByHandle(h, FileDispositionInfo, &disposition, sizeof(disposition)); CloseHandle(h); error = "could not write complete JSON lock"; return false; }
        CloseHandle(h); path_ = path; owner_ = owner; held_ = true; return true;
    }
    bool Release(std::string& error) {
        if (!held_) return true;
        bool ok = ReleaseOwnedLock(path_, owner_, error, token_, identity_);
        if (ok) held_ = false;
        return ok;
    }
    // Persistent CLI lock acquire: later release requires the same owner. Caller should select a
    // durable owner_pid (the calling agent/shell), since the short-lived CLI PID exits immediately.
    void Detach() { held_ = false; }
};

} // namespace vi_session
```

`src/vi_text.h`:

```h
// Text matching over OCR output for vinput UI navigation. Pure functions, no OCR or pipe dependency,
// so the matching rules are unit-tested separately (test\vi_uitest.cpp).
//
// Rules (documented in README "UI navigation"):
//  * default: case-insensitive; ALL whitespace is ignored on both sides ("Load  Game" == "LoadGame" == "load game");
//    the query may be a substring of a line ("PLAY" also matches inside "PLAYERS" - use --exact to forbid that).
//  * exact:   case-sensitive, and the match must start and end on OCR word boundaries.
//  * fuzzy N: also accept a run of whole words whose letters differ from the query by <= N edits (OCR slips such as
//    BATTLE -> BATTIE). Fuzzy hits have score < 1.
//  * hits are returned in reading order (rows top to bottom, left to right inside a row); --nth is 1-based on that order.
//  * a hit's box is the union of the OCR words it touches (a match starting mid-word boxes the whole word).
#pragma once
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#pragma comment(lib, "user32.lib")

namespace vi_text {
struct Box { int x = 0, y = 0, w = 0, h = 0; };
struct Word { std::wstring text; Box box; };
struct Line { std::wstring text; Box box; std::vector<Word> words; };
struct Hit {
    int line = 0, first = 0, last = 0;   // word span [first, last] inside lines[line]
    Box box;
    double score = 1.0;                  // 1.0 = literal match, <1 = fuzzy (1 - edits / query length)
    std::wstring line_text;
};
struct Options { bool exact = false; int fuzzy = 0; };

inline std::wstring Lower(std::wstring s) {
    if (!s.empty()) CharLowerBuffW(&s[0], static_cast<DWORD>(s.size()));
    return s;
}
inline std::wstring StripSpace(const std::wstring& s) {
    std::wstring o; o.reserve(s.size());
    for (wchar_t c : s) if (!iswspace(c)) o += c;
    return o;
}
inline Box Union(const Box& a, const Box& b) {
    const int l = (std::min)(a.x, b.x), t = (std::min)(a.y, b.y);
    const int r = (std::max)(a.x + a.w, b.x + b.w), bo = (std::max)(a.y + a.h, b.y + b.h);
    return {l, t, r - l, bo - t};
}
inline int Edits(const std::wstring& a, const std::wstring& b) {
    std::vector<int> prev(b.size() + 1), cur(b.size() + 1);
    for (size_t j = 0; j <= b.size(); ++j) prev[j] = static_cast<int>(j);
    for (size_t i = 1; i <= a.size(); ++i) {
        cur[0] = static_cast<int>(i);
        for (size_t j = 1; j <= b.size(); ++j)
            cur[j] = (std::min)({prev[j] + 1, cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j - 1] + (a[i - 1] == b[j - 1] ? 0 : 1)});
        std::swap(prev, cur);
    }
    return prev[b.size()];
}

// Hits inside ONE line, in word order.
inline void FindInLine(const Line& line, int lineIndex, const std::wstring& query, const Options& opt, std::vector<Hit>& out) {
    const std::wstring q = opt.exact ? StripSpace(query) : Lower(StripSpace(query));
    if (q.empty() || line.words.empty()) return;
    std::wstring s; std::vector<int> owner; std::vector<char> wordStart, wordEnd;
    for (size_t w = 0; w < line.words.size(); ++w) {
        std::wstring t = StripSpace(line.words[w].text);
        if (!opt.exact) t = Lower(t);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < t.size(); ++i) {
            s += t[i]; owner.push_back(static_cast<int>(w));
            wordStart.push_back(i == 0); wordEnd.push_back(i + 1 == t.size());
        }
    }
    std::vector<Hit> hits;
    auto addHit = [&](int first, int last, double score) {
        Hit h; h.line = lineIndex; h.first = first; h.last = last; h.score = score; h.line_text = line.text;
        h.box = line.words[first].box;
        for (int w = first + 1; w <= last; ++w) h.box = Union(h.box, line.words[w].box);
        hits.push_back(h);
    };
    for (size_t pos = s.find(q); pos != std::wstring::npos; pos = s.find(q, pos + q.size())) {
        const size_t end = pos + q.size() - 1;
        if (opt.exact && !(wordStart[pos] && wordEnd[end])) continue;
        addHit(owner[pos], owner[end], 1.0);
    }
    if (opt.fuzzy > 0) {
        const int n = static_cast<int>(line.words.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            std::wstring joined;
            for (int j = i; j < n; ++j) {
                std::wstring t = StripSpace(line.words[j].text);
                joined += opt.exact ? t : Lower(t);
                if (joined.size() > q.size() + static_cast<size_t>(opt.fuzzy)) break;
                if (joined.size() + static_cast<size_t>(opt.fuzzy) < q.size()) continue;
                const int d = Edits(joined, q);
                if (d == 0 || d > opt.fuzzy) continue;
                bool overlaps = false;
                for (const Hit& h : hits) if (!(j < h.first || i > h.last)) { overlaps = true; break; }
                if (!overlaps) addHit(i, j, 1.0 - static_cast<double>(d) / static_cast<double>(q.size()));
            }
        }
    }
    for (auto& h : hits) out.push_back(std::move(h));
}

// Reading order: group by row (centre within half a box height of the row's first box), then left to right.
inline void ReadingOrder(std::vector<Hit>& hits) {
    std::stable_sort(hits.begin(), hits.end(), [](const Hit& a, const Hit& b) { return a.box.y + a.box.h / 2 < b.box.y + b.box.h / 2; });
    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < hits.size()) {
        const int rowCentre = hits[i].box.y + hits[i].box.h / 2, tolerance = (std::max)(4, hits[i].box.h / 2);
        size_t j = i + 1;
        while (j < hits.size() && hits[j].box.y + hits[j].box.h / 2 - rowCentre <= tolerance) ++j;
        std::stable_sort(hits.begin() + i, hits.begin() + j, [](const Hit& a, const Hit& b) { return a.box.x < b.box.x; });
        i = j;
    }
}

inline std::vector<Hit> Find(const std::vector<Line>& lines, const std::wstring& query, const Options& opt) {
    std::vector<Hit> hits;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < lines.size(); ++i) FindInLine(lines[i], static_cast<int>(i), query, opt, hits);
    ReadingOrder(hits);
    return hits;
}
}
```

`src/vi_trace.h`:

```h
// Per-VK observation counters. Reads prove API delivery, never that the application acted on it.
#pragma once
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>

struct ChannelTrace {
    std::atomic<long long> reads{0};
    std::atomic<long long> down_reads{0};
    std::atomic<int> last{0};

    void record(int value, bool down) noexcept {
        reads.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        if (down) down_reads.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        last.store(value, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }

    // Win32 SHORT states use bit 15; BYTE keyboard/DirectInput states use bit 7.
    // For raw MAKE/BREAK flags use the explicit overload: raw MAKE is zero.
    void record(int value) noexcept {
        record(value, (static_cast<unsigned int>(value) & 0x8080u) != 0);
    }
};

struct KeyTrace {
    std::atomic<long long> injected_down{0}, injected_up{0};
    std::atomic<long long> delivered_down{0}, delivered_up{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> last_injected_down_ms{0}, last_injected_up_ms{0};
    ChannelTrace gaks, gks, gkbs, di_state, di_buffer, raw_data, raw_buffer;

    void injection(bool down, std::uint64_t tick_ms) noexcept {
        if (down) {
            injected_down.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            last_injected_down_ms.store(tick_ms, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        } else {
            injected_up.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            last_injected_up_ms.store(tick_ms, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        }
    }

    void delivery(bool down) noexcept {
        if (down) delivered_down.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        else delivered_up.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
};
```
