```cpp
    if (cmd == "status") return StatusJson();
    if (cmd == "trace") return KeyTraceJson(VkFromName(JStr(j, "key")));
    if (cmd == "log") {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_logMx);
        std::string a = "["; bool f = true; for (auto& l : g_logRing) { if (!f) a += ','; f = false; a += '"' + JEsc(l) + '"'; } a += "]";
        JOut o; o.bol("ok", true); o.raw("log", a); return o.done();
    }
    if (cmd == "config") {
        if (JHas(j, "fakefocus")) g_cfg.fakefocus = JBool(j, "fakefocus", true);
        if (JHas(j, "isolate")) g_cfg.isolate = JBool(j, "isolate", true);
        if (JHas(j, "autoactivate")) g_cfg.autoactivate = JBool(j, "autoactivate", true);
        if (JHas(j, "blockfocus")) g_cfg.blockfocus = JBool(j, "blockfocus", true);
        if (JHas(j, "nofullscreen")) g_cfg.nofullscreen = JBool(j, "nofullscreen", true);
        if (JHas(j, "keepvisible")) g_cfg.keepvisible = JBool(j, "keepvisible", true);
        if (JHas(j, "vk")) g_vkEnabled = JBool(j, "vk", true);   // vk=off: Vulkan hooks pass through (no usage change, no capture)
        if (JHas(j, "cursor")) { std::string c = JStr(j, "cursor"); g_cfg.cursor = c == "virtual" ? 1 : c == "real" ? 2 : 0; }
        if (JHas(j, "raw")) { std::string c = JStr(j, "raw"); g_cfg.rawmode = c == "post" ? 1 : c == "buffer" ? 2 : c == "off" ? 3 : 0; }
        if (JHas(j, "msgs")) { std::string c = JStr(j, "msgs"); g_cfg.msgmode = c == "on" ? 1 : c == "off" ? 2 : 0; }
        if (JHas(j, "hwnd")) { HWND h = (HWND)(ULONG_PTR)strtoull(JStr(j, "hwnd").c_str(), nullptr, 0); if (IsWindow(h)) { g_hwndForced = true; Retarget(h); } else return ErrJ("not a window"); }
        return StatusJson();
    }
    if (cmd == "activate") {
        if (!g_hwnd) return ErrJ("no window");
        // Posting activation messages can run an application's activation handler and
        // indirectly take the real foreground. Refresh the API shims without invoking it.
        g_cfg.fakefocus = true;
        JOut o; o.bol("ok", true); o.str("activation", "virtual");
        o.bol("really_foreground", ComputeRealFg()); o.bol("posts_activation", false);
        return o.done();
    }
    if (cmd == "restore-foreground") {
        // Only relinquishes a real foreground already owned by this process.
        // It cannot grant foreground to a background game or generate system input.
        HWND previous = (HWND)(ULONG_PTR)strtoull(JStr(j, "hwnd").c_str(), nullptr, 0);
        if (!ComputeRealFg()) return OkJ();
        if (!IsWindow(previous) || IsOurWindow(previous)) return ErrJ("restore needs a previous window outside the target");
        BOOL restored = o_SetForegroundWindow(previous);
        JOut o; o.bol("ok", restored != FALSE); o.bol("foreground_restored", !ComputeRealFg()); return o.done();
    }
    if (cmd == "release") { ReleaseAll(); return OkJ(); }
    if (cmd == "restore") { if (!g_hwnd) return ErrJ("no window"); ShowWindowAsync(g_hwnd, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE); Sleep(300); return StatusJson(); }
    if (cmd == "key" || cmd == "hold" || cmd == "down" || cmd == "up") {
        std::vector<int> vks = ParseCombo(JStr(j, "key"));
        if (vks.empty()) return ErrJ("unknown key: " + JStr(j, "key"));
        int count = (int)JNum(j, "count", 1);
        double ms = JNum(j, "ms", cmd == "hold" ? 1000 : 80), gap = JNum(j, "gap", 80);
        for (int r = 0; r < count; r++) {
            if (cmd != "up") for (int vk : vks) { KeyEvent(vk, true); if (vks.size() > 1) Sleep(15); }
            if (cmd == "down") break;
            if (cmd != "up") SleepMs(ms);
            for (size_t i = vks.size(); i-- > 0;) { KeyEvent(vks[i], false); if (vks.size() > 1) Sleep(15); }
            if (cmd == "up") break;
            if (r + 1 < count) SleepMs(gap);
        }
        return OkJ();
    }
    if (cmd == "type") {
        std::wstring t = U2W(JStr(j, "text"));
        double delay = JNum(j, "delay", 30);
        bool keys = JBool(j, "keys", false);
        if (!g_hwnd) return ErrJ("no window");
        for (wchar_t ch : t) {
            if (keys) {
                SHORT vs = VkKeyScanW(ch);
                if (vs != -1) {
                    int vk = vs & 0xFF; bool sh = (vs & 0x100) != 0;
                    if (sh) KeyEvent(VK_SHIFT, true);
                    KeyEvent(vk, true); Sleep(20); KeyEvent(vk, false);
                    if (sh) KeyEvent(VK_SHIFT, false);
                }
            } else {
                if (ch == L'\n') { KeyEvent(VK_RETURN, true); Sleep(20); KeyEvent(VK_RETURN, false); }
                else PostMessageW(g_hwnd, WM_CHAR, (WPARAM)ch, 1);
            }
            SleepMs(delay);
        }
        return OkJ();
    }
    if (cmd == "mouse" || cmd == "move") {
        if (!g_hwnd) return ErrJ("no window");
        int steps = (int)JNum(j, "steps", 1);
        if (steps < 1 || steps > 10000) return ErrJ("steps must be 1..10000");
        double stepms = JNum(j, "step_ms", 10);
        if (!(stepms >= 0 && stepms <= 1000) || stepms*(steps-1) > 120000) return ErrJ("mouse timing exceeds bounds");
        bool unbounded = JBool(j, "raw", false);
        if (unbounded && cmd != "move") return ErrJ("--raw is a relative move mode");
        if (unbounded) g_cfg.cursor=1;
        long long appliedX=0, appliedY=0;
        LONG rawX=0, rawY=0;
        if (JHas(j, "dx") || JHas(j, "dy")) {
            double dxValue=JNum(j,"dx",0), dyValue=JNum(j,"dy",0);
            if (!(dxValue>=-1000000 && dxValue<=1000000 && dyValue>=-1000000 && dyValue<=1000000)) return ErrJ("relative delta must be within +/-1000000");
            LONG dx=(LONG)dxValue, dy=(LONG)dyValue; LONG sx=0, sy=0; rawX=dx; rawY=dy;
            for (int s = 1; s <= steps; s++) {
                LONG tx=(LONG)((long long)dx*s/steps), ty=(LONG)((long long)dy*s/steps);
                AppliedMouse a=MouseMoveTo(0,0,true,tx-sx,ty-sy,unbounded); appliedX+=a.dx; appliedY+=a.dy;
                sx=tx; sy=ty; if(s<steps) SleepMs(stepms);
            }
        } else {
            LONG x, y; ResolveXY(j, x, y); LONG ox = g_vcurX, oy = g_vcurY;
            for (int s=1; s<=steps; s++) {
                AppliedMouse a=MouseMoveTo((LONG)(ox+((long long)x-ox)*s/steps),(LONG)(oy+((long long)y-oy)*s/steps),false,0,0);
                appliedX+=a.dx; appliedY+=a.dy; if(s<steps) SleepMs(stepms);
            }
        }
        JOut o; o.bol("ok", true); o.num("x", g_vcurX); o.num("y", g_vcurY);
        o.num("applied_dx", (double)appliedX); o.num("applied_dy", (double)appliedY);
        o.num("raw_dx", rawX); o.num("raw_dy", rawY); o.bol("unbounded", unbounded);
        o.str("cursor", UseVirtualCursor() ? "virtual" : "real"); return o.done();
    }
    if (cmd == "click" || cmd == "mousedown" || cmd == "mouseup") {
        if (!g_hwnd) return ErrJ("no window");
        std::string b = JStr(j, "button", "left");
        if (b != "left" && b != "right" && b != "middle" && b != "x1" && b != "x2") return ErrJ("unknown mouse button: " + b);
        int vk = b == "right" ? VK_RBUTTON : b == "middle" ? VK_MBUTTON : b == "x1" ? VK_XBUTTON1 : b == "x2" ? VK_XBUTTON2 : VK_LBUTTON;
        int previousCursor = g_cfg.cursor;
        // Keep virtual mode after the command: applications may poll GetCursorPos on a later frame.
        // A scoped override would report success then race the game's input consumer.
        g_cfg.cursor = 1;
        long hoverFrames = 0;
        if (JHas(j, "x") || JHas(j, "y")) {
            LONG x, y; ResolveXY(j, x, y);
            long delivered = g_mouseMovesDelivered;
            MouseMoveTo(x, y, false, 0, 0);
            DWORD start = GetTickCount(), timeout = (DWORD)JNum(j, "hover_timeout_ms", 1500);
            RawReg rr = QueryRawReg();
            if (MsgsWanted(false, rr)) {
                while (g_mouseMovesDelivered == delivered && GetTickCount() - start < timeout) Sleep(2);
                if (g_mouseMovesDelivered == delivered) return ErrJ("virtual hover not dispatched before timeout");
            }
            long frame = C.present_ours, requested = (long)JNum(j, "hover_frames", 3);
            if (frame > 0 && requested > 0) {
                while (C.present_ours - frame < requested && GetTickCount() - start < timeout) Sleep(2);
                hoverFrames = C.present_ours - frame;
                if (hoverFrames < requested) return ErrJ("virtual hover not rendered before timeout");
            }
            SleepMs(JNum(j, "settle_ms", frame > 0 ? 0 : 100));
        }
        int count = (int)JNum(j, "count", 1); double ms = JNum(j, "ms", 60);
        if (cmd == "mousedown") MouseButton(vk, true);
        else if (cmd == "mouseup") MouseButton(vk, false);
        else for (int r = 0; r < count; r++) { MouseButton(vk, true); SleepMs(ms); MouseButton(vk, false); if (r + 1 < count) SleepMs(JNum(j, "gap", 80)); }
        JOut o; o.bol("ok", true); o.num("x", g_vcurX); o.num("y", g_vcurY);
        o.str("cursor", "virtual"); o.num("previous_cursor_mode", previousCursor); o.num("hover_frames", hoverFrames);
        o.str("delivery", "injected; application response is not implied"); return o.done();
    }
    if (cmd == "wheel") { MouseWheel((int)JNum(j, "delta", 120), JBool(j, "horizontal", false)); return OkJ(); }
    if (cmd == "pad") {
        std::string names = JStr(j, "buttons");
        std::string lower = names; for (auto& ch : lower) ch = (char)tolower((unsigned char)ch);
        if (lower == "off") {   // stop overriding: pad 0 is the real pad again (or "not connected" when there is none)
            g_padActive = false; g_padButtons = 0; g_padSetMask = 0; g_padPacket++;
            JOut o; o.bol("ok", true); o.bol("pad_active", false); return o.done();
        }
        std::string bad;
        WORD b = PadButtonsFromNames(names, &bad);
        if (!bad.empty()) return ErrJ("pad: unknown button '" + bad + "' (a b x y up down left right start back ls rs lb rb, none, off)");
        const double kUnset = -1e18;
        const char* axes[6] = {"lt", "rt", "lx", "ly", "rx", "ry"};
        int v[6] = {}, mask = 0; bool clamped = false;
        for (int a = 0; a < 6; a++) {
            double d = JNum(j, axes[a], kUnset);
            if (d == kUnset) continue;
            double lo = a < 2 ? 0 : -32768, hi = a < 2 ? 255 : 32767;
            if (d < lo) { d = lo; clamped = true; } if (d > hi) { d = hi; clamped = true; }
            v[a] = (int)d; mask |= 1 << a;
        }
        g_padLT = v[0]; g_padRT = v[1]; g_padLX = v[2]; g_padLY = v[3]; g_padRX = v[4]; g_padRY = v[5];
        g_padButtons = b; g_padSetMask = mask; g_padActive = true; g_padPacket++;
        double ms = JNum(j, "ms", 100);
        bool hold = JBool(j, "hold", false);
        if (!hold) { SleepMs(ms); g_padButtons = 0; g_padSetMask = 0; g_padLX = g_padLY = g_padRX = g_padRY = g_padLT = g_padRT = 0; g_padPacket++; }
        JOut o; o.bol("ok", true); o.num("buttons", b); o.num("axes_set_mask", mask); o.bol("clamped", clamped);
        o.bol("hold", hold); o.num("xinput_calls", (double)C.xinput.load());
        o.str("delivery", "XInputGetState/Ex user 0 overridden; application response is not implied"); return o.done();
    }
    if (cmd == "capture") return DoCapture(j);
    if (cmd == "frame-hash") { j["hash_only"] = JV{3, {}, 0, true}; return DoCapture(j); }
    if (cmd == "wait") { SleepMs(JNum(j, "ms", 100)); return OkJ(); }
    return ErrJ("unknown cmd: " + cmd);
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// pipe server
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DWORD WINAPI ClientThread(LPVOID p) {
    HANDLE pipe = (HANDLE)p;
    CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
    static std::mutex execMx;  // commands from several clients run one at a time
    std::string buf; char tmp[4096];
    for (;;) {
        DWORD n = 0;
        if (!ReadFile(pipe, tmp, sizeof(tmp), &n, nullptr) || n == 0) break;
        buf.append(tmp, n);
        size_t nl;
        while ((nl = buf.find('\n')) != std::string::npos) {
            std::string line = buf.substr(0, nl); buf.erase(0, nl + 1);
            while (!line.empty() && (line.back() == '\r' || line.back() == ' ')) line.pop_back();
            if (line.empty()) continue;
            std::string resp;
            // Read-only / ownership commands skip the exec mutex. The mutex lives in this target process, so it only
            // serialises clients of THIS game; other targets (other processes) are never blocked by it.
            JObj peek; bool open = ParseJson(line, peek) && IsOpenCommand(JStr(peek, "cmd"));
            if (open) { try { resp = Exec(line); } catch (...) { resp = ErrJ("exception"); } }
            else { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(execMx); try { resp = Exec(line); } catch (...) { resp = ErrJ("exception"); } }
            resp += "\n";
            DWORD w; if (!WriteFile(pipe, resp.data(), (DWORD)resp.size(), &w, nullptr)) goto out;
        }
    }
out:
    FlushFileBuffers(pipe); DisconnectNamedPipe(pipe); CloseHandle(pipe);
    CoUninitialize();
    return 0;
}
DWORD WINAPI PipeThread(LPVOID) {
    // An AppContainer (UWP / Xbox app game) may only create pipes in its own namespace: \\.\pipe\LOCAL\<name> lands in
    // \Sessions\<n>\AppContainerNamedObjects\<container SID>\<name>; vinput.exe resolves that path from our token.
    // The DACL must also grant the AppContainer groups (AC = ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES, S-1-15-2-2 = restricted),
    // or our own next CreateNamedPipe instance is denied (dual access check).
    wchar_t name[64]; swprintf_s(name, g_appContainer ? L"\\\\.\\pipe\\LOCAL\\vinput_%lu" : L"\\\\.\\pipe\\vinput_%lu", g_pid);
    // Access: only the game's own user account (and SYSTEM); never other users, never the network
    // (PIPE_REJECT_REMOTE_CLIENTS). The AppContainer groups and the low-integrity label are added only when the game
    // itself runs in an AppContainer, where they are required (see above).
    std::wstring userSid;
    {
        HANDLE tok = nullptr; BYTE buf[256]; DWORD n = 0; LPWSTR s = nullptr;
        if (OpenProcessToken(GetCurrentProcess(), TOKEN_QUERY, &tok)) {
            if (GetTokenInformation(tok, TokenUser, buf, sizeof(buf), &n) && ConvertSidToStringSidW(((TOKEN_USER*)buf)->User.Sid, &s)) { userSid = s; LocalFree(s); }
            CloseHandle(tok);
        }
        if (userSid.empty()) Log("pipe: cannot read the user SID (%lu); the pipe will only admit SYSTEM", GetLastError());
    }
    std::wstring sddl = L"D:(A;;GA;;;SY)";
    if (!userSid.empty()) sddl += L"(A;;GA;;;" + userSid + L")";
    if (g_appContainer) sddl += L"(A;;GA;;;AC)(A;;GA;;;S-1-15-2-2)S:(ML;;NW;;;LW)";
    SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES sa = {sizeof(sa)}; PSECURITY_DESCRIPTOR sd = nullptr;
    if (!ConvertStringSecurityDescriptorToSecurityDescriptorW(sddl.c_str(), SDDL_REVISION_1, &sd, nullptr)) Log("pipe: bad security descriptor %lu", GetLastError());
    sa.lpSecurityDescriptor = sd;
    Log("pipe %s", W2U(name).c_str());
    for (;;) {
        HANDLE h = CreateNamedPipeW(name, PIPE_ACCESS_DUPLEX, PIPE_TYPE_BYTE | PIPE_READMODE_BYTE | PIPE_WAIT | PIPE_REJECT_REMOTE_CLIENTS, PIPE_UNLIMITED_INSTANCES, 65536, 65536, 0, sd ? &sa : nullptr);
        if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) { Log("CreateNamedPipe failed %lu", GetLastError()); Sleep(1000); continue; }
        BOOL c = ConnectNamedPipe(h, nullptr) ? TRUE : (GetLastError() == ERROR_PIPE_CONNECTED);
        if (!c) { CloseHandle(h); continue; }
        HANDLE t = CreateThread(nullptr, 0, ClientThread, h, 0, nullptr);
        if (t) CloseHandle(t); else CloseHandle(h);
    }
}

// A game started in the background never receives WM_ACTIVATEAPP(TRUE). Games that keep their own "application is
// active" flag (Fallout 1/2's GNW95 loop, many DirectDraw-era titles) then ignore all input, and fakefocus only swallows
// DEactivations. Post the activation sequence a real switch would send, once, to the game's own window: posted messages
// cannot change the real foreground, and blockfocus (required) keeps the game's activation handler from taking it.
// Re-posted (at most every 2 s, 3 times) while the game's window procedure still has not seen an activation.
void MaybeSynthActivate() {
    HWND h = g_hwnd;
    if (!h || !g_origWndProc || !g_cfg.autoactivate || !g_cfg.fakefocus || !g_cfg.blockfocus || RealFg()) return;
    if (g_appActive.load() == 1 || g_synthLeft.load() <= 0 || IsIconic(h)) return;
    DWORD now = GetTickCount();
    if (g_lastSynthAct && now - g_lastSynthAct < 2000) return;
    g_lastSynthAct = now ? now : 1; g_synthLeft--;
    DWORD otherTid = GetWindowThreadProcessId(RealForeground(), nullptr);   // WM_ACTIVATEAPP lParam: the thread losing activation
    PostMessageW(h, WM_NCACTIVATE, TRUE, 0);
    PostMessageW(h, WM_ACTIVATEAPP, TRUE, (LPARAM)otherTid);
    PostMessageW(h, WM_ACTIVATE, WA_ACTIVE, 0);
    PostMessageW(h, WM_SETFOCUS, 0, 0);
    C.act_synth++;
    Log("game window not told it is active (app_active=%d) -> posted WM_NCACTIVATE/WM_ACTIVATEAPP/WM_ACTIVATE/WM_SETFOCUS (no foreground change)", g_appActive.load());
}

DWORD WINAPI MonitorThread(LPVOID) {
    bool lastFg = ComputeRealFg();
    DWORD lastSlow = 0;
    HWND lastFgWnd = RealForeground();
    for (;;) {
        HWND fw = RealForeground();
        bool fg = ComputeRealFg();
        g_realFg = fg;
        if (fg != lastFg) {
            DWORD pp = 0; GetWindowThreadProcessId(lastFgWnd, &pp);
            wchar_t t[128] = {0}; GetWindowTextW(lastFgWnd, t, 127);
            Log("REAL foreground %s (previous fg: pid %lu '%s')", fg ? "GAINED" : "lost", pp, W2U(t).c_str());
        }
        if (fw) lastFgWnd = fw;
        static DWORD lastRestore = 0;
        static RECT goodRect = {0, 0, 0, 0};
        if (g_hwnd) {
            RECT wr; GetWindowRect(g_hwnd, &wr);
            bool parked = wr.left <= -30000 || wr.top <= -30000;   // minimised placement (also seen NON-iconic after a shell "minimise all")
            bool iconic = IsIconic(g_hwnd) != FALSE;
            if (!iconic && !parked && wr.right - wr.left >= 200 && wr.bottom - wr.top >= 150) goodRect = wr;
            if (g_cfg.keepvisible && !fg && (iconic || parked) && GetTickCount() - lastRestore > 1500) {
                lastRestore = GetTickCount(); C.min_restored++;
                Log("game window minimised/parked (iconic=%d at %ld,%ld) while in background -> restoring without activation", (int)iconic, wr.left, wr.top);
                if (iconic) ShowWindowAsync(g_hwnd, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE);
                if (goodRect.right > goodRect.left)
                    o_SetWindowPos(g_hwnd, nullptr, goodRect.left, goodRect.top, goodRect.right - goodRect.left, goodRect.bottom - goodRect.top,
                                   SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOOWNERZORDER | SWP_ASYNCWINDOWPOS);
            }
        }
        if (lastFg && !fg && g_hwnd) {
            // the game just lost the real foreground: make sure it does not keep the real cursor trapped
            RECT clip, wr; GetClipCursor(&clip); GetWindowRect(g_hwnd, &wr);
            RECT inter; if (IntersectRect(&inter, &clip, &wr) && EqualRect(&inter, &clip)) o_ClipCursor(nullptr);
            for (int vk = 1; vk < 256; vk++) g_vkPressed[vk] = 0;
        }
        lastFg = fg;
        MaybeSynthActivate();
        DWORD now = GetTickCount();
        if (now - lastSlow > 1000) {
            lastSlow = now;
            TryHookDInput(); TryHookDInputLegacy(); TryHookXInput(); TryHookEcl(); TryHookGL(); TryHookVk();
            if (!g_hwndForced) {
                HWND best = FindMainWindow();
                if (!g_hwnd || !IsWindow(g_hwnd)) { if (best) Retarget(best); }
                else if (best && best != g_hwnd && now - g_t0 < 180000) Retarget(best);
            }
        }
        Sleep(15);
    }
}

// Loader DLL-load notification: hook vulkan-1 / opengl32 the moment they are mapped. With early injection
// (`launch --early`: process created suspended, vinput in before the game's first instruction) this closes the
// window between the game's LoadLibrary and its first vkCreateInstance/vkCreateDevice, which the 1 s monitor poll
// cannot. Runs under the loader lock on the loading thread: only GetProcAddress + MinHook, no LoadLibrary.
struct ViUnicodeString { USHORT Length, MaximumLength; PWSTR Buffer; };
struct ViLdrDllData { ULONG Flags; const ViUnicodeString* FullDllName; const ViUnicodeString* BaseDllName; PVOID DllBase; ULONG SizeOfImage; };
typedef VOID (CALLBACK* ViLdrNotify)(ULONG reason, const ViLdrDllData* data, PVOID ctx);
typedef LONG (NTAPI* PFN_LdrRegisterDllNotification)(ULONG flags, ViLdrNotify cb, PVOID ctx, PVOID* cookie);
std::atomic<long> g_ldrNotified{0};
bool BaseNameIs(const ViUnicodeString* n, const wchar_t* want) {
    if (!n || !n->Buffer) return false;
    size_t len = n->Length / sizeof(wchar_t), wl = wcslen(want);
    return len == wl && !_wcsnicmp(n->Buffer, want, wl);
}
VOID CALLBACK OnDllNotification(ULONG reason, const ViLdrDllData* data, PVOID) {
    if (reason != 1 || !data) return;   // 1 = LDR_DLL_NOTIFICATION_REASON_LOADED
    if (data->BaseDllName && data->BaseDllName->Buffer) {
        size_t len = data->BaseDllName->Length / sizeof(wchar_t);
        if (const char* p = vi_ac::MatchModule(data->BaseDllName->Buffer, len)) { NoteAntiCheat(p, data->BaseDllName->Buffer, len); return; }
    }
    if (BaseNameIs(data->BaseDllName, L"vulkan-1.dll")) { g_ldrNotified++; TryHookVk((HMODULE)data->DllBase); }
    else if (BaseNameIs(data->BaseDllName, L"opengl32.dll")) { g_ldrNotified++; TryHookGL((HMODULE)data->DllBase); }
}
void RegisterDllNotification() {
    auto reg = (PFN_LdrRegisterDllNotification)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleW(L"ntdll.dll"), "LdrRegisterDllNotification");
    PVOID cookie = nullptr;
    LONG st = reg ? reg(0, OnDllNotification, nullptr, &cookie) : -1;
    Log("dll-load notification %s (0x%08lX)", st == 0 ? "registered" : "FAILED", (unsigned long)st);
}

DWORD WINAPI InitThread(LPVOID) {
    if (ScanOwnModulesForAntiCheat()) {
        char name[256] = {0}; WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, g_acModule, -1, name, sizeof(name) - 1, nullptr, nullptr);
        Log("REFUSED: anti-cheat module loaded (%s, %s). vinput is for offline games only: no hooks, no pipe.", g_acProduct.load(), name);
        return 0;
    }
    g_capEvent = CreateEventW(nullptr, TRUE, FALSE, nullptr);
    MH_STATUS s = VIMH_Initialize();
    if (s != MH_OK && s != MH_ERROR_ALREADY_INITIALIZED) { Log("MinHook init failed %s", VIMH_StatusToString(s)); }
    RegisterDllNotification();
    InstallUser32Hooks();
    // GL / Vulkan before DXGI: their drivers may present through an internal DXGI swapchain, which is only recognised
    // as foreign once the GL/VK hook is in. Vulkan before the pipe exists: a target that waits for the pipe and then
    // creates its VkDevice is covered.
    TryHookGL();
    TryHookVk();
    InstallDxgiHooks();
    TryHookDInput(); TryHookDInputLegacy(); TryHookXInput();
    FindRawDevices();
    g_realFg = ComputeRealFg();
    HANDLE t = CreateThread(nullptr, 0, PipeThread, nullptr, 0, nullptr); if (t) CloseHandle(t);
    for (int i = 0; i < 600 && !g_hwnd; i++) { HWND h = FindMainWindow(); if (h) { Retarget(h); break; } Sleep(200); }
    Log("hooks ok: %s", g_hooksOk.c_str());
    if (!g_hooksFail.empty()) Log("hooks FAILED: %s", g_hooksFail.c_str());
    t = CreateThread(nullptr, 0, MonitorThread, nullptr, 0, nullptr); if (t) CloseHandle(t);
    return 0;
}

}  // namespace

extern "C" const char* VInput_Version(void) { return VI_VERSION; }

extern "C" int VInput_Init(void) {
    static volatile LONG once = 0;
    if (InterlockedCompareExchange(&once, 1, 0) != 0) return 0;
    g_pid = GetCurrentProcessId();
    wchar_t mx[64]; swprintf_s(mx, L"Local\\vinput_instance_%lu", g_pid);
    HANDLE m = CreateMutexW(nullptr, FALSE, mx);
    if (m && GetLastError() == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS) { CloseHandle(m); return 0; }  // another copy (DLL vs compiled-in) owns this process
    g_t0 = GetTickCount();
    { HANDLE tok = nullptr; DWORD isAc = 0, n = 0; if (OpenProcessToken(GetCurrentProcess(), TOKEN_QUERY, &tok)) { if (GetTokenInformation(tok, TokenIsAppContainer, &isAc, sizeof(isAc), &n)) g_appContainer = isAc != 0; CloseHandle(tok); } }
    GetModuleHandleExW(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT, (LPCWSTR)&VInput_Init, &g_self);
    wchar_t dir[MAX_PATH] = {0};
    if (GetModuleFileNameW(g_self, dir, MAX_PATH)) {
        wchar_t* sl = wcsrchr(dir, L'\\'); if (sl) *sl = 0;
        wchar_t logs[MAX_PATH]; swprintf_s(logs, L"%s\\logs", dir); CreateDirectoryW(logs, nullptr);
        swprintf_s(g_logPath, L"%s\\vinput_%lu.log", logs, g_pid);
    }
    Log("%s starting in pid %lu", VI_VERSION, g_pid);
    HANDLE t = CreateThread(nullptr, 0, InitThread, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    if (t) CloseHandle(t);
    return 1;
}
```

```cpp
// vinput_dll.cpp - standalone injectable vinput DLL (vinput64.dll / vinput32.dll).
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN

#include "vinput.h"

extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) const char* vinput_version(void) { return VInput_Version(); }

BOOL APIENTRY DllMain(HMODULE h, DWORD reason, LPVOID) {
    if (reason == DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH) {
        DisableThreadLibraryCalls(h);
        HMODULE pinned = nullptr;  // hooks point into this module: never let it unload
        GetModuleHandleExW(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_PIN, (LPCWSTR)&DllMain, &pinned);
```

`test/compilein_test.cpp`:

```cpp
// compilein_test.cpp - stands in for a host DLL (your own tool or mod) that (1) links its OWN MinHook and hooks Present like
// a typical overlay does, and (2) compiles vinput in behind VINPUT_COMPILE_IN.
// Proves: no duplicate symbols at link time, both MinHook instances coexist, both Present hooks chain.
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <d3d11.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include "MinHook.h"   // the host's own, un-renamed MinHook
#include "vinput.h"
#pragma comment(lib, "d3d11.lib")

static volatile LONG g_hostPresents = 0;
typedef HRESULT(STDMETHODCALLTYPE* PFN_Present)(IDXGISwapChain*, UINT, UINT);
static PFN_Present o_Present;
static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE HostPresent(IDXGISwapChain* s, UINT a, UINT b) { InterlockedIncrement(&g_hostPresents); return o_Present(s, a, b); }
extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) LONG host_present_count() { return g_hostPresents; }

static DWORD WINAPI Init(LPVOID) {
    VINPUT_INIT();  // compiled in only when VINPUT_COMPILE_IN is defined
    Sleep(1500);    // let vinput hook Present FIRST, so the host's MinHook has to hook vinput's jmp (worst case)
    WNDCLASSW wc = {}; wc.lpfnWndProc = DefWindowProcW; wc.hInstance = GetModuleHandleW(nullptr); wc.lpszClassName = L"host_dummy";
    RegisterClassW(&wc);
    HWND h = CreateWindowW(wc.lpszClassName, L"", WS_OVERLAPPED, 0, 0, 8, 8, nullptr, nullptr, wc.hInstance, nullptr);
    DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC d = {}; d.BufferCount = 1; d.BufferDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM; d.BufferUsage = DXGI_USAGE_RENDER_TARGET_OUTPUT;
    d.OutputWindow = h; d.SampleDesc.Count = 1; d.Windowed = TRUE;
    IDXGISwapChain* sc; ID3D11Device* dev; ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx;
    if (SUCCEEDED(D3D11CreateDeviceAndSwapChain(nullptr, D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_HARDWARE, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 0, D3D11_SDK_VERSION, &d, &sc, &dev, nullptr, &ctx))) {
        void* present = (*(void***)sc)[8];
        MH_Initialize();
        MH_CreateHook(present, (void*)&HostPresent, (void**)&o_Present);
        MH_EnableHook(present);
        ctx->Release(); dev->Release(); sc->Release();
    }
    DestroyWindow(h);
    // publish the host-side Present count so a test can see the host's own hook still fires
    wchar_t path[MAX_PATH]; HMODULE self = nullptr;
    GetModuleHandleExW(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT, (LPCWSTR)&Init, &self);
    GetModuleFileNameW(self, path, MAX_PATH); wcscat_s(path, L".presents.txt");
    for (;;) { FILE* f = nullptr; _wfopen_s(&f, path, L"w"); if (f) { fprintf(f, "%ld\n", g_hostPresents); fclose(f); } Sleep(500); }
}
BOOL APIENTRY DllMain(HMODULE m, DWORD r, LPVOID) {
    if (r == DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH) { DisableThreadLibraryCalls(m); CloseHandle(CreateThread(nullptr, 0, Init, nullptr, 0, nullptr)); }
    return TRUE;
}
```

`test/vi_aclaunch.cpp`:

```cpp
// vi_aclaunch.cpp - starts a program inside an AppContainer (profile "vinput.capture.test", no capabilities),
// the same sandbox a UWP / Xbox app game runs in. Used by verify\run_nativecapture.ps1 to test vinput's
// AppContainer support (DLL/log ACLs, pipe in the container namespace) without a real UWP game.
//   vi_aclaunch.exe <exe> [args...]      -> {"ok":true,"pid":N,"appcontainer_sid":"S-1-15-2-..."}
// The exe and anything it must read/write need ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES (S-1-15-2-1) access (the script grants it).
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <userenv.h>
#include <sddl.h>
#include <string>
#include <cstdio>
#pragma comment(lib, "userenv.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "advapi32.lib")

int wmain(int argc, wchar_t** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) { printf("{\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"usage: vi_aclaunch <exe> [args]\"}\n"); return 2; }
    const wchar_t* name = L"vinput.capture.test";
    PSID sid = nullptr;
    HRESULT hr = CreateAppContainerProfile(name, L"vinput capture test", L"vinput synthetic AppContainer target", nullptr, 0, &sid);
    if (hr == HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS)) hr = DeriveAppContainerSidFromAppContainerName(name, &sid);
    if (FAILED(hr) || !sid) { printf("{\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"AppContainer profile hr=0x%08X\"}\n", (unsigned)hr); return 2; }
    SECURITY_CAPABILITIES caps = {}; caps.AppContainerSid = sid;
    SIZE_T sz = 0; InitializeProcThreadAttributeList(nullptr, 1, 0, &sz);
    std::string buf(sz, '\0');
    LPPROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_LIST al = (LPPROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_LIST)&buf[0];
    if (!InitializeProcThreadAttributeList(al, 1, 0, &sz) ||
        !UpdateProcThreadAttribute(al, 0, PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_SECURITY_CAPABILITIES, &caps, sizeof(caps), nullptr, nullptr)) {
        printf("{\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"attribute list %lu\"}\n", GetLastError()); return 2;
    }
    std::wstring cmd = L"\"" + std::wstring(argv[1]) + L"\"";
    for (int i = 2; i < argc; i++) { cmd += L" \""; cmd += argv[i]; cmd += L"\""; }
    STARTUPINFOEXW si = {}; si.StartupInfo.cb = sizeof(si); si.lpAttributeList = al;
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi = {};
    if (!CreateProcessW(argv[1], &cmd[0], nullptr, nullptr, FALSE, EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT, nullptr, nullptr, &si.StartupInfo, &pi)) {
        printf("{\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"CreateProcess %lu\"}\n", GetLastError()); return 2;
    }
    LPWSTR ss = nullptr; ConvertSidToStringSidW(sid, &ss);
    printf("{\"ok\":true,\"pid\":%lu,\"appcontainer_sid\":\"%ls\"}\n", pi.dwProcessId, ss ? ss : L"");
    if (ss) LocalFree(ss);
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread); CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
    DeleteProcThreadAttributeList(al); FreeSid(sid);
    return 0;
}
```

`test/vi_actarget.cpp`:

```cpp
// vi_actarget.cpp - synthetic target for the anti-cheat refusal tests (verify\run_actest.ps1).
// A plain window that can load DLLs in order at start-up and one more DLL when it receives the key 'L':
//   vi_actarget.exe <logfile> [--load <dll>]... [--late <dll>]
// The test loads a harmless dummy DLL named like an anti-cheat module (test\vi_acdummy.cpp) to prove vinput refuses.
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <share.h>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#pragma comment(lib, "user32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "gdi32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "shell32.lib")

static FILE* g_log = nullptr;
static std::wstring g_late;
static void L(const char* fmt, ...) {
    if (!g_log) return;
    va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt); vfprintf(g_log, fmt, ap); va_end(ap);
    fputc('\n', g_log); fflush(g_log);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK Wnd(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    switch (m) {
    case WM_KEYDOWN:
        L("WM_KEYDOWN vk=0x%02X", (unsigned)w);
        if (w == 'L' && !g_late.empty()) {
            HMODULE mod = LoadLibraryW(g_late.c_str());
            L("LATE_LOAD %s err=%lu", mod ? "ok" : "failed", mod ? 0ul : GetLastError());
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_DESTROY: PostQuitMessage(0); return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}

int WINAPI wWinMain(HINSTANCE hi, HINSTANCE, LPWSTR, int) {
    int argc = 0; wchar_t** argv = CommandLineToArgvW(GetCommandLineW(), &argc);
    if (argc >= 2) g_log = _wfsopen(argv[1], L"w", _SH_DENYNO);   // readable by the test while open
    L("START pid=%lu", GetCurrentProcessId());
    for (int i = 2; i < argc; i++) {
        std::wstring a = argv[i];
        if (a == L"--load" && i + 1 < argc) {
            HMODULE mod = LoadLibraryW(argv[++i]);
            L("LOAD %s err=%lu", mod ? "ok" : "failed", mod ? 0ul : GetLastError());
        } else if (a == L"--late" && i + 1 < argc) g_late = argv[++i];
    }
    WNDCLASSW wc = {}; wc.lpfnWndProc = Wnd; wc.hInstance = hi; wc.lpszClassName = L"vi_actarget";
    wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(nullptr, IDC_ARROW); wc.hbrBackground = (HBRUSH)GetStockObject(DKGRAY_BRUSH);
    RegisterClassW(&wc);
    HWND hwnd = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_NOACTIVATE, wc.lpszClassName, L"vinput anti-cheat refusal target", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW,
                                -28000, 600, 320, 200, nullptr, nullptr, hi, nullptr);
    ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE);
    L("WINDOW ready");
    MSG msg;
    while (GetMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0) > 0) { TranslateMessage(&msg); DispatchMessageW(&msg); }
    if (g_log) fclose(g_log);
    return 0;
}
```

`test/vi_channelprobe.cpp`:

```cpp
// Synthetic vinput channel observer. This target never requests foreground or sends OS input by default.
// Usage: vi_channelprobe.exe <absolute-log-path>
// WM_APP+1: polling enabled=(wParam!=0); +2: cursor-recenter enabled; +3: post invalid WM_INPUT;
// WM_APP+4: guarded target-side SendInput probe; +5: add a chaining overlay WndProc; +6: raw-buffer polling.
// WM_APP+7: remove overlay; +8: quit. Guarded SendInput requires an actual vinput status reply proving
// redirect_sendinput=true, really_foreground=false, and a SendInput hook. Missing support => REFUSED.
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#define UNICODE
#define _UNICODE
#define DIRECTINPUT_VERSION 0x0800
#include <windows.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <dinput.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <string>
#include <share.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "user32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "gdi32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "shell32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "dinput8.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "dxguid.lib")
typedef unsigned __int64 QWORD; // NEXTRAWINPUTBLOCK on Windows SDK with WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN.

namespace {
FILE* g_log = nullptr;
HWND g_window = nullptr;
bool g_poll = true, g_recenter = false, g_rawBuffer = false;
WNDPROC g_overlayPrevious = nullptr;
unsigned g_clicks = 0;
constexpr LPARAM kExternalRaw = 0x49340001;

void Log(const char* fmt, ...) {
    char line[1024];
    va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt); vsprintf_s(line, fmt, ap); va_end(ap);
    if (g_log) { fprintf(g_log, "%llu %s\n", GetTickCount64(), line); fflush(g_log); }
}

bool StatusAllowsSendInput() {
    wchar_t path[80]; swprintf_s(path, L"\\\\.\\pipe\\vinput_%lu", GetCurrentProcessId());
    HANDLE pipe = CreateFileW(path, GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, nullptr);
    if (pipe == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) { Log("SENDINPUT_REFUSED no_vinput_pipe"); return false; }
    const char request[] = "{\"cmd\":\"status\"}\n";
    DWORD written = 0;
    bool ok = WriteFile(pipe, request, sizeof(request) - 1, &written, nullptr) != FALSE;
    std::string reply;
    const ULONGLONG deadline = GetTickCount64() + 2000;
    while (ok && GetTickCount64() < deadline && reply.size() < 65536) {
        DWORD available = 0;
        if (!PeekNamedPipe(pipe, nullptr, 0, nullptr, &available, nullptr)) break;
        if (!available) { Sleep(2); continue; }
        char buffer[4096]; DWORD got = 0;
        if (!ReadFile(pipe, buffer, sizeof(buffer), &got, nullptr) || !got) break;
        reply.append(buffer, got);
        if (reply.find('\n') != std::string::npos) break;
    }
    CloseHandle(pipe);
    const bool enabled = reply.find("\"redirect_sendinput\":true") != std::string::npos;
    const bool background = reply.find("\"really_foreground\":false") != std::string::npos;
    const auto hookStart = reply.find("\"hooks_ok\":\"");
    const auto hookEnd = hookStart == std::string::npos ? hookStart : reply.find('"', hookStart + 12);
    const bool hooked = hookStart != std::string::npos && hookEnd != std::string::npos &&
        reply.substr(hookStart, hookEnd - hookStart).find("SendInput") != std::string::npos;
    if (!enabled || !background || !hooked) {
        Log("SENDINPUT_REFUSED enabled=%d background=%d hooked=%d", enabled, background, hooked);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

void GuardedSendInput() {
    if (!StatusAllowsSendInput()) return;
    INPUT input[3]{};
    input[0].type = INPUT_MOUSE; input[0].mi.dx = 19; input[0].mi.dy = -11; input[0].mi.dwFlags = MOUSEEVENTF_MOVE;
    input[1].type = INPUT_KEYBOARD; input[1].ki.wVk = VK_F8;
    input[2].type = INPUT_KEYBOARD; input[2].ki.wVk = VK_F8; input[2].ki.dwFlags = KEYEVENTF_KEYUP;
    const UINT sent = SendInput(3, input, sizeof(INPUT));
    Log("TARGET_SENDINPUT sent=%u expected=3 dx=19 dy=-11 key=F8", sent);
}

void DescribeRaw(const RAWINPUT& raw, const char* source) {
    if (raw.header.dwType == RIM_TYPEKEYBOARD)
        Log("%s_KBD vk=0x%02X flags=0x%X", source, raw.data.keyboard.VKey, raw.data.keyboard.Flags);
    if (raw.header.dwType == RIM_TYPEMOUSE)
        Log("%s_MOUSE dx=%ld dy=%ld buttons=0x%X", source, raw.data.mouse.lLastX, raw.data.mouse.lLastY, raw.data.mouse.usButtonFlags);
}

LRESULT CALLBACK Overlay(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    if (m == WM_MOUSEMOVE || m == WM_LBUTTONDOWN || m == WM_LBUTTONUP) {
        POINT p{}; GetCursorPos(&p); ScreenToClient(h, &p);
        Log("OVERLAY msg=0x%X lp=%d,%d cursor=%ld,%ld", m, (short)LOWORD(l), (short)HIWORD(l), p.x, p.y);
    }
    return CallWindowProcW(g_overlayPrevious, h, m, w, l);
}

LRESULT CALLBACK WindowProc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    switch (m) {
    case WM_MOUSEACTIVATE: return MA_NOACTIVATE;
    case WM_APP + 1: g_poll = w != 0; Log("POLLING %s", g_poll ? "on" : "off"); return 0;
    case WM_APP + 2: g_recenter = w != 0; Log("RECENTER %s", g_recenter ? "on" : "off"); return 0;
    case WM_APP + 3: Log("EXTERNAL_RAW_POST handle=0x%llX", (unsigned long long)kExternalRaw); PostMessageW(h, WM_INPUT, RIM_INPUT, kExternalRaw); return 0;
    case WM_APP + 4: GuardedSendInput(); return 0;
    case WM_APP + 5:
        if (!g_overlayPrevious) { g_overlayPrevious = (WNDPROC)SetWindowLongPtrW(h, GWLP_WNDPROC, (LONG_PTR)Overlay); Log("OVERLAY_INSTALLED prev=%p", g_overlayPrevious); }
        return 0;
    case WM_APP + 6: g_rawBuffer = w != 0; Log("RAW_BUFFER %s", g_rawBuffer ? "on" : "off"); return 0;
    case WM_APP + 7:
        if (g_overlayPrevious && (WNDPROC)GetWindowLongPtrW(h, GWLP_WNDPROC) == Overlay) {
            const WNDPROC previous = g_overlayPrevious;
            SetWindowLongPtrW(h, GWLP_WNDPROC, (LONG_PTR)previous); g_overlayPrevious = nullptr;
            Log("OVERLAY_REMOVED");
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_APP + 8: DestroyWindow(h); return 0;
    case WM_KEYDOWN: case WM_SYSKEYDOWN: case WM_KEYUP: case WM_SYSKEYUP:
        Log("WM_KEY msg=0x%X vk=0x%02X sc=0x%02X", m, (unsigned)w, (unsigned)((l >> 16) & 0xff)); return 0;
    case WM_CHAR: Log("WM_CHAR u16=0x%04X", (unsigned)w); return 0;
    case WM_MOUSEMOVE: Log("WM_MOUSEMOVE %d %d", (short)LOWORD(l), (short)HIWORD(l)); return 0;
    case WM_LBUTTONDOWN: {
        POINT p{}; GetCursorPos(&p); ScreenToClient(h, &p);
        Log("WM_LBUTTONDOWN lp=%d,%d cursor=%ld,%ld", (short)LOWORD(l), (short)HIWORD(l), p.x, p.y);
        ++g_clicks; InvalidateRect(h, nullptr, FALSE); return 0;
    }
    case WM_LBUTTONUP: Log("WM_LBUTTONUP %d %d", (short)LOWORD(l), (short)HIWORD(l)); return 0;
    case WM_MOUSEWHEEL: Log("WM_WHEEL %d", (short)HIWORD(w)); return 0;
    case WM_INPUT: {
        if (l == kExternalRaw) { Log("EXTERNAL_RAW_REACHED_APP"); return 0; }
        RAWINPUT raw{}; UINT bytes = sizeof(raw);
        const UINT result = GetRawInputData((HRAWINPUT)l, RID_INPUT, &raw, &bytes, sizeof(RAWINPUTHEADER));
        if (result == (UINT)-1) Log("RAW_ERROR %lu", GetLastError()); else DescribeRaw(raw, "RAW");
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_PAINT: {
        PAINTSTRUCT paint{}; HDC dc = BeginPaint(h, &paint);
        RECT client{}; GetClientRect(h, &client); FillRect(dc, &client, (HBRUSH)GetStockObject(WHITE_BRUSH));
        SetTextColor(dc, RGB(0, 0, 0)); SetBkMode(dc, TRANSPARENT);
        TextOutW(dc, 25, 25, L"Load Game", 9); TextOutW(dc, 25, 75, L"New Game", 8);
        wchar_t count[80]; swprintf_s(count, L"Clicks: %u", g_clicks); TextOutW(dc, 25, 130, count, (int)wcslen(count));
        EndPaint(h, &paint); return 0;
    }
    case WM_DESTROY: PostQuitMessage(0); return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}
}

int WINAPI wWinMain(HINSTANCE instance, HINSTANCE, LPWSTR, int) {
    int argc = 0; wchar_t** argv = CommandLineToArgvW(GetCommandLineW(), &argc);
    if (!argv || argc < 2) return 2;
    g_log = _wfsopen(argv[1], L"w", _SH_DENYNO); LocalFree(argv);
    if (!g_log) return 3;
    WNDCLASSW cls{}; cls.lpfnWndProc = WindowProc; cls.hInstance = instance; cls.lpszClassName = L"vi_channelprobe";
    cls.hCursor = LoadCursorW(nullptr, IDC_ARROW); RegisterClassW(&cls);
    g_window = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_NOACTIVATE, cls.lpszClassName, L"vinput channel probe", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW,
        -28000, 600, 480, 300, nullptr, nullptr, instance, nullptr);
    if (!g_window) { fclose(g_log); return 4; }
    ShowWindow(g_window, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE);
    RAWINPUTDEVICE devices[2] = {{1, 6, 0, g_window}, {1, 2, 0, g_window}};
    RegisterRawInputDevices(devices, 2, sizeof(devices[0]));
    IDirectInput8W* di = nullptr; IDirectInputDevice8W* keyboard = nullptr; IDirectInputDevice8W* mouse = nullptr;
    if (SUCCEEDED(DirectInput8Create(instance, DIRECTINPUT_VERSION, IID_IDirectInput8W, (void**)&di, nullptr))) {
        di->CreateDevice(GUID_SysKeyboard, &keyboard, nullptr); di->CreateDevice(GUID_SysMouse, &mouse, nullptr);
        DIPROPDWORD buffer{}; buffer.diph.dwSize = sizeof(buffer); buffer.diph.dwHeaderSize = sizeof(buffer.diph);
        buffer.diph.dwHow = DIPH_DEVICE; buffer.dwData = 128;
        if (keyboard) { keyboard->SetDataFormat(&c_dfDIKeyboard); keyboard->SetCooperativeLevel(g_window, DISCL_FOREGROUND | DISCL_NONEXCLUSIVE); keyboard->SetProperty(DIPROP_BUFFERSIZE, &buffer.diph); }
        if (mouse) { mouse->SetDataFormat(&c_dfDIMouse2); mouse->SetCooperativeLevel(g_window, DISCL_FOREGROUND | DISCL_NONEXCLUSIVE); mouse->SetProperty(DIPROP_BUFFERSIZE, &buffer.diph); }
    }
    Log("START pid=%lu hwnd=%p noactivate=1", GetCurrentProcessId(), g_window);
    USHORT prevAsync[256]{}; SHORT prevState[256]{}; BYTE prevKeyboard[256]{}, prevDI[256]{};
    POINT prevCursor{-100000, -100000};
    bool running = true;
    while (running) {
        MSG msg{};
        while (PeekMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) {
            if (msg.message == WM_QUIT) { running = false; break; }
            TranslateMessage(&msg); DispatchMessageW(&msg);
        }
        if (!running) break;
        if (g_poll) {
            for (int vk = 1; vk < 256; ++vk) {
                const USHORT async = (USHORT)GetAsyncKeyState(vk) & 0x8000;
                const SHORT state = GetKeyState(vk);
                if (async != prevAsync[vk]) { Log("GAKS vk=0x%02X value=0x%04X", vk, (unsigned)(USHORT)async); prevAsync[vk] = async; }
                if (state != prevState[vk]) { Log("GKS vk=0x%02X value=0x%04X", vk, (unsigned)(USHORT)state); prevState[vk] = state; }
            }
            BYTE keyboardState[256]{};
            if (GetKeyboardState(keyboardState)) for (int vk = 1; vk < 256; ++vk) {
                if (keyboardState[vk] != prevKeyboard[vk]) { Log("GKBS vk=0x%02X value=0x%02X", vk, keyboardState[vk]); prevKeyboard[vk] = keyboardState[vk]; }
            }
            if (keyboard) {
                BYTE keys[256]{}; HRESULT hr = keyboard->GetDeviceState(sizeof(keys), keys);
                if (FAILED(hr)) { keyboard->Acquire(); hr = keyboard->GetDeviceState(sizeof(keys), keys); }
                if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) for (unsigned dik = 0; dik < 256; ++dik) {
                    if (keys[dik] != prevDI[dik]) { Log("DI_STATE dik=0x%02X value=0x%02X", dik, keys[dik]); prevDI[dik] = keys[dik]; }
                }
                DIDEVICEOBJECTDATA data[128]{}; DWORD n = 128;
                if (SUCCEEDED(keyboard->GetDeviceData(sizeof(data[0]), data, &n, 0))) for (DWORD i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                    Log("DI_BUFFER dik=0x%02lX value=0x%02lX", data[i].dwOfs, data[i].dwData);
            }
            if (mouse) {
                DIMOUSESTATE2 state{}; HRESULT hr = mouse->GetDeviceState(sizeof(state), &state);
                if (FAILED(hr)) { mouse->Acquire(); hr = mouse->GetDeviceState(sizeof(state), &state); }
                if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && (state.lX || state.lY || state.lZ)) Log("DI_MOUSE dx=%ld dy=%ld wheel=%ld", state.lX, state.lY, state.lZ);
            }
        }
        POINT cursor{};
        if (GetCursorPos(&cursor)) {
            ScreenToClient(g_window, &cursor);
            if (cursor.x != prevCursor.x || cursor.y != prevCursor.y) { Log("CURSOR %ld %ld", cursor.x, cursor.y); prevCursor = cursor; }
            if (g_recenter) {
                RECT client{}; GetClientRect(g_window, &client);
                POINT center{client.right / 2, client.bottom / 2};
                if (cursor.x != center.x || cursor.y != center.y) Log("CURSOR_LOOK dx=%ld dy=%ld", cursor.x - center.x, cursor.y - center.y);
                ClientToScreen(g_window, &center); SetCursorPos(center.x, center.y);
            }
        }
        if (g_rawBuffer) {
            alignas(16) BYTE buffer[16384]{}; UINT bytes = sizeof(buffer);
            const UINT count = GetRawInputBuffer((PRAWINPUT)buffer, &bytes, sizeof(RAWINPUTHEADER));
            if (count != (UINT)-1) {
                PRAWINPUT raw = (PRAWINPUT)buffer;
                for (UINT i = 0; i < count && (BYTE*)raw + sizeof(RAWINPUTHEADER) <= buffer + sizeof(buffer); ++i) {
                    DescribeRaw(*raw, "RAW_BUFFER"); raw = NEXTRAWINPUTBLOCK(raw);
                }
            }
        }
        Sleep(10);
    }
    if (keyboard) keyboard->Release(); if (mouse) mouse->Release(); if (di) di->Release();
    Log("STOP"); fclose(g_log); return 0;
}
```

`test/vi_d3d12test.cpp`:

```cpp
// vi_d3d12test.cpp - synthetic D3D12 capture target for vinput. Flip-model swapchain on a DIRECT queue; every frame
// the CPU writes vi_pattern.h (frame counter + colour bars) into an upload buffer and the GPU copies it into the
// current back buffer. Handles WM_SIZE with ResizeBuffers (all back-buffer refs released first).
//   vi_d3d12test.exe <log> <x> <y> <w> <h> [--fmt bgra|rgba|r10|f16] [--vsync 0|1]
// Never activates: WS_EX_NOACTIVATE + SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE.
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <d3d12.h>
#include <dxgi1_4.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <share.h>
#include "vi_pattern.h"
#pragma comment(lib, "d3d12.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "dxgi.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "user32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "shell32.lib")

static FILE* g_log; static HWND g_hwnd; static volatile bool g_resize = false;
static void L(const char* f, ...) { if (!g_log) return; va_list a; va_start(a, f); vfprintf(g_log, f, a); va_end(a); fputc('\n', g_log); fflush(g_log); }
static LRESULT CALLBACK Wnd(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    if (m == WM_SIZE) g_resize = true;
    if (m == WM_DESTROY) { PostQuitMessage(0); return 0; }
    return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}
#define CK(x) do { HRESULT hr_ = (x); if (FAILED(hr_)) { L("FAIL %s hr=0x%08X line %d", #x, (unsigned)hr_, __LINE__); return 2; } } while (0)

int WINAPI wWinMain(HINSTANCE hi, HINSTANCE, LPWSTR, int) {
    int argc; wchar_t** argv = CommandLineToArgvW(GetCommandLineW(), &argc);
    g_log = _wfsopen(argc > 1 ? argv[1] : L"vi_d3d12test.log", L"w", _SH_DENYNO);
    int x = argc > 5 ? _wtoi(argv[2]) : 100, y = argc > 5 ? _wtoi(argv[3]) : 100, w = argc > 5 ? _wtoi(argv[4]) : 800, hgt = argc > 5 ? _wtoi(argv[5]) : 450;
    vipat::Fmt pf = vipat::BGRA8; DXGI_FORMAT fmt = DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM; UINT vsync = 1;
    for (int i = 6; i + 1 < argc; i++) {
        if (!wcscmp(argv[i], L"--fmt")) {
            const wchar_t* f = argv[++i];
            if (!wcscmp(f, L"rgba")) { pf = vipat::RGBA8; fmt = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM; }
            else if (!wcscmp(f, L"r10")) { pf = vipat::R10G10B10A2; fmt = DXGI_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_UNORM; }
            else if (!wcscmp(f, L"f16")) { pf = vipat::RGBA16F; fmt = DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_FLOAT; }
        } else if (!wcscmp(argv[i], L"--vsync")) vsync = (UINT)_wtoi(argv[++i]);
    }
    WNDCLASSW wc = {}; wc.lpfnWndProc = Wnd; wc.hInstance = hi; wc.lpszClassName = L"vi_d3d12test"; wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
    RegisterClassW(&wc);
    g_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_NOACTIVATE, wc.lpszClassName, L"vinput d3d12 capture target", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, x, y, w, hgt, nullptr, nullptr, hi, nullptr);
    ShowWindow(g_hwnd, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE);

    ID3D12Device* dev = nullptr; IDXGIFactory4* fac = nullptr; ID3D12CommandQueue* q = nullptr;
    CK(CreateDXGIFactory1(__uuidof(IDXGIFactory4), (void**)&fac));
    if (FAILED(D3D12CreateDevice(nullptr, D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0, __uuidof(ID3D12Device), (void**)&dev))) {
        IDXGIAdapter* warp = nullptr; CK(fac->EnumWarpAdapter(__uuidof(IDXGIAdapter), (void**)&warp));
        CK(D3D12CreateDevice(warp, D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0, __uuidof(ID3D12Device), (void**)&dev)); warp->Release(); L("WARP");
    }
    D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_DESC qd = {}; qd.Type = D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT;
    CK(dev->CreateCommandQueue(&qd, __uuidof(ID3D12CommandQueue), (void**)&q));
    const UINT N = 3;
    RECT rc; GetClientRect(g_hwnd, &rc);
    UINT cw = rc.right, ch = rc.bottom;
    DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC1 sd = {}; sd.Width = cw; sd.Height = ch; sd.Format = fmt; sd.SampleDesc.Count = 1; sd.BufferUsage = DXGI_USAGE_RENDER_TARGET_OUTPUT;
    sd.BufferCount = N; sd.SwapEffect = DXGI_SWAP_EFFECT_FLIP_DISCARD;
    IDXGISwapChain1* sc1 = nullptr; IDXGISwapChain3* sc = nullptr;
    CK(fac->CreateSwapChainForHwnd(q, g_hwnd, &sd, nullptr, nullptr, &sc1));
    CK(sc1->QueryInterface(__uuidof(IDXGISwapChain3), (void**)&sc)); sc1->Release();
    fac->MakeWindowAssociation(g_hwnd, DXGI_MWA_NO_ALT_ENTER);
    ID3D12CommandAllocator* al = nullptr; ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* cl = nullptr; ID3D12Fence* fe = nullptr; UINT64 fv = 0;
    CK(dev->CreateCommandAllocator(D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, __uuidof(ID3D12CommandAllocator), (void**)&al));
    CK(dev->CreateCommandList(0, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, al, nullptr, __uuidof(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList), (void**)&cl)); cl->Close();
    CK(dev->CreateFence(0, D3D12_FENCE_FLAG_NONE, __uuidof(ID3D12Fence), (void**)&fe));
    HANDLE ev = CreateEventW(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr);
    auto wait = [&]() { ++fv; q->Signal(fe, fv); if (fe->GetCompletedValue() < fv) { fe->SetEventOnCompletion(fv, ev); WaitForSingleObject(ev, 5000); } };
    ID3D12Resource* up = nullptr; UINT64 upSize = 0; BYTE* upMap = nullptr;
    L("START hwnd=%p fmt=%d client=%ux%u", g_hwnd, (int)fmt, cw, ch);
    UINT32 frame = 0; DWORD lastLog = 0; int resizes = 0;
    LARGE_INTEGER qpf, prevT{}; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&qpf); double maxMs = 0, worstMs = 0;
    MSG msg;
    for (;;) {
        while (PeekMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) { if (msg.message == WM_QUIT) { wait(); L("EXIT frames=%u resizes=%d", frame, resizes); return 0; } TranslateMessage(&msg); DispatchMessageW(&msg); }
        if (g_resize) {
            g_resize = false;
            GetClientRect(g_hwnd, &rc);
            if (rc.right > 0 && rc.bottom > 0 && ((UINT)rc.right != cw || (UINT)rc.bottom != ch)) {
                wait();   // no back-buffer refs are held between frames
                HRESULT hr = sc->ResizeBuffers(0, rc.right, rc.bottom, DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN, 0);
                L("RESIZE %ldx%ld hr=0x%08X", rc.right, rc.bottom, (unsigned)hr);
                if (FAILED(hr)) return 3;
                cw = rc.right; ch = rc.bottom; resizes++; prevT.QuadPart = 0;   // a resize is not a capture stall
            }
        }
        UINT idx = sc->GetCurrentBackBufferIndex();
        ID3D12Resource* bb = nullptr; CK(sc->GetBuffer(idx, __uuidof(ID3D12Resource), (void**)&bb));
        D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC rd = bb->GetDesc();
        D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT fp; UINT rows; UINT64 rb, total;
        dev->GetCopyableFootprints(&rd, 0, 1, 0, &fp, &rows, &rb, &total);
        if (total > upSize) {
            if (up) { wait(); up->Release(); }
            D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp = {}; hp.Type = D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD;
            D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC bd = {}; bd.Dimension = D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER; bd.Width = total; bd.Height = 1; bd.DepthOrArraySize = 1; bd.MipLevels = 1; bd.SampleDesc.Count = 1; bd.Layout = D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR;
            CK(dev->CreateCommittedResource(&hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &bd, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr, __uuidof(ID3D12Resource), (void**)&up));
            D3D12_RANGE none = {0, 0}; CK(up->Map(0, &none, (void**)&upMap)); upSize = total;
        }
        for (UINT yy = 0; yy < rd.Height; yy++) vipat::Row(pf, (int)yy, (int)rd.Width, frame, upMap + fp.Offset + (size_t)yy * fp.Footprint.RowPitch);
        CK(al->Reset()); CK(cl->Reset(al, nullptr));
        D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER b = {}; b.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION; b.Transition.pResource = bb; b.Transition.Subresource = 0;
        b.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT; b.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST; cl->ResourceBarrier(1, &b);
        D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION dst = {}, src = {};
        dst.pResource = bb; dst.Type = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_SUBRESOURCE_INDEX; dst.SubresourceIndex = 0;
        src.pResource = up; src.Type = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_PLACED_FOOTPRINT; src.PlacedFootprint = fp;
        cl->CopyTextureRegion(&dst, 0, 0, 0, &src, nullptr);
        b.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST; b.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT; cl->ResourceBarrier(1, &b);
        CK(cl->Close());
        ID3D12CommandList* lists[] = {cl}; q->ExecuteCommandLists(1, lists);
        bb->Release();
        HRESULT hr = sc->Present(vsync, 0);
        if (FAILED(hr)) { L("PRESENT_FAIL hr=0x%08X removed=0x%08X", (unsigned)hr, (unsigned)dev->GetDeviceRemovedReason()); return 4; }
        wait();   // simple: one frame in flight (the upload buffer is rewritten next frame)
        ++frame;
        LARGE_INTEGER now; QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
        if (prevT.QuadPart) { double ms = (now.QuadPart - prevT.QuadPart) * 1000.0 / qpf.QuadPart; if (ms > maxMs) maxMs = ms; if (ms > worstMs) worstMs = ms; }
        prevT = now;
        if (GetTickCount() - lastLog > 1000) { lastLog = GetTickCount(); L("FRAME %u maxms=%.1f worstms=%.1f", frame, maxMs, worstMs); maxMs = 0; }
        Sleep(4);   // bounded render rate (an offscreen flip-model window is never vsync-throttled)
    }
}
```

`test/vi_dinput1test.cpp`:

```cpp
// Synthetic target for the LEGACY DirectInput path (dinput.dll, DirectInputCreateA, DirectInput 1-7), which 1990s games
// such as Fallout still use. vinput's dinput8 hooks never see these devices.
// usage: vi_dinput1test.exe <log> [--buffered] [--gated]
// --gated: behave like Fallout 1/2's GNW95 loop - a window that never activates itself (no-activate, off-screen) and
//          does not poll input at all until its window procedure has received WM_ACTIVATEAPP(TRUE) (logs ACTIVATEAPP 0|1).
// Polls the keyboard (GetDeviceState, or buffered GetDeviceData with --buffered) and the mouse every ~2 ms and logs
//   <hh:mm:ss.mmm> KEY dik=0xNN down|up       <hh:mm:ss.mmm> MOUSE b0 down|up       <hh:mm:ss.mmm> READY
#define DIRECTINPUT_VERSION 0x0300
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <dinput.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "dinput8.lib")   // only for c_dfDI* and the GUIDs; the target talks to dinput.dll
#pragma comment(lib, "dxguid.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "user32.lib")

static FILE* g_log;
static void Out(const char* fmt, ...) {
    SYSTEMTIME t; GetLocalTime(&t);
    fprintf(g_log, "%02d:%02d:%02d.%03d ", t.wHour, t.wMinute, t.wSecond, t.wMilliseconds);
    va_list a; va_start(a, fmt); vfprintf(g_log, fmt, a); va_end(a);
    fputc('\n', g_log); fflush(g_log);
}
static bool g_active = false;
static LRESULT CALLBACK Proc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    if (m == WM_DESTROY) { PostQuitMessage(0); return 0; }
    if (m == WM_ACTIVATEAPP) { g_active = w != 0; Out("ACTIVATEAPP %d", (int)(w != 0)); return 0; }
    return DefWindowProcA(h, m, w, l);
}
int WINAPI WinMain(HINSTANCE hi, HINSTANCE, LPSTR cmd, int) {
    char path[MAX_PATH] = {}; bool buffered = false, gated = false;
    { char* c = cmd; while (*c == ' ') c++; bool q = *c == '"'; if (q) c++; char* e = c; while (*e && (q ? *e != '"' : *e != ' ')) e++;
      memcpy(path, c, (size_t)(e - c)); buffered = strstr(e, "--buffered") != nullptr; gated = strstr(e, "--gated") != nullptr; }
    g_log = fopen(path, "w"); if (!g_log) return 2;
    WNDCLASSA wc = {}; wc.lpfnWndProc = Proc; wc.hInstance = hi; wc.lpszClassName = "vi_dinput1test"; wc.hbrBackground = (HBRUSH)(COLOR_WINDOW + 1);
    RegisterClassA(&wc);
    HWND w = gated ? CreateWindowExA(WS_EX_NOACTIVATE, wc.lpszClassName, "vinput dinput1 test", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, -28000, 600, 404, 260, nullptr, nullptr, hi, nullptr)
                   : CreateWindowA(wc.lpszClassName, "vinput dinput1 test", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW | WS_VISIBLE, 100, 100, 404, 260, nullptr, nullptr, hi, nullptr);
    if (gated) ShowWindow(w, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE);
    LPDIRECTINPUTA di = nullptr; LPDIRECTINPUTDEVICEA kb = nullptr, ms = nullptr;
    using PFN_Create = HRESULT(WINAPI*)(HINSTANCE, DWORD, LPDIRECTINPUTA*, LPUNKNOWN);
    HMODULE dl = LoadLibraryA("dinput.dll");
    PFN_Create create = dl ? (PFN_Create)GetProcAddress(dl, "DirectInputCreateA") : nullptr;
    if (!create || FAILED(create(hi, 0x0300, &di, nullptr))) { Out("ERROR DirectInputCreateA"); return 3; }
    if (FAILED(di->CreateDevice(GUID_SysKeyboard, &kb, nullptr)) || FAILED(di->CreateDevice(GUID_SysMouse, &ms, nullptr))) { Out("ERROR CreateDevice"); return 4; }
    kb->SetDataFormat(&c_dfDIKeyboard); ms->SetDataFormat(&c_dfDIMouse);
    kb->SetCooperativeLevel(w, DISCL_NONEXCLUSIVE | DISCL_FOREGROUND); ms->SetCooperativeLevel(w, DISCL_NONEXCLUSIVE | DISCL_FOREGROUND);
    if (buffered) { DIPROPDWORD p = {{sizeof(DIPROPDWORD), sizeof(DIPROPHEADER), 0, DIPH_DEVICE}, 32}; kb->SetProperty(DIPROP_BUFFERSIZE, &p.diph); }
    kb->Acquire(); ms->Acquire();
    Out("READY mode=%s%s", buffered ? "buffered" : "state", gated ? " gated" : "");
    BYTE prev[256] = {}, cur[256]; BYTE pb = 0;
    MSG m;
    for (;;) {
        while (PeekMessageA(&m, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) { if (m.message == WM_QUIT) return 0; TranslateMessage(&m); DispatchMessageA(&m); }
        if (gated && !g_active) { Sleep(2); continue; }   // GNW95: an inactive program does not read its devices
        if (buffered) {
            DIDEVICEOBJECTDATA d[32]; DWORD n = 32;
            if (SUCCEEDED(kb->GetDeviceData(sizeof(DIDEVICEOBJECTDATA), d, &n, 0))) for (DWORD i = 0; i < n; i++) Out("KEY dik=0x%02X %s", d[i].dwOfs, (d[i].dwData & 0x80) ? "down" : "up");
        } else if (SUCCEEDED(kb->GetDeviceState(256, cur))) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) if ((cur[i] & 0x80) != (prev[i] & 0x80)) Out("KEY dik=0x%02X %s", i, (cur[i] & 0x80) ? "down" : "up");
            memcpy(prev, cur, 256);
        }
        DIMOUSESTATE s = {};
        if (SUCCEEDED(ms->GetDeviceState(sizeof s, &s))) { BYTE b = s.rgbButtons[0] & 0x80; if (b != pb) Out("MOUSE b0 %s", b ? "down" : "up"); pb = b; }
        Sleep(2);
    }
}
```

`test/vi_gltest.cpp`:

```cpp
// vi_gltest.cpp - synthetic OpenGL capture target for vinput. Draws vi_pattern.h (frame-counter bits + colour bars)
// with scissored glClear into the default framebuffer, then presents with gdi32 SwapBuffers (default) or by
// calling opengl32!wglSwapBuffers directly (--wgl). Also leaves a non-default GL state behind every frame (pack
// alignment 1, a bound pixel-pack buffer when available) so a capture that does not restore state is visible.
//   vi_gltest.exe <log> <x> <y> <w> <h> [--wgl]
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <GL/gl.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <share.h>
#include "vi_pattern.h"
#pragma comment(lib, "opengl32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "gdi32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "user32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "shell32.lib")

static FILE* g_log;
static void L(const char* f, ...) { if (!g_log) return; va_list a; va_start(a, f); vfprintf(g_log, f, a); va_end(a); fputc('\n', g_log); fflush(g_log); }
static LRESULT CALLBACK Wnd(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    if (m == WM_DESTROY) { PostQuitMessage(0); return 0; }
    return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}
typedef BOOL(WINAPI* PFN_wglSwap)(HDC);
typedef void(APIENTRY* PFN_glGenBuffers)(GLsizei, GLuint*);
typedef void(APIENTRY* PFN_glBindBuffer)(GLenum, GLuint);
typedef void(APIENTRY* PFN_glBufferData)(GLenum, ptrdiff_t, const void*, GLenum);

int WINAPI wWinMain(HINSTANCE hi, HINSTANCE, LPWSTR, int) {
    int argc; wchar_t** argv = CommandLineToArgvW(GetCommandLineW(), &argc);
    g_log = _wfsopen(argc > 1 ? argv[1] : L"vi_gltest.log", L"w", _SH_DENYNO);
    int x = argc > 5 ? _wtoi(argv[2]) : 100, y = argc > 5 ? _wtoi(argv[3]) : 100, w = argc > 5 ? _wtoi(argv[4]) : 800, hgt = argc > 5 ? _wtoi(argv[5]) : 450;
    bool useWgl = false;
    for (int i = 6; i < argc; i++) if (!wcscmp(argv[i], L"--wgl")) useWgl = true;
    WNDCLASSW wc = {}; wc.lpfnWndProc = Wnd; wc.hInstance = hi; wc.lpszClassName = L"vi_gltest"; wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(nullptr, IDC_ARROW); wc.style = CS_OWNDC;
    RegisterClassW(&wc);
    HWND hwnd = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_NOACTIVATE, wc.lpszClassName, L"vinput gl capture target", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW | WS_CLIPCHILDREN | WS_CLIPSIBLINGS, x, y, w, hgt, nullptr, nullptr, hi, nullptr);
    ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE);
    HDC dc = GetDC(hwnd);
    PIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR pfd = {sizeof(pfd), 1, PFD_DRAW_TO_WINDOW | PFD_SUPPORT_OPENGL | PFD_DOUBLEBUFFER, PFD_TYPE_RGBA, 32};
    pfd.cDepthBits = 24; pfd.iLayerType = PFD_MAIN_PLANE;
    int pf = ChoosePixelFormat(dc, &pfd);
    if (!pf || !SetPixelFormat(dc, pf, &pfd)) { L("FAIL pixel format %lu", GetLastError()); return 2; }
    HGLRC rc = wglCreateContext(dc);
    if (!rc || !wglMakeCurrent(dc, rc)) { L("FAIL context %lu", GetLastError()); return 2; }
    PFN_wglSwap wglSwap = (PFN_wglSwap)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleW(L"opengl32.dll"), "wglSwapBuffers");
    // leave non-default pack state + a bound pixel-pack buffer (if GL >= 2.1) for the capture to save/restore
    PFN_glGenBuffers genB = (PFN_glGenBuffers)wglGetProcAddress("glGenBuffers");
    PFN_glBindBuffer bindB = (PFN_glBindBuffer)wglGetProcAddress("glBindBuffer");
    PFN_glBufferData dataB = (PFN_glBufferData)wglGetProcAddress("glBufferData");
    GLuint pbo = 0;
    if (genB && bindB && dataB) { genB(1, &pbo); bindB(0x88EB, pbo); dataB(0x88EB, 64, nullptr, 0x88E1 /*STREAM_READ*/); }
    glPixelStorei(GL_PACK_ALIGNMENT, 1);
    L("START hwnd=%p gl=%s vendor=%s swap=%s pbo=%u", hwnd, (const char*)glGetString(GL_VERSION), (const char*)glGetString(GL_VENDOR), useWgl ? "wglSwapBuffers" : "SwapBuffers", pbo);
    UINT32 frame = 0; DWORD lastLog = 0; int stateBad = 0;
    LARGE_INTEGER qpf, prevT{}; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&qpf); double maxMs = 0;
    MSG msg;
    for (;;) {
        while (PeekMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) { if (msg.message == WM_QUIT) { L("EXIT frames=%u state_bad=%d", frame, stateBad); return 0; } TranslateMessage(&msg); DispatchMessageW(&msg); }
        RECT cr; GetClientRect(hwnd, &cr); int cw = cr.right, ch = cr.bottom;
        if (cw > 0 && ch > 0) {
            glViewport(0, 0, cw, ch);
            glEnable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
            for (int b = 0; b < 8; b++) {
                int x0 = (b * cw + 7) / 8, x1 = ((b + 1) * cw + 7) / 8;
                glScissor(x0, 0, x1 - x0, ch - vipat::kBandH);
                glClearColor(vipat::kBars[b][0] / 255.f, vipat::kBars[b][1] / 255.f, vipat::kBars[b][2] / 255.f, 1);
                glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
            }
            glScissor(0, ch - vipat::kBandH, cw, vipat::kBandH); glClearColor(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f, 1); glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
            for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
                float v = ((frame >> (31 - i)) & 1) ? 1.f : 0.f;
                glScissor(i * vipat::kCell, ch - vipat::kBandH, vipat::kCell, vipat::kBandH); glClearColor(v, v, v, 1); glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
            }
            glDisable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
        }
        if (useWgl) wglSwap(dc); else SwapBuffers(dc);
        GLint al = 0; glGetIntegerv(GL_PACK_ALIGNMENT, &al);
        GLint bound = 0; if (pbo) glGetIntegerv(0x88ED, &bound);
        GLint rb = 0; glGetIntegerv(GL_READ_BUFFER, &rb);
        if (al != 1 || (pbo && (GLuint)bound != pbo) || rb != GL_BACK) { if (stateBad++ < 5) L("STATE_CHANGED align=%d pbo=%d readbuf=0x%X", al, bound, rb); }
        ++frame;
        LARGE_INTEGER now; QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
        if (prevT.QuadPart) { double ms = (now.QuadPart - prevT.QuadPart) * 1000.0 / qpf.QuadPart; if (ms > maxMs) maxMs = ms; }
        prevT = now;
        if (GetTickCount() - lastLog > 1000) { lastLog = GetTickCount(); L("FRAME %u maxms=%.1f", frame, maxMs); maxMs = 0; }
        Sleep(4);
    }
}
```

```cpp
#include "../src/vi_keys.h"

#define NOMINMAX

#include <chrono>
static int checks = 0, failures = 0;
static void Check(bool ok, const char* text) {
  ++checks;
  if (!ok) { ++failures; std::printf("FAIL %s\n", text); }
}
static void ExpectKey(const char* text, int expected) {
  int vk = 1234;
  bool ok = vi_keys::ParseKey(text, vk) && vk == expected && vi_keys::VkFromName(text) == expected;
  Check(ok, text);
}
static void ExpectChord(const char* text, const std::vector<int>& expected) {

  Check(vi_keys::ParseCombo(text) == expected, text);
}

```

`test/vi_locktest.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "vi_sessions.h"
#include <atomic>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>

static unsigned failures = 0, checks = 0;
static void Check(bool pass, const char* name) {
    ++checks; if (!pass) ++failures;
    printf("%s %s\n", pass ? "PASS" : "FAIL", name);
}
static bool WriteText(const std::wstring& path, const std::string& text) {
    HANDLE h = CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return false;
    DWORD n = 0; bool ok = WriteFile(h, text.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(text.size()), &n, nullptr) && n == text.size(); CloseHandle(h); return ok;
}
static std::string ReadText(const std::wstring& path) {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary); return std::string(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f), {});
}
int wmain(int argc, wchar_t** argv) {
    using namespace vi_session;
    if (argc != 2) { fprintf(stderr, "need a scratch lock path\n"); return 2; }
    const std::wstring path = argv[1];
    if (GetFileAttributesW(path.c_str()) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) { fprintf(stderr, "scratch lock must not exist yet\n"); return 2; }
    std::string error;
    Check(!InspectLock(path).exists, "missing lock is absent");
    {
        JsonLock a, b;
        Check(a.Acquire(path, "agent \"A\" \\ \xE2\x98\x83", 120, error), "atomic create with escaped UTF-8 owner");
        auto s = InspectLock(path);
        Check(s.exists && s.format_ok && !s.stale && s.owner == "agent \"A\" \\ \xE2\x98\x83" && s.pid == GetCurrentProcessId(), "JSON round trip and live owner positive control");
        const auto before = ReadText(path);
        Check(!b.Acquire(path, "agent B", 120, error), "second owner refused");
        Check(!ReleaseOwnedLock(path, "agent B", error), "foreign release refused");
        Check(!ReleaseOwnedLock(path, s.owner, error, "wrong-token"), "wrong token refused");
        FileIdentity wrong_id = s.identity; wrong_id.low ^= 1;
        Check(!ReleaseOwnedLock(path, s.owner, error, a.Token(), wrong_id), "wrong file identity refused independently of token");
        Check(ReadText(path) == before, "foreign acquisition/release leaves exact bytes unchanged");
        Check(a.Release(error) && !InspectLock(path).exists, "token and identity checked release");
    }
    {
        JsonLock a;
        Check(!a.Acquire(path, "", 120, error) && !a.Acquire(path, "a", 0, error) && !a.Acquire(path, "a", 86401, error), "invalid owner and TTL rejected");
        Check(!a.Acquire(path, std::string("bad\0owner", 9), 120, error) && !a.Acquire(path, "\xFF", 120, error), "NUL and invalid UTF-8 owner rejected");
        Check(!InspectLock(path).exists, "invalid acquire creates no file");
        Check(a.Acquire(path, "raii", 120, error), "RAII lease created");
    }
    Check(!InspectLock(path).exists, "RAII destructor releases its lease");
    {
        JsonLock a;
        Check(a.Acquire(path, "durable", 120, error), "persistent lease created"); a.Detach();
    }
    Check(InspectLock(path).exists && ReleaseOwnedLock(path, "durable", error), "detach persists until matching owner releases");
    {
        JsonLock a;
        Check(a.Acquire(path, "ttl", 1, error), "short lease created");
        Sleep(1100);
        auto s = InspectLock(path);
        Check(s.format_ok && s.expired && s.stale && !s.owner_dead, "TTL expires independently of live process");
        JsonLock b; const auto before = ReadText(path);
        Check(!b.Acquire(path, "other", 120, error) && ReadText(path) == before, "expired foreign lock remains untouched");
        Check(a.Release(error), "original owner releases expired lock");
    }
    {
        const std::string legacy = "Someone busy PID=123; DO NOT DELETE\n";
        Check(WriteText(path, legacy), "legacy test fixture created");
        auto s = InspectLock(path); JsonLock a;
        Check(s.exists && !s.format_ok && !s.stale, "legacy is unknown, never inferred stale");
        Check(!a.Acquire(path, "new", 120, error) && !ReleaseOwnedLock(path, "new", error) && ReadText(path) == legacy, "legacy lock acquisition/release refused and bytes retained");
        Check(DeleteFileW(path.c_str()) != FALSE, "remove our own legacy fixture");
    }
    {
        JsonLock a, replacement;
        Check(a.Acquire(path, "same-owner", 120, error), "replacement test original acquired");
        const auto s = InspectLock(path);
        Check(ReleaseOwnedLock(path, s.owner, error, a.Token()), "remove our own original fixture");
        Check(replacement.Acquire(path, "same-owner", 120, error), "same owner replacement acquired");
        const auto before = ReadText(path);
        Check(!a.Release(error) && ReadText(path) == before, "old RAII lease cannot delete replacement");
        Check(replacement.Release(error), "new lease releases replacement");
    }
    {
        JsonLock a;
        Check(a.Acquire(path, "pid-reuse", 120, error), "PID identity fixture acquired");
        auto s = InspectLock(path); auto body = ReadText(path); a.Detach();
        const std::string good = "\"pid_created_100ns\":\"" + std::to_string(s.pid_created_100ns) + "\"";
        const auto p = body.find(good);
        Check(p != std::string::npos, "identity field fixture found");
        body.replace(p, good.size(), "\"pid_created_100ns\":\"1\"");
        Check(WriteText(path, body), "write mismatched PID creation identity");
        s = InspectLock(path);
        Check(s.format_ok && s.owner_dead && s.stale && !s.expired, "PID reuse mismatch marks stale");
        Check(ReleaseOwnedLock(path, "pid-reuse", error), "owner releases our mismatched fixture");
    }
    {
        JsonLock a;
        Check(a.Acquire(path, "malformed", 120, error), "malformed fixture acquired");
        auto body = ReadText(path); a.Detach();
        body.insert(1, "\"owner\":\"duplicate\",");
        Check(WriteText(path, body), "write duplicate JSON key fixture");
        auto s = InspectLock(path);
        Check(s.exists && !s.format_ok && !ReleaseOwnedLock(path, "malformed", error) && ReadText(path) == body, "duplicate keys rejected without deleting");
        Check(DeleteFileW(path.c_str()) != FALSE, "remove our own malformed fixture");
    }
    {
        JsonLock a;
        Check(a.Acquire(path, "reader-race", 120, error), "reader race fixture acquired");
        std::atomic<bool> reader_ready{false}; std::atomic<bool> reader_opened{false};
        std::thread reader([&] {
            const auto first_status = InspectLock(path);
            HANDLE h = CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
            const auto held_status = h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ? InspectLockHandle(h) : LockStatus{};
            reader_opened = h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE && first_status.format_ok && held_status.format_ok; reader_ready = true;
            Sleep(70); if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) CloseHandle(h);
        });
        while (!reader_ready.load()) Sleep(0);
        Check(reader_opened.load(), "concurrent status reader opened");
        const auto start = GetTickCount64(); bool released = a.Release(error); const auto elapsed = GetTickCount64() - start;
        reader.join();
        Check(released && elapsed >= 50 && elapsed < 1000, "release retries past transient status reader");
        Check(!InspectLock(path).exists, "reader race leaves no owned lease behind");
    }
    {
        JsonLock a;
        Check(a.Acquire(path, "busy-reader", 120, error), "bounded reader fixture acquired");
        HANDLE reader = CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
        Check(reader != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, "long-lived reader opened");
        const auto start = GetTickCount64(); bool released = a.Release(error); const auto elapsed = GetTickCount64() - start;
        Check(!released && elapsed >= 200 && elapsed < 1000 && InspectLock(path).exists, "release retry is bounded and retains lease on failure");
        if (reader != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) CloseHandle(reader);
        Check(a.Release(error), "later release succeeds after busy reader exits");
    }
    {
        std::atomic<unsigned> ready{0}, attempted{0}, acquired{0}; std::atomic<bool> go{false}, release{false};
        std::vector<std::thread> threads;
        for (unsigned n = 0; n != 8; ++n) threads.emplace_back([&, n] {
            JsonLock a; std::string e; ready.fetch_add(1);
            while (!go.load()) Sleep(0);
            bool held = a.Acquire(path, "parallel-" + std::to_string(n), 120, e);
            if (held) acquired.fetch_add(1);
            attempted.fetch_add(1);
            if (held) while (!release.load()) Sleep(0);
        });
        while (ready.load() != 8) Sleep(0); go = true;
        while (attempted.load() != 8) Sleep(0);
        Check(acquired.load() == 1, "8 concurrent acquirers have exactly one winner");
        release = true; for (auto& t : threads) t.join();
        Check(!InspectLock(path).exists, "concurrency test winner released only its own lock");
    }
    printf("%s: %u checks, %u failures\n", failures ? "FAIL" : "PASS", checks, failures);
    return failures ? 1 : 0;
}
```
