`test/vi_ncctest.cpp`:

```cpp
// vi_ncctest.cpp - unit tests for NCC template matching (vi_ncc.h). Positive AND negative controls.
// Exit code = number of failures.
#include "vi_ncc.h"
#include <cstdio>

static int failures = 0;
static void Check(bool value, const char* name) { std::printf("%s %s\n", value ? "PASS" : "FAIL", name); if (!value) ++failures; }

// ---- NCC ----
using vi_vision::Image;
static Image Blank(int w, int h, std::uint8_t v) {
    Image im; im.w = w; im.h = h; im.pixels.assign((size_t)w * h * 4, v);
    for (size_t i = 3; i < im.pixels.size(); i += 4) im.pixels[i] = 255;
    return im;
}
static Image Texture(int w, int h) {   // structured pattern, not noise only
    Image im = Blank(w, h, 0); std::uint32_t s = 12345u;
    for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y) for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
        s = s * 1664525u + 1013904223u;
        int ring = (int)std::sqrt((double)((x - w / 2) * (x - w / 2) + (y - h / 2) * (y - h / 2)));
        int v = (ring % 8 < 4 ? 200 : 60) + ((s >> 24) % 20) + ((x * 3 + y) % 17);
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) im.pixels[((size_t)y * w + x) * 4 + c] = (std::uint8_t)(v + c * 7);
    }
    return im;
}
static void Paste(Image& dst, const Image& src, int x0, int y0, double gain = 1.0, int offset = 0) {
    for (int y = 0; y < src.h; ++y) for (int x = 0; x < src.w; ++x) for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) {
        int v = (int)(src.pixels[((size_t)y * src.w + x) * 4 + c] * gain) + offset; v = v < 0 ? 0 : v > 255 ? 255 : v;
        dst.pixels[((size_t)(y0 + y) * dst.w + x0 + x) * 4 + c] = (std::uint8_t)v;
    }
}
static Image ScaleBy(const Image& src, double f) {
    vi_ncc::Plane p = vi_ncc::Gray(src); vi_ncc::Plane q = vi_ncc::Resample(p, (int)std::lround(src.w * f), (int)std::lround(src.h * f));
    Image out = Blank(q.w, q.h, 0);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < q.v.size(); ++i) for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) out.pixels[i * 4 + c] = (std::uint8_t)(q.v[i] < 0 ? 0 : q.v[i] > 255 ? 255 : q.v[i]);
    return out;
}
static bool Near(const vi_ncc::Match& m, int x, int y, int tol) { return std::abs(m.x - x) <= tol && std::abs(m.y - y) <= tol; }

static void NccTests() {
    Image tpl = Texture(48, 40);
    Image scene = Blank(400, 240, 90);
    // background clutter so the window variance is never zero
    for (int y = 0; y < scene.h; ++y) for (int x = 0; x < scene.w; ++x) scene.pixels[((size_t)y * scene.w + x) * 4] = (std::uint8_t)(70 + (x * 7 + y * 13) % 40);
    Paste(scene, tpl, 120, 90);
    auto r = vi_ncc::Find(scene, tpl, {});
    Check(r.error.empty() && !r.matches.empty() && Near(r.matches[0], 120, 90, 1) && r.matches[0].score > 0.97, "template found at the pasted position with score > 0.97");
    Image dim = scene; Paste(dim, tpl, 120, 90, 0.7, -10);
    r = vi_ncc::Find(dim, tpl, {});
    Check(!r.matches.empty() && Near(r.matches[0], 120, 90, 1), "NCC survives a gain/offset change (0.7x - 10)");
    Image two = scene; Paste(two, tpl, 300, 150);
    r = vi_ncc::Find(two, tpl, {});
    Check(r.matches.size() == 2 && ((Near(r.matches[0], 120, 90, 1) && Near(r.matches[1], 300, 150, 1)) || (Near(r.matches[1], 120, 90, 1) && Near(r.matches[0], 300, 150, 1))), "two copies give exactly two matches");
    Image absent = Blank(400, 240, 0);
    for (int y = 0; y < absent.h; ++y) for (int x = 0; x < absent.w; ++x) absent.pixels[((size_t)y * absent.w + x) * 4 + 1] = (std::uint8_t)(70 + (x * 7 + y * 13) % 40);
    r = vi_ncc::Find(absent, tpl, {});
    Check(r.error.empty() && r.matches.empty(), "absent template: no match (negative control)");
    Image big = scene; Image scaled = ScaleBy(tpl, 1.1);
    Image sceneScaled = Blank(400, 240, 90);
    for (int y = 0; y < sceneScaled.h; ++y) for (int x = 0; x < sceneScaled.w; ++x) sceneScaled.pixels[((size_t)y * sceneScaled.w + x) * 4] = (std::uint8_t)(70 + (x * 7 + y * 13) % 40);
    Paste(sceneScaled, scaled, 200, 60);
    r = vi_ncc::Find(sceneScaled, tpl, {});
    Check(!r.matches.empty() && Near(r.matches[0], 200, 60, 2) && r.matches[0].scale > 1.0 && r.matches[0].score > 0.85, "1.1x scaled copy is found by the default scale list and reports scale > 1");
    vi_ncc::Options noScale; noScale.scales = {1.0}; noScale.threshold = 0.9;
    r = vi_ncc::Find(sceneScaled, tpl, noScale);
    Check(r.matches.empty(), "1.1x copy is NOT found with --no-scale at 0.9 (documents the limit)");
    Image huge = ScaleBy(tpl, 1.6);
    Image sceneHuge = Blank(400, 240, 90); Paste(sceneHuge, huge, 100, 80);
    r = vi_ncc::Find(sceneHuge, tpl, {});
    Check(r.matches.empty(), "1.6x copy is outside the default scale range (documented limit)");
    Image flat = Blank(30, 30, 128);
    r = vi_ncc::Find(scene, flat, {});
    Check(!r.error.empty(), "flat template is refused with an error");
    Image tiny = Texture(14, 12), tinyScene = Blank(200, 120, 90);
    for (int y = 0; y < tinyScene.h; ++y) for (int x = 0; x < tinyScene.w; ++x) tinyScene.pixels[((size_t)y * tinyScene.w + x) * 4] = (std::uint8_t)(70 + (x * 7 + y * 13) % 40);
    Paste(tinyScene, tiny, 77, 55);
    r = vi_ncc::Find(tinyScene, tiny, {});
    Check(!r.matches.empty() && Near(r.matches[0], 77, 55, 1), "small template (full-resolution path) found");
}

int main() {
    NccTests();
    std::printf(failures ? "FAILED %d\n" : "ALL PASS\n", failures);
    return failures;
}
```

`test/vi_overlaytarget.cpp`:

```cpp
// vi_overlaytarget.cpp - synthetic target that behaves like a DDraw wrapper (DDrawCompat, dgVoodoo...): the game's own
// window (client 320x240) holds only a stale yellow square on black and the picture lives in a SEPARATE top-level window of class
// "DDrawCompatPresentationWindow" (800x480) that shows the game scaled 2x, aspect-fitted and centred (x offset 80).
// Picture (in game client pixels): left half red, right half blue, a 40x40 green square at the top-left corner.
// usage: vi_overlaytarget.exe [x y]   (default -28000 600: off screen)
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <shellapi.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "shell32.lib")
static LRESULT CALLBACK GameWnd(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    if (m == WM_PAINT) { PAINTSTRUCT ps; HDC dc = BeginPaint(h, &ps); RECT r; GetClientRect(h, &r); FillRect(dc, &r, (HBRUSH)GetStockObject(BLACK_BRUSH)); RECT st{ 140, 100, 180, 140 }; HBRUSH y = CreateSolidBrush(RGB(230, 230, 0)); FillRect(dc, &st, y); DeleteObject(y); EndPaint(h, &ps); return 0; }   // a stale leftover frame (like a finished intro video): the game window is NOT blank
    if (m == WM_DESTROY) { PostQuitMessage(0); return 0; }
    return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}
static void DrawPicture(HDC dc, HWND h) {
    RECT r; GetClientRect(h, &r);
    FillRect(dc, &r, (HBRUSH)GetStockObject(BLACK_BRUSH));
    HBRUSH red = CreateSolidBrush(RGB(220, 20, 20)), blue = CreateSolidBrush(RGB(20, 20, 220)), green = CreateSolidBrush(RGB(20, 220, 20));
    RECT a{ 80, 0, 80 + 320, 480 }, b{ 80 + 320, 0, 80 + 640, 480 }, g{ 80, 0, 80 + 80, 80 };
    FillRect(dc, &a, red); FillRect(dc, &b, blue); FillRect(dc, &g, green);
    DeleteObject(red); DeleteObject(blue); DeleteObject(green);
}
static LRESULT CALLBACK PresWnd(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    if (m == WM_ERASEBKGND) return 1;
    if (m == WM_PRINTCLIENT) { DrawPicture((HDC)w, h); GdiFlush(); return 0; }   // GdiFlush: the caller reads the DIB from another thread   // what PrintWindow asks a plain GDI window for
    if (m == WM_PAINT) { PAINTSTRUCT ps; HDC dc = BeginPaint(h, &ps); DrawPicture(dc, h); EndPaint(h, &ps); return 0; }
    return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}
int WINAPI wWinMain(HINSTANCE hi, HINSTANCE, PWSTR, int) {
    int x = -28000, y = 600;
    int argc = 0; LPWSTR* argv = CommandLineToArgvW(GetCommandLineW(), &argc);
    if (argv && argc >= 3) { x = _wtoi(argv[1]); y = _wtoi(argv[2]); }
    WNDCLASSW wc{}; wc.hInstance = hi; wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
    wc.lpfnWndProc = GameWnd; wc.lpszClassName = L"OverlayGame"; RegisterClassW(&wc);
    wc.lpfnWndProc = PresWnd; wc.lpszClassName = L"DDrawCompatPresentationWindow"; RegisterClassW(&wc);
    RECT r{ 0, 0, 320, 240 }; AdjustWindowRect(&r, WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, FALSE);
    HWND game = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_NOACTIVATE, L"OverlayGame", L"vi overlay game", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, x, y, r.right - r.left, r.bottom - r.top, nullptr, nullptr, hi, nullptr);
    HWND pres = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW | WS_EX_NOACTIVATE, L"DDrawCompatPresentationWindow", L"", WS_POPUP, x, y + 400, 800, 480, nullptr, nullptr, hi, nullptr);
    ShowWindow(game, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE); ShowWindow(pres, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE);
    MSG msg; while (GetMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0) > 0) { TranslateMessage(&msg); DispatchMessageW(&msg); }
    return 0;
}
```

`test/vi_pattern.h`:

```h
// vi_pattern.h - the known, changing test pattern drawn by the synthetic capture targets (D3D12 / GL / Vulkan).
//   rows 0..15 : 32 bit-cells of 16 px, MSB first, white = 1, black = 0, encoding the target's frame counter;
//                x >= 512 in that band is mid gray
//   rows 16..  : 8 vertical colour bars across the client width (white yellow cyan green magenta red blue black)
// verify\vi_patterncheck.ps1 decodes a capture PNG back into (frame, bars ok).
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>

namespace vipat {
static const uint8_t kBars[8][3] = {{255, 255, 255}, {255, 255, 0}, {0, 255, 255}, {0, 255, 0}, {255, 0, 255}, {255, 0, 0}, {0, 0, 255}, {0, 0, 0}};
const int kBandH = 16, kCell = 16;
// RGB (0/128/255) of pixel (x,y) for a w-wide client at frame f
inline void Pixel(int x, int y, int w, uint32_t f, uint8_t rgb[3]) {
    if (y < kBandH) {
        if (x < 32 * kCell) { uint8_t v = ((f >> (31 - x / kCell)) & 1) ? 255 : 0; rgb[0] = rgb[1] = rgb[2] = v; }
        else rgb[0] = rgb[1] = rgb[2] = 128;
        return;
    }
    int b = (int)((long long)x * 8 / (w > 0 ? w : 1)); if (b > 7) b = 7;
    memcpy(rgb, kBars[b], 3);
}
inline uint16_t Half(uint8_t v) { return v == 255 ? 0x3C00 : v == 0 ? 0 : 0x3800; }   // 1.0 / 0.0 / 0.5 (gray only)
enum Fmt { BGRA8, RGBA8, R10G10B10A2, RGBA16F };
inline int Bpp(Fmt f) { return f == RGBA16F ? 8 : 4; }
// Writes one row in the given layout.
inline void Row(Fmt fmt, int y, int w, uint32_t f, uint8_t* dst) {
    uint8_t c[3];
    for (int x = 0; x < w; x++) {
        Pixel(x, y, w, f, c);
        switch (fmt) {
        case BGRA8: dst[4 * x] = c[2]; dst[4 * x + 1] = c[1]; dst[4 * x + 2] = c[0]; dst[4 * x + 3] = 255; break;
        case RGBA8: dst[4 * x] = c[0]; dst[4 * x + 1] = c[1]; dst[4 * x + 2] = c[2]; dst[4 * x + 3] = 255; break;
        case R10G10B10A2: {
            auto ten = [](uint8_t v) -> uint32_t { return v == 255 ? 1023u : v == 0 ? 0u : 512u; };
            uint32_t p = ten(c[0]) | (ten(c[1]) << 10) | (ten(c[2]) << 20) | (3u << 30); memcpy(dst + 4 * x, &p, 4); break;
        }
        case RGBA16F: { uint16_t h[4] = {Half(c[0]), Half(c[1]), Half(c[2]), 0x3C00}; memcpy(dst + 8 * x, h, 8); break; }
        }
    }
}
}  // namespace vipat
```

`test/vi_testinput.cpp`:

```cpp
// vi_testinput.cpp - positive-control target for vinput. A D3D11 window that reads input through EVERY
// channel vinput claims to drive and logs each observation to a file:
//   WM_KEYDOWN/UP, WM_CHAR, WM_INPUT keyboard+mouse (raw input registered), GetAsyncKeyState polling,
//   GetKeyState, DirectInput8 keyboard+mouse GetDeviceState, GetCursorPos, WM_MOUSEMOVE/LBUTTON/WHEEL,
//   WM_ACTIVATEAPP, GetForegroundWindow.
// The clear colour encodes the number of key-down observations so a capture can be checked too.
// usage: vi_testinput.exe <logfile> [x y w h] [--hover-gated] [--steal-fg-after-pipe <ms>]
//   --steal-fg-after-pipe: <ms> after vinput's pipe appears, a NON-injected child (vi_testinput --fg-thief <hwnd>)
//   makes this window REALLY foreground from outside (AttachThreadInput + SetForegroundWindow), like a launcher's
//   dialog closing activates a just-launched game. Logs STEAL_FG ... with the thief's result. Touches the real
//   foreground: run it under a --lock file (verify\run_fgguardtest.ps1 does).
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define DIRECTINPUT_VERSION 0x0800
#include <windows.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <d3d11.h>
#include <dinput.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <share.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "d3d11.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "shell32.lib")

static FILE* g_log; static HWND g_hwnd; static int g_keydowns = 0;
static bool g_hoverGated = false;
static unsigned g_frames = 0, g_hoverFrame = 0;
static bool g_hovered = false;
static void L(const char* fmt, ...) {
    char b[512]; va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt); vsprintf_s(b, fmt, ap); va_end(ap);
    fprintf(g_log, "%lu %s\n", GetTickCount(), b); fflush(g_log);
}
static LRESULT CALLBACK Wnd(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    switch (m) {
    case WM_KEYDOWN: case WM_SYSKEYDOWN: g_keydowns++; L("WM_KEYDOWN vk=0x%02X sc=0x%02X", (unsigned)w, (unsigned)((l >> 16) & 0xFF)); return 0;
    case WM_KEYUP: case WM_SYSKEYUP: L("WM_KEYUP vk=0x%02X", (unsigned)w); return 0;
    case WM_CHAR: L("WM_CHAR %u '%c'", (unsigned)w, (w >= 32 && w < 127) ? (char)w : '?'); return 0;
    case WM_MOUSEMOVE:
        g_hoverFrame = g_frames; g_hovered = true;
        L("WM_MOUSEMOVE %d %d", (short)LOWORD(l), (short)HIWORD(l)); return 0;
    case WM_LBUTTONDOWN: {
        L("WM_LBUTTONDOWN %d %d", (short)LOWORD(l), (short)HIWORD(l));
        if (g_hoverGated) {
            POINT p{}; GetCursorPos(&p); ScreenToClient(h, &p);
            bool ok = g_hovered && g_frames - g_hoverFrame >= 3 &&
                p.x == (short)LOWORD(l) && p.y == (short)HIWORD(l);
            L("CLICK_%s hover_frames=%u cursor=%ld,%ld", ok ? "ACCEPT" : "REJECT", g_frames - g_hoverFrame, p.x, p.y);
        }
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_LBUTTONUP: L("WM_LBUTTONUP %d %d", (short)LOWORD(l), (short)HIWORD(l)); return 0;
    case WM_RBUTTONDOWN: L("WM_RBUTTONDOWN %d %d", (short)LOWORD(l), (short)HIWORD(l)); return 0;
    case WM_MOUSEWHEEL: L("WM_MOUSEWHEEL %d", (short)HIWORD(w)); return 0;
    case WM_ACTIVATEAPP: L("WM_ACTIVATEAPP %d", (int)w); break;
    case WM_KILLFOCUS: L("WM_KILLFOCUS"); break;
    case WM_INPUT: {
        RAWINPUT ri; UINT sz = sizeof(ri);
        if (GetRawInputData((HRAWINPUT)l, RID_INPUT, &ri, &sz, sizeof(RAWINPUTHEADER)) != (UINT)-1) {
            if (ri.header.dwType == RIM_TYPEKEYBOARD) L("RAW_KBD vk=0x%02X %s sink=%d", ri.data.keyboard.VKey, (ri.data.keyboard.Flags & RI_KEY_BREAK) ? "up" : "down", (int)w);
            else if (ri.header.dwType == RIM_TYPEMOUSE) L("RAW_MOUSE dx=%ld dy=%ld btn=0x%X sink=%d", ri.data.mouse.lLastX, ri.data.mouse.lLastY, ri.data.mouse.usButtonFlags, (int)w);
        }
        break;
    }
    case WM_DESTROY: PostQuitMessage(0); return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}
// External foreground thief (never injected): exit 0 = the target really was foreground right after the call.
static int FgThief(HWND target) {
    HWND fg = GetForegroundWindow(); DWORD fgThread = fg ? GetWindowThreadProcessId(fg, nullptr) : 0, me = GetCurrentThreadId();
    BOOL attached = fgThread && fgThread != me ? AttachThreadInput(me, fgThread, TRUE) : FALSE;
    BOOL set = SetForegroundWindow(target); bool was = GetForegroundWindow() == target; BringWindowToTop(target);
    if (attached) AttachThreadInput(me, fgThread, FALSE);
    return (set && was) ? 0 : set ? 2 : 1;   // 0 = really foreground right after the call; 2 = granted but already handed back
}
int WINAPI wWinMain(HINSTANCE hi, HINSTANCE, LPWSTR, int) {
    int argc; wchar_t** argv = CommandLineToArgvW(GetCommandLineW(), &argc);
    if (argc > 2 && !wcscmp(argv[1], L"--fg-thief")) return FgThief((HWND)(ULONG_PTR)wcstoull(argv[2], nullptr, 0));
    int stealAfterPipe = -1;
    g_log = _wfsopen(argc > 1 ? argv[1] : L"vi_testinput.log", L"w", _SH_DENYNO);
    int x = argc > 5 ? _wtoi(argv[2]) : 100, y = argc > 5 ? _wtoi(argv[3]) : 100, w = argc > 5 ? _wtoi(argv[4]) : 640, hgt = argc > 5 ? _wtoi(argv[5]) : 360;
    WNDCLASSW wc = {}; wc.lpfnWndProc = Wnd; wc.hInstance = hi; wc.lpszClassName = L"vi_testinput"; wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
    RegisterClassW(&wc);
    for (int i = 6; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (!wcscmp(argv[i], L"--hover-gated")) g_hoverGated = true;
        else if (!wcscmp(argv[i], L"--steal-fg-after-pipe") && i + 1 < argc) stealAfterPipe = _wtoi(argv[++i]);
    }
    wchar_t pipeName[64]; swprintf_s(pipeName, L"\\\\.\\pipe\\vinput_%lu", GetCurrentProcessId());
    DWORD pipeSeenAt = 0, lastPipeCheck = 0, thiefPid = 0; bool stolen = false; HANDLE thief = nullptr;
    // Synthetic tests never take the human's foreground, including before injection.
    g_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_NOACTIVATE, wc.lpszClassName, L"vinput test target", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW,
        x, y, w, hgt, nullptr, nullptr, hi, nullptr);
    ShowWindow(g_hwnd, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE);
    RAWINPUTDEVICE rd[2] = {{1, 6, 0, g_hwnd}, {1, 2, 0, g_hwnd}};
    RegisterRawInputDevices(rd, 2, sizeof(RAWINPUTDEVICE));
    DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC d = {}; d.BufferCount = 2; d.BufferDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM; d.BufferUsage = DXGI_USAGE_RENDER_TARGET_OUTPUT;
    d.OutputWindow = g_hwnd; d.SampleDesc.Count = 1; d.Windowed = TRUE; d.SwapEffect = DXGI_SWAP_EFFECT_FLIP_DISCARD;
    IDXGISwapChain* sc; ID3D11Device* dev; ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx;
    D3D11CreateDeviceAndSwapChain(nullptr, D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_HARDWARE, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 0, D3D11_SDK_VERSION, &d, &sc, &dev, nullptr, &ctx);
    ID3D11Texture2D* bb; sc->GetBuffer(0, __uuidof(ID3D11Texture2D), (void**)&bb); ID3D11RenderTargetView* rtv; dev->CreateRenderTargetView(bb, nullptr, &rtv); bb->Release();
    IDirectInput8W* di = nullptr; IDirectInputDevice8W* kb = nullptr; IDirectInputDevice8W* ms = nullptr;
    DirectInput8Create(hi, DIRECTINPUT_VERSION, IID_IDirectInput8W, (void**)&di, nullptr);
    di->CreateDevice(GUID_SysKeyboard, &kb, nullptr); kb->SetDataFormat(&c_dfDIKeyboard); kb->SetCooperativeLevel(g_hwnd, DISCL_FOREGROUND | DISCL_NONEXCLUSIVE);
    di->CreateDevice(GUID_SysMouse, &ms, nullptr); ms->SetDataFormat(&c_dfDIMouse2); ms->SetCooperativeLevel(g_hwnd, DISCL_FOREGROUND | DISCL_NONEXCLUSIVE);
    L("START hwnd=%p", g_hwnd);
    BYTE prevG[256] = {0}, prevD[256] = {0}; POINT prevC = {-1, -1}; HWND prevFg = (HWND)1; int prevMB = 0;
    MSG msg;
    for (;;) {
        while (PeekMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) { if (msg.message == WM_QUIT) return 0; TranslateMessage(&msg); DispatchMessageW(&msg); }
        for (int vk = 1; vk < 256; vk++) {
            BYTE dn = (GetAsyncKeyState(vk) & 0x8000) ? 1 : 0;
            if (dn != prevG[vk]) { L("GAKS vk=0x%02X %s", vk, dn ? "down" : "up"); prevG[vk] = dn; }
        }
        BYTE ks[256];
        HRESULT hr = kb->GetDeviceState(256, ks);
        if (FAILED(hr)) { kb->Acquire(); hr = kb->GetDeviceState(256, ks); }
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) { BYTE dn = (ks[i] & 0x80) ? 1 : 0; if (dn != prevD[i]) { L("DI_KBD dik=0x%02X %s", i, dn ? "down" : "up"); prevD[i] = dn; } }
        DIMOUSESTATE2 mst; hr = ms->GetDeviceState(sizeof(mst), &mst);
        if (FAILED(hr)) { ms->Acquire(); hr = ms->GetDeviceState(sizeof(mst), &mst); }
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) { if (mst.lX || mst.lY || mst.lZ) L("DI_MOUSE dx=%ld dy=%ld dz=%ld", mst.lX, mst.lY, mst.lZ); int mb = mst.rgbButtons[0] ? 1 : 0; if (mb != prevMB) { L("DI_MOUSE b0=%d", mb); prevMB = mb; } }
        POINT c; GetCursorPos(&c); ScreenToClient(g_hwnd, &c);
        if (c.x != prevC.x || c.y != prevC.y) { L("CURSOR %ld %ld", c.x, c.y); prevC = c; }
        if (stealAfterPipe >= 0 && !stolen) {
            DWORD now = GetTickCount();
            if (!pipeSeenAt && now - lastPipeCheck >= 50) { lastPipeCheck = now; if (WaitNamedPipeW(pipeName, 1) || GetLastError() == ERROR_SEM_TIMEOUT) { pipeSeenAt = now; L("STEAL_FG pipe seen, stealing in %d ms", stealAfterPipe); } }
            if (pipeSeenAt && now - pipeSeenAt >= (DWORD)stealAfterPipe) {
                stolen = true;
                wchar_t self[MAX_PATH]; GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, self, MAX_PATH);
                wchar_t cl[MAX_PATH + 64]; swprintf_s(cl, L"\"%s\" --fg-thief 0x%llX", self, (unsigned long long)(ULONG_PTR)g_hwnd);
                STARTUPINFOW si = {sizeof(si)}; PROCESS_INFORMATION pi = {};
                // never block this (window) thread on the thief: its SetForegroundWindow waits for this thread
                if (CreateProcessW(self, cl, nullptr, nullptr, FALSE, 0, nullptr, nullptr, &si, &pi)) { thief = pi.hProcess; thiefPid = pi.dwProcessId; CloseHandle(pi.hThread); L("STEAL_FG thief started pid=%lu", thiefPid); }
                else L("STEAL_FG CreateProcess failed %lu", GetLastError());
            }
        }
        if (thief && WaitForSingleObject(thief, 0) == WAIT_OBJECT_0) {
            DWORD code = 99; GetExitCodeProcess(thief, &code); CloseHandle(thief); thief = nullptr;
            L("STEAL_FG thief_pid=%lu thief_exit=%lu (0 = target was really foreground)", thiefPid, code);
        }
        HWND fg = GetForegroundWindow(); if (fg != prevFg) { L("FG %s", fg == g_hwnd ? "self" : "other"); prevFg = fg; }
        float col[4] = {(g_keydowns % 4) / 3.0f, ((g_keydowns / 4) % 4) / 3.0f, 0.25f, 1};
        ctx->OMSetRenderTargets(1, &rtv, nullptr); ctx->ClearRenderTargetView(rtv, col);
        ++g_frames;
        sc->Present(1, 0);
        Sleep(16); // bounded render rate even for an occluded offscreen target
    }
}
```

`test/vi_uitarget.cpp`:

```cpp
// vi_uitarget.cpp - synthetic game-menu target for vinput UI navigation tests.
// A D3D11 (flip-model) window whose pixels are drawn with GDI into a DIB and uploaded each frame, so vinput's
// native swapchain capture sees real text and buttons. Every click and mouse/char event is logged with coordinates.
//   usage: vi_uitarget.exe <logfile> x y [--load-ms N] [--icon-scale F] [--button-scale F]
// Client area is fixed at 800x450. Screens:
//   LOAD   "Loading ..." for --load-ms, then MAIN
//   MAIN   buttons PLAY, OPTIONS, Load   Game, BATTLE (left), BATTLE (right), QUIT, plus a texture icon (click = ICON)
//   SELECT "Select a game type" with SOLO and BACK   (PLAY opens it)
//   GAME   "Game started"                           (SOLO opens it)
// Log lines: "<tick> CLICK <x> <y> <button name|none>", "SCREEN <name>", "MOVE <x> <y> btn=<0|1>", "UP <x> <y>",
//            "WHEEL <delta> <x> <y>", "CHAR U+XXXX".
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <d3d11.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cmath>
#include <share.h>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#pragma comment(lib, "d3d11.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "user32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "gdi32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "shell32.lib")

enum Screen { LOAD, MAIN, SELECT, GAME };
struct Button { const wchar_t* label; RECT r; Screen screen; };
static const int kW = 800, kH = 450;
static FILE* g_log; static HWND g_hwnd; static Screen g_screen = LOAD;
static DWORD g_loadMs = 0, g_start = 0;
static double g_iconScale = 1.0, g_buttonScale = 1.0;
static std::vector<Button> g_buttons;

static void Log(const char* fmt, ...) {
    char b[512]; va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt); vsprintf_s(b, fmt, ap); va_end(ap);
    fprintf(g_log, "%lu %s\n", GetTickCount(), b); fflush(g_log);
}
static const char* ScreenName(Screen s) { return s == LOAD ? "LOAD" : s == MAIN ? "MAIN" : s == SELECT ? "SELECT" : "GAME"; }
static void SetScreen(Screen s) { if (s != g_screen) { g_screen = s; Log("SCREEN %s", ScreenName(s)); } }

static void BuildButtons() {
    g_buttons.clear();
    auto S = [](int v) { return static_cast<int>(v * g_buttonScale); };
    auto add = [&](const wchar_t* t, int x, int y, int w, int h, Screen s) { g_buttons.push_back({t, {S(x), S(y), S(x + w), S(y + h)}, s}); };
    add(L"PLAY", 60, 110, 200, 60, MAIN);
    add(L"OPTIONS", 60, 190, 200, 60, MAIN);
    add(L"BATTLE", 60, 340, 200, 60, MAIN);
    add(L"BATTLE", 540, 340, 200, 60, MAIN);
    add(L"Load   Game", 300, 110, 200, 60, MAIN);
    add(L"QUIT", 300, 190, 200, 60, MAIN);
    add(L"SOLO", 300, 150, 200, 60, SELECT);
    add(L"BACK", 300, 240, 200, 60, SELECT);
}
static RECT IconRect() { const int s = static_cast<int>(64 * g_iconScale); return {600, 110, 600 + s, 110 + s}; }

// Deterministic 64x64 icon with plenty of structure (rings, diagonals, colour blocks).
static void DrawIcon(HDC dc, const RECT& r) {
    HDC mem = CreateCompatibleDC(dc); HBITMAP bmp = CreateCompatibleBitmap(dc, 64, 64); HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(mem, bmp);
    // 8x8 grid of pseudo-random colour cells: not self-similar, so a wrong-scale copy cannot correlate well.
    unsigned state = 0xC0FFEEu;
    for (int cy = 0; cy < 8; ++cy) for (int cx = 0; cx < 8; ++cx) {
        state = state * 1664525u + 1013904223u;
        HBRUSH b = CreateSolidBrush(RGB(40 + ((state >> 8) & 0xBF), 40 + ((state >> 16) & 0xBF), 40 + ((state >> 24) & 0xBF)));
        RECT q{cx * 8, cy * 8, cx * 8 + 8, cy * 8 + 8}; FillRect(mem, &q, b); DeleteObject(b);
    }
    HPEN pen = CreatePen(PS_SOLID, 3, RGB(255, 255, 255)); HGDIOBJ op = SelectObject(mem, pen);
    MoveToEx(mem, 2, 2, nullptr); LineTo(mem, 62, 40); MoveToEx(mem, 62, 2, nullptr); LineTo(mem, 14, 62);
    SelectObject(mem, op); DeleteObject(pen);
    HBRUSH red = CreateSolidBrush(RGB(220, 20, 20)); RECT dot{40, 40, 54, 52}; FillRect(mem, &dot, red); DeleteObject(red);
    SetStretchBltMode(dc, HALFTONE); SetBrushOrgEx(dc, 0, 0, nullptr);
    StretchBlt(dc, r.left, r.top, r.right - r.left, r.bottom - r.top, mem, 0, 0, 64, 64, SRCCOPY);
    SelectObject(mem, old); DeleteObject(bmp); DeleteDC(mem);
}

static void Text(HDC dc, const wchar_t* t, RECT r, int px, COLORREF col, UINT fmt) {
    HFONT f = CreateFontW(-px, 0, 0, 0, FW_BOLD, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, DEFAULT_CHARSET, OUT_DEFAULT_PRECIS, CLIP_DEFAULT_PRECIS, ANTIALIASED_QUALITY, DEFAULT_PITCH, L"Segoe UI");
    HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(dc, f); SetBkMode(dc, TRANSPARENT); SetTextColor(dc, col);
    DrawTextW(dc, t, -1, &r, fmt | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_NOPREFIX); SelectObject(dc, old); DeleteObject(f);
}
static void Paint(HDC dc) {
    HBRUSH bg = CreateSolidBrush(RGB(18, 28, 56)); RECT all{0, 0, kW, kH}; FillRect(dc, &all, bg); DeleteObject(bg);
    if (g_screen == LOAD) { Text(dc, L"Loading game assets", {0, 150, kW, 250}, 40, RGB(255, 255, 255), DT_CENTER | DT_VCENTER); return; }
    if (g_screen == GAME) { Text(dc, L"Game started", {0, 150, kW, 250}, 48, RGB(120, 255, 120), DT_CENTER | DT_VCENTER); return; }
    Text(dc, g_screen == MAIN ? L"MAIN MENU" : L"Select a game type", {0, 20, kW, 80}, 40, RGB(255, 255, 255), DT_CENTER | DT_VCENTER);
    for (const Button& b : g_buttons) {
        if (b.screen != g_screen) continue;
        HBRUSH fill = CreateSolidBrush(RGB(40, 140, 60)); RECT r = b.r; FillRect(dc, &r, fill); DeleteObject(fill);
        Text(dc, b.label, r, static_cast<int>(30 * g_buttonScale), RGB(255, 255, 255), DT_CENTER | DT_VCENTER);
    }
    if (g_screen == MAIN) { RECT ir = IconRect(); DrawIcon(dc, ir); }
}

static const Button* Hit(int x, int y) {
    for (const Button& b : g_buttons) if (b.screen == g_screen && x >= b.r.left && x < b.r.right && y >= b.r.top && y < b.r.bottom) return &b;
    return nullptr;
}
static LRESULT CALLBACK Wnd(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    switch (m) {
    case WM_LBUTTONDOWN: {
        const int x = (short)LOWORD(l), y = (short)HIWORD(l);
        const Button* b = Hit(x, y);
        std::string name = "none";
        if (b) { name.clear(); for (const wchar_t* p = b->label; *p; ++p) name += (*p == L' ') ? '_' : static_cast<char>(*p); }
        if (!b && g_screen == MAIN) { RECT ir = IconRect(); if (x >= ir.left && x < ir.right && y >= ir.top && y < ir.bottom) name = "ICON"; }
        Log("CLICK %d %d %s", x, y, name.c_str());
        if (b && !wcscmp(b->label, L"PLAY")) SetScreen(SELECT);
        else if (b && !wcscmp(b->label, L"SOLO")) SetScreen(GAME);
        else if (b && !wcscmp(b->label, L"BACK")) SetScreen(MAIN);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_LBUTTONUP: Log("UP %d %d", (short)LOWORD(l), (short)HIWORD(l)); return 0;
    case WM_MOUSEMOVE: Log("MOVE %d %d btn=%d", (short)LOWORD(l), (short)HIWORD(l), (w & MK_LBUTTON) ? 1 : 0); return 0;
    case WM_MOUSEWHEEL: { POINT p{(short)LOWORD(l), (short)HIWORD(l)}; ScreenToClient(h, &p); Log("WHEEL %d %ld %ld", (short)HIWORD(w), p.x, p.y); return 0; }
    case WM_CHAR: Log("CHAR U+%04X", (unsigned)w); return 0;
    case WM_DESTROY: PostQuitMessage(0); return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}

int WINAPI wWinMain(HINSTANCE hi, HINSTANCE, LPWSTR, int) {
    int argc; wchar_t** argv = CommandLineToArgvW(GetCommandLineW(), &argc);
    g_log = _wfsopen(argc > 1 ? argv[1] : L"vi_uitarget.log", L"w", _SH_DENYNO);
    int x = argc > 3 ? _wtoi(argv[2]) : 100, y = argc > 3 ? _wtoi(argv[3]) : 100;
    for (int i = 4; i + 1 < argc; ++i) {
        if (!wcscmp(argv[i], L"--load-ms")) g_loadMs = (DWORD)_wtoi(argv[++i]);
        else if (!wcscmp(argv[i], L"--icon-scale")) g_iconScale = _wtof(argv[++i]);
        else if (!wcscmp(argv[i], L"--button-scale")) g_buttonScale = _wtof(argv[++i]);
    }
    BuildButtons();
    WNDCLASSW wc = {}; wc.lpfnWndProc = Wnd; wc.hInstance = hi; wc.lpszClassName = L"vi_uitarget"; wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
    RegisterClassW(&wc);
    RECT rc{0, 0, kW, kH}; AdjustWindowRect(&rc, WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW & ~(WS_THICKFRAME | WS_MAXIMIZEBOX), FALSE);
    g_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_NOACTIVATE, wc.lpszClassName, L"vinput ui target", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW & ~(WS_THICKFRAME | WS_MAXIMIZEBOX),
        x, y, rc.right - rc.left, rc.bottom - rc.top, nullptr, nullptr, hi, nullptr);
    ShowWindow(g_hwnd, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE);
    DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC d = {}; d.BufferCount = 2; d.BufferDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM; d.BufferUsage = DXGI_USAGE_RENDER_TARGET_OUTPUT;
    d.OutputWindow = g_hwnd; d.SampleDesc.Count = 1; d.Windowed = TRUE; d.SwapEffect = DXGI_SWAP_EFFECT_FLIP_DISCARD;
    IDXGISwapChain* sc; ID3D11Device* dev; ID3D11DeviceContext* ctx;
    if (FAILED(D3D11CreateDeviceAndSwapChain(nullptr, D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_HARDWARE, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 0, D3D11_SDK_VERSION, &d, &sc, &dev, nullptr, &ctx))) { Log("D3D11 FAILED"); return 1; }
    ID3D11Texture2D* bb; sc->GetBuffer(0, __uuidof(ID3D11Texture2D), (void**)&bb);
    RECT cr; GetClientRect(g_hwnd, &cr); Log("START client=%ldx%ld", cr.right, cr.bottom);
    HDC screen = GetDC(nullptr); HDC mem = CreateCompatibleDC(screen);
    BITMAPINFO bi = {}; bi.bmiHeader = {sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER), kW, -kH, 1, 32, BI_RGB};
    void* bits = nullptr; HBITMAP dib = CreateDIBSection(mem, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0); SelectObject(mem, dib);
    std::vector<unsigned char> rgba(static_cast<size_t>(kW) * kH * 4u);
    g_start = GetTickCount(); Log("SCREEN LOAD");
    if (!g_loadMs) SetScreen(MAIN);
    MSG msg;
    for (;;) {
        while (PeekMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) { if (msg.message == WM_QUIT) return 0; TranslateMessage(&msg); DispatchMessageW(&msg); }
        if (g_screen == LOAD && GetTickCount() - g_start >= g_loadMs) SetScreen(MAIN);
        Paint(mem); GdiFlush();
        const unsigned char* src = static_cast<const unsigned char*>(bits);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < static_cast<size_t>(kW) * kH; ++i) { rgba[i * 4] = src[i * 4 + 2]; rgba[i * 4 + 1] = src[i * 4 + 1]; rgba[i * 4 + 2] = src[i * 4]; rgba[i * 4 + 3] = 255; }
        ctx->UpdateSubresource(bb, 0, nullptr, rgba.data(), kW * 4, 0);
        sc->Present(1, 0);
        Sleep(16);
    }
}
```

`test/vi_uitest.cpp`:

```cpp
// vi_uitest.cpp - unit tests for the pure UI-navigation text matching (vi_text.h). Positive AND negative controls. Exit code = number of failures.
#include "vi_text.h"
#include <cstdio>

static int failures = 0;
static void Check(bool value, const char* name) { std::printf("%s %s\n", value ? "PASS" : "FAIL", name); if (!value) ++failures; }

using vi_text::Box; using vi_text::Line; using vi_text::Word;
static Line MakeLine(std::initializer_list<const wchar_t*> words, int x, int y, int h = 20) {
    Line l; int cx = x;
    for (const wchar_t* w : words) {
        Word word; word.text = w; word.box = {cx, y, 10 * (int)wcslen(w), h}; cx += 10 * (int)wcslen(w) + 8;
        if (l.words.empty()) l.box = word.box; else l.box = vi_text::Union(l.box, word.box);
        if (!l.text.empty()) l.text += L' ';
        l.text += w; l.words.push_back(word);
    }
    return l;
}

static void TextTests() {
    std::vector<Line> lines = {
        MakeLine({L"MAIN", L"MENU"}, 300, 20), MakeLine({L"PLAY"}, 60, 110), MakeLine({L"Load", L"Game"}, 300, 110),
        MakeLine({L"BATTLE"}, 540, 340), MakeLine({L"BATTLE"}, 60, 340), MakeLine({L"PLAYERS", L"ONLINE"}, 60, 200)};
    vi_text::Options o;
    auto hits = vi_text::Find(lines, L"main menu", o);
    Check(hits.size() == 1 && hits[0].box.x == 300 && hits[0].box.w == 4 * 10 + 8 + 4 * 10, "case-insensitive multi-word match, box = union of words");
    hits = vi_text::Find(lines, L"LoadGame", o);
    Check(hits.size() == 1, "fuzzy whitespace: query without space matches 'Load Game'");
    hits = vi_text::Find(lines, L"  load    game ", o);
    Check(hits.size() == 1, "fuzzy whitespace: extra spaces in the query");
    hits = vi_text::Find(lines, L"BATTLE", o);
    Check(hits.size() == 2 && hits[0].box.x == 60 && hits[1].box.x == 540, "two BATTLE hits are in reading order (left before right)");
    hits = vi_text::Find(lines, L"play", o);
    Check(hits.size() == 2 && hits[0].box.y == 110 && hits[1].box.y == 200, "substring 'play' also hits PLAYERS (documented), top-to-bottom order");
    o.exact = true;
    hits = vi_text::Find(lines, L"PLAY", o);
    Check(hits.size() == 1 && hits[0].box.y == 110, "--exact: PLAY does not match inside PLAYERS");
    hits = vi_text::Find(lines, L"play", o);
    Check(hits.empty(), "--exact is case-sensitive (negative control)");
    o.exact = false;
    hits = vi_text::Find(lines, L"NONEXISTENT", o);
    Check(hits.empty(), "absent text gives no hit");
    o.fuzzy = 1;
    std::vector<Line> noisy = {MakeLine({L"BATTIE"}, 10, 10)};
    hits = vi_text::Find(noisy, L"BATTLE", o);
    Check(hits.size() == 1 && hits[0].score < 1.0 && hits[0].score > 0.8, "--fuzzy 1 accepts one OCR slip (BATTIE) with score < 1");
    o.fuzzy = 0;
    hits = vi_text::Find(noisy, L"BATTLE", o);
    Check(hits.empty(), "without --fuzzy the OCR slip is not matched (negative control)");
    o.fuzzy = 1;
    std::vector<Line> distant = {MakeLine({L"XXXXXX"}, 10, 10)};
    Check(vi_text::Find(distant, L"BATTLE", o).empty(), "--fuzzy 1 rejects a 6-edit difference");
    // same row but y jittered by a couple of pixels: still left-to-right
    std::vector<Line> row = {MakeLine({L"OK"}, 500, 102), MakeLine({L"OK"}, 100, 99)};
    hits = vi_text::Find(row, L"OK", vi_text::Options());
    Check(hits.size() == 2 && hits[0].box.x == 100, "row grouping tolerates a few pixels of vertical jitter");
    Check(vi_text::Edits(L"kitten", L"sitting") == 3, "edit distance sanity");
}

int main() {
    TextTests();
    std::printf(failures ? "FAILED %d\n" : "ALL PASS\n", failures);
    return failures;
}
```

`test/vi_visiontest.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "vi_vision.h"
#include <chrono>
#include <climits>
#include <cstdio>

using namespace vi_vision;
static int failures = 0;
static void Check(bool value, const char* name) {
    std::printf("%s %s\n", value ? "PASS" : "FAIL", name);
    if (!value) ++failures;
}
static Image Solid(int w, int h, std::uint8_t value) {
    Image image; image.w = w; image.h = h; image.pixels.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(w) * h * 4u);
    for (std::size_t p = 0; p < image.pixels.size(); p += 4) {
        image.pixels[p] = image.pixels[p + 1] = image.pixels[p + 2] = value; image.pixels[p + 3] = 255;
    }
    return image;
}
static Image Pattern(int w, int h) {
    Image image = Solid(w, h, 0);
    std::uint32_t state = 0x3197a54bu;
    for (std::size_t p = 0; p < image.pixels.size(); p += 4)
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) { state = state * 1664525u + 1013904223u; image.pixels[p + c] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(40u + (state >> 24) % 176u); }
    return image;
}
static void Paste(Image& image, const Image& pattern, int x, int y, int noise = 0) {
    for (int ty = 0; ty < pattern.h; ++ty) for (int tx = 0; tx < pattern.w; ++tx) {
        auto* out = image.pixels.data() + (static_cast<std::size_t>(y + ty) * image.w + x + tx) * 4u;
        const auto* in = pattern.pixels.data() + (static_cast<std::size_t>(ty) * pattern.w + tx) * 4u;
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) out[c] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(in[c] + (((tx + ty + c) & 1) ? noise : -noise));
        out[3] = in[3];
    }
}
static bool At(const MatchResult& result, int x, int y) {
    for (const auto& match : result.matches) if (match.x == x && match.y == y) return true;
    return false;
}
static bool SavePngFixture(const std::wstring& path, const Image& image, std::string& error) {
    detail::ComScope com;
    detail::ComPtr<IWICImagingFactory> factory;
    if (detail::Failure(CoCreateInstance(CLSID_WICImagingFactory, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER,
        __uuidof(IWICImagingFactory), reinterpret_cast<void**>(factory.GetAddressOf())), "fixture factory", error)) return false;
    detail::ComPtr<IWICStream> stream;
    if (detail::Failure(factory->CreateStream(stream.GetAddressOf()), "fixture stream", error)) return false;
    if (detail::Failure(stream->InitializeFromFilename(path.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE), "fixture output", error)) return false;
    detail::ComPtr<IWICBitmapEncoder> encoder;
    if (detail::Failure(factory->CreateEncoder(GUID_ContainerFormatPng, nullptr, encoder.GetAddressOf()), "fixture encoder", error)) return false;
    if (detail::Failure(encoder->Initialize(stream.Get(), WICBitmapEncoderNoCache), "fixture initialize", error)) return false;
    detail::ComPtr<IWICBitmapFrameEncode> frame;
    if (detail::Failure(encoder->CreateNewFrame(frame.GetAddressOf(), nullptr), "fixture frame", error)) return false;
    if (detail::Failure(frame->Initialize(nullptr), "fixture frame initialize", error)) return false;
    if (detail::Failure(frame->SetSize(static_cast<UINT>(image.w), static_cast<UINT>(image.h)), "fixture size", error)) return false;
    WICPixelFormatGUID format = GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppBGRA;
    if (detail::Failure(frame->SetPixelFormat(&format), "fixture pixel format", error)) return false;
    if (!IsEqualGUID(format, GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppBGRA)) { error = "PNG encoder changed fixture pixel format"; return false; }
    auto bgra = image.pixels;
    if (detail::Failure(frame->WritePixels(static_cast<UINT>(image.h), static_cast<UINT>(image.w) * 4u,
        static_cast<UINT>(bgra.size()), bgra.data()), "fixture pixels", error)) return false;
    if (detail::Failure(frame->Commit(), "fixture frame commit", error)) return false;
    return !detail::Failure(encoder->Commit(), "fixture encoder commit", error);
}

int wmain(int argc, wchar_t** argv) {
    if (argc != 2) return 2;
    Image pattern = Pattern(8, 6), image = Solid(96, 72, 250);
    Paste(image, pattern, 13, 19); Paste(image, pattern, 60, 40);
    MatchOptions options; options.threshold = 1;
    const auto exact = MatchTemplate(image, pattern, options);
    Check(exact.complete && !exact.truncated && exact.matches.size() == 2 && At(exact, 13, 19) && At(exact, 60, 40), "two exact instances return client boxes");
    Check(exact.matches.size() == 2 && exact.matches[0].score == 1 && exact.matches[1].score == 1, "exact scores equal one");

    Image noisyPattern = Pattern(16, 12), noisy = Solid(160, 100, 250);
    Paste(noisy, noisyPattern, 40, 55, 2); options.threshold = 0.99;
    const auto noisyMatch = MatchTemplate(noisy, noisyPattern, options);
    Check(noisyMatch.complete && noisyMatch.matches.size() == 1 && At(noisyMatch, 40, 55) && noisyMatch.matches[0].score >= 0.99 && noisyMatch.matches[0].score < 1,
        "small RGB noise matches within threshold");
    const auto absent = MatchTemplate(Solid(160, 100, 250), noisyPattern, options);
    Check(absent.complete && absent.matches.empty(), "negative fixture returns complete zero with preceding positive control");

    Image constant = Solid(12, 8, 100), tile = Solid(3, 3, 100); options.threshold = 1;
    auto nms = MatchTemplate(constant, tile, options);
    bool overlaps = false;
    for (std::size_t a = 0; a < nms.matches.size(); ++a) for (std::size_t b = a + 1; b < nms.matches.size(); ++b)
        overlaps = overlaps || IntersectionOverUnion(nms.matches[a], nms.matches[b]) > options.nms_iou;
    Check(nms.complete && !nms.matches.empty() && !overlaps, "NMS suppresses overlapping boxes");
    options.max_matches = 2;
    const auto capped = MatchTemplate(constant, tile, options);
    Check(capped.complete && capped.truncated && capped.matches.size() == 2, "result cap reports truncation separately from search completeness");

    options = {}; options.max_pixel_comparisons = 2;
    const auto budget = MatchTemplate(image, pattern, options);
    Check(!budget.complete && budget.pixel_comparisons == 2 && !budget.error.empty(), "work budget reports incomplete instead of false absence");
    options = {}; options.max_candidates = 2;
    const auto candidateBudget = MatchTemplate(image, pattern, options);
    Check(!candidateBudget.complete && candidateBudget.candidates == 2 && !candidateBudget.error.empty(), "candidate budget reports incomplete");
    options = {}; options.max_detections = 2; options.threshold = 1;
    const auto detectionBudget = MatchTemplate(constant, tile, options);
    Check(!detectionBudget.complete && !detectionBudget.error.empty(), "matching candidate memory cap reports incomplete");
    options = {}; options.threshold = std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
    Check(!MatchTemplate(image, pattern, options).complete, "NaN threshold rejected");
    Check(MatchTemplate(tile, constant).complete && MatchTemplate(tile, constant).matches.empty(), "larger-than-image template has complete zero");

    Image cropped; std::string error;
    Check(Crop(image, {13, 19, 8, 6}, cropped, error) && cropped.pixels == pattern.pixels, "crop uses exact BGRA client region");
    Check(!Crop(image, {INT_MAX, 0, INT_MAX, 1}, cropped, error), "overflowing crop bounds rejected");
    Pixel pixel;
    Check(ReadPixel(pattern, 0, 0, pixel, error) && pixel.r == pattern.pixels[2] && pixel.g == pattern.pixels[1] &&
        pixel.b == pattern.pixels[0] && pixel.a == 255, "pixel returns RGBA from BGRA bytes");
    Check(!ReadPixel(pattern, pattern.w, 0, pixel, error), "outside pixel rejected");
    Image malformed = pattern; malformed.pixels.pop_back();
    Check(!Validate(malformed, error), "malformed BGRA length rejected");

    const std::wstring fixture = std::wstring(argv[1]) + L"\\vision_fixture.png";
    const bool saved = SavePngFixture(fixture, pattern, error);
    if (!saved) std::printf("PNG fixture error: %s\n", error.c_str());
    Image loaded;
    const bool decoded = saved && LoadPng(fixture, loaded, error);
    if (!decoded) std::printf("PNG decode error: %s\n", error.c_str());
    Check(decoded && loaded.w == pattern.w && loaded.h == pattern.h && loaded.pixels == pattern.pixels, "WIC PNG roundtrip preserves exact BGRA pixels");
    Check(!LoadPng(std::wstring(argv[1]) + L"\\missing_fixture.png", loaded, error) && !error.empty(), "missing PNG returns diagnostic");

    Image large = Solid(1920, 1080, 250), marker = Pattern(24, 16); Paste(large, marker, 1712, 927);
    options = {}; options.threshold = 0.98;
    const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    const auto timed = MatchTemplate(large, marker, options);
    const auto ms = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count();
    Check(timed.complete && timed.matches.size() == 1 && At(timed, 1712, 927), "1080p fixture completes within default work limits");
    std::printf("BENCH image=1920x1080 template=24x16 threshold=0.98 ms=%lld candidates=%llu comparisons=%llu complete=%d\n",
        static_cast<long long>(ms), static_cast<unsigned long long>(timed.candidates), static_cast<unsigned long long>(timed.pixel_comparisons), timed.complete);
    std::printf("failures=%d\n", failures);
    return failures ? 1 : 0;
}

```

`test/vi_vktest.cpp`:

```cpp
// vi_vktest.cpp - synthetic Vulkan capture target for vinput. Every frame the CPU writes vi_pattern.h (frame counter +
// colour bars) into a host-visible staging buffer and the GPU copies it into the acquired swapchain image
// (swapchain usage = TRANSFER_DST only: vinput must add TRANSFER_SRC itself). Recreates the swapchain on WM_SIZE /
// OUT_OF_DATE / SUBOPTIMAL. vulkan-1.dll is loaded at runtime (never linked).
//   vi_vktest.exe <log> <x> <y> <w> <h> [--fmt bgra|rgba|r10] [--gdpa] [--wait-vinput <ms>]
//   --gdpa         resolve instance functions through vkGetInstanceProcAddr and device functions through
//                  vkGetDeviceProcAddr (the volk path) instead of the loader's exports
//   --wait-vinput  load vulkan-1.dll, then wait up to <ms> for \\.\pipe\vinput_<pid> (vinput injected) BEFORE
//                  creating the instance / device / swapchain
// Log: START, VINPUT_PIPE, RESIZE WxH hr=0x00000000, FRAME n maxms= worstms=, FAIL ...
// Never activates: WS_EX_NOACTIVATE + SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE.
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstring>
#include <share.h>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#define VK_NO_PROTOTYPES
#define VK_USE_PLATFORM_WIN32_KHR
#include "../third_party/vulkan/vulkan_core.h"
#include "../third_party/vulkan/vulkan_win32.h"
#include "vi_pattern.h"
#pragma comment(lib, "user32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "shell32.lib")

static FILE* g_log; static HWND g_hwnd; static volatile bool g_resize = false;
static void L(const char* f, ...) { if (!g_log) return; va_list a; va_start(a, f); vfprintf(g_log, f, a); va_end(a); fputc('\n', g_log); fflush(g_log); }
static LRESULT CALLBACK Wnd(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    if (m == WM_SIZE) g_resize = true;
    if (m == WM_DESTROY) { PostQuitMessage(0); return 0; }
    return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}
#define VKCK(x) do { VkResult r_ = (x); if (r_ != VK_SUCCESS) { L("FAIL %s vk=%d line %d", #x, (int)r_, __LINE__); return 2; } } while (0)

#define INST_FNS(X) X(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices) X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties) X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceSupportKHR) \
    X(vkCreateWin32SurfaceKHR) X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR) X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR) \
    X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfacePresentModesKHR) X(vkCreateDevice) X(vkGetDeviceProcAddr) X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties) \
    X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties) X(vkDestroySurfaceKHR) X(vkDestroyInstance)
#define DEV_FNS(X) X(vkGetDeviceQueue) X(vkCreateSwapchainKHR) X(vkDestroySwapchainKHR) X(vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR) \
    X(vkAcquireNextImageKHR) X(vkQueuePresentKHR) X(vkCreateSemaphore) X(vkDestroySemaphore) X(vkCreateFence) X(vkDestroyFence) \
    X(vkWaitForFences) X(vkResetFences) X(vkCreateCommandPool) X(vkDestroyCommandPool) X(vkAllocateCommandBuffers) \
    X(vkResetCommandBuffer) X(vkBeginCommandBuffer) X(vkEndCommandBuffer) X(vkCmdPipelineBarrier) X(vkCmdCopyBufferToImage) \
    X(vkQueueSubmit) X(vkCreateBuffer) X(vkDestroyBuffer) X(vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements) X(vkAllocateMemory) X(vkFreeMemory) \
    X(vkBindBufferMemory) X(vkMapMemory) X(vkDeviceWaitIdle) X(vkDestroyDevice)
#define DECL(n) static PFN_##n n;
INST_FNS(DECL) DEV_FNS(DECL)

int WINAPI wWinMain(HINSTANCE hi, HINSTANCE, LPWSTR, int) {
    int argc; wchar_t** argv = CommandLineToArgvW(GetCommandLineW(), &argc);
    g_log = _wfsopen(argc > 1 ? argv[1] : L"vi_vktest.log", L"w", _SH_DENYNO);
    int x = argc > 5 ? _wtoi(argv[2]) : 100, y = argc > 5 ? _wtoi(argv[3]) : 100, w = argc > 5 ? _wtoi(argv[4]) : 800, hgt = argc > 5 ? _wtoi(argv[5]) : 450;
    vipat::Fmt pf = vipat::BGRA8; VkFormat want = VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM; bool gdpa = false; int waitVinput = 0;
    for (int i = 6; i < argc; i++) {
        if (!wcscmp(argv[i], L"--fmt") && i + 1 < argc) {
            const wchar_t* f = argv[++i];
            if (!wcscmp(f, L"rgba")) { pf = vipat::RGBA8; want = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM; }
            else if (!wcscmp(f, L"r10")) { pf = vipat::R10G10B10A2; want = VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_UNORM_PACK32; }
        } else if (!wcscmp(argv[i], L"--gdpa")) gdpa = true;
        else if (!wcscmp(argv[i], L"--wait-vinput") && i + 1 < argc) waitVinput = _wtoi(argv[++i]);
    }
    WNDCLASSW wc = {}; wc.lpfnWndProc = Wnd; wc.hInstance = hi; wc.lpszClassName = L"vi_vktest"; wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
    RegisterClassW(&wc);
    g_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_NOACTIVATE, wc.lpszClassName, L"vinput vulkan capture target", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, x, y, w, hgt, nullptr, nullptr, hi, nullptr);
    ShowWindow(g_hwnd, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE);

    HMODULE vk = LoadLibraryW(L"vulkan-1.dll");
    if (!vk) { L("FAIL LoadLibrary vulkan-1.dll err=%lu", GetLastError()); return 2; }
    auto gipa = (PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr)GetProcAddress(vk, "vkGetInstanceProcAddr");
    auto createInstance = (PFN_vkCreateInstance)GetProcAddress(vk, "vkCreateInstance");
    if (!gipa || !createInstance) { L("FAIL loader exports missing"); return 2; }
    if (waitVinput > 0) {
        wchar_t pipe[64]; swprintf_s(pipe, L"\\\\.\\pipe\\vinput_%lu", GetCurrentProcessId());
        DWORD t0 = GetTickCount(); bool seen = false;
        while (GetTickCount() - t0 < (DWORD)waitVinput) {
            MSG m; while (PeekMessageW(&m, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) { TranslateMessage(&m); DispatchMessageW(&m); }
            if (WaitNamedPipeW(pipe, 1) || GetLastError() == ERROR_SEM_TIMEOUT) { seen = true; break; }
            Sleep(20);
        }
        L("VINPUT_PIPE seen=%d after %lu ms", seen ? 1 : 0, GetTickCount() - t0);
    }
    VkApplicationInfo ai{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO}; ai.pApplicationName = "vi_vktest"; ai.apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1;
    const char* iexts[] = {"VK_KHR_surface", "VK_KHR_win32_surface"};
    VkInstanceCreateInfo ici{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO}; ici.pApplicationInfo = &ai; ici.enabledExtensionCount = 2; ici.ppEnabledExtensionNames = iexts;
    VkInstance inst = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VKCK(createInstance(&ici, nullptr, &inst));
    int same = 0, total = 0;
#define LOADI(n) n = gdpa ? (PFN_##n)gipa(inst, #n) : (PFN_##n)GetProcAddress(vk, #n); if (!n) { L("FAIL resolve %s", #n); return 2; } \
    total++; if ((void*)n == (void*)GetProcAddress(vk, #n)) same++;
    INST_FNS(LOADI)
    L("RESOLVE instance mode=%s same_as_export=%d/%d", gdpa ? "gipa" : "exports", same, total);

    VkWin32SurfaceCreateInfoKHR sci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WIN32_SURFACE_CREATE_INFO_KHR}; sci.hinstance = hi; sci.hwnd = g_hwnd;
    VkSurfaceKHR surf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VKCK(vkCreateWin32SurfaceKHR(inst, &sci, nullptr, &surf));
    uint32_t npd = 0; VKCK(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(inst, &npd, nullptr));
    std::vector<VkPhysicalDevice> pds(npd); VKCK(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(inst, &npd, pds.data()));
    VkPhysicalDevice pd = VK_NULL_HANDLE; uint32_t fam = UINT32_MAX;
    for (VkPhysicalDevice d : pds) {
        uint32_t nq = 0; vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(d, &nq, nullptr);
        std::vector<VkQueueFamilyProperties> qp(nq); vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(d, &nq, qp.data());
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nq; i++) {
            VkBool32 sup = VK_FALSE; vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceSupportKHR(d, i, surf, &sup);
            if (sup && (qp[i].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT)) { pd = d; fam = i; break; }
        }
        if (pd) break;
    }
    if (!pd) { L("FAIL no graphics+present queue family"); return 2; }
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties props; vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(pd, &props);
    float prio = 1.0f;
    VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo qci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO}; qci.queueFamilyIndex = fam; qci.queueCount = 1; qci.pQueuePriorities = &prio;
    const char* dexts[] = {"VK_KHR_swapchain"};
    VkDeviceCreateInfo dci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO}; dci.queueCreateInfoCount = 1; dci.pQueueCreateInfos = &qci; dci.enabledExtensionCount = 1; dci.ppEnabledExtensionNames = dexts;
    VkDevice dev = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VKCK(vkCreateDevice(pd, &dci, nullptr, &dev));
    same = 0; total = 0;
#define LOADD(n) n = gdpa ? (PFN_##n)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(dev, #n) : (PFN_##n)GetProcAddress(vk, #n); if (!n) { L("FAIL resolve %s", #n); return 2; } \
    total++; if ((void*)n == (void*)GetProcAddress(vk, #n)) same++;
    DEV_FNS(LOADD)
    L("RESOLVE device mode=%s same_as_export=%d/%d gpu=%s", gdpa ? "gdpa" : "exports", same, total, props.deviceName);
    VkQueue q = VK_NULL_HANDLE; vkGetDeviceQueue(dev, fam, 0, &q);

    // surface format
    uint32_t nf = 0; vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR(pd, surf, &nf, nullptr);
    std::vector<VkSurfaceFormatKHR> sfs(nf); vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR(pd, surf, &nf, sfs.data());
    VkSurfaceFormatKHR sf{VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED, VK_COLOR_SPACE_SRGB_NONLINEAR_KHR};
    for (auto& f : sfs) if (f.format == want) { sf = f; break; }
    if (sf.format == VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED) {
        std::string have; for (auto& f : sfs) { have += std::to_string((int)f.format) + " "; }
        L("FAIL surface does not offer format %d (offers %s)", (int)want, have.c_str()); return 5;
    }
    uint32_t npm = 0; vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfacePresentModesKHR(pd, surf, &npm, nullptr);
    std::vector<VkPresentModeKHR> pms(npm); vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfacePresentModesKHR(pd, surf, &npm, pms.data());
    VkPresentModeKHR pm = VK_PRESENT_MODE_FIFO_KHR;
    for (auto m : pms) if (m == VK_PRESENT_MODE_IMMEDIATE_KHR) pm = m;
    for (auto m : pms) if (m == VK_PRESENT_MODE_MAILBOX_KHR && pm != VK_PRESENT_MODE_IMMEDIATE_KHR) pm = m;
    VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties mp; vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(pd, &mp);

    VkSwapchainKHR sc = VK_NULL_HANDLE; std::vector<VkImage> imgs; std::vector<VkSemaphore> done; VkExtent2D ext{};
    auto destroySems = [&]() { for (auto s : done) vkDestroySemaphore(dev, s, nullptr); done.clear(); };
    // returns 0 ok, 1 zero-size (minimized), 2+ failure
    auto makeSwapchain = [&]() -> int {
        VkSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR caps; VKCK(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR(pd, surf, &caps));
        RECT rc; GetClientRect(g_hwnd, &rc);
        ext = caps.currentExtent.width != 0xFFFFFFFFu ? caps.currentExtent : VkExtent2D{(uint32_t)rc.right, (uint32_t)rc.bottom};
        if (!ext.width || !ext.height) return 1;
        if (!(caps.supportedUsageFlags & VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT)) { L("FAIL surface lacks TRANSFER_DST usage"); return 2; }
        uint32_t n = caps.minImageCount + 1; if (caps.maxImageCount && n > caps.maxImageCount) n = caps.maxImageCount;
        VkCompositeAlphaFlagBitsKHR ca = (caps.supportedCompositeAlpha & VK_COMPOSITE_ALPHA_OPAQUE_BIT_KHR) ? VK_COMPOSITE_ALPHA_OPAQUE_BIT_KHR : (VkCompositeAlphaFlagBitsKHR)(caps.supportedCompositeAlpha & (~caps.supportedCompositeAlpha + 1));
        VkSwapchainCreateInfoKHR ci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SWAPCHAIN_CREATE_INFO_KHR};
        ci.surface = surf; ci.minImageCount = n; ci.imageFormat = sf.format; ci.imageColorSpace = sf.colorSpace; ci.imageExtent = ext;
        ci.imageArrayLayers = 1; ci.imageUsage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT; ci.imageSharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
        ci.preTransform = caps.currentTransform; ci.compositeAlpha = ca; ci.presentMode = pm; ci.clipped = VK_TRUE; ci.oldSwapchain = sc;
        VkSwapchainKHR nsc = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VKCK(vkCreateSwapchainKHR(dev, &ci, nullptr, &nsc));
        if (sc) vkDestroySwapchainKHR(dev, sc, nullptr);
        sc = nsc;
        uint32_t ni = 0; VKCK(vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR(dev, sc, &ni, nullptr)); imgs.resize(ni); VKCK(vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR(dev, sc, &ni, imgs.data()));
        destroySems(); done.resize(ni);
        VkSemaphoreCreateInfo si{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_CREATE_INFO};
        for (auto& s : done) VKCK(vkCreateSemaphore(dev, &si, nullptr, &s));
        return 0;
    };
    if (makeSwapchain() != 0) { L("FAIL initial swapchain"); return 2; }

    VkCommandPoolCreateInfo pci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO}; pci.queueFamilyIndex = fam; pci.flags = VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT;
    VkCommandPool pool; VKCK(vkCreateCommandPool(dev, &pci, nullptr, &pool));
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo cai{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO}; cai.commandPool = pool; cai.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY; cai.commandBufferCount = 1;
    VkCommandBuffer cb; VKCK(vkAllocateCommandBuffers(dev, &cai, &cb));
    VkSemaphoreCreateInfo semi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_CREATE_INFO}; VkSemaphore acq; VKCK(vkCreateSemaphore(dev, &semi, nullptr, &acq));
    VkFenceCreateInfo fci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO}; VkFence fence; VKCK(vkCreateFence(dev, &fci, nullptr, &fence));
    VkBuffer stg = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkDeviceMemory stgMem = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkDeviceSize stgSize = 0; uint8_t* stgMap = nullptr;

    L("START hwnd=%p fmt=%d client=%ux%u present_mode=%d images=%u", g_hwnd, (int)sf.format, ext.width, ext.height, (int)pm, (unsigned)imgs.size());
    uint32_t frame = 0; DWORD lastLog = 0; int resizes = 0; bool recreate = false;
    LARGE_INTEGER qpf, prevT{}; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&qpf); double maxMs = 0, worstMs = 0;
    MSG msg;
    for (;;) {
        while (PeekMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) {
            if (msg.message == WM_QUIT) { vkDeviceWaitIdle(dev); L("EXIT frames=%u resizes=%d", frame, resizes); return 0; }
            TranslateMessage(&msg); DispatchMessageW(&msg);
        }
        if (g_resize || recreate) {
            RECT rc; GetClientRect(g_hwnd, &rc);
            if (recreate || (uint32_t)rc.right != ext.width || (uint32_t)rc.bottom != ext.height) {
                vkDeviceWaitIdle(dev);
                int r = makeSwapchain();
                if (r == 1) { Sleep(10); continue; }
                if (r != 0) return 3;
                L("RESIZE %ux%u hr=0x00000000", ext.width, ext.height);
                resizes++; prevT.QuadPart = 0;
            }
            g_resize = false; recreate = false;
        }
        VkDeviceSize need = (VkDeviceSize)ext.width * ext.height * vipat::Bpp(pf);
        if (need > stgSize) {
            if (stg) { vkDeviceWaitIdle(dev); vkDestroyBuffer(dev, stg, nullptr); vkFreeMemory(dev, stgMem, nullptr); }
            VkBufferCreateInfo bci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO}; bci.size = need; bci.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT;
            VKCK(vkCreateBuffer(dev, &bci, nullptr, &stg));
            VkMemoryRequirements mr; vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(dev, stg, &mr);
            uint32_t mt = UINT32_MAX;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mp.memoryTypeCount; i++)
                if ((mr.memoryTypeBits & (1u << i)) && (mp.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & (VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT)) == (VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT)) { mt = i; break; }
            if (mt == UINT32_MAX) { L("FAIL no host-coherent memory"); return 2; }
            VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO}; mai.allocationSize = mr.size; mai.memoryTypeIndex = mt;
            VKCK(vkAllocateMemory(dev, &mai, nullptr, &stgMem)); VKCK(vkBindBufferMemory(dev, stg, stgMem, 0));
            VKCK(vkMapMemory(dev, stgMem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, (void**)&stgMap)); stgSize = need;
        }
        uint32_t idx = 0;
        VkResult ar = vkAcquireNextImageKHR(dev, sc, 2000000000ULL, acq, VK_NULL_HANDLE, &idx);
        if (ar == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR) { recreate = true; continue; }
        if (ar != VK_SUCCESS && ar != VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR) { L("FAIL vkAcquireNextImageKHR vk=%d", (int)ar); return 4; }
        for (uint32_t yy = 0; yy < ext.height; yy++) vipat::Row(pf, (int)yy, (int)ext.width, frame, stgMap + (size_t)yy * ext.width * vipat::Bpp(pf));
        VKCK(vkResetCommandBuffer(cb, 0));
        VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO}; bi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
        VKCK(vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &bi));
        VkImageMemoryBarrier b{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER};
        b.srcAccessMask = 0; b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT; b.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED; b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
        b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.image = imgs[idx]; b.subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1};
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 1, &b);
        VkBufferImageCopy rg{}; rg.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}; rg.imageExtent = {ext.width, ext.height, 1};
        vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(cb, stg, imgs[idx], VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &rg);
        b.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT; b.dstAccessMask = 0; b.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL; b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR;
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_BIT, 0, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 1, &b);
        VKCK(vkEndCommandBuffer(cb));
        VkPipelineStageFlags ws = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT;
        VkSubmitInfo si{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO}; si.waitSemaphoreCount = 1; si.pWaitSemaphores = &acq; si.pWaitDstStageMask = &ws;
        si.commandBufferCount = 1; si.pCommandBuffers = &cb; si.signalSemaphoreCount = 1; si.pSignalSemaphores = &done[idx];
        VKCK(vkResetFences(dev, 1, &fence));
        VKCK(vkQueueSubmit(q, 1, &si, fence));
        VkPresentInfoKHR pi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PRESENT_INFO_KHR}; pi.waitSemaphoreCount = 1; pi.pWaitSemaphores = &done[idx]; pi.swapchainCount = 1; pi.pSwapchains = &sc; pi.pImageIndices = &idx;
        VkResult pr = vkQueuePresentKHR(q, &pi);
        // one frame in flight: the staging buffer and the command buffer are reused next frame
        VkResult fr = vkWaitForFences(dev, 1, &fence, VK_TRUE, 5000000000ULL);
        if (fr != VK_SUCCESS) { L("FAIL vkWaitForFences vk=%d", (int)fr); return 4; }
        if (pr == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR || pr == VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR) recreate = true;
        else if (pr != VK_SUCCESS) { L("FAIL vkQueuePresentKHR vk=%d", (int)pr); return 4; }
        ++frame;
        LARGE_INTEGER now; QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
        if (prevT.QuadPart) { double ms = (now.QuadPart - prevT.QuadPart) * 1000.0 / qpf.QuadPart; if (ms > maxMs) maxMs = ms; if (ms > worstMs) worstMs = ms; }
        prevT = now;
        if (GetTickCount() - lastLog > 1000) { lastLog = GetTickCount(); L("FRAME %u maxms=%.1f worstms=%.1f", frame, maxMs, worstMs); maxMs = 0; }
        Sleep(4);
    }
}

```

`test/vi_xinputtest.cpp`:

```cpp
// vi_xinputtest.cpp - synthetic XInput reader for verify\run_xinputtest.ps1.
// Polls pad 0 every ~2 ms through XInputGetState (and, with --ex, XInputGetStateEx = ordinal 100) of the DLL named by
// --dll (default xinput1_4.dll), and logs every change of the result code or of the gamepad fields:
//   STATE src=<std|ex> rc=<code> pkt=<n> b=0x<hex> lt=<n> rt=<n> lx=<n> ly=<n> rx=<n> ry=<n>
// It owns a small window (vinput wants a main window) placed where the script says, never activated.
//   vi_xinputtest.exe <log> x y w h [--dll name] [--ex]
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <share.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <timeapi.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "winmm.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "shell32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "user32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "gdi32.lib")

struct XGP { WORD b; BYTE lt, rt; SHORT lx, ly, rx, ry; };
struct XST { DWORD pkt; XGP gp; };
using PFN_XGS = DWORD(WINAPI*)(DWORD, XST*);

static FILE* g_log = nullptr;
static void Log(const char* f, ...) {
    if (!g_log) return;
    SYSTEMTIME t; GetLocalTime(&t);
    fprintf(g_log, "%02d:%02d:%02d.%03d ", t.wHour, t.wMinute, t.wSecond, t.wMilliseconds);
    va_list a; va_start(a, f); vfprintf(g_log, f, a); va_end(a);
    fputc('\n', g_log); fflush(g_log);
}

struct Src { const char* name; PFN_XGS fn; DWORD rc; XST st; bool first; };

static void Poll(Src& s) {
    if (!s.fn) return;
    XST st = {};
    DWORD rc = s.fn(0, &st);
    if (rc != ERROR_SUCCESS) memset(&st, 0, sizeof(st));
    bool changed = s.first || rc != s.rc || memcmp(&st.gp, &s.st.gp, sizeof(st.gp)) != 0;
    if (!changed) return;
    s.first = false; s.rc = rc; s.st = st;
    Log("STATE src=%s rc=%lu pkt=%lu b=0x%04X lt=%u rt=%u lx=%d ly=%d rx=%d ry=%d", s.name, rc, st.pkt, st.gp.b,
        st.gp.lt, st.gp.rt, st.gp.lx, st.gp.ly, st.gp.rx, st.gp.ry);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK WndProc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    if (m == WM_DESTROY) { PostQuitMessage(0); return 0; }
    if (m == WM_PAINT) { PAINTSTRUCT ps; HDC dc = BeginPaint(h, &ps); FillRect(dc, &ps.rcPaint, (HBRUSH)GetStockObject(GRAY_BRUSH)); EndPaint(h, &ps); return 0; }
    return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}

int WINAPI wWinMain(HINSTANCE hi, HINSTANCE, LPWSTR, int) {
    int argc = 0; wchar_t** argv = CommandLineToArgvW(GetCommandLineW(), &argc);
    if (argc < 6) return 2;
    g_log = _wfsopen(argv[1], L"w", _SH_DENYNO);   // the test script reads it while we run
    int x = _wtoi(argv[2]), y = _wtoi(argv[3]), w = _wtoi(argv[4]), hgt = _wtoi(argv[5]);
    const wchar_t* dll = L"xinput1_4.dll"; bool ex = false;
    for (int i = 6; i < argc; i++) {
        if (!wcscmp(argv[i], L"--dll") && i + 1 < argc) dll = argv[++i];
        else if (!wcscmp(argv[i], L"--ex")) ex = true;
    }
    HMODULE h = LoadLibraryW(dll);
    if (!h) { Log("FAIL LoadLibrary %ls err=%lu", dll, GetLastError()); return 3; }
    Src std_ = {"std", (PFN_XGS)GetProcAddress(h, "XInputGetState"), 0, {}, true};
    Src exs = {"ex", ex ? (PFN_XGS)GetProcAddress(h, MAKEINTRESOURCEA(100)) : nullptr, 0, {}, true};
    if (!std_.fn || (ex && !exs.fn)) { Log("FAIL GetProcAddress std=%p ex=%p", (void*)std_.fn, (void*)exs.fn); return 3; }
    Log("READY dll=%ls ex=%d pid=%lu", dll, ex ? 1 : 0, GetCurrentProcessId());

    WNDCLASSW wc = {}; wc.lpfnWndProc = WndProc; wc.hInstance = hi; wc.lpszClassName = L"vi_xinputtest"; wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
    RegisterClassW(&wc);
    HWND hw = CreateWindowExW(0, wc.lpszClassName, L"vi_xinputtest", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, x, y, w, hgt, nullptr, nullptr, hi, nullptr);
    ShowWindow(hw, SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE);
    timeBeginPeriod(1);
    for (;;) {
        MSG m;
        while (PeekMessageW(&m, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) { if (m.message == WM_QUIT) { timeEndPeriod(1); return 0; } TranslateMessage(&m); DispatchMessageW(&m); }
        Poll(std_); Poll(exs);
        Sleep(2);
    }
}
```

```h
/*
 *  MinHook - The Minimalistic API Hooking Library for x64/x86
 *  Copyright (C) 2009-2017 Tsuda Kageyu.
 *  All rights reserved.
 *
 *  Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without
 *  modification, are permitted provided that the following conditions
 *  are met:
 *
 *   1. Redistributions of source code must retain the above copyright
 *      notice, this list of conditions and the following disclaimer.
 *   2. Redistributions in binary form must reproduce the above copyright
 *      notice, this list of conditions and the following disclaimer in the
 *      documentation and/or other materials provided with the distribution.
 *
 *  THIS SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED BY THE COPYRIGHT HOLDERS AND CONTRIBUTORS
 *  "AS IS" AND ANY EXPRESS OR IMPLIED WARRANTIES, INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED
 *  TO, THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND FITNESS FOR A
 *  PARTICULAR PURPOSE ARE DISCLAIMED. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE COPYRIGHT HOLDER
 *  OR CONTRIBUTORS BE LIABLE FOR ANY DIRECT, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL,
 *  EXEMPLARY, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES (INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO,
 *  PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES; LOSS OF USE, DATA, OR
 *  PROFITS; OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION) HOWEVER CAUSED AND ON ANY THEORY OF
 *  LIABILITY, WHETHER IN CONTRACT, STRICT LIABILITY, OR TORT (INCLUDING
 *  NEGLIGENCE OR OTHERWISE) ARISING IN ANY WAY OUT OF THE USE OF THIS
 *  SOFTWARE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE.
 */

#pragma once

#if !(defined _M_IX86) && !(defined _M_X64) && !(defined __i386__) && !(defined __x86_64__)
    #error MinHook supports only x86 and x64 systems.
#endif

#include <windows.h>

// MinHook Error Codes.
typedef enum MH_STATUS
{
    // Unknown error. Should not be returned.
    MH_UNKNOWN = -1,

    // Successful.
    MH_OK = 0,

    // MinHook is already initialized.
    MH_ERROR_ALREADY_INITIALIZED,

    // MinHook is not initialized yet, or already uninitialized.
    MH_ERROR_NOT_INITIALIZED,

    // The hook for the specified target function is already created.
    MH_ERROR_ALREADY_CREATED,

    // The hook for the specified target function is not created yet.
    MH_ERROR_NOT_CREATED,

    // The hook for the specified target function is already enabled.
    MH_ERROR_ENABLED,

    // The hook for the specified target function is not enabled yet, or already
    // disabled.
    MH_ERROR_DISABLED,

    // The specified pointer is invalid. It points the address of non-allocated
    // and/or non-executable region.
    MH_ERROR_NOT_EXECUTABLE,

    // The specified target function cannot be hooked.
    MH_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION,

    // Failed to allocate memory.
    MH_ERROR_MEMORY_ALLOC,

    // Failed to change the memory protection.
    MH_ERROR_MEMORY_PROTECT,

    // The specified module is not loaded.
    MH_ERROR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND,

    // The specified function is not found.
    MH_ERROR_FUNCTION_NOT_FOUND
}
MH_STATUS;

// Can be passed as a parameter to MH_EnableHook, MH_DisableHook,
// MH_QueueEnableHook or MH_QueueDisableHook.
#define MH_ALL_HOOKS NULL

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

    // Initialize the MinHook library. You must call this function EXACTLY ONCE
    // at the beginning of your program.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_Initialize(VOID);

    // Uninitialize the MinHook library. You must call this function EXACTLY
    // ONCE at the end of your program.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_Uninitialize(VOID);

    // Creates a hook for the specified target function, in disabled state.
    // Parameters:
    //   pTarget     [in]  A pointer to the target function, which will be
    //                     overridden by the detour function.
    //   pDetour     [in]  A pointer to the detour function, which will override
    //                     the target function.
    //   ppOriginal  [out] A pointer to the trampoline function, which will be
    //                     used to call the original target function.
    //                     This parameter can be NULL.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_CreateHook(LPVOID pTarget, LPVOID pDetour, LPVOID *ppOriginal);

    // Creates a hook for the specified API function, in disabled state.
    // Parameters:
    //   pszModule   [in]  A pointer to the loaded module name which contains the
    //                     target function.
    //   pszProcName [in]  A pointer to the target function name, which will be
    //                     overridden by the detour function.
    //   pDetour     [in]  A pointer to the detour function, which will override
    //                     the target function.
    //   ppOriginal  [out] A pointer to the trampoline function, which will be
    //                     used to call the original target function.
    //                     This parameter can be NULL.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_CreateHookApi(
        LPCWSTR pszModule, LPCSTR pszProcName, LPVOID pDetour, LPVOID *ppOriginal);

    // Creates a hook for the specified API function, in disabled state.
    // Parameters:
    //   pszModule   [in]  A pointer to the loaded module name which contains the
    //                     target function.
    //   pszProcName [in]  A pointer to the target function name, which will be
    //                     overridden by the detour function.
    //   pDetour     [in]  A pointer to the detour function, which will override
    //                     the target function.
    //   ppOriginal  [out] A pointer to the trampoline function, which will be
    //                     used to call the original target function.
    //                     This parameter can be NULL.
    //   ppTarget    [out] A pointer to the target function, which will be used
    //                     with other functions.
    //                     This parameter can be NULL.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_CreateHookApiEx(
        LPCWSTR pszModule, LPCSTR pszProcName, LPVOID pDetour, LPVOID *ppOriginal, LPVOID *ppTarget);

    // Removes an already created hook.
    // Parameters:
    //   pTarget [in] A pointer to the target function.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_RemoveHook(LPVOID pTarget);

    // Enables an already created hook.
    // Parameters:
    //   pTarget [in] A pointer to the target function.
    //                If this parameter is MH_ALL_HOOKS, all created hooks are
    //                enabled in one go.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_EnableHook(LPVOID pTarget);

    // Disables an already created hook.
    // Parameters:
    //   pTarget [in] A pointer to the target function.
    //                If this parameter is MH_ALL_HOOKS, all created hooks are
    //                disabled in one go.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_DisableHook(LPVOID pTarget);

    // Queues to enable an already created hook.
    // Parameters:
    //   pTarget [in] A pointer to the target function.
    //                If this parameter is MH_ALL_HOOKS, all created hooks are
    //                queued to be enabled.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_QueueEnableHook(LPVOID pTarget);

    // Queues to disable an already created hook.
    // Parameters:
    //   pTarget [in] A pointer to the target function.
    //                If this parameter is MH_ALL_HOOKS, all created hooks are
    //                queued to be disabled.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_QueueDisableHook(LPVOID pTarget);

    // Applies all queued changes in one go.
    MH_STATUS WINAPI MH_ApplyQueued(VOID);

    // Translates the MH_STATUS to its name as a string.
    const char *WINAPI MH_StatusToString(MH_STATUS status);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```
