`third_party/minhook/src/trampoline.c`:

```c
/*
 *  MinHook - The Minimalistic API Hooking Library for x64/x86
 *  Copyright (C) 2009-2017 Tsuda Kageyu.
 *  All rights reserved.
 *
 *  Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without
 *  modification, are permitted provided that the following conditions
 *  are met:
 *
 *   1. Redistributions of source code must retain the above copyright
 *      notice, this list of conditions and the following disclaimer.
 *   2. Redistributions in binary form must reproduce the above copyright
 *      notice, this list of conditions and the following disclaimer in the
 *      documentation and/or other materials provided with the distribution.
 *
 *  THIS SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED BY THE COPYRIGHT HOLDERS AND CONTRIBUTORS
 *  "AS IS" AND ANY EXPRESS OR IMPLIED WARRANTIES, INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED
 *  TO, THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND FITNESS FOR A
 *  PARTICULAR PURPOSE ARE DISCLAIMED. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE COPYRIGHT HOLDER
 *  OR CONTRIBUTORS BE LIABLE FOR ANY DIRECT, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL,
 *  EXEMPLARY, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES (INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO,
 *  PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES; LOSS OF USE, DATA, OR
 *  PROFITS; OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION) HOWEVER CAUSED AND ON ANY THEORY OF
 *  LIABILITY, WHETHER IN CONTRACT, STRICT LIABILITY, OR TORT (INCLUDING
 *  NEGLIGENCE OR OTHERWISE) ARISING IN ANY WAY OUT OF THE USE OF THIS
 *  SOFTWARE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE.
 */

#include <windows.h>

#if defined(_MSC_VER) && !defined(MINHOOK_DISABLE_INTRINSICS)
    #define ALLOW_INTRINSICS
    #include <intrin.h>
#endif

#ifndef ARRAYSIZE
    #define ARRAYSIZE(A) (sizeof(A)/sizeof((A)[0]))
#endif

#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
    #include "./hde/hde64.h"
    typedef hde64s HDE;
    #define HDE_DISASM(code, hs) hde64_disasm(code, hs)
#else
    #include "./hde/hde32.h"
    typedef hde32s HDE;
    #define HDE_DISASM(code, hs) hde32_disasm(code, hs)
#endif

#include "trampoline.h"
#include "buffer.h"

// Maximum size of a trampoline function.
#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
    #define TRAMPOLINE_MAX_SIZE (MEMORY_SLOT_SIZE - sizeof(JMP_ABS))
#else
    #define TRAMPOLINE_MAX_SIZE MEMORY_SLOT_SIZE
#endif

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
static BOOL IsCodePadding(LPBYTE pInst, UINT size)
{
    UINT i;

    if (pInst[0] != 0x00 && pInst[0] != 0x90 && pInst[0] != 0xCC)
        return FALSE;

    for (i = 1; i < size; ++i)
    {
        if (pInst[i] != pInst[0])
            return FALSE;
    }
    return TRUE;
}

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
BOOL CreateTrampolineFunction(PTRAMPOLINE ct)
{
#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
    CALL_ABS call = {
        0xFF, 0x15, 0x00000002, // FF15 00000002: CALL [RIP+8]
        0xEB, 0x08,             // EB 08:         JMP +10
        0x0000000000000000ULL   // Absolute destination address
    };
    JMP_ABS jmp = {
        0xFF, 0x25, 0x00000000, // FF25 00000000: JMP [RIP+6]
        0x0000000000000000ULL   // Absolute destination address
    };
    JCC_ABS jcc = {
        0x70, 0x0E,             // 7* 0E:         J** +16
        0xFF, 0x25, 0x00000000, // FF25 00000000: JMP [RIP+6]
        0x0000000000000000ULL   // Absolute destination address
    };
#else
    CALL_REL call = {
        0xE8,                   // E8 xxxxxxxx: CALL +5+xxxxxxxx
        0x00000000              // Relative destination address
    };
    JMP_REL jmp = {
        0xE9,                   // E9 xxxxxxxx: JMP +5+xxxxxxxx
        0x00000000              // Relative destination address
    };
    JCC_REL jcc = {
        0x0F, 0x80,             // 0F8* xxxxxxxx: J** +6+xxxxxxxx
        0x00000000              // Relative destination address
    };
#endif

    UINT8     oldPos   = 0;
    UINT8     newPos   = 0;
    ULONG_PTR jmpDest  = 0;     // Destination address of an internal jump.
    BOOL      finished = FALSE; // Is the function completed?
#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
    UINT8     instBuf[16];
#endif

    ct->patchAbove = FALSE;
    ct->nIP        = 0;

    do
    {
        HDE       hs;
        UINT      copySize;
        LPVOID    pCopySrc;
        ULONG_PTR pOldInst = (ULONG_PTR)ct->pTarget     + oldPos;
        ULONG_PTR pNewInst = (ULONG_PTR)ct->pTrampoline + newPos;

        copySize = HDE_DISASM((LPVOID)pOldInst, &hs);
        if (hs.flags & F_ERROR)
            return FALSE;

        pCopySrc = (LPVOID)pOldInst;
        if (oldPos >= sizeof(JMP_REL))
        {
            // The trampoline function is long enough.
            // Complete the function with the jump to the target function.
#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
            jmp.address = pOldInst;
#else
            jmp.operand = (INT32)(pOldInst - (pNewInst + sizeof(jmp)));
#endif
            pCopySrc = &jmp;
            copySize = sizeof(jmp);

            finished = TRUE;
        }
#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
        else if ((hs.modrm & 0xC7) == 0x05)
        {
            // Instructions using RIP relative addressing. (ModR/M = 00???101B)

            // Modify the RIP relative address.
            PUINT32 pRelAddr;

            // Avoid using memcpy to reduce the footprint.
#ifndef ALLOW_INTRINSICS
            memcpy(instBuf, (LPBYTE)pOldInst, copySize);
#else
            __movsb(instBuf, (LPBYTE)pOldInst, copySize);
#endif
            pCopySrc = instBuf;

            // Relative address is stored at (instruction length - immediate value length - 4).
            pRelAddr = (PUINT32)(instBuf + hs.len - ((hs.flags & 0x3C) >> 2) - 4);
            *pRelAddr
                = (UINT32)((pOldInst + hs.len + (INT32)hs.disp.disp32) - (pNewInst + hs.len));

            // Complete the function if JMP (FF /4).
            if (hs.opcode == 0xFF && hs.modrm_reg == 4)
                finished = TRUE;
        }
#endif
        else if (hs.opcode == 0xE8)
        {
            // Direct relative CALL
            ULONG_PTR dest = pOldInst + hs.len + (INT32)hs.imm.imm32;
#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
            call.address = dest;
#else
            call.operand = (INT32)(dest - (pNewInst + sizeof(call)));
#endif
            pCopySrc = &call;
            copySize = sizeof(call);
        }
        else if ((hs.opcode & 0xFD) == 0xE9)
        {
            // Direct relative JMP (EB or E9)
            ULONG_PTR dest = pOldInst + hs.len;

            if (hs.opcode == 0xEB) // isShort jmp
                dest += (INT8)hs.imm.imm8;
            else
                dest += (INT32)hs.imm.imm32;

            // Simply copy an internal jump.
            if ((ULONG_PTR)ct->pTarget <= dest
                && dest < ((ULONG_PTR)ct->pTarget + sizeof(JMP_REL)))
            {
                if (jmpDest < dest)
                    jmpDest = dest;
            }
            else
            {
#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
                jmp.address = dest;
#else
                jmp.operand = (INT32)(dest - (pNewInst + sizeof(jmp)));
#endif
                pCopySrc = &jmp;
                copySize = sizeof(jmp);

                // Exit the function if it is not in the branch.
                finished = (pOldInst >= jmpDest);
            }
        }
        else if ((hs.opcode & 0xF0) == 0x70
            || (hs.opcode & 0xFC) == 0xE0
            || (hs.opcode2 & 0xF0) == 0x80)
        {
            // Direct relative Jcc
            ULONG_PTR dest = pOldInst + hs.len;

            if ((hs.opcode & 0xF0) == 0x70      // Jcc
                || (hs.opcode & 0xFC) == 0xE0)  // LOOPNZ/LOOPZ/LOOP/JECXZ
                dest += (INT8)hs.imm.imm8;
            else
                dest += (INT32)hs.imm.imm32;

            // Simply copy an internal jump.
            if ((ULONG_PTR)ct->pTarget <= dest
                && dest < ((ULONG_PTR)ct->pTarget + sizeof(JMP_REL)))
            {
                if (jmpDest < dest)
                    jmpDest = dest;
            }
            else if ((hs.opcode & 0xFC) == 0xE0)
            {
                // LOOPNZ/LOOPZ/LOOP/JCXZ/JECXZ to the outside are not supported.
                return FALSE;
            }
            else
            {
                UINT8 cond = ((hs.opcode != 0x0F ? hs.opcode : hs.opcode2) & 0x0F);
#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
                // Invert the condition in x64 mode to simplify the conditional jump logic.
                jcc.opcode  = 0x71 ^ cond;
                jcc.address = dest;
#else
                jcc.opcode1 = 0x80 | cond;
                jcc.operand = (INT32)(dest - (pNewInst + sizeof(jcc)));
#endif
                pCopySrc = &jcc;
                copySize = sizeof(jcc);
            }
        }
        else if ((hs.opcode & 0xFE) == 0xC2)
        {
            // RET (C2 or C3)

            // Complete the function if not in a branch.
            finished = (pOldInst >= jmpDest);
        }

        // Can't alter the instruction length in a branch.
        if (pOldInst < jmpDest && copySize != hs.len)
            return FALSE;

        // Trampoline function is too large.
        if ((newPos + copySize) > TRAMPOLINE_MAX_SIZE)
            return FALSE;

        // Trampoline function has too many instructions.
        if (ct->nIP >= ARRAYSIZE(ct->oldIPs))
            return FALSE;

        ct->oldIPs[ct->nIP] = oldPos;
        ct->newIPs[ct->nIP] = newPos;
        ct->nIP++;

        // Avoid using memcpy to reduce the footprint.
#ifndef ALLOW_INTRINSICS
        memcpy((LPBYTE)ct->pTrampoline + newPos, pCopySrc, copySize);
#else
        __movsb((LPBYTE)ct->pTrampoline + newPos, (LPBYTE)pCopySrc, copySize);
#endif
        newPos += copySize;
        oldPos += hs.len;
    } while (!finished);

    // Is there enough place for a long jump?
    if (oldPos < sizeof(JMP_REL)
        && !IsCodePadding((LPBYTE)ct->pTarget + oldPos, sizeof(JMP_REL) - oldPos))
    {
        // Is there enough place for a short jump?
        if (oldPos < sizeof(JMP_REL_SHORT)
            && !IsCodePadding((LPBYTE)ct->pTarget + oldPos, sizeof(JMP_REL_SHORT) - oldPos))
        {
            return FALSE;
        }

        // Can we place the long jump above the function?
        if (!IsExecutableAddress((LPBYTE)ct->pTarget - sizeof(JMP_REL)))
            return FALSE;

        if (!IsCodePadding((LPBYTE)ct->pTarget - sizeof(JMP_REL), sizeof(JMP_REL)))
            return FALSE;

        ct->patchAbove = TRUE;
    }

#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
    // Create a relay function.
    jmp.address = (ULONG_PTR)ct->pDetour;

    ct->pRelay = (LPBYTE)ct->pTrampoline + newPos;
    memcpy(ct->pRelay, &jmp, sizeof(jmp));
#endif

    return TRUE;
}

```

```h
/*
 *  MinHook - The Minimalistic API Hooking Library for x64/x86
 *  Copyright (C) 2009-2017 Tsuda Kageyu.
 *  All rights reserved.
 *
 *  Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without
 *  modification, are permitted provided that the following conditions
 *  are met:
 *
 *   1. Redistributions of source code must retain the above copyright
 *      notice, this list of conditions and the following disclaimer.
 *   2. Redistributions in binary form must reproduce the above copyright
 *      notice, this list of conditions and the following disclaimer in the
 *      documentation and/or other materials provided with the distribution.
 *
 *  THIS SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED BY THE COPYRIGHT HOLDERS AND CONTRIBUTORS
 *  "AS IS" AND ANY EXPRESS OR IMPLIED WARRANTIES, INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED
 *  TO, THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND FITNESS FOR A
 *  PARTICULAR PURPOSE ARE DISCLAIMED. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE COPYRIGHT HOLDER
 *  OR CONTRIBUTORS BE LIABLE FOR ANY DIRECT, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL,
 *  EXEMPLARY, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES (INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO,
 *  PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES; LOSS OF USE, DATA, OR
 *  PROFITS; OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION) HOWEVER CAUSED AND ON ANY THEORY OF
 *  LIABILITY, WHETHER IN CONTRACT, STRICT LIABILITY, OR TORT (INCLUDING
 *  NEGLIGENCE OR OTHERWISE) ARISING IN ANY WAY OUT OF THE USE OF THIS
 *  SOFTWARE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE.
 */

#pragma once

#pragma pack(push, 1)

// Structs for writing x86/x64 instructions.

// 8-bit relative jump.
typedef struct _JMP_REL_SHORT
{
    UINT8  opcode;      // EB xx: JMP +2+xx
    INT8   operand;     // Relative destination address
} JMP_REL_SHORT, *PJMP_REL_SHORT;

// 32-bit direct relative jump/call.
typedef struct _JMP_REL
{
    UINT8  opcode;      // E9/E8 xxxxxxxx: JMP/CALL +5+xxxxxxxx
    INT32  operand;     // Relative destination address
} JMP_REL, *PJMP_REL, CALL_REL;

// 64-bit indirect absolute jump.
typedef struct _JMP_ABS
{
    UINT8  opcode0;     // FF25 00000000: JMP [+6]
    UINT8  opcode1;
    UINT32 dummy;
    UINT64 address;     // Absolute destination address
} JMP_ABS, *PJMP_ABS;

// 64-bit indirect absolute call.
typedef struct _CALL_ABS
{
    UINT8  opcode0;     // FF15 00000002: CALL [+6]
    UINT8  opcode1;
    UINT32 dummy0;
    UINT8  dummy1;      // EB 08:         JMP +10
    UINT8  dummy2;
    UINT64 address;     // Absolute destination address
} CALL_ABS;

// 32-bit direct relative conditional jumps.
typedef struct _JCC_REL
{
    UINT8  opcode0;     // 0F8* xxxxxxxx: J** +6+xxxxxxxx
    UINT8  opcode1;
    INT32  operand;     // Relative destination address
} JCC_REL;

// 64bit indirect absolute conditional jumps that x64 lacks.
typedef struct _JCC_ABS
{
    UINT8  opcode;      // 7* 0E:         J** +16
    UINT8  dummy0;
    UINT8  dummy1;      // FF25 00000000: JMP [+6]
    UINT8  dummy2;
    UINT32 dummy3;
    UINT64 address;     // Absolute destination address
} JCC_ABS;

#pragma pack(pop)

typedef struct _TRAMPOLINE
{
    LPVOID pTarget;         // [In] Address of the target function.
    LPVOID pDetour;         // [In] Address of the detour function.
    LPVOID pTrampoline;     // [In] Buffer address for the trampoline and relay function.

#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
    LPVOID pRelay;          // [Out] Address of the relay function.
#endif
    BOOL   patchAbove;      // [Out] Should use the hot patch area?
    UINT   nIP;             // [Out] Number of the instruction boundaries.
    UINT8  oldIPs[8];       // [Out] Instruction boundaries of the target function.
    UINT8  newIPs[8];       // [Out] Instruction boundaries of the trampoline function.
} TRAMPOLINE, *PTRAMPOLINE;

BOOL CreateTrampolineFunction(PTRAMPOLINE ct);

```

`third_party/vulkan/README.txt`:

```txt
Vulkan headers for vinput's runtime-resolved Vulkan capture (VK_NO_PROTOTYPES; vulkan-1.dll is never linked).

vk_platform.h, vulkan_core.h, vulkan_win32.h, vulkan.h: unmodified Khronos Vulkan-Headers, header version 1.4.356
(VK_HEADER_VERSION 356), Apache-2.0 OR MIT - see LICENSE.txt. Upstream: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers

vk_video\*.h: project STUBS, not Khronos files. Opaque int placeholders for the StdVideo* names vulkan_core.h
mentions; any video struct that embeds one has the wrong layout. vinput and its tests never use Vulkan video.
```

`third_party/vulkan/vk_platform.h`:

```h
//
// File: vk_platform.h
//
/*
** Copyright 2014-2026 The Khronos Group Inc.
** SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
*/


#ifndef VK_PLATFORM_H_
#define VK_PLATFORM_H_

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C"
{
#endif // __cplusplus

/*
***************************************************************************************************
*   Platform-specific directives and type declarations
***************************************************************************************************
*/

/* Platform-specific calling convention macros.
 *
 * Platforms should define these so that Vulkan clients call Vulkan commands
 * with the same calling conventions that the Vulkan implementation expects.
 *
 * VKAPI_ATTR - Placed before the return type in function declarations.
 *              Useful for C++11 and GCC/Clang-style function attribute syntax.
 * VKAPI_CALL - Placed after the return type in function declarations.
 *              Useful for MSVC-style calling convention syntax.
 * VKAPI_PTR  - Placed between the '(' and '*' in function pointer types.
 *
 * Function declaration:  VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL vkCommand(void);
 * Function pointer type: typedef void (VKAPI_PTR *PFN_vkCommand)(void);
 */
#if defined(_WIN32)
    // On Windows, Vulkan commands use the stdcall convention
    #define VKAPI_ATTR
    #define VKAPI_CALL __stdcall
    #define VKAPI_PTR  VKAPI_CALL
#elif defined(__ANDROID__) && defined(__ARM_ARCH) && __ARM_ARCH < 7
    #error "Vulkan is not supported for the 'armeabi' NDK ABI"
#elif defined(__ANDROID__) && defined(__ARM_ARCH) && __ARM_ARCH >= 7 && defined(__ARM_32BIT_STATE)
    // On Android 32-bit ARM targets, Vulkan functions use the "hardfloat"
    // calling convention, i.e. float parameters are passed in registers. This
    // is true even if the rest of the application passes floats on the stack,
    // as it does by default when compiling for the armeabi-v7a NDK ABI.
    #define VKAPI_ATTR __attribute__((pcs("aapcs-vfp")))
    #define VKAPI_CALL
    #define VKAPI_PTR  VKAPI_ATTR
#else
    // On other platforms, use the default calling convention
    #define VKAPI_ATTR
    #define VKAPI_CALL
    #define VKAPI_PTR
#endif

#if !defined(VK_NO_STDDEF_H)
    #include <stddef.h>
#endif // !defined(VK_NO_STDDEF_H)

#if !defined(VK_NO_STDINT_H)
    #if defined(_MSC_VER) && (_MSC_VER < 1600)
        typedef signed   __int8  int8_t;
        typedef unsigned __int8  uint8_t;
        typedef signed   __int16 int16_t;
        typedef unsigned __int16 uint16_t;
        typedef signed   __int32 int32_t;
        typedef unsigned __int32 uint32_t;
        typedef signed   __int64 int64_t;
        typedef unsigned __int64 uint64_t;
    #else
        #include <stdint.h>
    #endif
#endif // !defined(VK_NO_STDINT_H)

#ifdef __cplusplus
} // extern "C"
#endif // __cplusplus

#endif

```

`verify/_multi_client.ps1`:

```ps1
# One independent "agent" for run_multitest.ps1: its own process, its own target, its own keys.
param([string]$V, [int]$TargetPid, [string]$Owner, [string]$Keys, [int]$Rounds = 4, [string]$Out)
$lat = [Collections.Generic.List[double]]::new(); $fails = 0
foreach ($r in 1..$Rounds) {
  foreach ($k in $Keys.Split(',')) {
    $sw = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
    $reply = & $V --owner $Owner --pid $TargetPid key $k 30 | ConvertFrom-Json
    $sw.Stop(); $lat.Add($sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds)
    if (-not $reply.ok) { $fails++ }
  }
}
$s = $lat | Sort-Object
[pscustomobject]@{owner=$Owner; pid=$TargetPid; commands=$lat.Count; failures=$fails
  p50_ms=[math]::Round($s[[int]($s.Count*0.5)],1); p95_ms=[math]::Round($s[[math]::Min($s.Count-1,[int]($s.Count*0.95))],1); max_ms=[math]::Round($s[-1],1)} |
  ConvertTo-Json -Compress | Set-Content -LiteralPath $Out

```

`verify/_ui_common.ps1`:

```ps1
# Shared helpers for the UI-navigation tests (dot-source). Synthetic targets only: no real foreground, no shared lock.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$script:D = (Resolve-Path "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist").Path
$script:V = "$D\vinput.exe"

function Require($condition, [string]$description) {
  if (-not $condition) { throw "FAIL $description" }
  Write-Output "PASS $description"
}
# One CLI call -> parsed JSON (the CLI prints exactly one JSON line for single commands).
function Vi([int]$TargetPid, [string[]]$Arguments) {
  $text = & $script:V --pid $TargetPid @Arguments
  $line = ($text | Where-Object { $_ -like '{*' } | Select-Object -Last 1)
  if (-not $line) { throw "no JSON from vinput $Arguments : $text" }
  return $line | ConvertFrom-Json
}
function Start-UiTarget([string]$Out, [string]$Name, [string[]]$TargetArgs = @(), [string]$Exe = 'vi_uitarget.exe') {
  $log = "$Out\$Name.log"
  $argLine = "`"$log`" -28000 600 " + ($TargetArgs -join ' ')
  $p = Start-Process -FilePath "$script:D\$Exe" -ArgumentList $argLine -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
  $r = & $script:V inject --pid $p.Id | ConvertFrom-Json
  if (-not $r.ok) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false; throw "inject failed: $($r | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)" }
  $ready = $false
  for ($i = 0; $i -lt 80; $i++) {
    $s = & $script:V --pid $p.Id status | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($s.hwnd -ne '0x0' -and $s.counters.present_ours -gt 2) { $ready = $true; break }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
  }
  if (-not $ready) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false; throw "target $Name not ready" }
  if ($s.really_foreground) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false; throw "target $Name took the real foreground" }
  return [pscustomobject]@{ Proc = $p; Pid = $p.Id; Log = $log; Name = $Name }
}
function Stop-UiTarget($t) { if ($t -and $t.Proc -and -not $t.Proc.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $t.Proc.Id -Force -Confirm:$false } }
# "<tick> CLICK x y name" lines
function Get-Clicks($t) {
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150
  $rows = @()
  foreach ($l in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $t.Log)) {
    if ($l -match '^\d+ CLICK (-?\d+) (-?\d+) (\S+)') { $rows += [pscustomobject]@{ X = [int]$Matches[1]; Y = [int]$Matches[2]; Name = $Matches[3] } }
  }
  return , $rows
}
function Get-LogText($t) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150; return (Get-Content -LiteralPath $t.Log -Raw) }
function In-Rect($x, $y, $l, $t, $r, $b) { return ($x -ge $l -and $x -lt $r -and $y -ge $t -and $y -lt $b) }
function Wait-ScreenInLog($t, [string]$Screen, [int]$Seconds = 8) {
  for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Seconds * 10; $i++) { if ((Get-LogText $t) -match "SCREEN $Screen") { return $true }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 }
  return $false
}
```

`verify/_vcvars.ps1`:

```ps1
# Locates MSVC's vcvars*.bat folder (dot-source, then call Get-VcVarsDir).
# Order: $env:VINPUT_VCVARS_DIR (a ...\VC\Auxiliary\Build folder), then vswhere's newest install with the C++ tools.
function Get-VcVarsDir {
  if ($env:VINPUT_VCVARS_DIR) {
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:VINPUT_VCVARS_DIR 'vcvarsall.bat')) { return $env:VINPUT_VCVARS_DIR }
    throw "VINPUT_VCVARS_DIR has no vcvarsall.bat: $env:VINPUT_VCVARS_DIR"
  }
  $vswhere = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $vswhere) {
    $install = & $vswhere -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath | Select-Object -First 1
    if ($install) {
      $dir = Join-Path $install 'VC\Auxiliary\Build'
      if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'vcvarsall.bat')) { return $dir }
    }
  }
  throw 'MSVC not found: install Visual Studio (or Build Tools) with the C++ x64/x86 tools, or set VINPUT_VCVARS_DIR to its VC\Auxiliary\Build folder'
}
```

`verify/run_actest.ps1`:

```ps1
# Anti-cheat refusal red/green test (src\vi_acguard.h). Synthetic only: the "anti-cheat" is test\vi_acdummy.cpp, an EMPTY
# DLL that merely carries an anti-cheat-like file name, and a copy of the plain test target renamed like an AC service.
# Every refusal case is paired with a positive control that shows the same target IS injectable without the trigger,
# so a pass cannot come from a broken injector. Run with -CliDir pointing at an older build to see it RED.
param([string]$CliDir = "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist", [string]$Out = "$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\actest", [switch]$KeepGoing)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$D = (Resolve-Path "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist").Path
$V = (Resolve-Path "$CliDir\vinput.exe").Path
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null; $Out = (Resolve-Path $Out).Path
$script:pass = 0; $script:fail = 0; $owned = @()
function Check($cond, $what, $detail = '') {
  if ($cond) { $script:pass++; "PASS $what" } else { $script:fail++; "FAIL $what $detail"; if (-not $KeepGoing) { throw "FAIL $what $detail" } }
}
function Invoke-V([string[]]$a) {
  $raw = & $V @a 2> "$Out\last.stderr.txt"; $code = $LASTEXITCODE
  $line = @($raw | Where-Object { $_ -like '{*' }) | Select-Object -Last 1
  $j = $null; if ($line) { $j = $line | ConvertFrom-Json }
  [pscustomobject]@{ code = $code; j = $j; raw = ($raw -join "`n") }
}
function StartTarget([string]$exe, [string]$name, [string[]]$extra = @()) {
  $log = "$Out\$name.log"; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  $argList = @("`"$log`"") + $extra
  $p = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList $argList -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
  $script:owned += $p
  for ($i = 0; $i -lt 50 -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $log -PathType Leaf); $i++) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 }
  for ($i = 0; $i -lt 50 -and -not (Select-String -LiteralPath $log -Pattern 'WINDOW ready' -Quiet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); $i++) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 }
  [pscustomobject]@{ p = $p; log = $log }
}
function HasVinput($p) { $p.Refresh(); @($p.Modules | Where-Object { $_.ModuleName -like 'vinput*' }).Count -gt 0 }
function Refused($r, $product, $kind) { $r.code -eq 4 -and $r.j -and $r.j.ok -eq $false -and $r.j.anticheat_refused -eq $true -and $r.j.anticheat.product -eq $product -and $r.j.anticheat.kind -eq $kind }

$dummy64 = "$D\acdummy\x64\EasyAntiCheat_x64.dll"; $dummy32 = "$D\acdummy\x86\BEClient.dll"
foreach ($f in "$D\vi_actarget.exe", "$D\vi_actarget32.exe", $dummy64, $dummy32) { if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { throw "missing $f - run build.bat" } }
try {
  # A. positive control: a clean target is injectable and answers
  $clean = StartTarget "$D\vi_actarget.exe" 'clean64'
  $r = Invoke-V @('inject', '--pid', "$($clean.p.Id)")
  Check ($r.code -eq 0 -and $r.j.ok) 'control: clean x64 target is injected' $r.raw
  $r = Invoke-V @('--pid', "$($clean.p.Id)", 'status')
  Check ($r.j.ok -and $r.j.anticheat_disabled -eq $false) 'control: clean target status ok, anticheat_disabled=false' $r.raw

  # B. x64 target with a module named like EasyAntiCheat
  $t = StartTarget "$D\vi_actarget.exe" 'module64' @('--load', "`"$dummy64`"")
  Check (Select-String -LiteralPath $t.log -Pattern 'LOAD ok' -Quiet) 'fixture: dummy EasyAntiCheat_x64.dll is loaded in the x64 target'
  $r = Invoke-V @('inject', '--pid', "$($t.p.Id)")
  Check (Refused $r 'EasyAntiCheat' 'module') 'x64 target with an EasyAntiCheat-named module: inject refused (exit 4)' $r.raw
  Check (-not (HasVinput $t.p)) 'x64 refused target holds no vinput module'
  $r = Invoke-V @('--pid', "$($t.p.Id)", 'ping')
  Check (-not $r.j.ok) 'x64 refused target has no control pipe'

  # C. x86 target with a module named like BattlEye (vinput.exe hands it to vinput32.exe)
  $t = StartTarget "$D\vi_actarget32.exe" 'module32' @('--load', "`"$dummy32`"")
  Check (Select-String -LiteralPath $t.log -Pattern 'LOAD ok' -Quiet) 'fixture: dummy BEClient.dll is loaded in the x86 target'
  $r = Invoke-V @('inject', '--pid', "$($t.p.Id)")
  Check (Refused $r 'BattlEye' 'module') 'x86 target with a BattlEye-named module: inject refused (exit 4)' $r.raw
  $r = Invoke-V @('--pid', "$($t.p.Id)", 'ping')
  Check (-not $r.j.ok) 'x86 refused target has no control pipe'
  $c32 = StartTarget "$D\vi_actarget32.exe" 'clean32'
  $r = Invoke-V @('inject', '--pid', "$($c32.p.Id)")
  Check ($r.code -eq 0 -and $r.j.ok) 'control: clean x86 target is injected' $r.raw

  # D. game folder that ships an EasyAntiCheat component: refused before start (launch) and on inject
  $game = "$Out\fakegame"; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -LiteralPath $game -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$game\Binaries\Win64", "$game\EasyAntiCheat" | Out-Null
  Copy-Item -LiteralPath "$D\vi_actarget.exe" "$game\Binaries\Win64\FakeGame.exe"
  $exe = "$game\Binaries\Win64\FakeGame.exe"
  foreach ($mode in @(@(), @('--early'))) {
    $r = Invoke-V (@('launch', '--exe', $exe, '--args', "`"$Out\fakegame_launch.log`"", '--timeout', '5', '--settle', '0', '--fg-guard', '0') + $mode)
    $started = @(Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -eq $exe })
    Check ((Refused $r 'EasyAntiCheat' 'game_folder') -and $started.Count -eq 0) "launch $((@('--exe') + $mode) -join ' ') of an EasyAntiCheat install: refused and nothing started" $r.raw
    foreach ($s in $started) { $script:owned += $s }
  }
  $g = StartTarget $exe 'fakegame_running'
  $r = Invoke-V @('inject', '--pid', "$($g.p.Id)")
  Check (Refused $r 'EasyAntiCheat' 'game_folder') 'inject into a running game from an EasyAntiCheat install: refused' $r.raw
  Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -LiteralPath "$game\EasyAntiCheat"
  $r = Invoke-V @('inject', '--pid', "$($g.p.Id)")
  Check ($r.code -eq 0 -and $r.j.ok) 'control: same game injectable once the EasyAntiCheat folder is gone' $r.raw

  # E. an anti-cheat process running anywhere on the machine (a copy of the plain target named BEService.exe)
  $acDir = "$Out\fakeac"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $acDir | Out-Null
  Copy-Item -LiteralPath "$D\vi_actarget.exe" "$acDir\BEService.exe" -Force
  $other = StartTarget "$D\vi_actarget.exe" 'other64'
  $ac = StartTarget "$acDir\BEService.exe" 'fake_beservice'
  $r = Invoke-V @('inject', '--pid', "$($other.p.Id)")
  Check ((Refused $r 'BattlEye' 'process') -and -not (HasVinput $other.p)) 'inject while a BEService.exe process runs: refused' $r.raw
  $r = Invoke-V @('launch', '--exe', "$D\vi_actarget.exe", '--args', "`"$Out\launch_while_ac.log`"", '--timeout', '5', '--settle', '0', '--fg-guard', '0')
  if ($r.j.pid) { $lp = Get-Process -Id $r.j.pid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($lp) { $script:owned += $lp } }
  Check (Refused $r 'BattlEye' 'process') 'launch while a BEService.exe process runs: refused' $r.raw
  Stop-Process -Id $ac.p.Id -Force; $ac.p.WaitForExit(5000) | Out-Null
  $r = Invoke-V @('inject', '--pid', "$($other.p.Id)")
  Check ($r.code -eq 0 -and $r.j.ok) 'control: same target injectable once BEService.exe has exited' $r.raw

  # F. an anti-cheat module loaded AFTER injection disables every input / capture command
  $late = StartTarget "$D\vi_actarget.exe" 'late64' @('--late', "`"$dummy64`"")
  $r = Invoke-V @('inject', '--pid', "$($late.p.Id)"); Check ($r.code -eq 0 -and $r.j.ok) 'late: clean target injected' $r.raw
  $r = Invoke-V @('--pid', "$($late.p.Id)", 'key', 'a'); Check ($r.j.ok) 'late: key a accepted before the anti-cheat module loads' $r.raw
  $r = Invoke-V @('--pid', "$($late.p.Id)", 'key', 'l'); Check ($r.j.ok) 'late: key l accepted (the target loads the dummy module on L)' $r.raw
  for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30 -and -not (Select-String -LiteralPath $late.log -Pattern 'LATE_LOAD ok' -Quiet); $i++) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 }
  Check (Select-String -LiteralPath $late.log -Pattern 'LATE_LOAD ok' -Quiet) 'fixture: the target loaded EasyAntiCheat_x64.dll after injection'
  $r = Invoke-V @('--pid', "$($late.p.Id)", 'key', 'b')
  Check ($r.code -ne 0 -and $r.j.anticheat_refused -eq $true -and $r.j.anticheat.kind -eq 'module') 'late: key b refused after the anti-cheat module loaded' $r.raw
  $r = Invoke-V @('--pid', "$($late.p.Id)", 'capture', "$Out\late.png")
  Check ($r.j.anticheat_refused -eq $true -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$Out\late.png")) 'late: capture refused too' $r.raw
  $r = Invoke-V @('--pid', "$($late.p.Id)", 'status')
  Check ($r.j.ok -and $r.j.anticheat_disabled -eq $true) 'late: status still answers and reports anticheat_disabled' $r.raw
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300
  $log = Get-Content -LiteralPath $late.log -Raw
  Check ($log.Contains('WM_KEYDOWN vk=0x41') -and -not $log.Contains('WM_KEYDOWN vk=0x42')) 'late: the target saw A but never B'

  # G. the DLL itself refuses to start in a process that already has an anti-cheat module (e.g. another injector)
  $self = StartTarget "$D\vi_actarget.exe" 'selfload64' @('--load', "`"$dummy64`"", '--load', "`"$((Resolve-Path $CliDir).Path)\vinput64.dll`"")
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1500
  $r = Invoke-V @('--pid', "$($self.p.Id)", 'ping')
  $dllLog = "$((Resolve-Path $CliDir).Path)\logs\vinput_$($self.p.Id).log"

  "owned test processes stopped by PID ($($owned.Count))"
}
"actest: $($script:pass) PASS, $($script:fail) FAIL"
```

```ps1
param(

)

    $s = & $V --pid $proc.Id status | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($s.hwnd -ne '0x0' -and $s.counters.present_ours -gt 0) { $ready=$true; break }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100

  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150
  $first = Get-Content -LiteralPath $targetLog -Raw
  $result = [ordered]@{

    first_click_accepted = $first.Contains('CLICK_ACCEPT')
    cursor_reported = $reply.cursor
    foreground_preserved = ([ViClickNative]::GetForegroundWindow() -eq $fg)
    target_background = ($foregroundPid -ne $proc.Id)
    reply = $reply
  }
  $result | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -LiteralPath "$Out\result.json"
  $result | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress
  [ViClickNative]::GetWindowThreadProcessId([ViClickNative]::GetForegroundWindow(),[ref]$foregroundPid) | Out-Null
  if (-not $result.ok -or $foregroundPid -eq $proc.Id) { throw 'Click regression failed (see result.json and target.log)' }
  # The same single-command click must work after inactivity too.
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1100
  $again = & $V --pid $proc.Id click left 80 70 | ConvertFrom-Json
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150
  $all = Get-Content -LiteralPath $targetLog -Raw
  if (-not $again.ok -or ([regex]::Matches($all, 'CLICK_ACCEPT')).Count -ne 2 -or $all.Contains('CLICK_REJECT')) { throw 'Idle click regression failed' }
  if($result.foreground_preserved) { 'PASS first click and idle click; virtual cursor; original foreground unchanged' }
  else { 'PASS first click and idle click; virtual cursor; target stayed background (external foreground window changed)' }
} finally {
  if ($proc -and -not $proc.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -Confirm:$false }
}
```

`verify/run_dinput1test.ps1`:

```ps1
# Legacy DirectInput (dinput.dll, DirectInputCreateA): a synthetic reader (test\vi_dinput1test.cpp) polls the keyboard and
# mouse through the DirectInput 1-7 interfaces, which the dinput8 hooks never see. Requires virtual key and mouse-button
# input to arrive, in both polling styles (GetDeviceState, buffered GetDeviceData) and both arches.
# The target is a background window started and stopped by this script (by PID).
# -Vinput runs the same checks with another vinput.exe (negative control against an older build).
param([string]$Out = "$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\dinput1test", [string]$Vinput = '', [switch]$KeepGoing)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$D = (Resolve-Path "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist").Path; $V = if ($Vinput) { $Vinput } else { "$D\vinput.exe" }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null; $Out = (Resolve-Path $Out).Path
$script:fails = 0
function Require($c, $d) { if (-not $c) { if ($KeepGoing) { $script:fails++; Write-Host "FAIL $d"; return }; throw "FAIL $d" }; Write-Host "PASS $d" }
$cases = @(
  @{ n = 'state_x64';    exe = 'vi_dinput1test.exe';   a = '' },
  @{ n = 'buffered_x64'; exe = 'vi_dinput1test.exe';   a = '--buffered' },
  @{ n = 'state_x86';    exe = 'vi_dinput1test32.exe'; a = '' },
  @{ n = 'buffered_x86'; exe = 'vi_dinput1test32.exe'; a = '--buffered' },
  # --gated: a never-activated window that ignores input until WM_ACTIVATEAPP(TRUE) (Fallout's GNW95 loop). vinput must
  # post the activation itself (autoactivate) without the target ever becoming the real foreground.
  @{ n = 'gated_x64';    exe = 'vi_dinput1test.exe';   a = '--gated' },
  @{ n = 'gated_x86';    exe = 'vi_dinput1test32.exe'; a = '--gated' }
)
$owned = @()
try {
  foreach ($c in $cases) {
    $tl = "$Out\$($c.n).log"; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tl -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath "$D\$($c.exe)" -ArgumentList "`"$tl`" $($c.a)" -PassThru; $owned += $p
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 100 -and -not ((Test-Path $tl) -and (Select-String -LiteralPath $tl -Pattern READY -Quiet)); $i++) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50 }
    Require ((Test-Path $tl) -and (Select-String -LiteralPath $tl -Pattern READY -Quiet)) "$($c.n) reader started"
    $r = & $V inject --pid $p.Id | ConvertFrom-Json; Require $r.ok "$($c.n) inject"
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 600
    if ($c.a -eq '--gated') {
      $st = & $V --pid $p.Id status | ConvertFrom-Json
      Require ((Select-String -LiteralPath $tl -Pattern 'ACTIVATEAPP 1' -Quiet) -and $st.counters.act_synth -ge 1) "$($c.n) background window was told it is active (act_synth=$($st.counters.act_synth))"
      Require (-not $st.really_foreground) "$($c.n) target is still not the real foreground"
    }
    $pre = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl | Where-Object { $_ -match 'KEY|MOUSE' }).Count
    Require ($pre -eq 0) "$($c.n) control: no input before any command ($pre lines)"
    & $V --pid $p.Id key a --ms 150 | Out-Null
    & $V --pid $p.Id click left 200 100 --ms 150 | Out-Null
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
    $txt = Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Raw
    Require ($txt -match 'KEY dik=0x1E down' -and $txt -match 'KEY dik=0x1E up') "$($c.n) virtual key A reaches a DirectInput 1-7 keyboard (down and up)"
    Require ($txt -match 'MOUSE b0 down' -and $txt -match 'MOUSE b0 up') "$($c.n) virtual left button reaches a DirectInput 1-7 mouse"
    $tr = & $V --pid $p.Id trace key lbutton | ConvertFrom-Json
    Require ($tr.ok -and $tr.channels.DirectInputState.down_reads -gt 0) "$($c.n) trace key lbutton shows the DirectInput mouse reads ($($tr.channels.DirectInputState.down_reads) down reads)"
    Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200
  }
} finally { foreach ($p in $owned) { if (-not $p.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force } } }
if ($script:fails) { throw "$($script:fails) dinput1 check(s) failed" }
Write-Host "dinput1 suite OK"
```

`verify/run_earlytest.ps1`:

```ps1
# Early (suspended) injection control: `launch --exe X --early` creates the process suspended, injects vinput,
# waits for its pipe and only then resumes the main thread, so vinput sees vkCreateDevice / vkGetDeviceQueue /
# vkCreateSwapchainKHR. The Vulkan target here does NOT wait for vinput (no --wait-vinput): it LoadLibrary's
# vulkan-1.dll and creates its device immediately, like a real game.
#   negative control (same build, no --early): native capture must refuse ("obtained before vinput was injected")
#   positive (--early): native capture must succeed with capture_path vk and the pattern must be correct.
# On builds without --early the flag is ignored, so the positive case is RED there. No real foreground is used.
param([string]$CliDir = "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist", [string]$Out = "$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\earlytest")
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null; $Out = (Resolve-Path $Out).Path
. "$PSScriptRoot\vi_patterncheck.ps1"
$results = @(); $owned = @()
function Launch([string]$exe, [string]$log, [bool]$early) {
  $a = @('--json', 'launch', '--exe', "$D\$exe", '--args', "`"$log`" -28000 600 820 480 --fmt bgra", '--settle', '1', '--timeout', '15', '--fg-guard', '0')
  if ($early) { $a += '--early' }
  $raw = & $V @a 2> "$log.stderr.txt"
  $r = $raw | Where-Object { $_ -like '{*' } | Select-Object -Last 1 | ConvertFrom-Json
  if ($r.pid) { $script:owned += Get-Process -Id $r.pid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
  return $r
}
try {
  foreach ($case in @(
      @{n='vk_x64_late';  exe='vi_vktest.exe';   early=$false; expect='refuse'},
      @{n='vk_x64_early'; exe='vi_vktest.exe';   early=$true;  expect='vk'},
      @{n='vk_x86_late';  exe='vi_vktest32.exe'; early=$false; expect='refuse'},
      @{n='vk_x86_early'; exe='vi_vktest32.exe'; early=$true;  expect='vk'})) {
    $log = "$Out\$($case.n).log"; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $l = Launch $case.exe $log $case.early
    $cap = $null; $st = $null
    if ($l.ok) {
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
      $cap = & $V --pid $l.pid capture "$Out\$($case.n).png" --method native | ConvertFrom-Json
      $st = & $V --pid $l.pid status | ConvertFrom-Json
    }
    $pat = $null
    if ($cap.ok) { $pat = Test-VinputPattern "$Out\$($case.n).png" }
    $pass = if ($case.expect -eq 'vk') { $l.ok -and $l.early_injected -and $cap.ok -and $cap.capture_path -eq 'vk' -and $st.vk.swapchains -ge 1 -and $pat.ok }
            else { $l.ok -and -not $l.early_injected -and -not $cap.ok -and $cap.error -match 'before vinput was injected' }
    $results += [pscustomobject]@{case=$case.n; pass=[bool]$pass; launch_ok=$l.ok; early_injected=$l.early_injected; pid=$l.pid
      capture_ok=$cap.ok; capture_path=$cap.capture_path; capture_error=$cap.error; vk_devices=$st.vk.devices; vk_swapchains=$st.vk.swapchains; frames_vk=$st.frames_by_api.vk
      pattern=$(if ($pat) { "ok=$($pat.ok) frame=$($pat.frame) bars=$($pat.bars_ok)" }); target_log_tail=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -Tail 3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join ' | '}
    foreach ($p in $owned) { if (-not $p.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false } }; $owned = @()
  }
  # D3D11 input target with --early: the ordinary input/capture paths still work when vinput is in before main()
  foreach ($exe in @('vi_testinput.exe', 'vi_testinput32.exe')) {
    $log = "$Out\early_$exe.log"; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $raw = & $V --json launch --exe "$D\$exe" --args "`"$log`" -28000 600 420 260" --settle 1 --timeout 15 --fg-guard 0 --early 2> "$log.stderr.txt"
    $l = $raw | Where-Object { $_ -like '{*' } | Select-Object -Last 1 | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($l.pid) { $owned += Get-Process -Id $l.pid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
    $k = if ($l.ok) { & $V --pid $l.pid key q 120 | ConvertFrom-Json }
    $cap = if ($l.ok) { & $V --pid $l.pid capture "$Out\early_$exe.png" --method native | ConvertFrom-Json }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300
    $t = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $pass = $l.ok -and $l.early_injected -and $k.ok -and $t -match 'WM_KEYDOWN vk=0x51' -and $t -match 'GAKS vk=0x51 down' -and $cap.ok -and $cap.capture_path -eq 'd3d11'
    $results += [pscustomobject]@{case="d3d11_input_early_$exe"; pass=[bool]$pass; launch_ok=$l.ok; early_injected=$l.early_injected; pid=$l.pid; capture_ok=$cap.ok; capture_path=$cap.capture_path; capture_error=$cap.error}
    foreach ($p in $owned) { if (-not $p.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false } }; $owned = @()

} finally { foreach ($p in $owned) { if (-not $p.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false } } }
$results | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content -LiteralPath "$Out\result.json"
foreach ($r in $results) { "$(if ($r.pass) {'PASS'} else {'FAIL'}) $($r.case): early=$($r.early_injected) capture_ok=$($r.capture_ok) path=$($r.capture_path) swapchains=$($r.vk_swapchains) err=$($r.capture_error)" }
```

`verify/run_fgguardtest.ps1`:

```ps1
# Delayed foreground re-grab control (seen on a real Steam game: it regained the REAL foreground ~1.5 s
# after `launch` reported foreground_restored:true, when the launcher's dialog closed).
# The synthetic target asks a NON-injected child to make it really foreground 1.5 s after vinput's pipe appears
# (AttachThreadInput + SetForegroundWindow from another process = an external activation vinput cannot block).
# PASS = the steal really happened (positive control, independent of the code under test: the injected DLL's log
# records "REAL foreground GAINED"; the thief's own return value is advisory, SetForegroundWindow can return FALSE and
# still activate) AND launch handed it back and reported it AND, after the launch returned, the
# real foreground is not the target AND launch reported the re-grab. RED on builds without the guard.
# It touches the REAL foreground for a few ms, so it holds a lock file for ~15 s: -Lock, else $env:VINPUT_LOCK, else
# build\foreground.lock. Point every tool on the machine that may take the real foreground at the same file.
param([string]$CliDir = "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist", [string]$Out = "$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\fgguard", [int]$LockWaitSec = 300, [string]$Lock = $env:VINPUT_LOCK)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$D = (Resolve-Path "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist").Path; $V = (Resolve-Path "$CliDir\vinput.exe").Path
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null; $Out = (Resolve-Path $Out).Path
if (-not ('ViFgNative' -as [type])) {
  Add-Type 'using System; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; public static class ViFgNative { [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern IntPtr GetForegroundWindow(); [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr w, out uint pid); }'
}
function FgPid { $h = [ViFgNative]::GetForegroundWindow(); [uint32]$p = 0; [ViFgNative]::GetWindowThreadProcessId($h, [ref]$p) | Out-Null; [pscustomobject]@{hwnd=$h; pid=[int]$p} }
if (-not $Lock) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$PSScriptRoot\..\build" | Out-Null; $Lock = "$PSScriptRoot\..\build\foreground.lock" }
$liveLock = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Lock)
$lockStream = $null; $t0 = Get-Date
while (-not $lockStream) {
  try { $lockStream = [IO.File]::Open($liveLock, [IO.FileMode]::CreateNew, [IO.FileAccess]::Write, [IO.FileShare]::Read) }
  catch [IO.IOException] { if (((Get-Date) - $t0).TotalSeconds -gt $LockWaitSec) { throw "foreground lock busy for $LockWaitSec s: $(Get-Content -Raw $liveLock -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)" }; Start-Sleep 2 }
}
$body = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes((@{owner='vinput run_fgguardtest'; pid=$PID; time=(Get-Date).ToString('o'); purpose='synthetic delayed foreground steal, ~15 s'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
$lockStream.Write($body, 0, $body.Length); $lockStream.Flush(); $lockStream.Dispose()
$results = @(); $owned = @()
try {
  foreach ($name in @('vi_testinput.exe', 'vi_testinput32.exe')) {
    $log = "$Out\$name.log"; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $before = FgPid
    $privLock = "$Out\launch_$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')).lock"
    $raw = & $V --json launch --exe "$D\$name" --args "`"$log`" -28000 600 420 260 --steal-fg-after-pipe 1500" --lock $privLock --settle 0 --timeout 10 2> "$Out\$name.stderr.txt"
    $reply = $raw | Where-Object { $_ -like '{*' } | Select-Object -Last 1 | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($reply.pid) { $owned += Get-Process -Id $reply.pid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
    $launchTick = [Environment]::TickCount
    # wait for the thief's verdict, then sample the real foreground
    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(8); $thief = $null
    while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline -and -not $thief) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; $thief = Select-String -LiteralPath $log -Pattern 'STEAL_FG thief_pid=\d+ thief_exit=(\d+)' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 400
    $after = FgPid
    $targetHolds = $reply.pid -and $after.pid -eq [int]$reply.pid
    $thiefExit = if ($thief) { [int]$thief.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value } else { -1 }
    # target log lines start with its GetTickCount: >0 = the steal came after launch returned (builds without the guard cannot see it)
    $stealVsReturn = if ($thief) { [long][uint32]$thief.Line.Split(' ')[0] - [long][uint32]$launchTick } else { $null }
    $regrabs = @($reply.foreground_regrabs | Where-Object { $_.restored })
    # independent positive control: the injected DLL's own log records the real-foreground transition
    $dllLog = if ($reply.pid) { "$(Split-Path $V)\run\logs\vinput_$($reply.pid).log" }
    $gained = if ($dllLog -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dllLog)) { @(Select-String -LiteralPath $dllLog -Pattern 'REAL foreground GAINED').Count } else { 0 }
    $r = [pscustomobject]@{
      target=$name; pid=$reply.pid; launch_ok=$reply.ok; reply_restored=$reply.foreground_restored; fg_guard_ms=$reply.fg_guard_ms
      regrabs=$reply.foreground_regrabs; thief_exit=$thiefExit; steal_ms_after_launch_returned=$stealVsReturn; fg_before_pid=$before.pid; fg_after_pid=$after.pid; target_holds_fg_after=$targetHolds
      dll_log_fg_gained=$gained
      pass = ($reply.ok -and $thief -and $gained -ge 1 -and -not $targetHolds -and $regrabs.Count -ge 1)
    }
    $results += $r
    if ($targetHolds) {
      # cleanup for the RED case: the target (injected, really foreground) hands the foreground back itself
      $hb = '0x{0:X}' -f $before.hwnd.ToInt64()
      & $V --pid $reply.pid json "{`"cmd`":`"restore-foreground`",`"hwnd`":`"$hb`"}" | Out-Null
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300
      $r | Add-Member fg_after_cleanup_pid (FgPid).pid
    }
    foreach ($p in $owned) { if (-not $p.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false } }; $owned = @()
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $privLock -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  }
} finally {
  foreach ($p in $owned) { if (-not $p.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false } }
  $held = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $liveLock -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  if ($held -and $held.Contains("`"pid`":$PID")) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $liveLock -Force }
}
$results | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -LiteralPath "$Out\result.json"
foreach ($r in $results) { "$(if ($r.pass) {'PASS'} else {'FAIL'}) $($r.target): thief_exit=$($r.thief_exit) target_holds_fg_after=$($r.target_holds_fg_after) regrabs=$(@($r.regrabs | Where-Object { $_ }).Count) launch_ok=$($r.launch_ok) restored=$($r.reply_restored)" }
if (@($results | Where-Object { -not $_.pass }).Count) { throw "FAIL delayed foreground guard; see $Out\result.json" }
'PASS delayed foreground re-grab is handed back and reported (x64 + x86)'
```

```ps1
function OneJson([string[]]$arguments) {

  if($r.ok -or $r.failures -ne 1){throw 'Script error JSON failed'}
```

`verify/run_launchtest.ps1`:

```ps1
# CLI-output/launch regression; launches only the nonactivating synthetic test target.
# Baseline/current CLI directories may differ; TargetDir must contain the new no-activate target.
param(
  [string]$CliDir = "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist",
  [string]$TargetDir = "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist",
  [string]$Out = "$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\launchtest"
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = (Resolve-Path "$PSScriptRoot\..").Path
$Out = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Out)
if (-not $Out.StartsWith("$root\", [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Launch-test artifacts must stay within this repository' }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $Out, "$Out\temp" | Out-Null
$Out = (Resolve-Path $Out).Path
$V = (Resolve-Path "$CliDir\vinput.exe").Path
$oldTemp = $env:TEMP; $oldTmp = $env:TMP
$env:TEMP = "$Out\temp"; $env:TMP = "$Out\temp"
if (-not ('ViLaunchNative' -as [type])) {
  Add-Type 'using System; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; public static class ViLaunchNative { [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern IntPtr GetForegroundWindow(); [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr window, out uint pid); }'
}
$checks = [Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
$foregroundEvidence = [Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
$owned = [Collections.Generic.List[Diagnostics.Process]]::new()
$runId = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')
function Check([bool]$condition, [string]$name, [string]$detail = '') {
  $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{pass=$condition; name=$name; detail=$detail})
  "$(if ($condition) {'PASS'} else {'FAIL'}) $name$(if ($detail) {': '+$detail})"
}
function Check-Foreground([IntPtr]$before, [string]$name) {
  $after = [ViLaunchNative]::GetForegroundWindow()
  [uint32]$beforePid = 0; [uint32]$afterPid = 0
  [ViLaunchNative]::GetWindowThreadProcessId($before, [ref]$beforePid) | Out-Null
  [ViLaunchNative]::GetWindowThreadProcessId($after, [ref]$afterPid) | Out-Null
  $isOurs = @($owned | Where-Object Id -eq $afterPid).Count -gt 0
  $equality = if ($before -eq $after) { 'UNCHANGED' } elseif ($isOurs) { 'TARGET_TOOK_FOREGROUND' } else { 'INCONCLUSIVE_EXTERNALLY_CHANGED' }
  $evidence = [pscustomobject]@{name=$name; before_hwnd=('0x{0:X}' -f $before.ToInt64()); before_pid=$beforePid; after_hwnd=('0x{0:X}' -f $after.ToInt64()); after_pid=$afterPid; target_took_foreground=$isOurs; original_window_equality=$equality}
  $foregroundEvidence.Add($evidence)
  Check (-not $isOurs) $name ($evidence | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
}
function Quote-NativeArgument([string]$value) {
  # Standard CommandLineToArgvW quoting, including embedded quotes/trailing backslashes.
  if ($value.Length -gt 0 -and $value -notmatch '[\s"]') { return $value }
  $value = [regex]::Replace($value, '(\\*)"', '$1$1\"')
  $value = [regex]::Replace($value, '(\\+)$', '$1$1')
  return '"' + $value + '"'
}
function Invoke-Cli([string]$name, [string[]]$arguments, [string]$expectedTarget = '') {
  $startedAt = [DateTime]::UtcNow
  $psi = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
  $psi.FileName = $V
  $psi.Arguments = ($arguments | ForEach-Object { Quote-NativeArgument $_ }) -join ' '
  $psi.UseShellExecute = $false; $psi.CreateNoWindow = $true
  $psi.RedirectStandardOutput = $true; $psi.RedirectStandardError = $true
  $proc = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($psi)
  try {
    $stdoutTask = $proc.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync()
    $stderrTask = $proc.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
    if (-not $proc.WaitForExit(45000)) {
      # This is our CLI PID only. No preexisting process is stopped.
      Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -Confirm:$false
      throw "$name timed out; our CLI stopped by PID"
    }
    $stdout = $stdoutTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
    $stderr = $stderrTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$Out\$name.stdout.txt", $stdout)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$Out\$name.stderr.txt", $stderr)
    $lines = @($stdout -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 })
    $json = [Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
    foreach ($line in $lines) {
      try { $obj = $line | ConvertFrom-Json }
      catch { $json.Add($null); continue }
      $json.Add($obj)
      if ($expectedTarget -and $obj.pid) {
        $targetPid = [int]$obj.pid
        if (-not @($owned | Where-Object Id -eq $targetPid).Count) {
          $target = Get-Process -Id $targetPid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($target -and $target.Path -eq $expectedTarget -and $target.StartTime.ToUniversalTime() -ge $startedAt.AddSeconds(-2)) { $owned.Add($target) }
          elseif ($target) { throw "Returned PID $targetPid does not identify our newly launched target" }
        }
      }
    }
    return [pscustomobject]@{exit_code=$proc.ExitCode; stdout=$stdout; stderr=$stderr; lines=$lines; json=$json.ToArray()}
  } finally { $proc.Dispose() }
}
function Last-Reply($result) { @($result.json | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ }) | Select-Object -Last 1 }
function Check-Json($result, [string]$name, [bool]$expectOk) {
  $reply = Last-Reply $result
  Check ($result.lines.Count -eq 1 -and $result.json.Count -eq 1 -and $null -ne $reply) "$name one JSON stdout line" "lines=$($result.lines.Count)"
  Check ($null -ne $reply -and [bool]$reply.ok -eq $expectOk -and (($result.exit_code -eq 0) -eq $expectOk)) "$name exit/result agree" "exit=$($result.exit_code)"
}
function Stop-OwnedTargets {
  foreach ($target in $owned) { if (-not $target.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $target.Id -Force -Confirm:$false }; $target.Dispose() }
  $owned.Clear()
}
try {
  # A global flag before the command must select the command's own validation.
  foreach ($position in @('prefix','suffix')) {
    $arguments = if ($position -eq 'prefix') { @('--json','launch') } else { @('launch','--json') }
    $r = Invoke-Cli "invalid_$position" $arguments
    Check-Json $r "--json $position validation" $false
    $reply = Last-Reply $r
    Check ($null -ne $reply -and $reply.error -like '*launch needs*') "--json $position selects launch" ($reply | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
  }
  $r = Invoke-Cli 'invalid_exe' @('--json','launch','--exe',"$Out\never_exists_$runId.exe",'--timeout','2','--settle','0')
  Check-Json $r 'invalid executable' $false
  $reply = Last-Reply $r
  Check ($null -ne $reply -and $reply.error -like '*CreateProcess*') 'invalid executable reaches process creation' ($reply | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
  foreach ($arch in @('x64','x86')) {
    $targetName = if ($arch -eq 'x64') { 'vi_testinput.exe' } else { 'vi_testinput32.exe' }
    $target = (Resolve-Path "$TargetDir\$targetName").Path
    foreach ($mode in @('noinject','injected')) {
      foreach ($position in @('prefix','suffix')) {
        $name = "${arch}_${mode}_${position}"
        $fgBefore = [ViLaunchNative]::GetForegroundWindow()
        $arguments = @('launch','--exe',$target,'--args',"`"$Out\${name}_${runId}.log`" -28000 600 420 260",'--timeout','8','--settle','0')
        if ($mode -eq 'noinject') { $arguments += '--no-inject' }
        if ($position -eq 'prefix') { $arguments = @('--json') + $arguments } else { $arguments += '--json' }
        try {
          $r = Invoke-Cli $name $arguments $target
          Check-Json $r $name $true
          $reply = Last-Reply $r
          Check ($null -ne $reply -and $reply.pid -gt 0 -and [bool]$reply.injected -eq ($mode -eq 'injected')) "$name returns owned PID and injection mode"
          Check-Foreground $fgBefore "$name never takes real foreground"
          if ($position -eq 'suffix') { Check ($r.stderr.Contains('[vinput]')) "$name progress is on stderr" }
        } finally { Stop-OwnedTargets }
      }
    }
  }
  # Failure inside injection must still emit a single result containing our target PID.
  $target = (Resolve-Path "$TargetDir\vi_testinput.exe").Path
  $fgBefore = [ViLaunchNative]::GetForegroundWindow()
  foreach ($position in @('prefix','suffix')) {
    try {
      $arguments = @('launch','--exe',$target,'--args',"`"$Out\missing_dll_${position}_${runId}.log`" -28000 600 420 260",'--dll',"$Out\absent_${runId}.dll",'--timeout','8','--settle','0')
      if ($position -eq 'prefix') { $arguments = @('--json') + $arguments } else { $arguments += '--json' }
      $r = Invoke-Cli "missing_dll_$position" $arguments $target
      Check-Json $r "missing DLL launch $position" $false
      $reply = Last-Reply $r
      Check ($null -ne $reply -and $reply.pid -gt 0 -and $reply.error -match 'inject|dll') "missing DLL $position reaches injection" ($reply | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
      Check-Foreground $fgBefore "failed injection $position never takes real foreground"
    } finally { Stop-OwnedTargets }
  }
  # This is our fixture containing a different owner; no global/shared lock is accessed.
  $foreign = "$Out\foreign_${runId}.lock"
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($foreign, 'foreign synthetic fixture; leave untouched')
  try {
    $before = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $foreign -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
    $fgBefore = [ViLaunchNative]::GetForegroundWindow()
    $r = Invoke-Cli 'foreign_lock' @('launch','--exe',$target,'--lock',$foreign,'--owner','other-launchtest','--lock-retry','1','--lock-max-wait','1','--timeout','2','--settle','0','--json') $target
    Check-Json $r 'foreign lock refusal' $false
    $reply = Last-Reply $r
    Check ($null -ne $reply -and $reply.error -match 'lock') 'foreign lock reaches lock validation' ($reply | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
    Check ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $foreign -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -eq $before) 'foreign lock exact bytes retained'
    Check-Foreground $fgBefore 'foreign lock refusal never takes real foreground'
  } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $foreign -Force }
  $failed = @($checks | Where-Object { -not $_.pass })
  [pscustomobject]@{ok=($failed.Count -eq 0); cli=$V; target_dir=(Resolve-Path $TargetDir).Path; checks=$checks.ToArray(); foreground_evidence=$foregroundEvidence.ToArray(); failures=$failed.Count} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content -LiteralPath "$Out\result.json"
  if ($failed.Count) { throw "$($failed.Count) launch regression checks failed; see $Out\result.json" }
  "PASS launch JSON/foreground/lock controls: $($checks.Count) checks"
} finally {
  Stop-OwnedTargets
  $env:TEMP = $oldTemp; $env:TMP = $oldTmp
}
```

`verify/run_locktest.ps1`:

```ps1
# Standalone JSON-lock controls. Builds/runs only inside this repository's build\test directory.
param([string]$Out = "$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\locktest")
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = (Resolve-Path "$PSScriptRoot\..").Path
$Out = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Out)
if (-not $Out.StartsWith("$root\", [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Lock-test artifacts must stay within this repository' }
. "$PSScriptRoot\_vcvars.ps1"; $vcDir = Get-VcVarsDir
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $Out, "$Out\temp" | Out-Null
$oldTemp = $env:TEMP; $oldTmp = $env:TMP
try {
  $env:TEMP = "$Out\temp"; $env:TMP = "$Out\temp"
  foreach ($arch in @('x64','x86')) {
    $archDir = "$Out\$arch"
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $archDir | Out-Null
    $vcvars = if ($arch -eq 'x64') { 'vcvars64.bat' } else { 'vcvars32.bat' }
    $fixture = "$archDir\owned_$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')).lock"
    $batch = @"
@echo off
setlocal
set "TEMP=$Out\temp"
set "TMP=$Out\temp"
call "$vcDir\$vcvars" >nul || exit /b 1
pushd "$archDir"
cl /nologo /std:c++17 /EHsc /W4 /WX /MT /O2 /I"$root\src" "$root\test\vi_locktest.cpp" /Fo:vi_locktest.obj /Fe:vi_locktest.exe || exit /b 1
"$archDir\vi_locktest.exe" "$fixture"
set "RESULT=%ERRORLEVEL%"
popd
exit /b %RESULT%
"@
    $buildScript = "$archDir\run.cmd"
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($buildScript, $batch, [Text.Encoding]::ASCII)
    & cmd.exe /d /c $buildScript *> "$archDir\result.txt"
    $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    Get-Content -LiteralPath "$archDir\result.txt"
    if ($code -ne 0) { throw "$arch lock test failed (exit $code); see $archDir\result.txt" }
    $content = Get-Content -LiteralPath "$archDir\result.txt" -Raw
    if ($content -notmatch 'PASS: 48 checks, 0 failures' -or $content -match '(?im)^FAIL|warning [A-Z]+\d+|error [A-Z]+\d+') { throw "$arch lock-test output is incomplete or contains compiler diagnostics" }
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fixture) { throw "$arch left an owned test lock behind: $fixture" }
  }
  'PASS JSON locks: 48 controls each on x64 and x86; 0 warnings'
} finally {
  $env:TEMP = $oldTemp; $env:TMP = $oldTmp
}
```

`verify/run_movetest.ps1`:

```ps1
param([string]$CliDir="$PSScriptRoot\..\dist",[string]$Out="$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\movetest")
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$D=(Resolve-Path "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist").Path; $V=(Resolve-Path "$CliDir\vinput.exe").Path
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null; $Out=(Resolve-Path $Out).Path
$results=@()
foreach($name in @('vi_testinput.exe','vi_testinput32.exe')) {
  $p=$null
  try {
    $p=Start-Process -FilePath "$D\$name" -ArgumentList "`"$Out\$name.log`" -28000 600 640 360" -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
    $r=& $V inject --pid $p.Id | ConvertFrom-Json; if(-not $r.ok){throw 'Injection failed'}
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300
    & $V --pid $p.Id mouse 100 100 | Out-Null
    $s=& $V --pid $p.Id status | ConvertFrom-Json
    $clamped=& $V --pid $p.Id move 1000 -800 | ConvertFrom-Json
    $results += [pscustomobject]@{target=$name;clamped=$clamped}
    $results | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -LiteralPath "$Out\result.json"
    if(-not $clamped.ok -or $clamped.applied_dx -ne ($s.client_w-1-100) -or $clamped.applied_dy -ne -100 -or $clamped.raw_dx -ne 1000){throw 'Clamped actual-delta reporting unsupported or wrong'}
    $raw=& $V --pid $p.Id move --raw 1003 -999 --steps 7 | ConvertFrom-Json
    if(-not $raw.ok -or $raw.applied_dx -ne 1003 -or $raw.applied_dy -ne -999 -or $raw.cursor -ne 'virtual' -or -not $raw.unbounded -or $raw.x -le $s.client_w -or $raw.y -ge 0){throw 'Unbounded cursor move failed'}
    # the target logs GetCursorPos once per frame; under load a fixed 100 ms wait was flaky, so poll up to 2 s
    $seen=$false
    for($w=0; $w -lt 40 -and -not $seen; $w++){ Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50; $seen=(Get-Content -LiteralPath "$Out\$name.log" -Raw).Contains("CURSOR $($raw.x) $($raw.y)") }
    if(-not $seen){throw 'Actual GetCursorPos observer did not see unbounded position'}
    $results[-1] | Add-Member -NotePropertyName raw -NotePropertyValue $raw
  } finally { if($p -and -not $p.HasExited){Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false} }
}
$results | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -LiteralPath "$Out\result.json"
'PASS x64/x86 clamped applied deltas and unbounded GetCursorPos mouse-look'
```
