`verify/run_multitest.ps1`:

```ps1
# Multi-agent control: 4 targets (3 x64 + 1 x86), 4 independent client PROCESSES driving them concurrently.
#  - ownership: claim/unclaim/expiry/force; another owner (or no owner) is refused and nothing reaches the target
#  - no cross-talk: every target's log holds exactly its own client's keys
#  - no starvation: a long `capture --after-frames` on target A does not slow the other targets, and a `status` on
#    target A during it returns at once (on older builds it queued behind the capture on A's exec mutex)
# No real foreground or shared lock is used; targets are offscreen and never activated.
param([string]$CliDir = "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist", [string]$Out = "$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\multitest")
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$D = (Resolve-Path "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist").Path; $V = (Resolve-Path "$CliDir\vinput.exe").Path
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null; $Out = (Resolve-Path $Out).Path
$checks = [Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
function Check([bool]$c, [string]$name, [string]$detail = '') { $checks.Add([pscustomobject]@{pass=$c; name=$name; detail=$detail}); "$(if ($c) {'PASS'} else {'FAIL'}) $name$(if ($detail) {': ' + $detail})" }
function J([string[]]$a) { $o = & $V @a; ($o | Select-Object -Last 1) | ConvertFrom-Json }
$agents = @(
  @{o='agentA'; exe='vi_testinput.exe';   keys='a,b,c,d,e'},
  @{o='agentB'; exe='vi_testinput.exe';   keys='f,g,h,i,j'},
  @{o='agentC'; exe='vi_testinput.exe';   keys='k,l,m,n,o'},
  @{o='agentD'; exe='vi_testinput32.exe'; keys='p,q,r,s,t'})
$procs = @(); $clients = @()
try {
  foreach ($a in $agents) {
    $a.log = "$Out\$($a.o).log"; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $a.log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath "$D\$($a.exe)" -ArgumentList "`"$($a.log)`" -28000 600 420 260" -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
    $procs += $p; $a.pid = $p.Id
    $r = J @('inject', '--pid', "$($p.Id)"); if (-not $r.ok) { throw "inject $($a.o) failed: $($r | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)" }
  }
  foreach ($a in $agents) { for ($i = 0; $i -lt 50; $i++) { $s = J @('--pid', "$($a.pid)", 'status'); if ($s.hwnd -ne '0x0' -and $s.counters.present_ours -gt 0) { break }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 } }
  $tA, $tB, $tC, $tD = $agents   # NB: PowerShell names are case-insensitive, so not $A (= the loop variable $a)
  # --- ownership -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  foreach ($a in $agents) { $r = J @('--owner', $a.o, '--pid', "$($a.pid)", 'claim', '--ttl', '120'); Check ($r.ok -and $r.claim.owner -eq $a.o) "$($a.o) claims pid $($a.pid)" }
  $r = J @('--owner', 'agentB', '--pid', "$($tA.pid)", 'key', 'z'); Check (-not $r.ok -and $r.claim_refused -and $r.claim_owner -eq 'agentA') "agentB driving agentA's target is refused" $r.error
  $r = J @('--pid', "$($tA.pid)", 'click', 'left', '10', '10'); Check (-not $r.ok -and $r.claim_refused) "a client with no owner is refused"
  $r = J @('--owner', 'agentB', '--pid', "$($tA.pid)", 'claim'); Check (-not $r.ok -and $r.claim_refused) "agentB cannot take over agentA's claim"
  $r = J @('--owner', 'agentB', '--pid', "$($tA.pid)", 'status'); Check ($r.ok -and $r.claim.owner -eq 'agentA') "status stays readable by anyone (owner shown)"
  $r = J @('--owner', 'agentB', '--pid', "$($tA.pid)", 'unclaim'); Check (-not $r.ok) "agentB cannot release agentA's claim"
  $list = (& $V list) | ConvertFrom-Json
  $mine = @($list | Where-Object { $_.pid -eq $tA.pid })
  Check ($mine.Count -eq 1 -and $mine[0].owner -eq 'agentA' -and $mine[0].really_foreground -eq $false -and $mine[0].uptime_ms -gt 0) "list shows owner/uptime/really_foreground" ($mine | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
  # expiry: D re-claims with a 2 s TTL, goes idle; another owner may take it after expiry
  $r = J @('--owner', 'agentD', '--pid', "$($tD.pid)", 'claim', '--ttl', '2'); Check $r.ok "agentD re-claims with ttl 2 s"
  $r = J @('--owner', 'agentE', '--pid', "$($tD.pid)", 'key', 'z'); Check (-not $r.ok) "before expiry agentE is refused"
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 2600
  $r = J @('--owner', 'agentE', '--pid', "$($tD.pid)", 'claim', '--ttl', '30'); Check ($r.ok -and $r.claim.owner -eq 'agentE') "after expiry agentE can claim"
  $r = J @('--owner', 'agentE', '--pid', "$($tD.pid)", 'unclaim'); Check $r.ok "agentE releases explicitly"
  $r = J @('--owner', 'agentD', '--pid', "$($tD.pid)", 'claim', '--ttl', '120'); Check ($r.ok -and $r.claim.owner -eq 'agentD') "agentD claims again after the release"
  # force: logged override (used here to prove the key really reaches the target when forced)
  $r = J @('--owner', 'agentB', '--force-claim', '--pid', "$($tB.pid)", 'key', 'u'); Check $r.ok "--force-claim overrides (agentB's own target, harmless)"
  $r = J @('--owner', 'agentC', '--force-claim', '--pid', "$($tB.pid)", 'key', 'v'); Check $r.ok "--force-claim from agentC reaches agentB's target"
  # --- concurrency -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  $longCap = Start-Process -FilePath $V -ArgumentList "--owner agentA --pid $($tA.pid) capture `"$Out\longcap.png`" --after-frames 240 --timeout-ms 30000" -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput "$Out\longcap.json"
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700
  $sw = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew(); $st = J @('--owner', 'agentA', '--pid', "$($tA.pid)", 'status'); $sw.Stop()
  $statusMs = $sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds
  $capStillRunning = -not $longCap.HasExited
  Check ($st.ok -and $capStillRunning -and $statusMs -lt 1000) "status on target A answers during A's long --after-frames capture" ("{0:N0} ms, capture still running={1}" -f $statusMs, $capStillRunning)
  $t0 = Get-Date
  foreach ($a in $agents) {
    $cp = Start-Process -FilePath 'pwsh' -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile', '-File', "`"$PSScriptRoot\_multi_client.ps1`"", '-V', "`"$V`"", '-TargetPid', "$($a.pid)", '-Owner', $a.o, '-Keys', $a.keys, '-Out', "`"$Out\client_$($a.o).json`"") -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
    $clients += $cp
  }
  foreach ($cp in $clients) { $cp.WaitForExit(120000) | Out-Null }
  $wall = ((Get-Date) - $t0).TotalSeconds
  $longCap.WaitForExit(30000) | Out-Null
  $lc = Get-Content -Raw "$Out\longcap.json" | ConvertFrom-Json
  Check ($lc.ok -and ($lc.captured_present - $lc.present_before) -ge 240) "the long capture on A completed after >= 240 frames" "present $($lc.present_before)->$($lc.captured_present)"
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 400
  $stats = @()
  foreach ($a in $agents) {
    $cs = Get-Content -Raw "$Out\client_$($a.o).json" | ConvertFrom-Json; $stats += $cs
    Check ($cs.failures -eq 0 -and $cs.commands -eq 20) "$($a.o): 20 parallel key commands, 0 failures" ("p50 {0} ms, p95 {1} ms, max {2} ms" -f $cs.p50_ms, $cs.p95_ms, $cs.max_ms)
    $log = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $a.log
    $seen = @([regex]::Matches($log, 'WM_KEYDOWN vk=0x([0-9A-F]{2})') | ForEach-Object { [char][Convert]::ToInt32($_.Groups[1].Value, 16) } | ForEach-Object { "$_".ToLower() } | Sort-Object -Unique)
    $expected = @($a.keys.Split(',')); if ($a.o -eq 'agentB') { $expected += 'u', 'v' }
    $expected = @($expected | Sort-Object -Unique)
    Check ((Compare-Object $seen $expected).Count -eq 0) "$($a.o) target saw exactly its own keys" ("seen=" + ($seen -join '') + " expected=" + ($expected -join ''))
    $downs = ([regex]::Matches($log, 'WM_KEYDOWN vk=0x')).Count
    $want = 20 + $(if ($a.o -eq 'agentB') { 2 } else { 0 })
    Check ($downs -eq $want) "$($a.o) target: $want key-downs, none lost or duplicated" "got $downs"
    Check ($log -notmatch 'vk=0x5A') "$($a.o) target never received a refused 'z'"
    $s = J @('--pid', "$($a.pid)", 'status'); Check (-not $s.really_foreground) "$($a.o) target stayed in the background"
  }
  # Input commands to ONE target are serialized by design (ordered); the long capture runs on target A only, so
  # B/C/D must be unaffected while A's own input waits for its capture (that wait is the per-target mutex).
  $others = @($stats | Where-Object { $_.owner -ne 'agentA' })
  $p95 = ($others | Measure-Object -Property p95_ms -Maximum).Maximum
  Check ($p95 -lt 1500) "targets B/C/D unaffected by A's long capture: worst p95 under 1.5 s" ("{0} ms, wall {1:N1} s" -f $p95, $wall)
  $aStat = $stats | Where-Object { $_.owner -eq 'agentA' }
  Check ($aStat.failures -eq 0) "target A's own input is ordered behind its capture, none lost" ("A max {0} ms (= the capture's frame wait)" -f $aStat.max_ms)
} finally {
  foreach ($cp in $clients) { if (-not $cp.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $cp.Id -Force -Confirm:$false } }
  if ($longCap -and -not $longCap.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $longCap.Id -Force -Confirm:$false }
  foreach ($p in $procs) { if (-not $p.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false } }
}
$failed = @($checks | Where-Object { -not $_.pass })
[pscustomobject]@{ok = ($failed.Count -eq 0); checks = $checks.ToArray(); clients = $stats} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content -LiteralPath "$Out\result.json"
if ($failed.Count) { throw "FAIL $($failed.Count) multi-agent checks; see $Out\result.json" }
"PASS multi-agent: 4 targets, 4 parallel clients, ownership + no cross-talk + no starvation ($($checks.Count) checks)"

```

`verify/run_nativecapture.ps1`:

```ps1
# Native frame capture on synthetic targets that draw a known, changing pattern (test\vi_pattern.h):
# frame-counter bits + 8 colour bars. For every case: inject, capture, decode the PNG (pixel-exact bars, frame
# bits), check capture_path, then capture again with --after-frames 10 and require the decoded frame counter
# AND vinput's captured_present to advance by >= 10. Cases with Leak=$true also run 50 resize+capture cycles
# and compare the target's handle count / private bytes before and after. Every target is background,
# started and stopped by this script (by PID).
param([string]$Out = "$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\nativecapture", [string[]]$Only = @())
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$D = (Resolve-Path "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist").Path; $V = "$D\vinput.exe"
. "$PSScriptRoot\vi_patterncheck.ps1"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null; $Out = (Resolve-Path $Out).Path
$log = "$Out\nativecapture_log.txt"; Set-Content -LiteralPath $log -Value ''
function Note($m) { ("{0:HH:mm:ss.fff} {1}" -f (Get-Date), $m) | Tee-Object -Append $log }
function Require($c, $d) { if (-not $c) { throw "FAIL $d" }; Note "PASS $d" }
if (-not ('ViNc.W' -as [type])) {
Add-Type -Namespace ViNc -Name W -MemberDefinition @'
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SetWindowPos(IntPtr h, IntPtr a, int x, int y, int cx, int cy, uint f);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern IntPtr GetForegroundWindow();
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr h, out uint pid);
'@
}
function FgPid { $p = [uint32]0; [void][ViNc.W]::GetWindowThreadProcessId([ViNc.W]::GetForegroundWindow(), [ref]$p); return $p }
function Cmd([int]$TargetPid, [string[]]$C) { $r = & $V --pid $TargetPid @C | ConvertFrom-Json; return $r }

# n, exe, args, api (expected capture_path), leak, pre (vinput commands before the first capture), inject ('early'
# = target waits for the vinput pipe before creating its device)
$cases = @(
  @{ n='d3d12_bgra_x64'; exe='vi_d3d12test.exe';   a='--fmt bgra'; api='d3d12'; leak=$true },
  @{ n='d3d12_rgba_x86'; exe='vi_d3d12test32.exe'; a='--fmt rgba'; api='d3d12'; leak=$false },
  @{ n='d3d12_r10_x64';  exe='vi_d3d12test.exe';   a='--fmt r10';  api='d3d12'; leak=$false },
  @{ n='d3d12_f16_x64';  exe='vi_d3d12test.exe';   a='--fmt f16';  api='d3d12'; leak=$false },
  @{ n='d3d12_appcontainer_x64'; exe='vi_d3d12test.exe'; a='--fmt bgra'; api='d3d12'; leak=$false; ac=$true },
  @{ n='gl_swapbuffers_x64'; exe='vi_gltest.exe';   a='';       api='gl'; leak=$true },
  @{ n='gl_wglswap_x64';     exe='vi_gltest.exe';   a='--wgl';  api='gl'; leak=$false },
  @{ n='gl_swapbuffers_x86'; exe='vi_gltest32.exe'; a='';       api='gl'; leak=$false },
  # Vulkan: the target waits for vinput's pipe before creating its device (vinput must see vkCreateDevice /
  # vkGetDeviceQueue / vkCreateSwapchainKHR); its swapchain asks for TRANSFER_DST only
  @{ n='vk_bgra_x64';   exe='vi_vktest.exe';   a='--fmt bgra';        api='vk'; leak=$true;  early=$true },
  @{ n='vk_gdpa_x64';   exe='vi_vktest.exe';   a='--fmt bgra --gdpa'; api='vk'; leak=$false; early=$true },
  @{ n='vk_rgba_x86';   exe='vi_vktest32.exe'; a='--fmt rgba';        api='vk'; leak=$false; early=$true; optional=$true },
  @{ n='vk_r10_x64';    exe='vi_vktest.exe';   a='--fmt r10';         api='vk'; leak=$false; early=$true; optional=$true },
  @{ n='vk_bgra_x86';   exe='vi_vktest32.exe'; a='--fmt bgra';        api='vk'; leak=$false; early=$true },
  # negative: injected after the device exists -> native capture refuses with a clear reason, auto falls back to
  # PrintWindow, and the driver's internal DXGI swapchain is not counted as a second (d3d12) frame source
  @{ n='vk_late_inject_x64'; exe='vi_vktest.exe'; a='--fmt bgra'; api='vk'; leak=$false; late=$true }
)
if ($Only.Count) { $cases = $cases | Where-Object { $Only -contains $_.n } }
$owned = @()
$fgBefore = FgPid
try {
  foreach ($c in $cases) {
    $tl = "$Out\$($c.n)_target.log"
    if ($c.ac) {
      # same sandbox as a UWP / Xbox app game: AppContainer with no capabilities (test\vi_aclaunch.cpp)
      icacls $Out /grant '*S-1-15-2-1:(OI)(CI)M' | Out-Null
      icacls "$D\$($c.exe)" /grant '*S-1-15-2-1:(RX)' | Out-Null
      $j = & "$D\vi_aclaunch.exe" "$D\$($c.exe)" $tl -28000 600 820 480 @($c.a -split ' ' | Where-Object { $_ }) | ConvertFrom-Json
      Require $j.ok "$($c.n) started inside AppContainer $($j.appcontainer_sid)"
      $p = Get-Process -Id $j.pid
    } else {
      $extra = if ($c.early) { ' --wait-vinput 20000' } else { '' }
      $p = Start-Process -FilePath "$D\$($c.exe)" -ArgumentList "`"$tl`" -28000 600 820 480 $($c.a)$extra" -PassThru
    }
    $owned += $p
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $(if ($c.early) { 300 } elseif ($c.late) { 2500 } else { 700 })
    $r = & $V inject --pid $p.Id | ConvertFrom-Json
    Require $r.ok "$($c.n) inject"
    if ($c.optional) {
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 2500
      $tlog0 = Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Raw
      if ($tlog0 -match 'FAIL surface does not offer format') { Note "$($c.n) SKIP (not a vinput result): $(($tlog0 -split "`n" | Select-String 'FAIL').Line)"; Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false; continue }
    }
    if ($c.late) {
      $s = $null
      for ($i = 0; $i -lt 60; $i++) { $s = Cmd $p.Id @('status'); if ($s.frames -gt 30) { break }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 }
      $f0 = $s.frames_by_api
      Require ($s.frame_api -eq 'vk' -and $s.vk.hooked -and $s.vk.swapchains -eq 0) "$($c.n) frames counted as vk; vinput saw no device/swapchain (created before injection)"
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1000
      $s2 = Cmd $p.Id @('status')
      Require ($s2.frames_by_api.d3d12 -eq $f0.d3d12 -and $s2.frames_by_api.foreign_dxgi -gt $f0.foreign_dxgi -and $s2.frames_by_api.vk -gt $f0.vk) "$($c.n) the driver's DXGI presents are foreign, not d3d12 frames (d3d12 $($f0.d3d12)->$($s2.frames_by_api.d3d12), foreign $($f0.foreign_dxgi)->$($s2.frames_by_api.foreign_dxgi))"
      $n = Cmd $p.Id @('capture', "$Out\$($c.n)_native.png", '--method', 'native')
      Require (-not $n.ok -and $n.error -match 'before vinput was injected') "$($c.n) native capture refuses with a clear reason: $($n.error)"
      $a = Cmd $p.Id @('capture', "$Out\$($c.n)_auto.png")
      Require ($a.ok -and $a.capture_path -eq 'printwindow' -and $a.note -match 'before vinput was injected') "$($c.n) auto capture falls back to PrintWindow and says why"
      $pa = Test-VinputPattern "$Out\$($c.n)_auto.png"
      Note "$($c.n) INFO PrintWindow of a Vulkan window: pattern ok=$($pa.ok) $($pa.detail)"
      Require (-not $p.HasExited) "$($c.n) target alive"
      Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false
      continue
    }
    $s = $null
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 60; $i++) { $s = Cmd $p.Id @('status'); if ($s.frames -gt 5 -and $s.frame_api -eq $c.api) { break }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 }
    Require ($s.frame_api -eq $c.api) "$($c.n) frames counted as $($c.api) (frame_api=$($s.frame_api), frames=$($s.frames))"
    if ($c.api -eq 'gl' -or $c.api -eq 'vk') {
      Require ($s.frames_by_api.d3d12 -eq 0 -and $s.frames_by_api.d3d11 -eq 0) "$($c.n) no double counting: the driver's DXGI presents are not d3d11/d3d12 frames ($($s.frames_by_api | ConvertTo-Json -Compress))"
    }
    if ($c.ac) {
      Require ($s.app_container -eq $true) "$($c.n) vinput runs inside the AppContainer, pipe reached through the container namespace"
      $l = & $V list | ConvertFrom-Json
      Require (@($l | Where-Object { $_.pid -eq $p.Id }).Count -eq 1) "$($c.n) vinput list shows the AppContainer pipe"
      # an output folder the container cannot write (inheritance cut, only the current user): the CLI must stage the
      # PNG in dist\run\logs and move it (a UWP game failed here with "WIC png encode failed hr=0x80070005")
      $noac = "$Out\$($c.n)_noac"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $noac | Out-Null
      icacls $noac /inheritance:r /grant:r "$($env:USERNAME):(OI)(CI)F" '*S-1-5-32-544:(OI)(CI)F' | Out-Null
      $acl = (icacls $noac) -join ' '
      Require ($acl -notmatch 'APPLICATION PACKAGE|S-1-15-2') "$($c.n) control: $noac grants no AppContainer access"
      $n = Cmd $p.Id @('capture', "$noac\capture.png", '--method', 'native')
      Require ($n.ok -and $n.path -eq "$noac\capture.png" -and (Test-Path "$noac\capture.png") -and (Test-VinputPattern "$noac\capture.png").ok) "$($c.n) capture to a folder the container cannot write: staged + moved, pixels exact (err=$($n.error))"
    }
    $a = Cmd $p.Id @('capture', "$Out\$($c.n)_a.png", '--method', 'native')
    $a | ConvertTo-Json -Compress | Set-Content "$Out\$($c.n)_a.json"
    Require ($a.ok -and $a.capture_path -eq $c.api -and $a.method -eq 'swapchain') "$($c.n) native capture A path=$($a.capture_path) err=$($a.error)"
    $pa = Test-VinputPattern "$Out\$($c.n)_a.png"
    Require ($pa.ok -and $pa.w -eq $a.client_w -and $pa.h -eq $a.client_h) "$($c.n) capture A pixels: bars exact, frame bits decode (frame=$($pa.frame), $($pa.w)x$($pa.h)) $($pa.detail)"
    $pw = Cmd $p.Id @('capture', "$Out\$($c.n)_printwindow.png", '--method', 'printwindow')
    if ($pw.ok) { $pp = Test-VinputPattern "$Out\$($c.n)_printwindow.png"; Note "$($c.n) INFO PrintWindow comparison: pattern ok=$($pp.ok) frame=$($pp.frame) (native frame=$($pa.frame)) $($pp.detail)" } else { Note "$($c.n) INFO PrintWindow failed: $($pw.error)" }
    $b = Cmd $p.Id @('capture', "$Out\$($c.n)_b.png", '--after-frames', '10', '--method', 'native')
    $b | ConvertTo-Json -Compress | Set-Content "$Out\$($c.n)_b.json"
    $pb = Test-VinputPattern "$Out\$($c.n)_b.png"
    Require ($b.ok -and $pb.ok -and ($pb.frame - $pa.frame) -ge 10 -and ($b.captured_present - $a.captured_present) -ge 10 -and $b.frame -eq $b.captured_present) "$($c.n) --after-frames 10: target frame $($pa.frame)->$($pb.frame), vinput frame $($a.frame)->$($b.frame)"
    if ($c.api -eq 'vk' -and $c.n -eq 'vk_bgra_x86') {
      $off = Cmd $p.Id @('config', 'vk=off'); $k = Cmd $p.Id @('capture', "$Out\$($c.n)_vkoff.png", '--method', 'native')
      $on = Cmd $p.Id @('config', 'vk=on');  $k2 = Cmd $p.Id @('capture', "$Out\$($c.n)_vkon.png", '--method', 'native')
      Require ($off.ok -and -not $k.ok -and $k.error -match 'vk=off' -and $on.ok -and $k2.ok -and $k2.capture_path -eq 'vk') "$($c.n) config vk=off disables Vulkan capture ($($k.error)); vk=on restores it"
    }
    if ($c.leak) {
      $hwnd = [IntPtr][Convert]::ToInt64($s.hwnd, 16)
      for ($i = 0; $i -lt 5; $i++) { $w = Cmd $p.Id @('capture', "$Out\$($c.n)_warm.png", '--method', 'native'); if (-not $w.ok) { throw "warm capture failed: $($w.error)" } }
      $p.Refresh(); $h0 = $p.HandleCount; $m0 = $p.PrivateMemorySize64
      $bad = 0; $mismatch = 0
      for ($i = 0; $i -lt 50; $i++) {
        $cw = 700 + ($i % 5) * 60; $chh = 420 + ($i % 3) * 50
        [void][ViNc.W]::SetWindowPos($hwnd, [IntPtr]::Zero, 0, 0, $cw, $chh, 0x0002 -bor 0x0004 -bor 0x0010)   # NOMOVE|NOZORDER|NOACTIVATE
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 40
        $k = Cmd $p.Id @('capture', "$Out\$($c.n)_loop.png", '--after-frames', '2', '--method', 'native')
        if (-not $k.ok -or $k.capture_path -ne $c.api) { $bad++; Note "loop $i capture failed: $($k.error)"; continue }
        $pk = Test-VinputPattern "$Out\$($c.n)_loop.png"
        if (-not $pk.ok) { $bad++; Note "loop $i pattern: $($pk.detail)" }
        if ($k.w -ne $k.client_w -or $k.h -ne $k.client_h) { $mismatch++ }
      }
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
      $p.Refresh(); $h1 = $p.HandleCount; $m1 = $p.PrivateMemorySize64
      $st = Cmd $p.Id @('status')
      Note ("{0} 50 resize+capture cycles: handles {1}->{2}, private MB {3:N1}->{4:N1}, size-lag captures {5}, d3d12={6}" -f $c.n, $h0, $h1, ($m0/1MB), ($m1/1MB), $mismatch, ($st.d3d12 | ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
      Require ($bad -eq 0) "$($c.n) all 50 resize+capture cycles native and pattern-exact"
      Require (-not $p.HasExited) "$($c.n) target alive after 50 resizes"
      Require (($h1 - $h0) -le 20) "$($c.n) handle growth <= 20 over 50 cycles ($h0 -> $h1)"
      Require ((($m1 - $m0) / 1MB) -le 64) "$($c.n) private-bytes growth <= 64 MB over 50 cycles"
      $tlog = Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Raw
      $resizes = ([regex]::Matches($tlog, 'RESIZE \d+x\d+ hr=0x00000000')).Count
      if ($c.api -eq 'd3d12' -or $c.api -eq 'vk') { Require ($resizes -ge 10 -and $tlog -notmatch 'FAIL') "$($c.n) target resized/recreated its swapchain $resizes times with no failure" }
      else { Require ($tlog -notmatch 'FAIL') "$($c.n) target log has no failure after 50 resizes" }
      if ($c.api -eq 'd3d12') { Require ($st.d3d12.releases -ge 1 -and $st.d3d12.leaks -eq 0) "$($c.n) ResizeBuffers released our D3D12 objects ($($st.d3d12.releases)x), no leaks" }
      if ($c.api -eq 'vk') { Require ($st.vk.swapchains -eq 1 -and $st.vk.usage_added -ge 10) "$($c.n) old swapchains forgotten (tracked now: $($st.vk.swapchains)), TRANSFER_SRC added to every recreated one ($($st.vk.usage_added))" }
    }
    $tlog = Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl
    $worst = ($tlog | Select-String 'maxms=([\d.]+)' | ForEach-Object { [double]$_.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value } | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum
    if ($null -ne $worst) { Note "$($c.n) worst per-second max frame time while injected/capturing: $worst ms"; Require ($worst -lt 250) "$($c.n) no capture stall >= 250 ms" }
    Require (-not (($tlog -join "`n") -match 'STATE_CHANGED')) "$($c.n) game-visible API state unchanged by captures (target self-check)"
    Require ((FgPid) -ne $p.Id) "$($c.n) target never became the real foreground"
    Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false
  }
  Note 'PASS native capture suite'
} finally {
  foreach ($p in $owned) { if (-not $p.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false } }
  Note "owned targets stopped by PID; real foreground pid before=$fgBefore after=$(FgPid)"
}
```

```ps1
# ocr: Windows.Media.Ocr in the CLI process; boxes in client pixels on a synthetic menu target.
param([string]$Out = "$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\ocr")
. "$PSScriptRoot\_ui_common.ps1"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null; $Out = (Resolve-Path $Out).Path

  Require ($null -eq $r.ocr_confidence) 'ocr reports no invented confidence (API has none)'
  $find = { param($text) $r.lines | Where-Object { $_.text -eq $text } }

  $xs = $battle | ForEach-Object { $_.box[0] + $_.box[2] / 2 } | Sort-Object
  Require ($xs[0] -gt 60 -and $xs[0] -lt 260 -and $xs[1] -gt 540 -and $xs[1] -lt 740) 'BATTLE boxes lie in the left and right buttons'
  Require (@(& $find 'MAIN MENU').Count -eq 1 -and $r.text.Contains('Load Game') -and $r.text.Contains('OPTIONS') -and $r.text.Contains('QUIT')) 'title, Load Game, OPTIONS and QUIT all read (tiled pass recovers dropped lines)'
  Require ($r.lines[0].words.Count -ge 1 -and $r.lines[0].words[0].box.Count -eq 4) 'word boxes present'
  # region: boxes stay in CLIENT pixels, not region-local pixels
  $reg = Vi $t.Pid @('ocr', '--region', '40,100,300,90')
  Require ($reg.ok -and $reg.origin_x -eq 40 -and $reg.origin_y -eq 100) 'region ocr reports its origin'
  $p2 = @($reg.lines | Where-Object { $_.text -eq 'PLAY' })
  Require ($p2.Count -eq 1 -and [math]::Abs($p2[0].box[0] - $play[0].box[0]) -le 3 -and [math]::Abs($p2[0].box[1] - $play[0].box[1]) -le 3) 'region ocr maps boxes back to client pixels (same PLAY box +-3 px)'
  # negative controls
  $empty = Vi $t.Pid @('ocr', '--region', '0,410,800,38')
  Require ($empty.ok -and $empty.line_count -eq 0) 'text-free region reads zero lines (positive control above proves the reader works)'
  $bad = & $V --pid $t.Pid ocr --region 700,400,200,200 | ConvertFrom-Json
  Require (-not $bad.ok) 'region outside the window is rejected'
  $lang = & $V --pid $t.Pid ocr --lang xx-QQ | ConvertFrom-Json
```

```ps1
# Capture of a DDraw-wrapper style game: the game window stays black, the picture is in a separate
# "DDrawCompatPresentationWindow" (scaled 2x, centred). Regression: capture used to return an all-black frame.
param([string]$CliDir="$PSScriptRoot\..\dist",[string]$Exe='vi_overlaytarget.exe')
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$D=(Resolve-Path "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist").Path; $V=(Resolve-Path "$CliDir\vinput.exe").Path
$Out="$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\overlaycapture"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null; $Out=(Resolve-Path $Out).Path
$p=$null
function Px($x,$y){ $r=& $V --pid $p.Id pixel $x $y | ConvertFrom-Json; if(-not $r.ok){throw "pixel $x $y failed"}; $r }
function Near($c,$r,$g,$b){ [math]::Abs($c.r-$r) -le 12 -and [math]::Abs($c.g-$g) -le 12 -and [math]::Abs($c.b-$b) -le 12 }
try {
  $p=Start-Process -FilePath "$D\$Exe" -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
  $ok=$false; for($i=0;$i -lt 50;$i++){ $r=& $V inject --pid $p.Id | ConvertFrom-Json; if($r.ok){$ok=$true;break}; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 }
  if(-not $ok){throw 'Injection failed'}
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
  $sw=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
  $c=& $V --pid $p.Id capture "$Out\full.png" | ConvertFrom-Json
  $ms=$sw.ElapsedMilliseconds
  if(-not $c.ok){throw "capture failed: $($c | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)"}
  if($c.w -ne 320 -or $c.h -ne 240){throw "capture size $($c.w)x$($c.h), expected 320x240"}
  if(-not (Near (Px 100 200) 220 20 20)){throw 'left half is not red: overlay window not captured (black frame)'}
  if(-not (Near (Px 250 200) 20 20 220)){throw 'right half is not blue'}
  if(-not (Near (Px 10 10) 20 220 20)){throw 'green marker not at the top-left: aspect-fit/centre mapping wrong'}
  if(-not (Near (Px 145 120) 220 20 20)){throw 'stale yellow square from the game window leaked into the capture'}
  if(-not (Near (Px 100 100) 220 20 20)){throw 'red region wrong below the marker'}
  if($c.capture_path -ne 'printwindow_overlay'){throw "capture_path $($c.capture_path)"}
  if($ms -gt 2500){throw "capture took $ms ms: waited for a swapchain frame that never comes"}
  "PASS overlay-window capture (red/blue/green at the right client pixels, ${ms} ms)"
} finally { if($p -and -not $p.HasExited){Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false} }
```

```ps1
# Standalone parser regressions. No target processes, injected DLLs, focus, or OS input.
param(
    [string]$Out = "$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\parsertests",
    [ValidateSet('keys', 'sequence', 'all')][string]$Kind = 'keys'
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$repo = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "$PSScriptRoot\..").Path
$outPath = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Out)
if (!$outPath.StartsWith($repo + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
    throw 'Parser build output must stay inside this repository.'
}
. "$PSScriptRoot\_vcvars.ps1"; $vcvars = Join-Path (Get-VcVarsDir) 'vcvarsall.bat'
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $vcvars -PathType Leaf)) { throw "MSVC environment missing: $vcvars" }
$failed = $false
$tests = if ($Kind -eq 'all') { @('vi_keystest', 'vi_sequencetest') }
    elseif ($Kind -eq 'sequence') { @('vi_sequencetest') } else { @('vi_keystest') }
foreach ($arch in @('x64', 'x86')) {
    $archOut = Join-Path $outPath $arch
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $archOut | Out-Null
    $batch = Join-Path $archOut 'run.bat'
    $lines = @(
        '@echo off',
        'setlocal',
        ('set "TEMP={0}"' -f $archOut),
        ('set "TMP={0}"' -f $archOut),
        ('call "{0}" {1} >nul || exit /b 2' -f $vcvars, $arch),
        ('cd /d "{0}"' -f $archOut)
    )
    foreach ($test in $tests) {
        $source = Join-Path $repo "test\$test.cpp"
        $lines += ('cl /nologo /std:c++17 /utf-8 /O2 /MT /EHsc /W4 /WX "{0}" /Fo:"{1}.obj" /Fe:"{1}.exe" || exit /b 2' -f $source, $test)
        $lines += ('"{0}\{1}.exe" || exit /b 1' -f $archOut, $test)
    }
    $lines += 'exit /b 0'
    Set-Content -LiteralPath $batch -Value $lines -Encoding ascii
    $result = @(& cmd.exe /d /c $batch 2>&1)
    $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    $result | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() } | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $archOut 'results.txt') -Encoding utf8
    $result | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_.ToString() }
    if ($code -ne 0) { Write-Output "FAIL parser regressions $arch (exit $code)"; $failed = $true }
    else { Write-Output "PASS parser regressions $arch (/W4 /WX)" }
}
if ($failed) { exit 1 }
exit 0
```

```ps1
# script runner: stops at the first failing line, reports its number; macros\ run end to end on the synthetic target.
param([string]$Out = "$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\script")
. "$PSScriptRoot\_ui_common.ps1"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null; $Out = (Resolve-Path $Out).Path
$M = (Resolve-Path "$PSScriptRoot\..\macros").Path
function Run-Script([int]$TargetPid, [string]$File, [string[]]$Extra = @()) {
  $lines = & $script:V --pid $TargetPid script $File @Extra
  $code = $LASTEXITCODE
  $objs = @($lines | Where-Object { $_ -like '{*' } | ForEach-Object { $_ | ConvertFrom-Json })
  return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $code; Lines = $objs; Summary = $objs[-1] }
}
$t = $null
try {
  $t = Start-UiTarget $Out 'script1'
  $r = Run-Script $t.Pid "$M\synthetic_menu_to_game.vin"
  Require ($r.Code -eq 0 -and $r.Summary.ok -and $r.Summary.commands_run -eq 6) 'macro synthetic_menu_to_game.vin runs all 6 commands and exits 0'
  Require ((Wait-ScreenInLog $t 'GAME' 5)) 'target reached the GAME screen through the macro'
  $clicks = Get-Clicks $t
  Require ($clicks.Count -eq 2 -and $clicks[0].Name -eq 'PLAY' -and $clicks[1].Name -eq 'SOLO') 'only PLAY and SOLO were clicked, in order'
  Stop-UiTarget $t; $t = $null

  $t = Start-UiTarget $Out 'script2'
  $bad = "$Out\fails.vin"
  Set-Content -LiteralPath $bad -Value @('# comment line', '', 'click-text PLAY', 'sleep 100', 'assert-text "THIS TEXT IS NOT ON SCREEN"', 'click-text SOLO', 'echo never reached')
  $r = Run-Script $t.Pid $bad
  Require ($r.Code -ne 0 -and -not $r.Summary.ok -and $r.Summary.stopped) 'a failing assert makes the script exit non-zero and stop'
  Require ($r.Summary.first_failure.failed_line -eq 5 -and $r.Summary.first_failure.line -like 'assert-text*') 'the failing LINE NUMBER (5) and text are reported (comments and blanks counted)'
  Require ($r.Summary.commands_run -eq 3) 'exactly 3 commands ran (click-text, sleep, assert-text); nothing after the failure'
  $clicks = Get-Clicks $t
  Require ($clicks.Count -eq 1 -and $clicks[0].Name -eq 'PLAY') 'SOLO was NOT clicked after the failed assertion'
  $cont = Run-Script $t.Pid $bad @('--continue')
  Require ($cont.Code -ne 0 -and $cont.Summary.failures -ge 1 -and $cont.Summary.commands_run -eq 5 -and -not $cont.Summary.stopped) '--continue runs past the failure but still exits non-zero and counts it'
  $unknown = "$Out\unknown.vin"
  Set-Content -LiteralPath $unknown -Value @('echo hi', 'frobnicate 1 2')
  $r = Run-Script $t.Pid $unknown
  Require ($r.Code -ne 0 -and $r.Summary.first_failure.failed_line -eq 2) 'an unknown command fails at its own line'
  $nest = "$Out\nested.vin"
  Set-Content -LiteralPath $nest -Value @("script $unknown")
  $r = Run-Script $t.Pid $nest
  Require ($r.Code -ne 0 -and $r.Summary.first_failure.line -like 'script*') 'script inside a script is refused'
  $r = & $V --pid $t.Pid script "$Out\does_not_exist.vin" | ConvertFrom-Json
  Require (-not $r.ok) 'missing script file is an error'
  Stop-UiTarget $t; $t = $null

  $t = Start-UiTarget $Out 'script3'
  $r = Run-Script $t.Pid "$M\synthetic_pick_second_battle.vin"
  $clicks = Get-Clicks $t
  Require ($r.Code -eq 0 -and $clicks.Count -eq 2 -and (In-Rect $clicks[0].X $clicks[0].Y 540 340 740 400) -and $clicks[1].Name -eq 'Load___Game') 'macro synthetic_pick_second_battle.vin: right BATTLE then Load Game'
  # relative paths in a script resolve against the script's folder, not the caller's working directory
  $sub = "$Out\relsub"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $sub | Out-Null
  Remove-Item "$sub\shot_rel.png" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  Set-Content -LiteralPath "$sub\rel.vin" -Value @('capture shot_rel.png --region 0,0,100,60', 'pixel 10 10')
  Push-Location $env:SystemRoot
  try { $r = Run-Script $t.Pid "$sub\rel.vin" } finally { Pop-Location }
  Require ($r.Code -eq 0 -and (Test-Path "$sub\shot_rel.png")) 'relative capture path in a script lands next to the script, whatever the caller cwd was'
  'PASS script'; $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
} finally { Stop-UiTarget $t }
```

`verify/run_selftest.ps1`:

```ps1
# Full self-test: synthetic targets only, no real game. Every case asserts; the first failure stops the run.
# Only run_fgguardtest touches the real foreground (milliseconds) and holds a lock file for it: set VINPUT_LOCK to the
# lock file that other foreground-taking tools on this machine use, or it uses build\foreground.lock.
param([string]$Out = "$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\selftest")
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$D = (Resolve-Path "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist").Path; $V = "$D\vinput.exe"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null
$Out = (Resolve-Path $Out).Path
$log = "$Out\selftest_log.txt"
Set-Content -LiteralPath $log -Value ''
function Note($m) { ("{0:HH:mm:ss.fff} {1}" -f (Get-Date), $m) | Tee-Object -Append $log }
function Require($condition, $description) { if (-not $condition) { throw "FAIL $description" }; Note "PASS $description" }
function Command([int]$targetPid, [string[]]$command) {
  $r = & $V --pid $targetPid @command | ConvertFrom-Json
  if (-not $r.ok) { throw "Command failed: $command : $($r | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)" }
  return $r
}
$cases = @(
  @{ n='x64_dll'; exe="$D\vi_testinput.exe"; dll=''; bits=64; key='q'; vk='51'; dik='10' },
  @{ n='x86_dll'; exe="$D\vi_testinput32.exe"; dll=''; bits=32; key='r'; vk='52'; dik='13' },
  @{ n='x64_compiled'; exe="$D\vi_testinput.exe"; dll="$D\compilein_test64.dll"; bits=64; key='s'; vk='53'; dik='1F' },
  @{ n='x86_compiled'; exe="$D\vi_testinput32.exe"; dll="$D\compilein_test32.dll"; bits=32; key='t'; vk='54'; dik='14' }
)
$started = @{}
try {
  foreach ($c in $cases) {
    $targetLog = "$Out\$($c.n).log"
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $c.exe -ArgumentList "`"$targetLog`" -28000 600 420 260" -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
    $started[$c.n] = $p
    $injectArgs = @('inject','--pid',"$($p.Id)"); if ($c.dll) { $injectArgs += @('--dll',$c.dll) }
    $r = & $V @injectArgs | ConvertFrom-Json
    Require $r.ok "$($c.n) injection"
    $ready=$false
    for ($i=0; $i -lt 50; $i++) {
      $s = Command $p.Id @('status')
      if ($s.hwnd -ne '0x0' -and $s.counters.present_ours -gt 0) { $ready=$true; break }
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
    }
    Require $ready "$($c.n) target ready"
  }
  foreach ($c in $cases) {
    $targetPid=$started[$c.n].Id
    Command $targetPid @('key',$c.key,'160') | Out-Null
    Command $targetPid @('click','left','50','40') | Out-Null
    Command $targetPid @('move','7','3') | Out-Null
    Command $targetPid @('wheel','120') | Out-Null
    Command $targetPid @('type','hi','--delay','10') | Out-Null
    $cap=Command $targetPid @('capture',"$Out\$($c.n).png")
    $s=Command $targetPid @('status')
    Require ($s.bits -eq $c.bits -and -not $s.really_foreground) "$($c.n) architecture and background isolation"
    Require ($cap.method -eq 'swapchain' -and $cap.w -gt 0 -and $cap.h -gt 0) "$($c.n) native D3D11 capture"
    $t=Get-Content -LiteralPath "$Out\$($c.n).log" -Raw
    foreach ($pattern in @("WM_KEYDOWN vk=0x$($c.vk)","WM_KEYUP vk=0x$($c.vk)","GAKS vk=0x$($c.vk) down","RAW_KBD vk=0x$($c.vk) down","DI_KBD dik=0x$($c.dik) down",'WM_LBUTTONDOWN 50 40','RAW_MOUSE dx=7 dy=3','DI_MOUSE dx=7 dy=3','WM_MOUSEWHEEL 120',"WM_CHAR 104 'h'","WM_CHAR 105 'i'")) {
      Require ($t.Contains($pattern)) "$($c.n) $pattern"
    }
    foreach ($other in $cases) { if ($other.n -ne $c.n) { Require (-not $t.Contains("WM_KEYDOWN vk=0x$($other.vk)")) "$($c.n) no $($other.key) cross-talk" } }
    if ($c.dll) {
      $pf=Get-ChildItem "$D\run" -Filter "$([IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($c.dll))_*.presents.txt" | Sort-Object LastWriteTime | Select-Object -Last 1
      Require ($pf -and [int](Get-Content -LiteralPath $pf.FullName) -gt 0 -and $s.counters.present_ours -gt 0) "$($c.n) host DLL and vinput Present hooks chain"
    }
  }
  & "$PSScriptRoot\run_clicktest.ps1" -Out "$Out\click"
  & "$PSScriptRoot\run_activatetest.ps1" -Out "$Out\activate"
  & "$PSScriptRoot\run_keytest.ps1" -Out "$Out\keys"
  & "$PSScriptRoot\run_tracetest.ps1" -Out "$Out\trace"
  & "$PSScriptRoot\run_capturetest.ps1" -Out "$Out\capture"
  & "$PSScriptRoot\run_foregroundtest.ps1" -Out "$Out\launch"
  & "$PSScriptRoot\run_movetest.ps1" -Out "$Out\move"
  & "$PSScriptRoot\run_nativecapture.ps1" -Out "$Out\nativecapture"
  & "$PSScriptRoot\run_xinputtest.ps1" -Out "$Out\xinput"
  if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw "FAIL xinput suite" }
  & "$PSScriptRoot\run_dinput1test.ps1" -Out "$Out\dinput1"

  & "$PSScriptRoot\run_actest.ps1" -Out "$Out\actest"
  if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw "FAIL anti-cheat refusal suite" }
  & "$PSScriptRoot\run_unittests.ps1" -Out "$Out\unit"  #@ocr
  & "$PSScriptRoot\run_ocrtest.ps1" -Out "$Out\ocr"  #@ocr
  & "$PSScriptRoot\run_texttest.ps1" -Out "$Out\text"  #@text

  & "$PSScriptRoot\run_fgguardtest.ps1" -Out "$Out\fgguard"
```

`verify/run_smalltest.ps1`:

```ps1
# pixel / scroll / drag / type against the synthetic menu target (which logs WM_MOUSEMOVE, wheel and WM_CHAR).
param([string]$Out = "$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\small")
. "$PSScriptRoot\_ui_common.ps1"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null; $Out = (Resolve-Path $Out).Path
$t = $null
try {
  $t = Start-UiTarget $Out 'small'
  # ---- pixel ----
  $p = Vi $t.Pid @('pixel', '10', '10')
  Require ($p.ok -and [math]::Abs($p.r - 18) -le 2 -and [math]::Abs($p.g - 28) -le 2 -and [math]::Abs($p.b - 56) -le 2 -and $p.hex -match '^#[0-9A-F]{6}$') 'pixel reads the background colour (18,28,56)'
  $p = Vi $t.Pid @('pixel', '70', '120')
  Require ($p.ok -and [math]::Abs($p.r - 40) -le 2 -and [math]::Abs($p.g - 140) -le 2 -and [math]::Abs($p.b - 60) -le 2) 'pixel reads the PLAY button green (40,140,60)'
  $bad = & $V --pid $t.Pid pixel 900 10 | ConvertFrom-Json
  Require (-not $bad.ok) 'pixel outside the client area is an error, not a colour'
  # ---- scroll ----
  $r = Vi $t.Pid @('scroll', '3', '400', '300')
  Require ($r.ok -and $r.notches -eq 3) 'scroll 3 at a point is accepted'
  $r = Vi $t.Pid @('scroll', '-2')
  Require ($r.ok) 'scroll -2 at the current virtual cursor'
  $log = Get-LogText $t
  $up = ([regex]::Matches($log, 'WHEEL 120 400 300')).Count; $down = ([regex]::Matches($log, 'WHEEL -120 400 300')).Count
  Require ($up -eq 3 -and $down -eq 2) 'target received 3 wheel notches up and 2 down, all at (400,300)'
  $bad = & $V --pid $t.Pid scroll 3 100 | ConvertFrom-Json
  Require (-not $bad.ok) 'scroll with X but no Y is rejected'
  # ---- drag ----
  $r = Vi $t.Pid @('drag', '100', '300', '300', '380', '--ms', '400')
  Require ($r.ok -and $r.steps -ge 3) 'drag completes'
  $log = Get-LogText $t
  $moves = @(); foreach ($l in ($log -split "`n")) { if ($l -match 'MOVE (-?\d+) (-?\d+) btn=1') { $moves += [pscustomobject]@{ X = [int]$Matches[1]; Y = [int]$Matches[2] } } }
  Require ($log -match 'CLICK 100 300 none') 'drag pressed the button at the start point'
  Require ($moves.Count -ge 3) "drag produced $($moves.Count) intermediate moves with the button held"
  $mono = $true; for ($i = 1; $i -lt $moves.Count; $i++) { if ($moves[$i].X -lt $moves[$i - 1].X -or $moves[$i].Y -lt $moves[$i - 1].Y) { $mono = $false } }
  Require ($mono -and $moves[0].X -ge 100 -and $moves[-1].X -le 300 -and $moves[-1].Y -le 380) 'held moves progress monotonically from start toward end'
  Require ($log -match 'UP 300 380') 'drag released the button at the end point'
  # ---- type ----
  $text = "h" + [char]0x00E9 + "llo " + [char]0x65E5 + [char]0x672C + " " + [char]::ConvertFromUtf32(0x1F600)
  $r = Vi $t.Pid @('type', $text, '--delay', '5')
  Require ($r.ok) 'type accepts unicode text'
  $log = Get-LogText $t
  $codes = @(); foreach ($l in ($log -split "`n")) { if ($l -match 'CHAR U\+([0-9A-F]{4})') { $codes += $Matches[1] } }
  $expect = @('0068', '00E9', '006C', '006C', '006F', '0020', '65E5', '672C', '0020', 'D83D', 'DE00')
  Require (($codes -join ',') -eq ($expect -join ',')) "WM_CHAR sequence is exact, incl. surrogate pair: $($codes -join ',')"
  'PASS small'; $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
} finally { Stop-UiTarget $t }
```

```ps1
# click-text / wait-text / assert-text against the synthetic menu target (clicks are logged with coordinates).
param([string]$Out = "$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\text")
. "$PSScriptRoot\_ui_common.ps1"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null; $Out = (Resolve-Path $Out).Path
$a = $null; $b = $null; $c = $null
try {
  # ---- A: the PLAY -> SOLO flow by text alone ----
  $a = Start-UiTarget $Out 'flow'
  $r = Vi $a.Pid @('click-text', 'PLAY')
  Require ($r.ok -and $r.clicked -and $r.match.text -eq 'PLAY' -and $r.match_count -eq 1) 'click-text PLAY clicks and reports the matched box'
  Require ($null -eq $r.ocr_confidence -and $r.match.match_score -eq 1) 'reply carries match_score and an honest null ocr_confidence'
  $clicks = Get-Clicks $a
  Require ($clicks.Count -eq 1 -and $clicks[0].Name -eq 'PLAY' -and (In-Rect $clicks[0].X $clicks[0].Y 60 110 260 170)) 'the target logged exactly one click, on the PLAY button'
  Require ($r.match.center[0] -eq $clicks[0].X -and $r.match.center[1] -eq $clicks[0].Y) 'reported centre equals the logged click coordinates'
  $w = Vi $a.Pid @('wait-text', 'Select a game type', '--timeout', '8000')
  Require ($w.ok -and $w.found -and $w.match_count -eq 1) 'wait-text sees the next screen'
  $r = Vi $a.Pid @('click-text', 'solo')
  Require ($r.ok) 'click-text is case-insensitive (solo -> SOLO)'
  Require (Wait-ScreenInLog $a 'GAME' 5) 'SOLO click switched the target to the GAME screen'
  $clicks = Get-Clicks $a
  Require ($clicks.Count -eq 2 -and $clicks[1].Name -eq 'SOLO') 'second click landed on SOLO'
  $w = Vi $a.Pid @('wait-text', 'Game started', '--timeout', '8000')
  Require ($w.ok) 'wait-text sees Game started'
  Stop-UiTarget $a; $a = $null

  # ---- B: ambiguity, --nth, whitespace, --exact, timeout ----
  $b = Start-UiTarget $Out 'menu'
  $before = (Get-Clicks $b).Count
  $r = & $V --pid $b.Pid click-text BATTLE | ConvertFrom-Json
  Require ((-not $r.ok) -and $r.ambiguous -and $r.match_count -eq 2 -and $r.candidates.Count -eq 2 -and $r.candidates[0].center[0] -lt $r.candidates[1].center[0]) 'ambiguous BATTLE is refused and both candidates are listed in reading order'
  Require ((Get-Clicks $b).Count -eq $before) 'the refusal clicked nothing'
  $r = Vi $b.Pid @('click-text', 'BATTLE', '--nth', '2')
  $clicks = Get-Clicks $b
  Require ($r.ok -and $clicks[-1].Name -eq 'BATTLE' -and (In-Rect $clicks[-1].X $clicks[-1].Y 540 340 740 400)) '--nth 2 clicks the RIGHT BATTLE button'
  $r = Vi $b.Pid @('click-text', 'BATTLE', '--nth', '1')
  $clicks = Get-Clicks $b
  Require ($r.ok -and $clicks[-1].Name -eq 'BATTLE' -and (In-Rect $clicks[-1].X $clicks[-1].Y 60 340 260 400)) '--nth 1 clicks the LEFT BATTLE button'
  $n = (Get-Clicks $b).Count
  $r = & $V --pid $b.Pid click-text BATTLE --nth 3 | ConvertFrom-Json
  Require ((-not $r.ok) -and $r.error -match 'only 2' -and (Get-Clicks $b).Count -eq $n) '--nth 3 of 2 is refused without clicking'
  $r = Vi $b.Pid @('click-text', 'LoadGame')
  $clicks = Get-Clicks $b
  Require ($r.ok -and $clicks[-1].Name -eq 'Load___Game') 'whitespace-insensitive: "LoadGame" clicks the "Load   Game" button'
  $r = Vi $b.Pid @('click-text', 'OPTIONS', '--exact')
  Require ($r.ok -and (Get-Clicks $b)[-1].Name -eq 'OPTIONS') '--exact with the right case clicks OPTIONS (label dropped by plain full-frame OCR, recovered by tiles)'
  $n = (Get-Clicks $b).Count
  $r = & $V --pid $b.Pid click-text options --exact --timeout 1200 | ConvertFrom-Json
  Require ((-not $r.ok) -and (Get-Clicks $b).Count -eq $n) '--exact is case-sensitive: "options" is not found and nothing is clicked'
  $t0 = Get-Date
  $r = & $V --pid $b.Pid click-text 'NO SUCH BUTTON' --timeout 1500 | ConvertFrom-Json
  $ms = ((Get-Date) - $t0).TotalMilliseconds
  Require ((-not $r.ok) -and $r.timed_out -and $r.ocr_saw -and $ms -ge 1400 -and $ms -lt 8000 -and (Get-Clicks $b).Count -eq $n) 'missing text times out after ~--timeout, lists what OCR saw, clicks nothing'
  $r = Vi $b.Pid @('click-text', 'QUIT', '--dry-run')
  Require ($r.ok -and -not $r.clicked -and $r.dry_run -and (Get-Clicks $b).Count -eq $n) '--dry-run reports the match without clicking'
  $r = Vi $b.Pid @('assert-text', 'MAIN MENU')
  Require ($r.ok) 'assert-text passes for present text'
  $t0 = Get-Date
  $r = & $V --pid $b.Pid assert-text 'Game started' | ConvertFrom-Json
  Require ((-not $r.ok) -and (((Get-Date) - $t0).TotalMilliseconds -lt 4000)) 'assert-text fails immediately for absent text'
  $r = Vi $b.Pid @('assert-text', 'Game started', '--absent')
  Require ($r.ok) 'assert-text --absent passes for absent text'
  Stop-UiTarget $b; $b = $null

  # ---- C: waiting for a load screen ----
  $c = Start-UiTarget $Out 'load' @('--load-ms', '7000')
  $w = Vi $c.Pid @('wait-text', 'Loading game', '--timeout', '5000')
  Require ($w.ok) 'wait-text sees the load screen'
  $w = Vi $c.Pid @('wait-text', 'MAIN MENU', '--timeout', '30000')
  Require ($w.ok -and $w.found -and $w.elapsed_ms -ge 800) 'wait-text MAIN MENU blocks until the load screen is gone (elapsed >= 800 ms)'
  Require ((Get-LogText $c) -match 'SCREEN MAIN') 'target log agrees: MAIN reached'
  $t0 = Get-Date
  $w = & $V --pid $c.Pid wait-text 'Loading game assets' --timeout 1500 | ConvertFrom-Json
  $ms = ((Get-Date) - $t0).TotalMilliseconds
  Require ((-not $w.ok) -and $w.timed_out -and $ms -ge 1400 -and $ms -lt 8000) 'wait-text for text that is not there times out correctly'
  $w = Vi $c.Pid @('wait-text', 'Loading game assets', '--gone', '--timeout', '3000')
  Require ($w.ok -and $w.gone) 'wait-text --gone succeeds once the text is absent'
  'PASS text'; $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
} finally { Stop-UiTarget $a; Stop-UiTarget $b; Stop-UiTarget $c }
```

`verify/run_tracetest.ps1`:

```ps1
param([string]$CliDir="$PSScriptRoot\..\dist",[string]$Out="$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\tracetest")
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$D=(Resolve-Path "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist").Path; $V=(Resolve-Path "$CliDir\vinput.exe").Path
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null; $Out=(Resolve-Path $Out).Path
if(-not ('ViTraceNative' -as [type])) { Add-Type 'using System; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; public static class ViTraceNative { [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool PostMessage(IntPtr h,uint m,IntPtr w,IntPtr l); }' }
$results=@()
foreach($name in @('vi_channelprobe.exe','vi_channelprobe32.exe')) {
  $p=$null
  try {
    $p=Start-Process -FilePath "$D\$name" -ArgumentList "`"$Out\$name.log`"" -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
    $r=& $V inject --pid $p.Id | ConvertFrom-Json; if(-not $r.ok){throw 'Injection failed'}
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 400
    $s=& $V --pid $p.Id status | ConvertFrom-Json
    $h=[IntPtr][long]::Parse($s.hwnd.Substring(2),[Globalization.NumberStyles]::HexNumber)
    [ViTraceNative]::PostMessage($h,0x8001,[IntPtr]::Zero,[IntPtr]::Zero) | Out-Null
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
    $before=& $V --pid $p.Id trace key esc | ConvertFrom-Json
    if(-not $before.ok){
      $results += [pscustomobject]@{target=$name;ok=$false;trace_supported=$false;reply=$before}
      $results | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 9 | Set-Content -LiteralPath "$Out\result.json"
      throw 'Trace unsupported (expected on baseline)'
    }
    & $V --pid $p.Id key esc 160 | Out-Null
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
    $notPolled=& $V --pid $p.Id trace key esc | ConvertFrom-Json
    if($notPolled.injected_down -le $before.injected_down -or $notPolled.message_down -le $before.message_down -or $notPolled.channels.RawInputData.down_reads -le $before.channels.RawInputData.down_reads -or $notPolled.channels.GetAsyncKeyState.down_reads -ne $before.channels.GetAsyncKeyState.down_reads){throw 'Delivered versus not-polled distinction failed'}
    [ViTraceNative]::PostMessage($h,0x8001,[IntPtr]1,[IntPtr]::Zero) | Out-Null
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
    & $V --pid $p.Id down esc | Out-Null
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150
    $polled=& $V --pid $p.Id trace key esc | ConvertFrom-Json
    foreach($channel in @('GetAsyncKeyState','GetKeyState','GetKeyboardState','DirectInputState','DirectInputBuffer','RawInputData')) {
      if($polled.channels.$channel.down_reads -le 0){throw "No positive API read on $channel"}
    }
    if(($polled.channels.GetAsyncKeyState.last -band 0x8000) -eq 0){throw 'Last GAKS value did not show held key'}
    & $V --pid $p.Id up esc | Out-Null
    & $V --pid $p.Id config fakefocus=false | Out-Null
    & $V --pid $p.Id down f | Out-Null
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150
    $noFocus=& $V --pid $p.Id trace key f | ConvertFrom-Json
    if(($noFocus.channels.GetAsyncKeyState.last -band 0x8000) -eq 0){throw 'fakefocus=false unexpectedly hid virtual GAKS'}
    & $V --pid $p.Id up f | Out-Null
    $results += [pscustomobject]@{target=$name;ok=$true;before=$before;delivered_not_polled=$notPolled;polled=$polled;fakefocus_false=$noFocus}
  } finally { if($p -and -not $p.HasExited){Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false} }
}
$results | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 9 | Set-Content -LiteralPath "$Out\result.json"
'PASS x64/x86 per-VK API observations, delivered-but-not-polled control, fakefocus=false'
```

`verify/run_xinputtest.ps1`:

```ps1
# XInput pad 0: a synthetic reader (test\vi_xinputtest.cpp) polls XInputGetState (and XInputGetStateEx with --ex)
# every ~2 ms and logs every change. For each case: record the baseline (before injection: no virtual state may appear),
# inject, then drive `vinput pad` and require the exact buttons / triggers / sticks to arrive and to be released.
# Targets are background windows started and stopped by this script (by PID).
# -Vinput runs the same checks with another vinput.exe (negative control against an older build).
param([string]$Out = "$PSScriptRoot\..\build\test\xinputtest", [string[]]$Only = @(), [string]$Vinput = '', [switch]$KeepGoing)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$D = (Resolve-Path "$PSScriptRoot\..\dist").Path; $V = if ($Vinput) { $Vinput } else { "$D\vinput.exe" }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null; $Out = (Resolve-Path $Out).Path
$log = "$Out\xinputtest_log.txt"; Set-Content -LiteralPath $log -Value ''
function Note($m) { ("{0:HH:mm:ss.fff} {1}" -f (Get-Date), $m) | Tee-Object -Append $log }
$script:fails = 0
function Require($c, $d) { if (-not $c) { if ($KeepGoing) { $script:fails++; Note "FAIL $d"; return }; throw "FAIL $d" }; Note "PASS $d" }
function Cmd([int]$TargetPid, [string[]]$C) { return (& $V --pid $TargetPid @C | ConvertFrom-Json) }
function States([string]$file) {
  $rx = '^(\d\d):(\d\d):(\d\d)\.(\d{3}) STATE src=(\w+) rc=(\d+) pkt=(\d+) b=0x([0-9A-F]{4}) lt=(\d+) rt=(\d+) lx=(-?\d+) ly=(-?\d+) rx=(-?\d+) ry=(-?\d+)'
  $i = 0
  foreach ($l in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $file)) {
    $m = [regex]::Match($l, $rx)
    if ($m.Success) {
      $g = $m.Groups
      [pscustomobject]@{ idx = $i; ms = ((([int]$g[1].Value * 60 + [int]$g[2].Value) * 60 + [int]$g[3].Value) * 1000 + [int]$g[4].Value)
        src = $g[5].Value; rc = [int]$g[6].Value; b = [Convert]::ToInt32($g[8].Value, 16); lt = [int]$g[9].Value; rt = [int]$g[10].Value
        lx = [int]$g[11].Value; ly = [int]$g[12].Value; rxv = [int]$g[13].Value; ry = [int]$g[14].Value }
      $i++
    }
  }
}
function Since([string]$file, [int]$from, [string]$src = 'std') { @(States $file | Where-Object { $_.idx -ge $from -and $_.src -eq $src }) }
function Count([string]$file) { @(States $file).Count }

$cases = @(
  @{ n='xinput1_4_ex_x64'; exe='vi_xinputtest.exe';   a='--dll xinput1_4.dll --ex' },
  @{ n='xinput9_1_0_x64';  exe='vi_xinputtest.exe';   a='--dll xinput9_1_0.dll' },
  @{ n='xinput1_4_ex_x86'; exe='vi_xinputtest32.exe'; a='--dll xinput1_4.dll --ex' }
)
if ($Only.Count) { $cases = $cases | Where-Object { $Only -contains $_.n } }
$owned = @()
try {
  foreach ($c in $cases) {
    $tl = "$Out\$($c.n)_target.log"
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tl -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue   # a stale log from the last run reads as this run's
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath "$D\$($c.exe)" -ArgumentList "`"$tl`" -28000 600 320 200 $($c.a)" -PassThru
    $owned += $p
    # the first XInputGetState can take seconds (device enumeration), measured >2 s right after the GPU suites
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 160 -and -not ((Test-Path $tl) -and (Count $tl) -ge 1); $i++) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50 }
    $base = @(States $tl)[0]
    Require ($null -ne $base) "$($c.n) reader started (baseline rc=$($base.rc), b=0x$('{0:X4}' -f $base.b))"
    $realPad = $base.rc -eq 0
    Note "$($c.n) INFO baseline: $(if ($realPad) { 'a real pad 0 is connected' } else { 'no real pad 0 (rc=' + $base.rc + ' = ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED)' })"
    $pre0 = Count $tl
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300
    $pre = Count $tl
    Require ($pre -eq $pre0 -or $realPad) "$($c.n) control: no state change before injection ($pre0 -> $pre state lines)"
    $r = & $V inject --pid $p.Id | ConvertFrom-Json
    Require $r.ok "$($c.n) inject"
    $s = $null
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 40; $i++) { $s = Cmd $p.Id @('status'); if ($s.counters.xinput -gt 0) { break }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 }
    Require ($s.counters.xinput -gt 0) "$($c.n) vinput sees the reader's XInput calls ($($s.counters.xinput))"

    # 1. buttons: press and auto-release
    $from = Count $tl
    $k = Cmd $p.Id @('pad', 'a+b+lb', '300')
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
    $st = Since $tl $from
    $on = @($st | Where-Object { $_.rc -eq 0 -and $_.b -eq 0x3100 })
    $off = @($st | Where-Object { $on.Count -and $_.idx -gt $on[0].idx -and ($_.b -band 0x3100) -eq 0 })
    Require ($k.ok -and $k.buttons -eq 0x3100 -and $on.Count -ge 1 -and $off.Count -ge 1) "$($c.n) pad a+b+lb: reader saw b=0x3100 then release (xinput_calls=$($k.xinput_calls))"
    Require ((($off[0].ms - $on[0].ms) -ge 250) -and (($off[0].ms - $on[0].ms) -le 600)) "$($c.n) held for the requested 300 ms (seen $($off[0].ms - $on[0].ms) ms)"

    # 2. every axis, including negative extremes and small values
    $from = Count $tl
    $k = Cmd $p.Id @('pad', '--lx', '-32768', '--ly', '32767', '--rx', '12345', '--ry', '-1', '--lt', '255', '--rt', '1', '300')
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
    $hit = @(Since $tl $from | Where-Object { $_.lx -eq -32768 -and $_.ly -eq 32767 -and $_.rxv -eq 12345 -and $_.ry -eq -1 -and $_.lt -eq 255 -and $_.rt -eq 1 -and $_.b -eq 0 })
    Require ($k.ok -and $k.axes_set_mask -eq 63 -and -not $k.clamped -and $hit.Count -ge 1) "$($c.n) sticks/triggers arrive exactly (lx -32768, ly 32767, rx 12345, ry -1, lt 255, rt 1)"
    $last = @(States $tl)[-1]
    Require ($last.lx -eq 0 -and $last.lt -eq 0) "$($c.n) axes released after the duration"

    # 3. out-of-range values are clamped, not wrapped (40000 used to become -25536)
    $from = Count $tl
    $k = Cmd $p.Id @('pad', '--lx', '40000', '--ry', '-40000', '--lt', '300', '200')
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
    $hit = @(Since $tl $from | Where-Object { $_.lx -eq 32767 -and $_.ry -eq -32768 -and $_.lt -eq 255 })
    Require ($k.ok -and $k.clamped -and $hit.Count -ge 1) "$($c.n) out-of-range values clamped (lx 40000->32767, ry -40000->-32768, lt 300->255)"

    # 4. a lone number after options is the duration ("pad --lx 20000 600" used to send buttons='600' and hold 100 ms)
    $from = Count $tl
    $k = Cmd $p.Id @('pad', '--lx', '20000', '600')
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
    $st = Since $tl $from
    $on = @($st | Where-Object { $_.lx -eq 20000 }); $off = @($st | Where-Object { $on.Count -and $_.idx -gt $on[0].idx -and $_.lx -eq 0 })
    Require ($k.ok -and $on.Count -and $off.Count -and ($off[0].ms - $on[0].ms) -ge 500) "$($c.n) 'pad --lx 20000 600' held 600 ms (seen $(if ($on.Count -and $off.Count) { $off[0].ms - $on[0].ms } else { 'n/a' }) ms)"

    # 5. --hold keeps the state until 'pad off', which hands pad 0 back to the real device
    $from = Count $tl
    $k = Cmd $p.Id @('pad', 'x', '--hold')
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700
    $last = @(States $tl)[-1]
    Require ($k.ok -and $k.hold -and $last.b -eq 0x4000) "$($c.n) pad x --hold still held after 700 ms"
    $k = Cmd $p.Id @('pad', 'off')
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150
    $last = @(States $tl)[-1]
    Require ($k.ok -and $last.rc -eq $base.rc -and ($realPad -or $last.b -eq 0)) "$($c.n) pad off: reader back to the real device state (rc=$($last.rc), baseline rc=$($base.rc))"

    # 6. unknown button names are an error, not a silent no-op
    $k = Cmd $p.Id @('pad', 'dpadup', '100')
    Require (-not $k.ok -and $k.error -match 'unknown button') "$($c.n) unknown button name rejected: $($k.error)"

    # 7. Guide: only through XInputGetStateEx, never through the documented XInputGetState
    if ($c.a -match '--ex') {
      $from = Count $tl
      $k = Cmd $p.Id @('pad', 'guide+a', '300')
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
      $ex = @(Since $tl $from 'ex' | Where-Object { $_.b -eq 0x1400 })
      $std = @(Since $tl $from 'std' | Where-Object { $_.b -eq 0x1000 })
      $leak = @(Since $tl $from 'std' | Where-Object { $_.b -band 0x400 })
      Require ($k.ok -and $ex.Count -ge 1 -and $std.Count -ge 1 -and $leak.Count -eq 0) "$($c.n) guide+a: XInputGetStateEx b=0x1400, XInputGetState b=0x1000 (Guide hidden)"
      Cmd $p.Id @('pad', 'off') | Out-Null
    }
    $st2 = Cmd $p.Id @('status')
    $xh = @(($st2.hooks_ok -split ' ') | Where-Object { $_ -like 'XInput*' })
    Require ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($st2.hooks_failed) -and $xh.Count -ge 1) "$($c.n) XInput hooks installed ($($xh -join ', ')), none failed; reader calls counted: $($st2.counters.xinput)"
    Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false
  }
  if ($script:fails) { Note "FAIL xinput suite: $($script:fails) checks failed"; exit 1 }
  Note 'PASS xinput suite'
} finally {
  foreach ($p in $owned) { if (-not $p.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -Confirm:$false } }
  Note 'owned targets stopped by PID'
}

```

`verify/vi_patterncheck.ps1`:

```ps1
# Decodes a capture of the synthetic capture targets (test\vi_pattern.h) back into the frame counter and checks
# the 8 colour bars pixel-exactly. Dot-source it:  . .\vi_patterncheck.ps1 ; $r = Test-VinputPattern a.png
#   returns @{ ok; frame; bars_ok; bits_ok; w; h; detail }
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
function Test-VinputPattern([string]$Path, [int]$Tolerance = 2) {
  $bmp = [System.Drawing.Bitmap]::FromFile($Path)
  try {
    $w = $bmp.Width; $h = $bmp.Height
    $res = @{ ok = $false; frame = -1; bars_ok = $false; bits_ok = $false; w = $w; h = $h; detail = '' }
    if ($w -lt 512 -or $h -lt 40) { $res.detail = "too small ${w}x${h}"; return $res }
    $frame = [uint32]0; $bitsOk = $true
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 32; $i++) {
      $c = $bmp.GetPixel($i * 16 + 8, 8)
      $v = ([int]$c.R + [int]$c.G + [int]$c.B) / 3
      if ($v -ge 255 - $Tolerance -and [Math]::Abs($c.R - $c.G) -le $Tolerance) { $frame = $frame -bor ([uint32]1 -shl (31 - $i)) }
      elseif ($v -gt $Tolerance) { $bitsOk = $false; $res.detail += "bit$i=($($c.R),$($c.G),$($c.B)) " }
    }
    $bars = @(@(255,255,255),@(255,255,0),@(0,255,255),@(0,255,0),@(255,0,255),@(255,0,0),@(0,0,255),@(0,0,0))
    $barsOk = $true
    for ($b = 0; $b -lt 8; $b++) {
      $x = [int](($b + 0.5) * $w / 8); $y = [int](16 + ($h - 16) / 2)
      $c = $bmp.GetPixel($x, $y); $e = $bars[$b]
      if ([Math]::Abs($c.R - $e[0]) -gt $Tolerance -or [Math]::Abs($c.G - $e[1]) -gt $Tolerance -or [Math]::Abs($c.B - $e[2]) -gt $Tolerance) {
        $barsOk = $false; $res.detail += "bar$b=($($c.R),$($c.G),$($c.B)) want ($($e -join ',')) "
      }
    }
    $res.frame = [long]$frame; $res.bits_ok = $bitsOk; $res.bars_ok = $barsOk; $res.ok = $bitsOk -and $barsOk
    return $res
  } finally { $bmp.Dispose() }
}
```
